tei:div.tei:p: na 'grel yang gsal snang mdzod kyi zur rgyan ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ba/kau sbya spyi smo///ཿཿ ba baḥ77707657565 bsaḥmathamaḥ55 9khyil ཿ5ཿ

nga sa nga 'i ༄ sko ngenge sku ri nga ci ciX tsho'irdo cig ci cirahrī ci dro /tshog pa sa ༄ ñca tshe ci mi ri mi mi gciX ///tsho pa ci sgo/sa sa ༷: /ci sgyu mi ri3 'i lto/ bye du skye snashāmi /cho ’ suX ci snyi sum̐/lha sdu hāX ri cig ci cig ri ci ṭā/smi34 ste/ rdo cho ci ri ci ritsho zlo ༷ rdo ga cho ༷r+shaci ca rim — ri mi ṣā /ringe/'i ri ciX / tsā riX tsho ri 4༄riX 〉byi ci gi ri/ri44sgyu ci choX ri ri sna 'i /༷༷ snga ri0mi ca ri /cho ༷ sdiḥ43ci /trīḥ)ri ci ri ༄༄ཿri ཿru 4ri dro ——byā ga / —tsho'i ci swā 454 44 45 4 tsho ri ri r+sādro dzo kroḥ sgo ci ༄ rwa/rna ༷༷

4)do———— — 1) rme nga ༷pol ngazhe༄༄ 1 4) sde〉 nga ge ri rmen ma nya ༄snye sa ngaX /byu —1 thog )5 tsha ༷ ༷ 4 1 (4 3 45 77544snang ri nga ༅4 ) ge sna nga ne ma tsho1 nga~X rdzo ༷ ) sngar) ri—— ༷ res ya ru ཿ 45
༄ga/snyan 'grelayang gsal snang mdzodakyi zur rgyan ngag rigasna 'phula'agugs ba'i lcags zhes bya ba bzhugasago/sdong yon tan rgya mtsho/gas sngos shes rig nor bu'i slob gli

gsal bshad/snyan 'grel yang gsal snang mdzod kyi zur rgyan ngag rig sgyu 'phal 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba 'di ni bdag gis gangs ljongs shes rig nor bu'i slob gling gi 'dzin grwa snga phyi mang bo zhig la snyan ngag dpe khrid kyi gzugs brnyan tsam 'dzin khul byas tshe slob ma tshos blo la 'dzin bde ba'i ched du dka' gnas dag sgo sam ngos la bris pa rnams phyogs bsdu byas pa zhig yin/'di ni nyin re'i dpe khrid skabs blo thog nas thol byung gis 'bri khul byas pas mkhas pa dgyes pa'i legs bshad cig lta ci/tha na lung tshig ji bzhin ma yong sa dang sdeb sbyor mi legs sa/tshig sna bsdus drags pa sogs skyon gyi cha mang bo zhig yod nges pa ni gsang thabs med pa'i don dngos shig yin gshis/ 'di ltar dpar bsgrun 'grem spel byed 'dod cig ye nas skye ma myong /'on kyang da lo'i skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwar snyan 'grel yang gsal snang mdzod cung rgyas khrid byas pas/ kho tshor btab pa'i zin bris de nges par du dpar la 'khod rgyu yin tshul yang yang bshad cing / don gnyer can gzhan mang bo zhig gis kyang de lugs kyi re ba mang du bton pas/ glo bur du dpar la 'khod du mi 'jug thabs med lta bur gyur song /don gnyer can re 'gar phan cung zad cig thogs na bdag la'ang de las dga' ba dang yid tshim pa zhig ga na yod mod/spyir bdag ni skyes sbyangs

kyi yon tan shin tu phra ba'i dbul bo dbul rkyang zhig yin khar/bshes gnyen bka' drin can tshor deb chung 'di spyan 'bul tsam yang byed long ma byung bas/ nyes bshad kyi khur bo shin tu lci nges so snyam du nang sems la 'tshub cha lta bu zhig kyang 'gog med du skye 'ong mod/ ded pas ded na rgyal bo mgyogs pa'i dpe ltar kho tsho'i nan bskul gyi ngo bzlog ma thub pas/ 'dzin grwa snga phyi'i slob ma tsho'i lag tu yod pa'i zin bris re 'ga' phyogs bsdu lta bus (skabs la la'i zin bris lag tu'ang ma son)da lan slob gling nang khul gyi tshod lta'i dpe char dpar bsgrun byed du bcug pa yin/sngar gyi zin bris dngos la 'phri snon sogs gcig kyang ma byas par de ltar dpar na shar mar spel ba zhes pa'i khyad chos dang mkhas nyams shig thon srid mod/ gong du zhus pa bzhin bdag ni mdo rgyud rig gnas gang la'ang dpyad stobs ma rdzogs pa'i mi rang ga ba zhig yin pa dang / khyad par du skabs thog cig la blo la gang shar de nyid bstan bcos kyi lugs su spel rkyang byas tshe/ phyogs gcig nas bsam na rang nyid brtsam bya'i gzhung la do khur chung ba dang / rang gi skad char rang gis 'gan mi khur ba/gzhan klog pa bor brtsi bkur ma byas pa sogs kyi skyon cha'ang mi nyung ba zhig yod par bsam ste/ gang lcogs ci lcogs kyis zhu dag nan mo thengs gcig byed khul byas yod/ 'on kyang sne mi gsal ba'i bya ba'i brel zing khrod nas zhu dag byed pa'i dus tshod gza' 'khor gcig las ma byung bas da dung chad lhag nor skyon sogs

mang du mchis srid na/ gzur gnas mkhyen ldan rnams kyis dag bcos gang dgos nges par du gnang rgyu'i re ba zhus pa yin/khrid yul gyi dgos mkhor dmigs te snyan ngag gi sngon 'gro'i skabs mchan 'grel dang lo rgyus ngo sprod/ mkho che'i rigs cung rgyas par bshad pa sogs tshig tshogs la ma 'dzems par bris yod la/ le'u bar mtha' gnyis dang thun min gyi rgyan bcu bor gtso bor dogs gcod ci thub byas te mtshan 'grel sogs gzhan mang bo bkod med/ zin bris 'di gtso bo yang gsal snang mdzod la 'brel nas bris mod/ spyir snyan ngag le'u gsum ga'i dka' sbyind dang dogs gcod sogs cung cha tshang zhig yin zhes bshad ga ཿswā/ dpon rin po che rje btsun dmu dge bsam gtan rgya mtsho dpal bzang bos/rgyu med pa las 'bras bu med pa skyed pa'i byed rgyu'i rgyan gyi skabs su/ 'di lta bu sogs kyi skabs su dka' gnad gsal byed dgos sa mang mod/ dkyus su bris na gzhung nyog 'gro bas zur mchan zhig logs su 'bri 'dod do/ /zhes gsungs 'dug kyang zur mchan dngos su gnang ba'i las skal bzang bo de rang cag la ma ldan pas/zur rgyan nyung ngu 'dis khong rin po che'i thugs re'i cha gcig bskangs thub yod na stong gsum gser gyis bkang ba phran la thob pa'i spro dgas kyang 'gran mi thub pa zhig cis mi 'byung ste 'byung nges so//mjug mthar tshod lta'i dpe cha 'di dpar sgrun thad la

dngos shugs brgyud gsum nas rgyab skyor gnang ba'i skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa spyi dang /khyad par du ma bskul dang blangs kyis dpal 'byor gyi 'gro song yongs rdzogs phul ba'i mgo log gcig sgril khang sar jo nang dpal nges don theg mchog gling gi sprul ba'i sku bsam pa lhun 'grub/glog klad yig gtag pa rme grwa tshe ring bsam 'grub dang spun chung ldong blo bzang sbyin pa/dpar bsgrun khur len byas pa'i skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin rtsom sgrig pa sogs la'ang bka' drin che zhus pa lags/zhes sdong yon tan rgya mtshor 'bod pas deb chung 'di'i gsal bshad du bris so//

dkar chagasngon 'gro/ 1mchod brjod kyi mchan 'grel dang rig gnas bcu'i ngo bo sogs/ 26bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i sgo sogs/ 80sgo de dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos dngos/ 108snyan ngag gi lus sogs/ 108be'u gnyis la/don rgyan spyi bshad/ 1671 rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan/ 170na dpe rgyan/ 1743 gzugs can gyi rgyan/ 2①4 gsal byed kyi rgyan/ 2125 bskor ba'i rgyan/ 2156 'gog rgyan/ 2177 don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan/ 222

8 sdog pa can gyi rgyan/ 226( srid pa can gyi rgyan/ 23210 bsdus brjod kyi rgyan/ 23411 phul byung gi rgyan/ 23512 rab btags kyi rgyan/ 2slo13 rgyu'i rgyan/ 24514 phra mo'i rgyan/ 7315 cha'i rgyan/ 25816 rim pa can gyi rgyan/ 26117 dga' ba'i rgyan/ 26318 nyams ldan gyi rgyan/ 26519 gzi brjid can gyi rgyan/ 27320 rnam grangs brjod pa'i rgyan/ 27521 kun phan gyi rgyan/ 27722 rgya che ba'i rgyan/ 278 23 bsnyon dor gyi rgyan/ 28024sbyar ba'i rgyan/ 7425 khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan/ 29126 mtshungs brjod kyi rgyan/ 295

27 'gal ba'i rgyan/ 8728 skabs min bstod pa'i rgyan/ 7329 thol bstod kyi rgyan/ 3yo30 nges bstan gyi rgyan/ maḥ31 lhan cig brjod pa'i rgyan/ 31032 yongs brjes kyi rgyan/ 31333 shis brjod kyi rgyan/ 31434rab spel gyi rgyan/ 31635 dgongs pa can gyi rgyan/ 318le'u zhesasum la/sgra rgyan/ 322gab tshig gi rgyan 339skyon sel bcu/ 45le'u dang tho/le'u dang bo'i thun min gyi rgyan bcu sogs/ 333sbyar byangan 372yang gsal snang mdzod kyi sa bcad phyogs bsdus/ 374

sngon 'gro/ 'oga'agro/sa //bstan pa'i bdag po yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas//des gsungs chos dang de sgrub dge 'dun sde//skyabs gsum kun 'dus dngos brgyud bshes gnyen kun//dang mun sel ba'i 'od kyi gong bur bzhugs//'o ma'i chu gter 'gyur ba'i rlabs phreng rtser//zla gzhon gsar ba'i ye shes gzhon lus can//dbyangs can lha mo chos kun glu len mas//ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu la//mdo rgyud rig gnas gan mdzod la dbang ba'i//rgya bod mkhas pa'i bka' drin gzo phyir dngan/rang gzhan tshig rgyan rigs par goms phyir du//dka' gnas mdud grol las la spro bzhin 'jug/skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —1

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ngo mtshar bstan bcos lugs su brtsams pa med//ngag rig dbang bor mkho ba'i legs bshad med//gzhung don cha tshang 'grel ba'i khyad chos med//de'i phyir 'di ni reg zig than thun tsam//bdag ni byis pa'i nang gi'ang byis pa ste//dpyad stobs ral gri'i rno dpal shin tu zhan//ma rtogs log rtog 'khrul ba'i nyes bshad kun//gzur gnas dran dbang spyan sngar 'gyod pas 'chags//zhes sngon du 'gro ba'i sems don tshigs bcad du bsdebs te skabs don gang gleng bar bya ba ni/de yang ji skad du/ lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje'i zhal nas/thos bsam phyogs su ma lhung zhing //gzhung lugs gdams par shar ba yi//nyan pas rigs pa'i lam smra ba//de nyid la ni mkhas pa zer//zhes gsungs pa ltar/dbang bo rab dang phul dang gya nom pa can zhig yin na ni/ mdo rgyud rig gnas kyis bsdus pa'i shes bya'i gnas thams cad la thos bsam sgom gsum phyogs su ma lhung ba zhig byas te kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang la brtson dgos shing /de ltar brtson pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byas zin pa dag la ni thams cad —2 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

sngon 'gro/ mkhyen pa dang skyes bu dam pa/ nges don gyi mkhas pa zhes sogs kyi mtshan gsol 'os pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ / 'on kyang da lta ni snyigs ma lnga'i rang mtshang mtsho ltar brdol phyir skye bo phal cher ngang rgyud thung zhing rig pa'i gnas la brtson sems zhan pa/ don zab mo la dpyod pa'i blo stobs phra zhing rnam g.yeng la spro ba sogs kyis de lta'i mkhas pa'i go 'phang dam pa zhig la brtson rgyu ni shin tu nas kyang dka' bar mngon mod/ kha mig yar lta dang skud pa yar 'khel gyi dpe ltar/bod gangs can gyi ljongs su khyed cag gi 'dzin grwas (gangs ljongs shes rig nor bu'i slob gling gi skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin ga)mtshon pa'i gzhon skyes ya rabs mang bo zhig gis rnam dpyod kyi rta mchog rgod po thos brtson lcag gis skul bzhin rang rang gang la mos pa'i rig gzhung bye brag pa re la'ang 'bad pas 'jug bzhin pa ni ches cher bsngags pa'i 'os su che ba yin te/ mnyam med jo bo chen po'i zhal nas/ tshe ni yun thung shes bya'i rnam grangs mang //tshe yi tshad kyang ci tsam mi shes pas/ /ngang bas chu las 'o ma len pa ltar/ /rang gi 'dod pa dang du len par gyis/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na da thengs khyed cag gi 'dzin grwa'i skabs babs sbyang bya'i dgos mkho dang bstun te nges don mkhas pa'i dbang phyug gsum gyi thugs kyi nying khu las 'khrungs pa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos chen po yang gsal snang mdzod kyi gzhung la 'jug pa'i skal bzang mngon du shar ba ni rang gzhan dge slob kun gyi bsod nams dang bod rig pa'i dge mtshan phyogs dang dus su rgyas pa'i rgyu rkyen nyag gcig tu skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —3

ngag rig sgyu 'phul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/gzung bar rigs so zhes thog ma'i snyan skul zhig phul ba yin // snyan ngag me long ma las/ sngon gyi rgyal bo grags pa'i gzugs//ngag gi rang bzhin me long thob//de dag nye bar mi gnas kyang //rang nyid nyams pa med la stos//zhes gsungs pa ltar/snyan ngag ni sngon gyi lo rgyus gsal ba'i me long dang /khor yug gnyid las dkrog byed kyi cong sgra/mi'i rigs kyi mgrin tshab pa/dga' skyo chags snang mtshon pa'i dbyangs rta/'tsho ba'i rang mdangs nying bsdus kyis mtshon pa'i sgyu rtsal zhig yin phyir/rgyal khab dang mi rigs/sa gnas dang tshogs pa/ rgan gzhon dang pho mo/ grub mtha' dang sha mdog sogs la khyad par med par/ ngang ngam shugs kyis snyan ngag la dga' zhing snyan ngag sgyu rtsal gyis bzi ste/mkha' dbugs ji bzhin med thabs med pa'i rig tshan zhig tu gyur 'dug pa des snyan ngag ni tshe srog gi sgra dbyangs dang mi tshe'i grub cha/zungs khrag gi dwangs ma yin zhes snyan ngag pa re 'gas sdom tshig bzhag myong ba'ang phal cher don la gnas pa'i tshod du yod do// ཿ shar nub rgyal khab sogs gang yin yang lo rgyus sku 'gros dang mthun pa'i gna' bo'i snyan ngag ni/lha sgrung dang rtog botags 'ol tshod sogs kyi rnam pa shugs che la/mi'i blo stobs je rgyas su song ba dang bstun nas/gzhung lugs kyi rnam pa dang /gtan tshigs kyi rnam pa/sgyu rtsal gyi rnam pa sogs su 'phel rgyas chen po byung bas/—4 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

sngon 'gro/mkhas pa la las rtsom rig ni sems kyi zas dang steng gi khyab khongs su gtogs pa'i skad cha'i sgyu rtsal/ rgyal khab srung byed kyi dmag dpung dang lcags ri yin zhes bsngags pa'ang mdzad yod do/// bod la mtshon na rtsom rig (46) ces pa'i brda chad 'di dar nas yun ring ma 'gor yang brda chad 'di'i 'jug yul ni gna' snga mo'i dus nas ches cher dar ba'i mi rigs shig yin/rgya nag sogs kyis rtsom rig dang snyan gzhung / rtsom dang snyan ngag bcas la khyad par chen po yod par brjod pa ltar so sor go ba blangs na'ang chog mod/mkhas dbang dor zhi tshang gi snyan tshig rig pa'i shes bya gnad bsdus kyi bshad sbyar rtsom rig 'jug sgo las/snyan ngag ces pa'ang sgra dog 'jug gi dbang du byas na/rgya skad kyi (7)dnganadabyin ji'i skad du pho yum 'gre)du 'bod pa'i snyan tshig gi ming dang /sgra yangs 'jug gi dbang du byas na sgyu rtsal rtsom rig spyi'i ming du 'jug cing /snyan ngag me long zhes pa'i snyan ngag ni sgra yangs 'jug tu bkral na gzhung gi don dang shin tu 'byor bar sems so//zhes gsungs pa ltar du go na 'grig ste/sngon rang res rtsom dang snyan ngag gnyis/rtsom pa bo dang snyan ngag pa gnyis la khyad par de 'dra mi 'byed par snang ngon// bod yig gi tshig mdzod sogs mang bo zhig tu snyan ngag dang snyan dngags gnyis brda gsar rnying gi khyad par tsam las don skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —3

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/gcig yin par bshad mod/ tshig rgyan rig pa'i sgo 'byed las/'ga' zhig tu snyan ngag ces 'byung ba ni snyan ngag gi tshig sbyor bzang bo 'byung bar byed pa'i gzhung yin pa'i cha nas btags pa yin pas/ gzhung me long ma lta bu ni das 'phul can gyi snyan dngags dang / dpag bsam 'khri shing dang skyes rabs so bzhi ba sogs das 'phul med pa'i snyan ngag tu ba zhag na legs so/ / zhes gsungs/de'i phyir snyan ngag dang snyan ngag gi gzhung gnyis la yin min gyi mu bzhi yang 'jog srol yod do// ཿ snyan tshig rig pa'i shes bya gnad bsdus kyi bshad sbyar rtsom rig 'jug sgo las/ de yang rtsom rigs dang rtsom rig ces rig la sa mtha' yod med kyi 'bri lugs gnyis las snga ma sa mtha' can ni rtsom ma yin pa'i dngos po rnam par bcad cing rtsom gyi rigs sbyi ston par byed pa'i sgra yin la/ phyi ma sa mtha' med pa ni rtsom gyi chos nyid blo yul du snang ba'i don nam/ rtsom 'bri thabs kyi gzhung gi don yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar de gnyis la'ang go don so sor yod pa shes par bya'o// bod mi rigs ni shes rig ches cher dar zhing khyad par du rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi yang rtser son pa'i mi rigs shig yin gshis rtsom rig lo rgyus ches ngo mtshar zhing brjod kyis mi langs pa zhig yod mod/ mdor dril na ngag thog snyan ngag dang yig thog snyan ngag—6 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

sngon 'gro/gzhung lugs kyi rnam pa'i snyan ngag bcas dus rim chen po gsum brgyud myong / dang bo ni/ srid pa chags glu dang / srid pa'i ba chung bsha' glu/ rta glu/lug glu/glu dang shags/mdza' gzhas dang mgur glu/bon sgrung lde'u gsum/ gtam dpe/ge sar gyi sgrung sogs bod rigs mang tshogs kyi rgyun ring 'tsho ba'i phab rta las byung zhing ngag nas ngag tu brgyud yong ba rnams so// gnyis pa ni/thon mi'i yig phud dang / thon mi'i nga rgyal gyi glu/ mi la'i mgur 'bum/ sa skya'i legs bshad/jo bo'i bstod pa sum cu ba lta bu ste shin tu mang ngon/ gsum pa ni/ rgya gar nas bsgyur ba'i snyan ngag me long ma dang / de'i ram 'dregs lta bur slob dpon dpa' bo'i skyes rabs so bzhi ba dang /rgyal bo dge dbang gi dpag bsam 'khri shing /slob dpon bde byed bdag po'i lha las phul byung gi bstod pa/mtho btsun grub rje'i khyad par 'phags bstod sogs rgya gar gyi snyan ngag grags can mang bo bod rang skad du bsgyur zin pa rnams dang /bod rang gis brtsams pa'i snyan gzhung thog ma ste rin spungs pa ngag dbang 'jig rten grags pa'i mi 'jigs seng ge'i nga ro/rgyal dbang lnga ba ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i dbyangs can dgyes glu/ bod mkhas pa mi pham dge legs rnam rgyal gyi daṇ+ḍi'i dgongs rgyan/ 'brug khams sprul bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma'i rgyan gyi bstan bcos dbyangs can ngag gi rol mtsho/ 'ju mi pham pa'i dbyangs can dgyes pa'i rol mtsho bcas snyan gzhung grags can lnga sogs dang /de dag las 'khrungs shing ram 'degs su gyur ba'i rje rin po che'i bstod chen bzhi/zhang skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 7

ngag rig sgyu 'phul 'gugs pa'i lcags myu/ zhung ba chos dbang grags pa'i rgyal bo rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod dang /rgyal dbang drug pa chen mo'i tshangs mgur/ gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i chu shing bstan bcos/gis steng blo bzang dpal ldan gyi pho dzhai ṅgi /spya ñji don grub sogs rtsom rig phul byung bgrang las 'das pa nye rabs su'ang mkhas dbang dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyi tshig rgyan rig pa'i sgo 'byed dang / ngag rig smra ba'i khyu mchog bse tshang blo bzang dpal ldan gyi tshangs sras bzhad sgra/mkhas dbang tshe tan zhabs drung gi snyan ngag spyi don/snyigs dus kyi slob dpon thon mi gnyis pa rje dmu dge bsam gtan rgya mtsho'i snyan 'grel yang gsal snang mdzod bcas snyan gzhung grags can bzhi sogs dang /lhug rtsom/ sgrung rtsom/snyan rtsom sogs gzhan la ngo gnong mi dgos pa'i tshod du yod kyang/de dag 'ga' re'i gzhung lugs da dung byung thub med/glog brnyan rtsom rig dang /zlos gar rtsom rig sogs ni da dung skas rim dang bo'i tshad tsam du yod do snyam mo//yang na dus rim gyi cha nas gna' rabs snyan ngag dang nye rabs snyan ngag deng rabs snyan ngag de dag la'ang rigs dang rnam pa du ma zhig phyes dang dbye bzhin 'dug go/ // snyan ngag me long ma las/rang bzhin gyis grub spobs pa dngan/mang du thos pa dri med dngan/mngon par sbyor ba mi dman pa//snyan ngag kun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu//zhes snyan ngag pa dam par 'gyur ba'i 8 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

sngon 'gro/rgyu gsum gsungs pa las/ gong du mdo tsam ngo sprad zin pa'i snyan gzhung dang snyan rtsom sogs gna' deng phyi nang gi mkhas pas brtsams pa'i rtsom rig skor gyi dpe cha gang mang zhig la sbyang ba dang blta klog nan tan byas te yod tshad sgyug rtse nas brdol thub pa'i rtsom pa bo dam par brtson rgyu ni shin tu gal chen po yin/'on kyang dus rabs khad kyis 'gyar zhing mi'i gshis spyod sogs kyang snyigs ma nas ches snyigs mar༄ spyar bas/ deng gi dus 'dir bod rigs gzhon skyes mang bo zhig zlor zing dang hol rgyugs kyi klong du phyin te/sto gos tsam gtso bo don du gnyer zhing gzhung lugs tshad ldan dang ring du gyes bzhin pa ni bod mi rigs nyams rgud kyi sna 'dren gtso bo zhig ste/lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje'i zhal nas/lto ba 'gong ba'i cho ga tsam//snying bor rlom pa'i bgyi ba la//'bad pas brtson pa lhur len pa//de dag phyugs dang khyad par ci//zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//de ltar na snyan ngag la sbyong mkhan zhig yin tshe snyan ngag dang skar rtsis la sbyong mkhan zhig yin na skar rtsis kyi skor sogs yongs su grags pa'i gzhung lugs tshad ldan dag la dpe klog dang zhib 'jug legs po byed pa ni shin tu gal che ba yin te/ 'jig rten khams kyi shes bya la brgyud nas shes thabs dang myong nas shes thabs gnyis yod pa las/lag rtsal sogs lus ngag gi sgyu rtsal mang bo zhig myong nas shes dgos so// de tsam gyis shes bya yongs rdzogs shes thabs med la 'gor 'gyang yang che bas/dus rabs dang sa gnas/mi rigs dang chos lugs/ rgan gzhon dang dbul phyug sogs kyis bkag rgya med skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga mi

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/pa'i sbyi'i /snas sdi blo gros kyi snying bcud dpe cha la blta rgyu ni shin tu gal 'a/ ma ma/na ṭā/ ma rje blo bzang grags pa'i zhal nas/ gzhung chen khu byug sgra ni nub gyur bas//bye'u sbrang ma'i dbyangs kyis sa 'di khyab/ /ces dang / 'jar man gyi rtsom pa bo grags can su'u pu nyer (1788—1860)gyi dpe klog dang dpe cha zhes pa las/ rtsom rig khrod du'ang dpe cha ngan pa grangs med cig rtswa ldum ltar skyes pas lo tog la gdod pa bzo bzhin yod/ de tsho ma gzhir dngul dang go gnas kyi ched du bris pa yin pas/ klog mkhan tsho'i dus tshod dang / sgor mo/sems shugs bcas chud zos su btang bas/ dpe cha legs po dang bya ba bzang bo don gnyer mi 'ong bar byas/des na phan pa med cing gnod pa shin tu che bar snang / spyi tsam nas bshad na mig sngar bcu cha'i dgu zin pa'i dpe cha ni ched du dngul sdud byed kyi dpe cha yin la/ dmigs yul de la rtsom pa bo dang dpyad brjod pa/ par bsgrun khe ba bcas tshang ma 'dzem med ngan sdeb byed bzhin 'dug ces dang / nga tshos dpe cha klog pa'i sngon du gdam gses med par mi klog pa'i rtsa don yid la 'dzin dgos/ zhes gsungs pa ltar dpe cha la'ang bzang ngan dang dgos mkho che min sogs sna tshogs shig yod pas thog mar brtag cing dpyad pa'i sgo nas 'jug na klog pa bor don du 'gyar ba yin/ 'o na dpe cha bzang ngan sogs la ci ltar brtag ce rno/ 1 rtsom pa bo'i lo rgyus la rgyus lon byed pa/ 2 dpe cha de rtsom pa'i tshe khungs btsun dang mkhas pa tshad ldan gyi gzhung —10 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

sngon 'gro/gang dag la blta klog byas yod med la brtag pa/ 3 sa bcad dang rab dbye/dkar chag ngo bo nges bstan sogs las gzhung gi spyi khog la blta ba dang rtsom pa bo'i blo rtsal dang rang gi dgos mkho dang 'tsham pa'i brjod don yod med la brtag pa/ 4sngon gyi dpe cha yin na rgyal blon gdan 'dzoms pa'i dbus su gzur gnas lo paṇa dag gis khas blangs min dang / deng rabs kyi dpe cha yin na dpe sgrun khang tshad ldan las dpe bsgrun byas min la brtag pa/ 5dpe cha de nyid dpar thengs dang dpar grangs mang min la brtag pa/6 gzur gnas klog pa bos gdengs 'jog mtho min la brtag pa/7 rang nyid kyi ched sbyong dang dga' phyogs kyi dpe cha yin min la brtag pa sogs dpyad thabs mang bo yod pas/ 'dam ga ma 'chug pa byas te rtsom rig skor gyi dpe cha tshad ldan ci mang zhig la zhib mjal byed pa shin tu gal che'o// bstan bcos gang zhig sbyangs kyang /ji skad du/rgyud 'di'i ming ni ci zhig bya//su yi don du 'di nyid mdzad//'di nyid mdzad po tshad ni ci//'di yi dgos pa'ang ci zhig yin//zhes gsungs pa ltar bstan bcos kyi mtshan don dang de gdul bya su'i ched du brtsams pa/rtsom pa bo'i lo rgyus/bstan bcos kyi bam grangs sam le'u/ sa bcad sogs ci tsam du bsdus tshul/ bstan bcos der sbyangs pa'i dgos chos bcas gleng bslangs pa rnam pa lnga bo ni nges par du shes dgos pa yin no// skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga —

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/༈ dang bo mtshan don ni/mdo sde dgongs 'grel gyi 'grel ba las/ gsung rab cagatogs pa thams cad kyi ming ni rnam pa bzhi ru 'gyur te/ yul dang / dpe dang / gang zag dang don la'o//zhes bstan bcos la mtshan 'dogs tshul gtso bo bzhi yod pa gsungs pa las/ dbyangs can zhal lung zhes sogs kyi ming 'di ni 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas btags pa ste dpe'i ming ngo // de ltar bstan bcos la ming btags pa'i dgos pa ni/ mdo lang gar gshegs pa las/ ming du gdags par ma mdzad na/ /'jig rten thams cad rmongs par 'gyur//de bas rmongs pa bsal ba'i phyir//mgon pos ming du btags par mdzad//ces gsungs pa ltar ming klad du smras pas btsal sla ba/ bstan bcos kyi dbu zhabs mi 'khrugs pa/ ming mthong bas don dran par 'gyur bas ming don gyi 'brel bar grub pa bcas dgos pa chen po gsum sogs dang ldan pa yin no//༈ gnyis pa gzhung 'di bu'i ched du mdzad ce na/mdo sngags rig gnas kyis bsdus pa'i gzhung lugs spyi dang khyad par du snyan ngag gi gzhung lugs dam pa'i me long la brten nas don ldan gyi snyan ngag par 'gyur 'dod pa dag gi ched du'o//༈ gsum pa rtsom pa bo'i lo rgyus/ skabs su babs pa'i khrid bya'i gzhung yang gsal snang mdzod 'di'i nang du bkod pa'i tshigs —/2 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

sngon 'gro/bcad sdom tshig dbyangs can zhal lung nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od can rtsom pa bo ni kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje yin la/le'u gsum ga'i dpe brjod phal che ba ni gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes mdzad/ sdom tshig gi 'bru 'grel yang gsal snang ba'i mdzod dang / rtsa bas dngos bstan dang rgya 'grel las kha snon mdzad pa mtshungs gsal gyi sgra re drug(cha la sogs pa bcu gcig gi dpe brjod rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa'i gsung yin)yon tan brjod pa bar gyi gsal byed dang rdzas brjod pa bar gyi gsal byed/ dbyangs sogs nges pa'i bya dka' ba bcu gnyis dang gab tshig gi rgyan/skyon sel bcas kyi dpe brjod sogs ni slob dpon chen mo rje btsun dmu dge bsam gtan rgya mtshos gsungs pa yin no//ཿ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje dpal bzang bo mchog ni rab drag sa byi ste spyi lo 1648 lor mdo smad kyi da lta'i kun su'u zhing chen gyi mdo lho khul bsang chu rdzong gi rgan gya smad du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bdun nas yi ge 'bri klog gi dbu btsugs/dgung lo bcu gsum par khyu mchog ye shes rgya mtsho las rab byung gi sdom pa bzhes shing mtshan la blo bzang rgyal mtshan du gsol/ rje de nyid las chos bka' mang du gsan/ dgung lo bcu drug nas sku chings mi bkrol bar dka' spyad dge sbyor la brtson pa sogs skyes bu dam pa'i rnam thar la ngang gis gzhol/ sngags bklag thabs dang sman rtsis sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung mang bor thugs gnyer skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzinagrwa ga 13

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/gnang /dgung lo nyer gcig par dbus 'gyur chos kyi zhing sa ru phebs te 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang du zhugs/yongs 'dzin khri chen rnam bzhis mtshon pa'i nges don mkhas pa'i dbang phyug du ma tshul bzhin du bsten nas mdo rgyud rig gnas kun la nang byan chud par sbyangs/ dgung lo nyer lnga bar gsang phur bka' bcu'i dam bca' dang de'i phyi lor chos khri ser bo'i dam bca' bzhag dgung grangs nyer bdun par rgyal dbang lnga ba chen mo las bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa zhus/mtshan la ngag dbang brtson 'grus su gsol/sngags kyi dam bca' chen mo bzhag rjes ri bo dge 'phel du byon te sgrub pa nyams len dang srad rgyud rdo rje 'chang dkon mchog yar 'phel sogs las zab chos mtha' yas pa gsan/ bka' rtsom mang du gnang /dgung lo nga gsum par 'bras spungs sgo mang mkhan por bzhugs te chos srid gnyis cha nas sngar sus kyang ma thon pa lta bur bskyangs/spyi lo 1707lor zur bzhugs kyis pha bong kha'i gdan sa bskyangs/dgung lo re gsum par phyir mdo smad du phebs shing de'i phyi lo ste spyi lo 1710 lor gdan sa chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil phyag 'debs mdzad/dgon lung du rgyud grwa btsugs pa sogs bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che 'ba' zhig bsgrubs mthar dgung grangs don bzhi ba ste spyi lo 1721 lor bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du sku gshegs/ gsung skyes bu slob dga' ldan gser khri rnam bzhi sogs grangs las 'das pa yod/mdo sngags rig gnas kyis bsdus pa'i gsung 'bum bod bco lnga bzhugs pa las/rgyal dbang lnga ba'i —14 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

sngon 'gro/dbyangs can dgyes glu'i dgongs don gzhir bzhag pa'i snyan ngag gi sdom tshig dbyangs can zhal lung nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od can 'di ni spyi lo 1683 lor brtsams pa yin no//༈ yang gsal snang mdzod nang gi dpe brjod phal cher gsung ba bo gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me mchog ni mdo smad kyi da lta'i mdo lho bsang chu rdzong gi mdzod dge smad du rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu rta (1762)lor sku 'khrungs shing / kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bos gung thang sku 'phreng gnyis pa ngag dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi yang sprul du ngos 'dzin gnang ste dgung lo bdurwa par bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du sku gong ma'i gser khrir mnga' gsol/kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i mdun nas dge bsnyen dang rab byung /dge tshul bcas kyi sdom pa dus gcig la bzhes shing mtshan la dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mer gsol/dgung grangs bcu bdun par bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos gyur zhugs te gzhung lugs rab 'byams la sbyangs/ lha ris dang rgya sog gi yi ge'ang byang chub par mdzad/ de nas dbus su phebs te 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang gi chos grwar zhugs/ hor skal bzang dngos grub sogs tshul bzhin bsten nas phar phyin dang dbu ma/mdzod 'dul sogs la byang chub par sbyangs pas 'dzin grwa gtug dang tshogs gleng / lha rams pa so so'i grwa skor dam bca' sogs skabs kun tu rje 'di'i mkhyen dpyod kyi grags snyan ches cher rgyas/ dgung lo nyi shu bar phar phyin dam bca' chen mo bzhag par dge bshes rgan gzhon bus kyang 'gran zla skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ — 3—

ngag rig sgyu 'phul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ma nus shing mkhyen rab kyi gting mi dpog par gyur/chos mtshams rnams su dgong re bzhin shog grangs brgya dang sum cu re ma chad pa byas nas skyor/ dgung grangs nyer gcig par gong sa brgyad pa'i mdun nas dge slong gi sdom pa zhus/ dgung grangs nyer lnga bar lha rams dam bca' bzhag par se 'bras dge gsum gyi dge bshes tshos mgrin dbyangs gcig gyar gyis/dus mtha' 'dir rje yab sras kyi gral du 'os pa'i mkhas (3na bzang 'dzoms kyi skyes chen dam pa 'di 'dra phebs pa skal ba bzang zhes bsngags brjod kyi rol mo bar med du bkrol/ lo der phyir bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs nas don gnyer can mang bor gzhung lugs rab 'byams kyi dpe khrid gnang ba'i dbu brtsams/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i mdun nas sgra dang sdeb sbyor/snyan ngag dang rtsis sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi skor dang dbang lung bka' chos sogs mtha' yas pa gsan/spyi lo 1791 lor tsha kho'i da tshang dgon gyi khrir bzhugs/lo der kun mkhyen bla ma'i bka' bzhin rnga yul sgo mang dgon gyi khri rabs dang bor phebs/ dgung grangs so gcig pa nas bkra shis 'khyil gyi khrir bzhugs te lo ngo bdun gyi ring chos thog rnams su brtsi bzhag chad med/gzhung lugs mang bo'i dpe khrid/bka' chos sogs 'chad nyan dmar ba kho nas dus 'da' bar mdzad/ de rjes dgon lung gi khri bskyangs pa dang kun mkhyen sku 'phreng gsum pa ngos 'dzin gnang ste yongs 'dzin du bzhugs pa/mchod rten mthong grol chen mo gsar bzhengs/ phyogs mtha' dag gi dgon sde dang ru sde —16 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

sngon 'gro/sogs don gnyer can rnams la mdo sngags rig gnas kyis bsdus pa'i zab khrid dang dbang lung man ngag gi chos char phabs pa/bsgrub bya stong phrag lhag tshangs spyod ngur sgrig gi dpal la bkod pa sogs gzhan phan gyi 'phrin las rlabs po ches dus 'da' bar mdzad/ dgung grangs zhe lnga ba nas gtso cher gdan sa rang dang ri khrod yid dga' chos 'dzin gnyis su bcad rgya'i tshul du bzhugs te spong ba bsam gtan gyi 'khor lor gzhol bar mdzad/ mdor na rje 'di ni mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi rgyan dang ldan zhing 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la 'dod dgur spyod pa'i nges don gyi rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' zhig ste/rgyal ba'i bka' dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i snying bo phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa lta bu'i gsung rtsom yang pod chen bcu gcig tsam bstan 'gro'i gsos sman du bstsal/ dgung grangs re gnyis pa rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i chu lug (1823)lor gzugs sku rags pa'i bkod pa bsdus tshul bstan pa sogs rgyas par khong gi thugs sras dbal mang paṇa ṭi ta dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i rgyal ba'i ring lugs pa chen po 'jam dbyangs bla ma dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me'i rnam par thar ba dad pa'i pad+mo bzhad pa'i nyin byed sogs las shes par bya'o//༈ 'bru 'grel yang gsal snang mdzod rtsom pa bo ni rang cag kha ba ri ba'i ljongs 'dir mdo sngags rig gnas rgya mtsho'i dgongs don rab 'byams smra ba la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i mkhas pa'i rgyal skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —17

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/thabs zin cing / bstan srid gnyis kyi khur mtha' dag yongs su 'degs bzod pa/ nges don gyi gangs ljongs thon mi gnyis pa 7rje btsun dmu dge bsam gtan rgya mtsho mi 'jigs dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros dpal bzang bo mchog lags te/ khong ni mdo smad rta'i chol kha'i lho rgyud/ deng skabs kyi si khron rnga ba khul zung chu rdzong gi khongs gtogs dmod dge'am dmu dge ru grags pa'i sar rong sde sog po ru zhes pa'i grong tsho der rab tshes shing stag(spyi lo1914)lor yab dge 'dun skyabs dang yum a tshe gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ chung ngu'i dus nas sku zhang bla ma rin po che dang yab kyi drung nas yi ge sbyor klog dang skyabs 'gro snang bshags sogs bslabs/ dgung lo bcu gcig par rab tu byung ste 'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa'i dngos slob tsha kho ngag dbang grags pas phyag btab pa'i chos sde chen po dmu dge bkra shis 'khor lo'i dgon du zhugs/ yig gzugs dang cho ga chos spyod/ bsdus grwa dang blo rtags/phar byin sogs la thos brtson gnad smin mdzad de 'dzin grwa'i skyor dpon yang gnang / dgung grangs nyi shu'i steng mdo smad bstan pa'i 'byung gnas bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du slob gnyer la phebs nas mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel sogs kyi rtsod zla rje dkon mchog bsam 'grub tshang dang / lnga rig smra ba oṃ 'khyil ba 'jam dbyangs legs bshad tshang / khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dngos a lags bla go rin po che sogs nges don mkhas pa'i dbang phyug du ma bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten te/ mdo sngags rig —18 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

sngon 'gro/gnas kun la gsan sbyong rdo rus thug pa lta bu gnang zhing 'dzin grwa'i skyor dpon gyi khur bzung ste lo ngo dgu'i ring la pha yul mig gis mthong ba tsam yang med par rdo rams dam bca' sogs dam bca' che phra dang tshogs gleng / 'dzin grwa gtug gang yod kyi bgro gleng rnams zhib chas zur phyin cing go bas gting phug par mdzad pas skabs de shed nas dbu dge bsam gtan zhes mkhas pa'i grags snyan gyis sa chen khyab pa byunganaskyabs mgon sku 'phreng lnga bas bla brang du gsar 'dzugs gnang ba'i slob grwa'i dge rgan du bzhugs shing khri chen gung thang drug pa chen pos khong gi drung chen mkhan po'i go ming bstsal/ dus kyi 'gyar ldog dang spyi tshogs kyi 'pho 'gyar rim gyis mtho sgang du mched zlo na/bla ma rnam pa'i bka'i gnang t+pa thob pa bzhin rdo khris dge bshes rje shes rab rgya mtsho mchog dang mnyam por pe cin du phebs te mi rigs don byed mu yon lhan khang nas phyag las cung tsam gnang rjes/skyabs mgon drug pa chen po'i bka' lung bzhin phyir rang yul du phebs te dmu dge dgon gyi dge rgan du bzhugs/ rig gnas gsar brje zhes gnam sa bla 'og bsgyur ba'i dus skabs su khong gis kyang blos mi dpog pa'i mnar gcod dang sku tshegs myong dgos byang bar ma zad gsung chos pod gnyis yod pa de yang gar song cha chod du gyar/rim gyis srid jus cung lhod yangs byang yang lo bcu'i god chad sogs kyis bod mi rigs kyi chos dang rir+sha gnas kun la nyams nyes chen po thebs pa thugs kyis ma bzod par/ brda sprod pa'i skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ — mi

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/bstan bcos blo gsal 'jug ngogs gsar rtsom gnang ste rnga ba dang /khyung mchu/ klu chu/ mdzod dge bzhag sdom sogs bod kyi sa gnas mang bo nas slob sbyong 'dzin grwa btsugs shing rig gnas dang 'brel ba'i chos kyi bag chags bzang bo dang mi rigs kyi la rgya sogs gzhon nu pho mo dpag tu med pa'i rgyud la bsgrun/kha cig gis mang tshogs dang thag je nyer gtong skad kyis gnad bsdus zhes bod kyi brda sprod gzhung du bsnyad btags pa'i log yig cig gang sar spel te gangs dkar sā la'i sman ljongs chen mo'i spyi skad rmang nas dkrags pa na spyi lo 1980lor pe cin du 'tshogs pa'i mi rigs grangs nyung skad yig tshan rig gros bsdur steng khong nyid ched phebs kyis nyin bcu gnyis la rtsod gleng bgyis mthar gnad bsdus ni log bshad cig yin par thag bcad nas slob dpon thon mi'i dgongs don rma med pa de nyid slar yang lag len du bstar thub pa byung ba'i sku drin gcig pu yang gzhal mtha' med pa'i tshod du yod/ gzhan yang lho nub mi rigs slob grwa chen mo dang /nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo/ pe cin mi rigs slob grwa chen mo/si khron zhing chen bod yig slob grwa sogs kyis gdan drangs pa bzhin slob grwa de dag la sgra dang snyan ngag skar rtsis dang lo rgyus sogs kyi 'chad khrid lan mang gnang / chos sde chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyis gtsos rnga yul sgo mang dgon dang a mchog mtshan nyid dgon/chab mdo dgon chen sogs sa gnas dang grub mtha' ris su ma mchis pa'i chos sde bgrang las 'das par mdo sngags rig gnas —20 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

sngon 'gro/skor gyi 'chad khrid dang / dbang lung man ngag spel ba/ dge tshul slong gi sdom pa 'bog pa sogs yang dar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rmang nas gso bar bla chen po dgongs pa rab gsal lta bu dang /mi rigs rig gnas dar spel la slob dpon thon mi lta bu'i phyag rjes gangs ljongs lo rgyus kyi rdo ring ngos su gsal ler bskos nas yod/spyir bstan 'gro'i gsos sman dang bye brag gdong dmar bod la legs skyes su bzhag pa'i gsung rtsom yang bod kyi lo rgyus kun dga'i me long dang / rje bla kho rin po che 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i rnam thar/bod du rig gnas dar tshul sogs lo rgyus kyi skor dang /byis pa'i dag yig dang mang yig 'bri ba'i re'u mig bod kyi yi ge'i spyi rnam blo gsal 'jug ngogs/brda sprod blo gsal dga' ston/sum rtags kyi 'grel rab gsal sgron me/ snyan 'grel yang gsal snang mdzod/ dbyangs can sgra mdo'i tshig 'grel zla ba'i 'od zer/dbyangs gsal gyi brda chad/byed mthun gyi nyi bla gza' 'dzin ri mo nag 'gros su bkod pa rigs ldan mchod pa'i me tog rigs ldan mchod pa'i 'od snang gi zur rgyan rin chen sgron me las chu mig klu mtsho'i re'u mig bsdus pa gza' nyi'i spyi nor sogs thun mong rig gnas kyi skor/shes bya'i rnam grangs blo gsal rigs sgo dang / shes bya'i rnam grangs blo gsal rigs mdzod/ kun mkhyen phar phyin mtha' dpyod kyi snyan ngag tshigs bcad rnams kyi tshig 'grel/ phar phyin skabs brgyad pa'i mtha' dpyod bsdus don chos mngon rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru gzings kyi tshig 'grel/ theg pa chen po rgyud bla skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga lha

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ma'i bstan bcos kyi tshig 'grel thub bstan yar rgyas sogs nang don rig pa'i skor/ 'jam dbyangs dkar bo dang dbyangs can ma sbrags pa'i bsgrub thabs sogs cho ga chos spyod kyi skor bcas khyon pod chen po drug lhag bzhugs/ de ltar rlabs chen 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad 'phrin nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i mkhas dbang khong gi dgung grangs brgyad cu bzhes pa rab gnas chu bya ste spyi lo 1993lo'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i tho rengs khar dmu dge bkra shis 'khor lo'i dgon du gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus pa'i tshul mdzad do// zhib rgyas rang gi byung ba brjod pa rang gsal ā dar sha las shes par bya'o//༈ bzhi ba gzhung tshad ni/ bod kyi snyan gzhung kun gyi phyi mor gyur ba snyan ngag me long ma la le'u gsum yod pa las le'u dang bor sho lo ka brgya dang lnga/ le'u gnyis par sho lo ka sum brgya dang re lnga/le'u gsum par sho lo ka brgya dang gya drug ste khyon sho lo ka drug brgya dang nga drug yod do//rgyan gyi cha nas le'u dang bor thun min gyi rgyan bcu (gtso che ba'i cha nas bshad pa ma gtogs thun mong gi rgyan yang yod)dang re re'i bzhed pa nang gses dang bcas par sum cu lhag le'u gnyis par don rgyan so lnga dang nang gses rgyan nyis brgya dang gsum tsam/(phyis kyi bod rang gi snyan gzhung dbyangs can dgyes glu sogs su yon tan brjod pa bar gyi gsal byed dang rdzas brjod pa bar gyi gsal byed/rab spel la gcig la gcig brten gyi rab spel dang stobs mtshungs rab spel gnyis/so lnga ba dgongs pa can la logs su dpe brjod 'jog pa bcas kyi dbang du byas na khyon —22 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

sngon 'gro/rgyan mi 'dra ba nyis brgya dang bdun tsam yod/〉le'u gsum pa sgra rgyan la khyon nang gses rgyan mi 'dra ba don brgyad tsam/ gab tshig gi rgyan bcu drug rtsa ba'i skyon sel bcu dang nang gses khyon bco lnga sogs yod do// kun mkhyen sdom tshig 'dir yang sngon 'gro dang bcas par khyon rab byed nyer lnga yod do//byu / lnga ba snyan gzhung 'di brtsams shing de la sbyong ba'i dgos pa dam pa ni/ bstan dar lha rams pa'i zhal nas/ rtsod la mkhas kyang rtsom la mi mkhas na//mkhas pa'i grags pa rang dang mnyam du shi//zhes dang / yi ge dag kyang snyan ngag mi ldan na//yid 'ong mdzes mas gos hrul gyon pa bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ngag rig dam pa'i sgyu rtsal la brten te rtsom pa bo'i sems don glu ru blangs pas bsngags 'os kyi phan bskyed phyogs sna tshogs nas thon phyir mkhas pa'i grags snyan kyang ji srid bar du gnas thub pa/ gos rgyan dang ldan pa'i mdzes mas 'dod ldan yid dbang 'gugs pa bzhin du klog pa bo'i bla srog dbang sdud kyi nus pa dang ldan pa sogs dgos pa du ma'i ched du yin no/ /༈ snyan 'grel yang gsal snang mdzod kyi thog ma'i mchod brjod kyi sho lo ka gcig la sum rkang bsgrigs yod pas dpar thengs dang bo dang gnyis pa sogs su de bzhin bkod yod kyang rjes su dpe sgrun khang re 'gas gang 'dod du blangs 'dug pa ni mi 'grig skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —23

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ste/ sdeb sbyor gyi sgo nas sum rkang bsgrigs pa ni bod kyi thun min khyad chos shig yin la slob dpon rin po che'i dgongs pa rma med pa'ang yin/ mkhas dbang dge chos kyis bod kyi sum rkang la thugs ma rangs pa'i gsung gnang yod mod/ rgya gar la med pas sam rgya nag la mi srid pa sogs kyis nga tshos gna' srol bzang bo dag 'dor ci thub byed pa ni thun min gzhung lugs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i mi rigs shig nyams pa'i snga ltas min nam snyam/ sum rkang ngam gsum sngags/ yang na sdeb sbyor gsum bid du grags pa de ni bstan bcos kyi 'go rgyan mchod brjod sogs su/ lañca/ wartu/ bod yig gsum gyis bris shing rgya gar ba'i sdeb sbyor gyi gzhung nas bstan pa bzhin lci yang bsdebs te sbyar ba la zer ro// spyir sdeb sbyor la dbyangs kyi yi ge bgrangs pa bṛta ta dang gsal byed kyi yi ge bgrangs pa dzā ti gnyis yod pa dang de dag gi lci yang sdeb tshul sogs sdeb sbyor gyi gzhung la sbyangs te shes dgos mod/ 'dir mdo tsam ngo sprad na/dbyangs can sgra mdo las/ pha rol tu yang dag par sbyor ba sogs med pa'i thung ngu ni yang ba'o//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ pha rol tu yi ge brtsegs ma dang / rnam bcad dang / nga ro can rnams med pa'i dbyangs thung ngu dang dbyangs thung ngu can rnams ni yang ba yin la/pha rol tu gsal byed dbyangs med ha lan ta'i mtshan ma can dang gsal byed brtsegs pa yod na de las tshu rol gyi yi ge lci ba dang /dbyangs ring cha dang 'greng bu rna ru can te ring bo rnams dang blu ta'i rtags can rnams ni gnas skabs thams cad du lci ba yin pa —24 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

sngon 'gro/dang / rnam bcad dang rjes su nga ro can rnams kyang lci ba yin no/ /yang na lci yang ngos 'dzin tshul tsam ni/ sa skya paṇa ṭi ta'i sdeb sbyor me tog chun po las/ ma gsum lci ba na gsum yang //bha thog lci ba ya thog yang / /dza dbus lci ba ra dbus yang / /sa mtha' lci ba ta mtha' yang //gsungs pa ltar sumarkang gi mgo'i sgokhyim gcig gi nang du yige gsumare yodapa las/sgokhyimagyi steng du mayig cigabakod yodatshe 'og gi yige gsumag lci ba'i yige yin pa dang /de bzhinan yig bkodayod na gsumagayang ba'iyigoyinapa sogasatshigazinaltar ro// bstar 'godatshulani/lci ba'i yiger ri mo'abyog po dngakayige yang ba lori modang bo zhiga'abrisrolayodab/ skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 25

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/mchod brjod kyi mchan 'grel dang rig gnas bcu'i ngo bo sogs/sho bka dang bo'i mchan 'grel/mthugs bskyedawa sems can gzhan gyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la dmigs shing /rang gi grogs rdzogs byang don gnyer gyi 'dun pa dang mtshungs ldan du spyar ba'i theg chen yid kyi rnam rig khyad par can de theg chen sermermi bskyed kyi mtshan nyid yin te/mngon rtogs rgyan las/sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir//yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod//ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro//de lta bu'i sems bskyed la grogs kyi sgo nas nyer gnyis sogs dbye sgo mang du yod kyang /ngo bo'i sgo nas rgyu byang chub tu smon pa sems bskyed dang/'bras bu byang chub tu 'jug pa sems bskyed gnyis su 'du'o//dang bo ni spyod pa nyams len gyis dngos su zin mi dgos pa'i sems bskyed dang /gnyis pa ni spyod pa nyams len gyis dngos su zin pa'i sems bskyed do//༈'dzin mgosa'i mngon brjod de bya dngos mtha' dag 'dzin pa'i ma'am rten sa'i gzhi yin pas so//—26 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

mchod brjod kyi mchan 'grel dang rig gnas bcu'i ngo bo sogs/༈ chogs gnyisawa chos gzugs kyi sku gnyis sgrub pa'i thabs su gyar ba'i dge ba dang /thabs shes ci rigs kyis bsdus pa ni tshogs skyo ngo bo yin la/de la bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis yod do//bsod nams kyi tshogs ni/sbyin pa gtong ba la sogs pa 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi gzugs sku sgrub byed kyi dkar bo dge ba'i las de yin zhing /phar phyin drug las/sbyin pa/tshul khrims/bzod pa gsum ni bsod nams kyi tshogs te/dbu ma 'jug pa las/sbyin sogs chos gsum de dag phal mo che//bde bar gshegs pas khyim pa rnams la bsngags//bsod nams zhes bya'i tshogs kyang de nyid de//sangs rgyas gzugs kyi bdag nyid sku yi rgyu//zhes gsungs/ye shes kyi tshogs ni stong nyid byang chub kyi sems kyis rtsis zin pa'i 'bras bu ye shes chos sku 'thob par byed pa'i zag med dge ba'i tshogs de yin/ phar phyin drug las bsam gtan dang shes rab gnyis ni ye shes kyi tshogs yin no//brtson 'grus ni tshogs gnyis kyi rgyu yin te/dbu ma 'jug par/yon tan ma lus brtson 'grus rjes 'gro zhing //bsod nams blo gros tshogs ni gnyis kyi rgyu//zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//sa wa kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i sa lam gyi rnam bzhag theg gsum mdzes rgyan las/sa'i mtshan nyid sra zhing 'thas pa yin la/sa'i byed las ni/rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba'i 'jig rten thams skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —27

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/cad skye zhing gnas pa'i rten byed pa'i phyir/ de ni 'byung ba bzhi'i nang tshan du gyur ba'i sa mtshan nyid pa yin la/ theg pa gsum gyi lam la sa zhes brjod pa ni/ sa btags pa ba yin zhing / de ltar 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan yang byed las chos mtshungs pa'i sgo nas so//zhes dang /rang gi 'bras bur gyur ba'i yon tan du ma'i gzhi rten byed pa'i lam zhugs kyi mngon rtogs de sa lam gnyis kyi nang tshan du gyar ba'i sa'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ nyan thos kyi sa/ rang rgyal rgyo sa/byang sems kyi sa dang gsum yod/ de gsum la sa zhes brjod pa ni/sas rtsi shing nags tshal la sogs pa'i rten byed pa bzhin du 'dis lam zhugs kyi yon tan du ma'i rten byed pas na de ltar du brjod pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs/ spyir sa'i tha snyad 'jug tshul du ma yod la mchog dman gyi sgo nas theg dman gyi sa dang theg chen gyi sa gnyis yod pa las/skabs 'dir phyi ma la go bar bya zhing / de yang stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab dang / snying rje chen pos zin pa'i byang 'phags kyi mkhyen pa de/ byang sems 'phags pa'i sa'i mtshan nyid/ der dbye na/ sa dang bo rab tu dga' ba/ gnyis pa dri ma med pa/ gsum pa 'od byed pa/ bzhi ba 'od 'phro ba/ lnga basbyang dka' ba/drug pa mngon du gyar ba/ bdun pa ring du song ba/ brgyad pa mi g.yo ba/ dgu ba legs rwa'i blo gros/ bcu ba chos kyi sprin rnams yod la so so'i go don sogs gzhung chen mo rnams las shes par bya'o//—28— skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

mchod brjod kyi mchan 'grel dang rig gnas bcu'i ngo bo sogs/ga lamawa was lam gyi rnam bzhag theg gsum mdzes rgyan las/rang 'bras byang chub tu bgrod pa'i go skabs phye shul du gyar ba'i lam zhugs kyi mkhyen pa de lam gyi mtshan nyid/ces dang /sdo la lam zhes brjod pa ni/thar ba'i go 'phang du bgrod par byed pa yin pas na de ltar brjod do//yang de la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/tshogs lam/sbyor lam/mthong lam/sgom lam/mi slob lam dang lnga yod/ces /sturdor+sha pa ltar te/theg gsum so so'i dbang du byas pa'i lam bco lha sa brtolawa dpag bsam ljon pa'i ming ste/dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'am ri rab lhun po'i sa brtol te skyes par grags pas so//shing 'di'i rtsa ba lha ma yin tu gnas shing gzhung shing mi yul na yod/rtse mo lha yul du gnas la 'bras bu rnams lhas longs spyod par byed/shing 'di las dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung bas yongs 'du dang phun tshogs 'phel/kha dog gser dang cha 'dra bas gser shing /lo ma shin tu che bas rnga yab can yang zer ro /༈ sku bzhi wasangs rgyas kyi ngo bo nyid sku dang /ye shes chos sku/longs sku sprul sku bcas so//skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —29

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/sho lo ka gnyis pa'i mchan 'grel// rgyal bawa bdud bzhi las rgyal bas na rgyal ba zhes bya ste sangs rgyas kyi mtshan no//bdud bzhi ni/nyon mongs pa'i bdud/'chi bdag gi bdud/phung bo'i bdud/lha'i bu'i bdud bcas so//༈ 'phrin lasawa rang rgyu sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje la brten nas byang ba'i rnam dkar gyi yon tan de sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las kyi mchen nyid/rgya gar bas 'phrin las kyi skad dod la kurma zhes zer te las kyi don no//sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'phrin las ni 'di dang 'di bya'o snyam pa'i rnam rtog dang 'bad rtsol cung zad kyang mi mnga' ba bzhin tu sku gsung thugs kyi 'phrin las mtha' yas pas gdul bya ji snyed pa'i don 'bad med lhun 'grub tu 'byung ste/rgyud bla ma las/gang zhig gang gis gdul bya yi//bya gang gang du gang gi tshe//de yi /spra sbyo/ n+dhe med phyir//thub pa rtag tu lhun gyis grub//ces gsungs lta brtan pa'i 'khor 'owa rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi mtshan te/las nyon gyi dbang gis rang dbang med par khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas su sdug bsngal ba'i 'gro ba sems can kun/sangs rgyas kyi lam yang dag par 'dren rgyu'i thugs stobs shin tu —30 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

mcho brjo kyi mcha 'grel nga ri sa bcu'i ngo bo so sabartan pos chos kyi 'khor lo bar mtshams med par bskor te bskal ba ji srid du gnas pas sam/yang na ngag gi rang bzhin brtan cing phyag zhabs la 'khor lo'i mtshan bzang dang ldan pas na brtan pa'i 'khor lo zhes bya'o/// mun tshogasawa skabs 'dir mun tshogs zhes pa ni 'khor ba'i rtsa ba ma rig pa la go dgos shing /chos gang rung la dmigs nas ma rtogs pa'i rnam pa can gyi sems byang de ma rig pa'i mtshan nyid yin/rig pa shes rab kyi mi mthun sdugs dang /shes pa gang zhig rang yul la dmigs pa'i tshe yul de'i rnam pa shin tu mi gsal ba/shes bya'i gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin ma shes par kun nyon skye ba'i sgor gyar ba bcas khyad chos gsum dang ldan pa zhig go//byang chub lam khrom chen mo las/ma rig pa ni/ bden bzhi dang /las 'bras dang /dkon mchog gi rang bzhin la blo mi gsal ba'i mi shes pa'i nyon mongs can no//zhes gsungs/ma rig pa'i dbang gis so so'i skye bo rnams kyis las dang nyon mongs sna tshogs pa bskyed de khams gsum gyi 'khor bar rang dbang med par 'khor bzhin yod pas/rje bla mas/'jig rten rgud pa ji snyed pa//de yi rtsa ba ma rig ste//zhes gsungs so//'di la bshad bya mang yang rgyas par gzhan nas shes par bya'o//skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —3/—

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/sho lo ka gsum pa'i mchan 'grel/ga zag med bde ba chen 'owa spyir nyon mongs dang ma 'dres pa'i bde ba la zag med kyi bde ba dang /nyon mongs dang 'dres pa'i bde ba ste 'jig rten gyi bde ba la zag bcas kyi bde ba zer/dmigs pa dang mtshungs ldan gang rung gi sgo nas nyon mongs rgyas su mi rung ba'i chos de zag med kyi mtshan nyid yin/skabs 'dir zag med bde ba chen po ni bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes la go dgos par gsungs so// ༈ brgyad khri bzhi stong chos sgra rgyud mang sgra las drangasawa 'di ni lha mo dbyangs can mas chos kyi phung bo brgyad khri bzhi stong bo rgyud mang ste pi wang gi sgra la drangs nas gsungs pa'i don no// spyir nyon mongs 'dul byed kyi gnyen por gsungs pa'i lung gi chos thams cad la chos kyi phung bo zhes bya ste/brjod bya rjod byed gnyis ka du ma spungs pa'i phung bor snang ba'i phyir ro//chos phung gcig gi tshad ni/mngon pa gong ma ltar na/tsheg bar so gnyis sho lo ka gcig de stong chos phung gcig gi tshad yin par gsungs la/mngon pa thog ma ltar na glang bo che sa srung gi bus theg tsam gyi snag tshas bris pa la chos phung gcig tu 'dod kyang /mdzod las/spyod pa rnams kyi gnyen por ni/ /chos kyi phung bo mthun par gsungs//ces gsungs pa ltar/spyir —32 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

mchod brjod kyi mchan 'grelodang rig gnas bcu'i ngo bo sogs/'dod chags sogs nyon mongs re re'i gnyen po'i bya ba yongs su rdzogs pa'i chos tshan re re gsungs pa la chos phung zhes bya ste/ grub mtha' chen mo las/ de yang nyon mongs kyi spyod pa sna re'i thog mtha' bar gsum gyi gnyen po cha tshang ba re bsdoms pas chos phung dang /de'i gnyen po dper na zhe snang shas cher spyad pa'i gnyen por thog mar byams pas de gzhil ba'i sgo gtod nas 'khrid pa la byams pa'i sgo btod par bshad pa lta bu'i tshul yin pas/ chos phung dang chos kyi sgo don 'dra la/ chos phung gi sgo gzhan rnams ni sgro btags pa yin/zhes gsungs/ grangs ni mdzod las/ chos kyi phung bo brgyad khri dag /gang rnams thub pas gsungs de dag /ces pa'i tshig don dang mthun par/ kha che bye brag smra ba la sogs pas chos phung brgyad khri las mi 'dod kyang sde ba kha cig gis brgyad khri bzhi stong du 'dod pa'ang yod par gsungs la/ theg chen pa rnams ni /gang rnams thub pas chos de dag /brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa las//zhes pa ltar khas len te/ grub mtha' chen mo las/ grangs kyang brgyad khri las mi 'dod pa sogs byang yang / mdo las/ chos kyi phung bo brgyad khri bzhi stong zhes re marngo 'byang la/ nyon mongs kyi spyod pa re'i gnyen po ston dgos pa'i phyir ༄rgyad khri bzhi stong ngam stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhir nges te/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro//rgyud mang la sngon gyi yig rnying mang bo dang khyad par du bod mkhas pas sa mtha' bzhag yod kyang rgyal dbang lnga ba'i gsung na skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 33

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/med/'di la dus kyi khyad par yang med pas sa mtha' ma bzhag na zigs zhes bshes gnyen rin po che khong rang nyid kyi zhal las thos ༈ mgrin pa'i rtsa mdud grolawa sngags lugs su spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo/mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo/snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo/ste ba sprul ba'i 'khor lo/gsang gnas bde skyong gi 'khor lo zhes lus kyi rtsa gnad chen po lnga gsungs pa las/mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa mdud sgom stobs kyis grol ba na gang shar rdo rje'i glu ru len pa zhes pa'i yon tan la mnga' brnyes par 'gyur zhes gsungs so//༈ mtsho ldan mawa dbyangs can ma'i mtshan te/phyi rol rig byed kyi gtam rgyud du/tshangs pa'i blo'i g.yo ba las sto phyogs 'o ma'i mtsho ru dbyangs can ma 'khrungs pas/mtsho byung ma dang /mtsho skyes/mtsho ldan ma/tshangs pa'i bu mo/tshangs dbyangs lha mo sogs mtshan gyi rnam grangs mang bo zhig rgyu mtshan de la brten nas byung ngo //34 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

mchod brjod kyi mchan 'grel dang rig gnas bcu'i ngo bo sogs/sho lo ka bzhi ba'i mchan 'greg༈ dala' bo snyan ngag pa slob dpon dpa' bo ni rgya gar nub phyogs su 'khrungs pa'i mkhas pa chen po zhig ste/ yab kyi mtshan la seng ge gsang ba dngag yum gyi mtshan la rig 'dzin dngos grub zhu/khong ni bram ze tshe'i rig 'dzin gyi rigs rgyud yin gshis/ thog mar phyi rol bar zhugs te mkhas pa chen por gyur rjes shar phyogs nang ba ba mang bo rtsod pa'i sgo nas phyi rol bar bsgyur/ phyis lho phyogs su phebs tshe 'phags pa lha ste ar+ya de bas rtsod pas pham par mdzad de nang bar zhugs shing dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi slob mar gyur/ mtshan gyi rnam grangs la/ mu stegs thub dka' nag po/ rta dbyangs/ pha khol/ ma khol/ chos ldan rab 'byor/ dkon mchog 'bangs sogs su 'bod/ rgya gar shar ba'i lugs kyi rtsom gshis 'dzin pa'i (lho ba'i lugs 'dzin par bzhed mkhan yang yod)mkhas pa chen po zhig yin 'dug lam rim bla brgyud sogs su slob dpon dpa' bo rdo rje zhes 'byung ba de dang mi 'dra ba shes dgos so// ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang de'i bstan par skyon chen po brjod pa'i 'gyod bshags lta bur skyes rabs so bzhi ba zhes snyan ngag grags can de brtsams kyang mjug ma rdzogs par rtsom 'phror lus/ skyes rabs so bzhi ba ni bod kyi mkhas pa mang bos ches cher bsngags brjod byed sa'i snyan ngag cig yin la/ btsan po khri srong lde skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —35

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/btsan gyi dus su lo tsā ba dbas 'jam dpal go chas bod skad du bsgyur/sho lo ka sum stong drug brgya ste bam po bcu gnyis yod/de'i 'grel ba rgya gar gyi slob dpon chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa zhig dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i 'gor lo tsā ba shākya blo gros kyis bsgyur ba dang bcas bstan 'gyur khrod du bzhugs/ bod kyi mkhas pas mdzad pa la'ang kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i skyes rabs so bzhi ba'i 'grel ba mkhas pa'i mgrin rgyan sogs mang ngon/ga rgyal tho dge dbangawa rgya gar lho phyogs su chos rgyal gyi rgyud du 'khrungs pa'i mkhas pa chen po rgyal bo dge ba'i dbang bo mchog ni rtsom gshis 'jam zhing kha gsal ba'i rgya gar gyi snyan ngag pa grags can zhig ste/grogs dga' ba'i grags pa dang na ga gnyis kyis bskul zhing / bcom ldan 'das mnal lam du byon pa sogs kyis bdag cag gi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs kyi skyes rabs la sbyar ba'i dpag bsam 'khri shing zhes pa'i bstan bcos chen mo le'u brgya dang bdun gyi bdag nyid can rtsa 'grel dang bcas pa brtsams/bkra shis grangs nges kyi phyir le'u brgya dang brgyad pa rgyal bu sprin gyi bzhon pa'i rtogs brjod ces pa rang gi bu zla ba'i dbang bor brtsam du bcug dpag bsam 'khri shing la/brjod bya don dang 'brel bas rtogs sla ba/rjod byed rgyan dang 'brel bas rna bar snyan pa/tshig sdeb sbyor dang 'brel bas gcod mtshams byed pa/ming mngon brjod dang 'brel bas ngo mtshar —36 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

mcho brjo kyi mchan 'grel dang rig gnas bcu'i ngo bo sogs/che ba bcas khyad chos bzhi dang ldan par gsungs so//phyis su lo tsā ba shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis dpag bsam 'khri shing rtsa 'grel dang bcas pa bod skad du bsgyur zhing rang re'i sngon byon mkhas pa tshos de ni ches snyan ngag grags can zhig tu brtsi la/ rtsom gshis 'dis shugs rkyen thebs pa'i bod kyi rtsom pa bo'ang ches mang bo zhig byang ngo //rje klong rdol bla ma ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i zhal nas/sdu gar na slob dpon dpa' bo'i skyes rabs so bzhi ba lta bu ni/snyan ngag gi nyams 'don lugs kyis go sla ba be+e dar bha'i lugs dang /rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing lta bu ni snyan ngag gi nyams 'don lugs kyis go dka' ba gi ḍa ba'i lugs yin zhes rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtsho'i zhal las thos so//zhes gsungs la snyan gzhung re 'gar yang de ltar bkod 'dug kyang bshes gnyen rin po ches ni go dka' sla'i khyad chos de ldog nas gsungs par ma zad gzhan gyi bzhed tshul la dgag gzhag gnang ba'ang dngos su thos la/dpag bsam 'khri shing gi par byang smon tshig tu'ang sa sgrengs a chi thu ho thog thu sku 'phreng lnga ba mchog gis dpag bsam 'khri shing ni lho phyogs pa'i lam gcig po la drangs pa'i tshigs bcad snyan ngag cig yin par gsungs pas da dung dpyad pa'i gnas so/// rmong dpon daṇ+ḍiwa daṇ+ḍi ni dbyag pa'i ming yin/phyag tu phyi rol ba'i cha byad bram ze'i dbya gu zhi'o thogs pas mtshan la'ang slob dpon daṇ+ḍi ste slob dporno dbyug pa can zhes bya/ khong ni skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —37

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/rab byung gsum pa'i byed phyi ma ste dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i smad/spyi lo1150 ———1200 (tshig rgyan rig pa'i sgo 'byed dang deb dkar sogs gzhung mang bor srong btsan sgam po dang dus mnyam par bshad kyang 'dir ni mkhas dbang dge chos kyi gsung sgros snyan ngag spyi don du bkod pa'i lo tshigs gzhir bzhag pa'o)yas mas su rjes khrid kyi sgra sbyor ba la 'gran zla dang bral ba'i snyan ngag pa bha ra slu'am mo dar bya ba'i rgyud du 'khrungs pa'i mkhas pa chen po zhig ste/ yab kyi mtshan la bi ra darka dang yum gyi mtshan la go ri zer/ chung dus nas dwa phrug tu gyur zhing yul 'khrug gi rkyen gyis nags khrod du yun ring bsnad de mkhas pa du ma'i mdun sar rig gzhung mang bor mkhas par sbyangs/ rjes su rgyal bo pā la ba'i blon por gyar cing rgyal bo pu la ke sha zhes pa'i bu dag gi ched du snyan ngag me༄ long ma dang gzhan pa'i bstan bcos gnyis bcas khyon 'jig rten na grags pa'i gzhung gsum brtsams zer/ rgya gar na snyan ngag pa grags can bzhi byung ba las snyan pa'i ro 'don pa la mchog tu gyur ba ni slob dpon dbyug pa can yin par bshad/ dbyug pa can gyi lo rgyus gzhan dang gzhan na'ang ches mang bas 'dir rgyas 'god mi byed do// khong gis mdzad pa'i snyan ngag me long ma de nyid lo tsā ba chen po shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan mchog gis bod skad du bsgyur ba nas rang re la snyan ngag gi gzhung lugs yod par gyur ba ni bsnyon du med la/ sngon byon mkhas pa phal mo ches me long ma 'di nyid grub mtha' ris med dang chos lugs pa yin min gnyis kyis sbyong 'os —38 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

mchod brjod kyi mchan 'grel dang rig gnas bcu'i ngo bo sogs/shing snyan ngag tsam ma yin par bstan bcos spyi'i rtsom lugs kyi rnam bzhag kyang gtan la dbab byed kyi gzhung lugs ngo mtshar ba zhig tu 'dod par snang ngo // 'on kyang deng rabs snyan ngag pa dang dpyad brjod par rlom pa re 'gas me long ma ni rnying drags pa'i gna' rdzas shig ste/ lus rgyan skyon sel sogs gang gi cha nas bltas kyang deng rabs kyi rig gzhung gi mdzub khrid mi nus pa sogs mang du brjod la/ chos lugs pa re 'gas me long ma ni 'jig rten khyim pas sbyang bya zhig yin tshul sogs mang du smra'o/ / phran gyis bsam na me long ma bod skad du ma bsgyur yar sngon nas bod la snyan ngag ches phun sum tshogs pa dar mod/ me long ma bod skad du bsgyur ba nas gzhung lugs rang bzhin gyi mdzub ston bla na med pa gnang bar ma zad bod la sngar med kyi rgyan ches mang bo zhig kyang kha snon gnang 'dug pa dang /sum cu ba'i rtsa bar/ de bzhin yi ge'i 'jug tshul rnams//smra ba kun la gnas gyur kyang //rang tshul de nyid mi shes pas//don la sbyor ba ga la shes/ /gsungs pa ltar bod rang la rgyun 'byams su gyur ba'i sngar yod kyi rgyan mang bo zhig kyang ma ngo bu ngo 'phrod pa ltar gsar du nges pa rnyed par gyur/ lhag par du bod 'gyur gyi snyan ngag me long ma de khrid thabs dang bzhed tshul sogs phyogs mang bo zhig nas bod rang gi rig gzhung zhig tu gyar la/ snyan ngag me long ma'i rtsom stangs sogs kyis bsam blo'i cha rnos bkag rgya ci yang bzo mi srid pa ma zad rgyan gang yin yang ji srid rtsom rig gi gzi dpal ma nyams pa de srid du dus dang gnas skabs gang du'ang skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —39

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/sbyor rung bas gna' rdzas bsham ston khang du bskyel dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan rnam dag sus kyang brjod du med pa zhig go snyam/khyad par du me long ma ni snyan ngag gi gzhung lugs dang / bstan bcos spyi'i rtsom tshul gyi gzhung lugs/ rtsom lus mang 'dus kyi gzhung lugs/ tshig rgyan rig pa'i gzhung lugs sogs khyad chos du mas phyug pa'i gzhung zhig yin/ 'on kyang a pha'i phor ba gtsang zhen gyis me long ma'i brjod bya rjod byed gnyis cha skyon bral yon tan gyi gong bu 'ba' zhig red ces bshad pa min te/ de ltar brjod thabs kyang med par 'dug lhag par du bod 'gyur gyi snyan ngag me long ma la mtshon na/le'u dang bo'i shar lho'i bzhed pa thun min skabs kyi yi ge 'jam rtsub dang lci yang gi rnam bzhag le'u gnyis pa'i sbyar rgyan phal mo che/le'u gsum pa'i kun tu zung ldan dang bzlog pa'i zung ldan/dbyangs sogs nges pa'i bya dka' ba las dbyangs kyi grangs dang yi ge'i skye gnas/ skyon sel bcu las dgu ba mtshams sbyor nyams pa sogs mang bo zhig bod kyi brda sprod gzhung lugs dang mi mthun pa dang / mdzes dpyod kyi lta ba dang yul srol goms gshis mi gcig pa'i dbang gis sha gzug za rkyang ma yin pa'i cha mang du yod pa yang don dngos shig sgo/de'i phyir sa skya paṇa chen gyi zhal nas/ yon tan kun ldan dkon pa ltar//yon tan ci yang med pa'ang dkon/ /skyon dang yon tan 'dres pa las//yon tan gtso che mkhas pas bsten//gsungs pa ltar 'dor len ma 'chug pa byed pa dang / yi ge'i skye gnas dang 'jam rtsub sogs bod rang gi brda sprod dang mthun pas —40 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

mchod brjod kyi mchan 'grel dang rig gnas bcu'i ngo bo sogs/gsos 'debs byas na me long mas sngar las lhag par bod kyi rtsom rig 'phel rgyas la gzhog 'degs bla na med pa byed thub par ma zad/ming don mtshungs pa'i bod kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i bod 'gyar gyi snyan ngag me long ma zhig tu'ang 'gyar nges pa yin no snyam/ stogazhan snyan ngag me long ma khyim rā kho nas sbyang bya zhig yin min /gas slob thun rjes ma dag tu rim bzhin gsal 'debs byed chog mchod brjod sho lo ka lnga ba'i mchan 'grel/༈ ma chen shong ston bod kyi lo tsā ba chen po shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan mchog ni spyi lo /1240 lor gtsang la stod lho'i dpyad lung shar gyi bong rwa zhes par sku 'khrungs/chung ngu'i dus nas rab tu byang / spyi lo 1265lor 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags par sdeb sdugs tshig gi sbyor ba'i bstod pa phul zhing sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba zhig 'ong ba'i ched slob gnyer la 'gro 'dod pas rdzong skyes gnang bar zhu zhus par/'gro mgon pas ljags rtsom dang thugs stobs la bsngags brjod gnang /gzhung lugs gsar ba bsgyur mi nus kyang paṇa ṭi ta bsten la slob sbyong yag po gyis/ rjes su sdeb sbyor me tog chun po dang tshig gter sogs shes pa zhig cis kyang byed dgos gsungs te/sdeb sbyor dang tshig gter gyi phyag dpe dang gser sogs gnang /rten 'brel brtag phyir rje btsun gong ma'i gzim chung nang nyal du skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —41—

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/bcug shong ston khong gi thugs su nga la skyes stobs kyi shes rab ni yod/sbyang brtson byas na sngar ma 'gyur ba'i legs bshad cis kyang bsgyur thub par dgongs nas bal yul du phebs/ paṇa ṭi ta sa bzang dbang bo'i drung nas rig gnas chung ba lnga la mkhas par sbyangs nas phyir sa skyar phebs pa na 'gro mgon 'phags pas sa skya rin po che'i zhal chems su rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing dang dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud phreng 'dzin gyi tshigs su bcad pa bod skad du bsgyur dgos tshul gsungs yod pas khur de khyod kyis bzhes dgos gsungs pa bzhin dus 'khor rgyud 'grel shong 'gyur du grags pa de legs par bsgyur/ de nas 'phags yul du phebs te mdo sngags rig gnas thams cad la mkhyen rtsal rab tu rgyas/ rgya gar gyi paṇa ṭi ta lak+ṣim ka ra bod du gdan drangs nas sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du snyan ngag me long ma dang /dpag bsam 'khri shing /klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi bstod pa brgya ba/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi bstod pa/tsan dra ba'i mdo sbyor ba'i rtsa 'grel/ bzlog pa bsdus pa rtsa 'grel/ smra ba kun la 'jug pa'i rtsa 'grel/ slob dpon seng ge bzang bos mdzad pa'i rnam dbye'i le'ur byas pa sogs gzhung mang bo gsar du bsgyur/ mngon brjod 'chi med mdzod la mchan yang mdzad pas bod la sku drin che ba'i lo tsā ba chen po zhig yin/ khong gi slob ma'i gtso bo tsha bu shong lo ṭā /sa gā hā kā /spyan pa/ de'i slob ma'i gtso bo lo tsā ba mchog ldan 42 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

mchod brjod kyi mchan 'grel dang rig gnas bcu'i ngo bo sogs/de'i thugs sras dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa ni spyi lo 1276lor gtsang du 'khrungs/ bal yul du (bal bo ni gna' snga mo'i dus nas rang re bod kyi nub phyogs su gnas pa'i rgyal khab zhig ste/srong btsan sgam po'i sku tshe'i smad tsam nas (gnam ri'i skabs dbang du bsdus par bshad pa'ang yod)bod kyi chab 'og tu bsdus te mes mag tshom gyi bar du bod kyis dbang bsgyur/ da dung yang kho tsho'i sum cha gcig bod kyi mi rgyud yin la/yul mi dang skad sogs ma 'gyar ba'ang mang bo yod/ de'i phyir bal bod gnyis la chos srid rig gnas kyi 'thol ba shin tu zab cing /bod kyi mkhas pa mang po zhig b.labor phebs te slob gnyer gnang myong /gtsang sa skya'i mkhas pa zhig yin phyin phalacher b.labor ma phebs pa med pa'i tshod yin/ bod kyi snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung lugs mang bo bsgyur spel la mdzad rjes gzengs su mtho ba'i shong dpang gnyis kyang gtso bo bal bor phebs te mkhas par gyur ba zhig yin 'dug)thengs bdun phebs shing mdo rgyud kyi gzhung mang bo bod skad du bsgyur/ dus 'khor bstod 'grel kā la ba dang snyan ngag me long ma'i mchan 'grel sogs mang du brtsams/ dgung grangs re bdun pa sbyo sbyo ༵ rno //4/2lor sku gshegs/ slob ma'i gtso bo lo tsā ba byang chub mchod brjod sho lo kusbag pa'i mchan 'greg༈ mchod brjod sho lo ka drug par rje tsong kha ba'i lo rgyus ngo sprod dgos par 'dug kyang 'og tu kun mkhyen sdom tshig gi mchod brjod du'ang 'byung bas skabs der chabs gcig tubashadapar bya'o//skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —43

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/mchod brjod sho lo ka bdun pa'i mchan 'gregaḥ tshigs bcad 'dis dbyangs can zhal lung nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od can rtsom pa bor bstod phyag phul yod de/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa chen po zhes pa'i mtshan bya dka' ba gnas gzhan na yod pa'i tshul gyis tshang bar byas yod/khong gi rnam thar mdo tsam gong du ngo sprad zin pa ltar lags pas 'dir bskyar bzlas mi dgos/mkhas pa mang bo zhig gis 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa zhes pa sgra'i kun bshad kyi mtshan yin par gsungs mod/khong gi gsang rnam tshigs bcad ma las/chos 'khor lha sar shākya mu ne dang //'jam dbyangs sku yis snyan dar phyag bzhes nas//'dzum bzhad gsung byon dgyes pa'i nyams mang mdzad//shākya'i rgyal bo chos kyi rgyal tshab lags//zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi lo rgyus la brten nas mtshan de thogs pa min nam snyam ste dpyad/༈ mkhas grubawa nye rabs kyi mkhas dbang dung dkar rin po ches/mkhas bya rig pa'i gnas che ba dang chung bar sbyangs shing /'chad pa dang / rtsod pa/ rtsom pa gsum ku'am gang rung zhig la mkhas pa ni mkhas pa yin zhing /de gsum gyi nang nas 'chad pa ni sla zhing /de las rtsod pa dka' ba dang /de las kyang rtsom pa dka' ba ste/rtsom pa ni gang brtsam bya'i gzhung don rnams rang gis legs —44 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

mcho brjo kyi mcha 'grel dang rig gnas bcu'i ngo bo sogs/par sbyangs shing dogs pa bcad de go ba cha tshang bar lon pa zhig med na rtsom yig 'bri ba'i skabs mi rgan gyis zas za ba ltar sla sar 'chad cing dka' sar 'dor ba sogs rtsom tshul yang ma dag pa'i skyon bco brgyad kyis gos par 'gyur bas/rtsom pa la mkhas pa'i mkhas pa zhung ba'i gnad kyang der thug yod/zhes gsungs/ grub thob ces pa ni gsang sngags kyi brda chad cig ste/ gsang sngags kyi lam la brten nās mchog thun gyi dngos grub gnyis sam gang rung mnga' brnyes pa zhig la grub thob ces bya/lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje'i zhal nas/ nyon mongs dpal ni gnon pa dang //rang dang gzhan rgyud 'dul bar nus//lta sgom 'khrul bral gdengs ldan pa//de nyid la ni grub pa zer//mkhas pas grub pa ma bcom zhing //grub pas mkhas pa ma bcom la//bstan la phan par bsgrubs pa ni//skyes bu dam pa zhes kyang zer//zhes kyang gsungs so//rte lung rtogasawa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa ni lung gi bstan pa dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa gnyis su 'du ba yin te/chos mngon pa'i mdzod las/ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te//lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do//de 'dzin byed pa smra byed pa//sgrub par byed pa kho na yin//zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'o na ji 'dra zhig la lung rtogs kyi bstan pa zer zhe na/byang chub lam rim chen mo las/lung gi bstan pa ni chos lag tu len pa'i tshul sgrub pa byed lugs gtan la 'bebs pa yin la/ rtogs pa'i bstan pa ni gtan la skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —45

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/phebs pa na ji ltar gtan la phab pa ltar sgrub pa yin pas/ de gnyis rgyu 'bras su 'gro ba ste/ dper na/ rta rgyug pa na sngon la rta la dkyus sa // shā kāng bstan zin nas der rgyug pa lta bu yin no/ / zhes sho lo ka brgyad pa dang dgu ba'i mchan 'grel/ga sho lo ka brgyad pas kun mkhyen bla ma'i snyan ngag gi sdom tshig de cha thams cad nas 'gran zla dang bral ba'i legs bshad ngo mtshar ba zhig yin yang deng gi dus 'dir 'phrin las rgyas thub kyin med pa'i tshul bstan pa dang / sho lo ka dgu bas khengs snangs dang bcas te snyan 'grel yang gsal snang mdzod rtsom pa'i rgyu rkyen bstan/mjug gi sho lo kus dgos chos brjod pa dang 'brel nas snod ldan gdul bya'i bgo skal du sngar med kyi bstan bcos 'di nyid rtsom par dam bcas pa'o//sho lo ka bcu ba'i don 'grel// blo gsal gzhon nu'i gzigs mor 'grem par bya zhes pa'i skabs snod ldan nyan skul dang 'brel nas rtsom par dam bca' —46 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

mchod brjod kyi mchan 'grel dang rig gnas bcu'i ngo bo sogs/gnang ba'o// 'o na sdod dang ldan pa'i slob ma ji lta bu zhig dgos zhe na/ bzhi brgya ba las/ gzur gnas blo ldan don gnyer ba/ /nyan po snod ces bya bar bshad//ces gsungs pa ltar/ chos nyan pa'i tshe na yid phyogs lhung gi dbang du ma gyur ba'i gzu bor gnas pa/ legs bshad lam yang dag pa dang nyes bshad lam ltar snang sogs rnam par 'byed pa ste blang dor gyi gnas la mi rmongs pa'i blo dang ldan pa/de gnyis yod kyang ri mo'i chos nyan ltar mi brtson na snod du mi rung bas shes rig yon tan gyi phyogs gang la'ang brtson pa chen po bskyed 'dod kyi don gnyer dang ldan pa bcas khyad chos gsum 'dzoms pa bo zhig la sdod ldan gyi slob ma zhes bya'o/ / byang chub lam rim chen mor/ chos la don gnyer che ba/ nyan pa'i tshe yid legs par gtod pa/ chos dang chos smra ba la gus pa chen po 'jog pa/ nyes bshad dor nas legs bshad 'dzin pa ste bzhi dang yang ldan dgos par gsungs/khyad chos de dag las kyang ches gal che ba ni don gnyer che ba yin te/ gzhung lugs zab mo dang bshes gnyen mkhas pa ci tsam la 'phrad kyang slob ma don gnyer med pa zhig yin na de'i rgyud la yon tan 'byor thabs med/ dper na/ lam khrid dag tu/ sangs rgyas ni dong kha'i mi dang / chos dngos ni thag pa/ rang re tsho ni dong zhabs kyi mi dang 'dra bas/ dong zhabs kyi mi des dong kha'i mis bslabs pa bzhin ma byas par rang dgar bsdad tshe skyob thabs med par gsungs pa ltar yin/ de'i phyir brgyad stong ba las/ legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zungs shig ces gsungs/ 'di ni don skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —47

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/gnad chen po ston pa'i sdom tshig cig ste/ legs par zhes pas kun slong skyon gyis ma gos pa/ rab tu nyon la zhes pas dpe khrid la nyan pa sogs kyi tshe sems rtse gcig tu gtod pa/ yid la zungs shig ces pas gang shes pa'i don sogs brjed nges kyi dbang du gtong mi nyan par gdams pa'o/ / 'di la gzhung chen mo dag tu/ 1snod kha sbub pa dngaka 2 kha gyen du bzed kyang nang mi gtsang ba dang / 3 gtsang du zin kyang zhabs brdol na der lhas char phab kyang nang du mi gnas pa zhes snod kyi skyon gsum spang tshul bum pa dang bdud rtsi gnyis dpe don sbyar nas gsungs la/ gzhan yang / 1 rang la nad pa lta bu'i 'du shes/ 2chos smra ba bo la sman pa lta bu'i 'du shes/ 3 rjes su bstan pa la sman gyi 'du shes/ 4 nan tan nyams su blangs pa la nad 'tsho ba'i 'du shes/ 5de bzhin gshegs pa la skyes bu dam pa'i 'du shes/ 6 chos kyi tshul la yun ring du gnas pa'i 'du shes bcas 'du shes drug dang ldan pa sogs slob mar tshang dgos pa'i cha rkyen du ma zhig yod/ dpe khrid la nyan stangs kyang lus ya yor 'dug pa dang / yar langs te nyan pa/ sun snang gi rnam pas nyan pa/ nyal nas nyan pa/ lam du 'gro zhor gyis nyan pa/ gzar ba dang gnya' gong du bsnol te nyan pa/ zhwa gyon pa/ lag tu phreng ba dang mtshon cha sogs 'dzin pa/ khyogs kyi steng du 'dug pa dang mchil lham gyon pa/rta sogs zhon pa/ stan mthon por 'dug pa/ 'ur sgra sgrog pa/ gnyid pa/ mgo bo g.yog pa/ slob dpon gyi rgyab phyogs nas nyan pa sogs ma yin par kun slong kun spyod tshad dang ldan par byas nas nyan —48 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

mchod brjod kyi mchan 'grel dang rig gnas bcu'i ngo bo sogs/dgos te/skyes rabs las/rab tu dma' ba'i stan la 'dug/dul ba'i dpal ni rnam par bskyed//dga' dang ldan pa'i mig gis blta//tshig gi bdud rtsi 'thung ba bzhin//gus pa bskyed cing rtsegacig btud//rab tu dang la dri med yid//nad pas sman pa'i tshig nyan bzhin//rim gro bskyed de chos nyon cig/ces gsungs pa lta bu zhig nges par du dgos so// 'on kyang dus dbang dang khor yug sogs kyis lham gyon nas dpe khrid la nyan pa sogs re 'ga' dmigs bsal gtong mi chog pa'ang ma yin no//༈ mno sde rgyan rje btsun byams pa mgon pos 'phags pa thogs med brgyud nas 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir skyes kyi tshul du gnang ba'i byams chos sde lnga'i nang tshan zhig ste/byams chos sde lnga ni/mngon rtogs rgyan/mdo sde rgyan/dbus mtha' rnam 'byed/chos nyid rnam 'byed/ rgyud bla ma bcas so// de las skabs brgyad kyi bdag nyid can mngon rtogs rgyan dang rgyud bla ma gnyis ni/ dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i dus dkyil du lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyis bod skad du bsgyur zhing /bam po gsum gyi bdag nyid can mdo sde rgyan ni dus rabs brgyad pa'i mjug tu lo tsā ba dka' ba dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed ni dus rabs brgyad pa'i mjug tu lo tsā ba zhang ye shes sdes bod skad du bsgyur zhing / chos nyid rnam 'byed ni dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i 'gor lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur/zha ma seng rgyal gyi 'gyur yang yod/skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —49

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/mdo sde rgyan gyi lung tshig der gsal ba'i 'phags mchog ces pa la'ang go tshul mang du yod de/ khams 'grel las/ 'phags mchog ces pa ni/ 'phags pa thams cad las ches mchog tu gyur pa sangs rgyas la go ba'i skabs shig dang / 'phags pa thob pa tsam la zhe sa'i brda sbyar nas brjod pa'i skabs shig phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la go ba'i skabs shig ste gsum yod pa las/skabs thob gang yin la dpyad nas sbyar bar bya yi mtha' gcig tu zhen par mi bya'o//zhes gsungs so/// drin lan bsabs pa'i mdo las/rig pa'i dngos po lngar ma bslabs na nam du yang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub bam thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob par mi 'gyar ro de bas bla na med pa'i ye shes thob par bya ba'i phyir rig parā dngos po lnga la bslab par bya'o// gsungs pa ltar rig pa'i gnas thams cad la phyogs su ma lhung bar sbyang ba byed rgyu ni gal che ba yin te/ ma bslabs masbyangs par rang grol dang thol byung lta bus mkhas pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang zhig 'thob tshul med pas/ sa skya paṇa chen gyi zhal las/ rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa 'di/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i khyad chos yin/ /ma bslabs par yang kun mkhyen du/ /'gro na rgyu 'bras ga la bden/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// de ltar na bod rigs gzhon skyes tshang mas mdo sngags rig gnas kun la phyogs su ma lhung ba'i slob gnyer gsha' ma zhig byed rgyu ni shin tu —50 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

mchod brjod kyi mchan 'grel dang rig gnas bcu'i ngo bo sogs/gal che ba yin yang / deng sang mang bo zhig slob gnyer la mi mos shing gal te slob gnyer gyi gzugs brnyan tsam bzung yang / yid rten med par the tshom dang bcas ngan rtog 'doms//de dag mthong tshe blo bzang grags pa shin tu skyo//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rig pa nyi tshe ba dang gzhung lugs ma dag pa re'i rjes su 'brangs nas mi tshe chud zos su gtong ba ni shin tu phangs che ba yin te/ gzhon skyes kyi khrod na yon tan gyi rang rkang zin pa nyung zhing slob gnyer rnal ma la nges 'byung skye mkhan mang ba ni rang rigs rgud cing phongs ba'i rtsa ba yin te/sa skya paṇa chen gyi zhal nas/ bsgom na thos pa mi dgos zhes//blun po blo rgya chung ngus smra//thos pa med pa'i sgom pa tsam//'bad kyang dud 'gro'i sgrub thabs yin//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de 'dra'i rigs kyis mi tshe'i snying bo rnam dag cig len mi thub la mi'i rigs la phan nges pa'i zhabs phyi dang phyag rjes shig kyang 'jog ga la thub/ tshul 'di 'dra la dgongs te yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis/ ke rer langs nas 'gro ba tsam gyis mi'i mtshan nyid mi rdzogs/ zhes gsungs 'dug ste blang dor dbye 'byed mi shes shing rig gnas yon tan la ma sbyangs pa rnams la thugs ma rangs pa'o// des na gna' deng rig pa'i gzhung lugs tshad ldan dag la slob gnyer rnal ma re cis kyang byed dgos pa ni rang cag mi ru skyes pa'i don snying dang mi rigs shig gi las dbang gleng bzhin pa tsho'i 'gan 'khri yin te/thos pa'i tshoms las/ thos pas chos rnams shes par 'gyar thos pas sdig las ldog par byed/ /thos pas don ma yin pa gleng / /thos skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —51—

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/pas mya ngan 'das pa 'thob/ / ces dang / skyes rabs las/ gang zhig thos pas yid ni dad gyur nas//legs par dga' la brtan pa nyid du 'gyar//shes rab skye zhing gti mug med par 'gyar rang gi shas kyang sdo ni nyo ba'i rigs//thos pa ma rig mun sel ston me yin//rkun po la sogs mi 'khyer nor gyi mchog /kun tu rmongs pa'i dgra 'joms mtshon cha yin/ /thabs tshul man ngag ston pas grogs kyi mchog/phongs par gyur kyang mi 'gyur mdza' bo yin//gnod pa med pa mya ngan nad kyi sman/ /nyes pa chen po'i dpung 'joms dpung gi mchog/grags dang dpal dang gter gyi mchog kyang yin//ya rabs rnams dang phrad na skyes kyi mchog /tshogs kyi nang na mkhas pa mgu ba yin//zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa ltar chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs tshul bzhin du shes pa dang dge sdig gi spang blang la mi rmongs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mngon du byed pa/ shes nas rnyed pa'i dad pa/ dka' tshegs la mi 'jigs shing lus srog longs spyod dang bcas par ci mi snyam pa sogs thos bsam rnam dag dang slob gnyer yang dag byas pa'i nus mthu kho na las 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ / de'i phyir gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes/ 'on kyang rmongs pa'i mun sel//thos pa'i sgron me med na//blang dor bya thabs bral bas//slob gnyer nan tan gyis shig / ces dang / sa skya paṇa chen gyis/ shes rab med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ /blun po yon tan mi slob lo/ /brtags na shes rab med nyid kyis//blun po 'bad pa lhag par dgos//skye ba snga mar ma bslabs pas//tshe 'dir blun por skyes pas na//phyi mar blun por —52 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/
