mchod brjod kyi mchan 'grel dang rig gnas bcu'i ngo bo sogs/skye dogs pas/ /blun po 'bad pa lhag par dgos/ /zhes gnas lugs dang bden don gyis ches cher phyug pa'i legs bshad 'di dag gi don la cung zad tsam re yin yang bsam ste shes rig yon tan gyi phyogs la brtson par rigs so//zhes drin lan bsabs pa'i mdo lung las 'phros te slob thun 'dir slob gnyer gal che tshul mdo tsam bshad pa yin no//kau kha ba gangs can pa ni rig gnas ches cher dar ba'i mi rigs shig yin no zhes kun la rlung ltar grags pa ltar thun min khyad chos dang ldan pa'i rig gnas rang skya 'pher ba mang bo zhig ches snga mo'i dus nas dar zhing rgyas la/ rig gnas che ba lnga dang chung ba lnga'i bshad pa dang 'chad nyan cha tshang ni sa skya paṇa chen gyi sku ring nas byung bar mngon te/ tha snyad rig pa'i gnas lngar grags pa rnams/ /sa skya paṇa chen yan la ma dar zhing / /thar lo yan la sgra mdo 'gyur ba med/ /ces sa skya'i mkhas pa mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtshos tha snyad rig gnas ji ltar byung ba'i tshul blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng bar drangs te gsungs pa ltar ro/ / thar lo yan la sgra mdo bsgyur ba med gsungs pa ni thar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis thog mar yi ge'i mdo dang de'i 'grel ba sogs bsgyur bas so//gna' deng phyi nang gi mkhas pa mang bos rig gnas la gnad du song ba dang ma song ba'i mtshan nyid da sngon nyis brgya lnga bcu yas skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —53

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/mas shig bzhag yod mod/ rang re bod kyis rig gnas kyi mtshan nyid 'di zhes gsal kha can zhig bzhag yod pa bdag gi mthong thos su ma gyur to// 'on kyang phal cher gyis rig gnas zhes pa rig pa'i gzhung lugs shig la go ba len pa 'di rgyugs che bar snyam/ des na gzhung bka' pod lnga dang gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi sogs rig gnas yin la/ de shes mkhan la rig gnas pa zhes brjod chog chog yin mod/ tha snyad rig gnas dang khyad par yod de/ rjod byed tshig gi ngo bo gtso bor gtan la 'beb byed kyi gzhung sgra dang snyan ngag mngon brjod dang sdeb sbyor sogs la tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung dang / de dag shes mkhan la tha snyad rig gnas pa'am tha snyad pa zhes kyang zer ro/ / tshul 'di tsam yang shes dgos pa'i gnas gal chen zhig yin no// ༈ de yang gangs can bsil mo'i ljongs 'dir bsdu na 'du zhing dbye na mang du bkram chog pa'i sbyang bya'i rig gnas che ba lnga dang chung ba lnga yod de/ btsun pa tshul khrims rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i rig gnas lnga'i rnam bshad las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis la mkhas pa ni nang don rig pa zhes bya'o/ /mngon sum dang rjes su dpag pa'i tshad mas zin pa'i tarka'i (gtan tshigs)gzhung la mkhas pa ni rgyu mtshan rig pa zhes bya'o//sgra'i gtsug lag byā ka ra ṇa la mkhas pa ni sgra rig pa zhes bya'o/ /rlung dang bad kun la sogs zhi bar byed pa'i gtsug lag la mkhas pa ni gso ba rig —54 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

mchod brjod kyi mchan 'grel dang rig gnas bcu'i ngo bo sogs/pa zhes bya'o//glu dang gar dang spos la sogs pa'i gtsug lag la mkhas pa ni bzo ba'i las kyi rig pa zhes bya'o//zhes gsungs pa ltar lags so//༷'og smra gzhan dag tshar gcad pa'i phyir du sgra rig sdawa watshig gi 'khrul ba tshar gcod pa'i phyir du sgra rig pa la slob dgos te/don gang dang gang zhig shes par 'dod na yang rjod byed kyi tshig la brten nas go bar bya dgos pas sgra shes na don la mi rmongs zhes grags pa yin no//de yang tshig rgyan rig pa'i sgo 'byed las/'jig rten gyi skad rigs mi 'dra ba gang dang gang yin yang yul lung so so'i lugs kyi ming dang /de la brjod don gsal bar byed pa'i rkyen rnam dbye dang tshig phrad sogs sbyar ba la brten nas brjod bya'i don legs par brda 'phrod par byed pa'i nges can gyi chos nyid gzhir bzung nas gtan la phab pa'i rig pa'i gzhung lugs de la rang rang gi lugs kyi sgra rig pa'i bstan bcos dang lung du ston pa'i bstan bcos zer zhing /bod skad kyi dbang du byas na thon mi sam sto ṭas brtsams pa'i sum cu ba dang rtags kyi 'jug pa sogs ni bod mi rigs rang nyid kyi skad gzhir bzung nas brtsams pa'i sgra rig pa'i bstan bcos yin la/ zhes dang / sgra rig pa'i bstan bcos zhes pa'ang saṃ skṛ ta'i sgra rig pa dang /rgyal spyi'i sgra rig pa kho na las med pa ma yin par/yi ge yod pa'i mi rigs tshang mar rang rang gi skad dang mthun pa'i sgra rig pa yod pa yin no//zhes gsungs so//skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —55

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/rang res goms gshis kyi dbang gis sgra rig pa zhes pa de rgya gar skad kyi sgra rig pa la go bzhin yod cing de bod kyi rig gnas che chung bcu'i ya gyal du'ang bgrang chog chog yin/ der sgra gzhung chen mo bcu sogs mang du yod pa las kā la pa dang / tsan dra ba/ pā ṇi ba/dbyangs can ma bzhi ni shin tu grags che zhing bod la'ang 'gyar te 'chad nyan ches cher rgyas/ bod kyi lo paṇa sku drin can tshozlo rnam dpyod la brten te bod yig gi lam nas legs sbyar gyi brda sprod gshis phyin pa mkhyen pa'i thabs 'phrul ngo mtshar ba gsar btod gnang bas rgya gzhung bgrang las 'das pa bod rang gi skad du bsgyur thub pa byung /sgra kā la ba ni bram ze dbang phyug go cha zhes pas gzhon nu gdong drug bsgrubs te sgra'i le'u bco lnga tsam bslabs mtshams chog sems skyes pas smin drug rma byar zhon nas 'phur/bram zes bltas pas rma bya'i mjug sgro ma gtogs ma mthong bas kā la ba bzod par gsol lo zhes smras pas sgra tā la ba zhes grags so// kā le ba ni cha bsags te rma bya'i mdongs la 'jug go/ / tā ra nā thas 'di dang cung mi mthun pa zhig gsungs/ ka lā ba'i gzhung 'di rtogs sla ba rgyal bo'i lugs kyi bstan bcos su grags shing dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan bas thog mar bod skad du bsgyur/ der klu'i rgyal bo zhig gis 'grel ba dang slob dpon tsan dra go mis yang 'grel shin tu rgyas pa zhig brtsams pas de nas brgyud pa la tsan dra bar grags te rtogs dka' ba paṇa ṭi ta'i lugs kyi bstan bcos so/ / gzhung 'di thog mar —56 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

mchod brjod kyi mchan 'grel dang rig gnas bcu'i ngo bo sogs/shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis bod skad du bsgyur/ pā ṇi ba ni rgya gar gyi sgra gzhung rnams kyi 'go khungs lta bu zhig ste thog mar lha'i yul du dar zhing /phyis bram ze pa ṇi ba zhes pas lha chen bsgrubs par zhal bstan pas sgra tshegs med par mkhyen/des sgra'i bstan bcos sho lo ka nyis stong tsam zhig brtsams pas pā ṇi ba'i gzhung byang /gzhung 'di thog mar lo tsā ba 'dar ba ngag dbang phun tshogs skyos bod skad du bsgyur/dbyangs can ma ni rgya gar lho phyogs bram ze'i rigs su 'khrungs pa'i a nu byu ti zhes par lha mo dbyangs can mas dngos su gsungs shing slob dpon rang nyid kyis 'grel ba gsal ldan zhes pa mdzad de dar rgyas byung ba zhig go//lha mthong lo tsā ba dang tā ra nā thas dbyangs can sgra mdo bod skad du bsgyur cing 'dar ba ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis rtsa 'grel gnyis ka legs par bsgyur to//ma tshad ma rig lawa spyir tshad ma'i don ni mi bslu ba ste rang gis rtogs bya'i don dngos la ma 'khrul ba dang /don dngos dang mthun pa zhig la go dgos par gsungs shing /sgra yangs 'jug gi dbang tu byas na tshad ma rig pa ni rtog ge'i rig pa la go yang chogade'i phyir tshad ma rig pa'am rtog ge'i rig pa ni ches snga mo'i dus nas rgya gar du dar zhing /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang mdo sde mang bor tshad ma'i rnam bzhag thor bu thor bu'i tshul gyis gsungs/dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i 'go tsam du slob dpon dbyig skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —57

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/gnyen gyi tshad ma rang las mkhas pa'i slob ma slob dpon phyogs glang gis dmigs pa brtag pa dang / sel bar brtag pa sogs bstan bcos thor bu brgya rtsa brgyad mdzad/ rjes su de rnams kyi don phyogs gcig tu bsdus te tshad ma mdo'am tshad ma kun btus zhes le'u drug gi bdag nyid can de nyid mdzad/ rjes su slob dpon dbang phyug sde'i slob ma dpal chos kyi grags pas tshad ma sde bdun brtsams/ de ni tshad ma rnam 'grel/ rnam nges/ rigs thigs te gtso bo lus lta bu'i bstan bcos gsum/ gtan tshigs thigs pa/ 'brel ba brtag pa/ rgyud gzhan grub pa/ rtsod pa'i rigs pa ste 'phros pa yan lag lta bu'i bstan bcos bzhi bcas so/ / de dag gi 'grel ba dang yang 'grel sogs rgya gar du tshad ma'i gzhung lugs ches mang bo byang /chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su lo tsā ba rma dge ba'i blo gros khyos tshad ma rnam 'grel thog mar bod skad du bsgyur zhing lo tsā ba dka' ba dpal brtsegs dang zhang ye shes sde sogs kyi sku drin las tshad ma'i 'chad nyan cung tsam dar yang rgyal bo 'u dum btsan po'i sku ring nas lo nyis brgya yas mas shig la gtan nub lta bur gyur/ dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i mjug tu rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis gsang phu dgon btab cing lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyis tshad ma sde bdun sogs tshad ma'i skor mang bo bod skad du bsgyur/ (da sngon bod kyi mkhas pa so sos tshad ma'i skor gyi glegs bam nyi shu yas mas shig bod skad du bsgyur zin pa dag bstan 'gyur khrod du bzhugs)tshad ma rnam nges la 'grel bshad dang rtsod pa'i yan lag du ma gsar btod sogs kyis slob ma —58 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

mchod brjod kyi mchan 'grel dang rig gnas bcu'i ngo bo sogs/tshig khri sum stong lhag bskyangs te bod 'dir tshad ma'i 'chad nyan rgya cher dar/phyis su bsdus grwa thog mar mdzad pa bo cha ba chos kyi seng ge/ seng chen brgyad dang seng chung brgyad/ sa skya paṇa chen/ rje yab sras/ yig cha so so'i dran dbang sogs tshad ma'i rigs lam la mnga' dbang 'byor ba grangs mtha' med pa byon te mdo dbus khams gsum gyi chos sde che phra du mar tshad ma'i 'chad nyan dbyar gsum chu gter gyi dpal la 'gran bzod par gyur la/ da lta bod brgyud tshad ma rig pa'i 'phel rgyas 'dzam gling rang bzhin can du 'gyur bzhin pa lags so//༈bzo rig lawa bzo rig pa la lus bzo dang ngag bzo yid bzo gsum yod pa las/rdo bzo dang shing bzo/pags pa dang tshar bu bzo ba/thong gshol bzo ba/gser dngul zangs lcags kyi mgar dang de dag 'dul sbyong /gos phug re 'thag sogs 'tsho ba'i rgyun bkol mang bo dang / sku gsung thugs gsum sogs kyi bris 'bur/gar gyi cha byad dgu/mchod rten gyi thig rtsa/zhi rgyas dbang drag dang dkyil 'khor sna tshogs kyi thig dang blos bslangs/yig gzugs mang bo'i 'bri rtsal sogs ni lus bzo yin la/lus kyi sgyu rtsal sum cu dang bzo'i bye brag bco brgyad ces pa'ang der gtogs so//glu dbyangs kyi nges pa bdun/ chos lugs kyi dbyangs bar rta/ glu dang mgur/gtam dang brjod pa sogs mang bo zhig ni ngag bzor gtogs/klong rdol rin po ches yig rigs drug cu rtsa bzhi yang ngag bzo'i skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —59

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/gtso bor gsungs so//thos bsam sgom gsum/rin po che brtag pa sogs brtag pa brgyad/sa bcu lam lnga/lha sku dang gzhal yas khang sgom pa sogs yid bzo la'ang mtha' yas pa yod de/mkhas dbang dung dkar tshang gis/yid bzo mchog ni/thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab dang rig gnas la mkhas shing byang chub pas gzhan la legs par bstan shes pa la zer/zhes gsungs so//rgya gar nas bsgyur ba'i bzo rig pa'i bstan bcos la mgon po klu sgrub kyi gser 'gyar gyi rtsi'i bstan bcos dang /skye bo gso thigs sogs yod la/bodo rang gis mdzad pa la'ang lha sku'i phyag tshad dang mchod rten brgyad kyi thig rtsa/yig ris sna tshogs kyi phyi mo me tog phreng ba sogs mang du yod do//༈ gso ba rig lawa rgyal khab dang mi rigs gang yin yang rgyun ring 'tsho ba'i nyams myong sogs la brten nas rang rang gi khyad chos dang ldan pa'i gso ba rig pa re yod pa bzhin/bod la mtshon na'ang khrag gcod pa dang rma bcos pa/dug sman du bsgyur ba/bsha' bcos byed pa sogs thun min khyad chos can gyi mi rigs rang gi gso rig steng gnya' khri'i skabs zhang zhung dang /lha tho tho ri'i skabs rgya gar/stag ri gnyan gzigs skabs 'a zha/gnam ri srong btsan dang srong btsan sgam po'i skabs rgya nag sogs nas gso dpyad sman gyi rig pa mang bo nang 'dren byas/khri srong lde btsan gyi skabs bod rang gi gso rig sman gyi ded dpon g.yu thog yon tan mgon po rgya —60 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

mchod brjod kyi mchan 'grel dang rig gnas bcu'i ngo bo sogs/gar dang kha che/bal bo/o rgyan sogs dang /bod mdo dbus khams gsum du phebs te slob sbyong dang zhib 'jug mtha' chod pa gnang rjes/rgyud bzhi dang lag len sgron me/nyams myong gsal sgron sogs sman gzhung mang bo brtsams pas bod kyi gso ba rig pa sngar las lhag par thun min khyad chos can gyi sgo nas 'phel rgyas bla na med pa byung / rjes su bod lugs sman pa'i bshad rgyun dang lag len thad byang lugs dang zur lugs gnyis su gyes pa sogs 'pho 'gyur mang du byung zhing /da lta bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i dge mtshan sngar las je rgyas su gyur te dus rabs nyer gcig pa ni bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i dus rabs yin zhes dpyod ldan pa mang bos smra'o// rgya gar nas bsgyur ba'i gso ba rig pa'i gzhung la slob dpon dpa' bo'i sman dpyad yan lag brgyad pa sogs dang /rgya nag gi skad nas bsgyur ba la sman dpyad chen mo dang sman dpyad so ma ra dza sogs mang du yod cing /bod rang gi mkhas pas brtsams pa la'ang byang ba bdag po rnam rgyal grags bzang gi rtsa rgyud bshad rgyud phyi ma rgyud gsum gyi 'grel ba dang /zur mkhar ba mnyam nyid rdo rje'i rgyud bzhi'i 'grel ba spos shel phra mo sogs mtha' med pa zhig yod do//rte nang non rig blowa brjod bya bslab pa gsum dang rjod byed sde snod gsum ci rigs kyis bsdus pa'i shes par bya ba de nang don rig pa'i mtshan nyid dam ngo bo yin la/bstan pa 'di'i dbang du byas na/spyi lo sngon gyi lo (lo tshigs 'di bugs lugs gzhir bzhag pa yin)skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyina'adzin grwa la/ —61

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/926 pa ste mnyam med shākya'i rgyal bo'i dgung grangs so lnga bar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa nas mi lo zhe lnga'i ring la bka' dang bo bden bzhi'i chos 'khor dang / bka' bar ba mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor/ bka' tha ma legs phyes kyi chos 'khor bcas chos 'khor rim pa gsum bskor zhing chos kyi phung bo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs/ spyi lo sngon gyi lo 881lor mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan rjes ston pa'i gtad rabs bdun dang 'dzam gling rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs kyis rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du ches cher dar bar mdzad/ bod kyi yul 'dir spyi lo 333lo nas dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes shing rim gyis rgyal blon dang lo paṇa sku drin can tshos rgya gar las kyang lhag pa'i dar rgyas gong 'phel du btang /nang bstan chos lugs ni da lta 'dzam gling gi chos lugs chen po gsum gyi ya rgyal yin zhing / sa chen po 'di'i khyon la nang chos kyi 'od snang gis khyab dang khyab bzhin yod la/rgyal khab brgyad cu lhag la bod brgyud nang bstan chos lugs kyi dgon sde'ang btsugs yod skad do//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi don thams cad tshur bsdu na gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis su 'du ste/ de ni slob dpon seng ge bzang bos mdzad pa'i brgyad stong 'grel chen snying bo'i rgyan las/ mdo sde dbyangs bsnyad lung du bstan//tshigs bcad ched brjod gleng gzhi dang //rtogs brjod de lta bu byung dang //skyes rabs shin tu rgyas pa dang //rmad byung gtan la dbab pa'i sde//gsung rab yan lag bcu —62 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

mchod brjod kyi mchan 'grel dang rig gnas bcu'i ngo bo sogs/gnyis yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// de dag kyang brjod bya bslab pa gsum dang rjod byed sde snod gsum kho nar 'du zhing /sde snod gsum yang mdo sngags gnyis las ma 'das te/mdo phyogs ni gzhung bka' pod lnga dang sngags phyogs ni rgyud sde bzhis gtan la 'beb cing der 'du ba yin no// 'di ni mdzub mo ri ston tsam ste rgyas par gzhan dang gzhan nas shes par bya'o//༈ rig gnas chung ba lnga'i ngo bo mdor bsdus ni/ mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ byang chub sems dpa'/ sems can kun 'dun par bya ba'i phyir gzhan dag la snyan par dngags pa'i bstan bcos dang / ming gcig don du mar 'jug pa dang / don gcig nyid kyang ming gi rnam grangs du mas mngon par brjod pa'i bstan bcos dang / lci ba dang yang ba'i yi ge bsgyur ba dang spel ba'i sgo nas tshigs su bcad pa sdeb pa'i bstan bcos dang /mdo 'dzin pa dang bzhad gad dang /skad du ma gzhan du bsgyur bas 'gro ba dga' bar byed pa zlos gar gyi bstan bcos dang / grangs kyi rig pas gzhal te ngo mtshar bar ston pa rtsis kyi bstan bcos rnams kyang bslab par bya ste/byang chub sems dpa' de ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar du shes par bya'o//: skar gyisagegaza' skar gyi rgyu ba dang chos nyid/de dag gi skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 63

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/byed las dang phan tshun gyi 'brel ba sogs gsal zhib tu ston pa zhig la skar rtsis rig pa zhes brjod pas/ bod rang sa nas nyams myong gi sgo nas dpyad pa btang ba'i gza' skar 'phrod sbyor sogs kyi rig pa dang / rgya gar ba'i dus 'khor lugs kyi rtsis dang phyi rol ba gzhan dag gi rtsis/ rgya nag gi hwang li'am rgya rtsis/ nub gling gi gnam rig bcas gang yin yang skar rtsis yin pa la khyad par med mod/ bod 'dir goms gshis kyi dbang gis spyi ming bye brag la btags te dus 'khor ba'i lugs gcig bur skar rtsis zhes brjod cing / rig gnas chung ba lnga'i nang tshan du'ang gtso bo gzhung 'di 'dren par mngon gcis shes na grangs lomi rmongs par brjod do//spyir rtsis kyi cha nas bod 'dir sngon byon yab mes dag gis rgyun ring 'tsho ba'i nyams myong la brten nas mtsho dang chab rom/rlung dang sprin pa/ 'dab chags kyi skad dang rtsi ljon gyi kha dog sogs dpyad thabs sna tshogs kyis rang byung khams kyi dus bzhi'i 'gyur ldog dang sad ser than pa 'byung min/ sa g.yo mtsho skyom dang 'byung bzhi'i 'du ba snyoms min sogs thun min khyad chos dang ldan pa'i rig pa mang bo gsar btod gnang bas rangaspya pher ba'i gnam rig skar rtsis yod la/ de'i steng du spyi lo 1027 lo nas rim bzhin rwa 'bro shong gsum sogs kyi sku drin la brten nas dus 'khor rtsa rgyud dang bsdus rgyud bod skad du bsgyur/ dus rabs bdun pa'i dus dkyil la nye bar rgya nag nas 'byung rtsis sam nag rtsis kyi gzhung —64— skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

mchod brjod kyi mchan 'grel dang rig gnas bcu'i ngo bo sogs/mang bo bod du 'gyur/dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i nang du glo lo tsā bas dbyangs dang gsal byed tshes la 'char tshul gyi sgo nas bde sdug legs nyes sogs lung du ston thub pa'i g.yul las rnam rgyal lam dbyangs 'char gyi gzhung bod du bsgyur/dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i nang du nyi zla gza' 'dzin gtso bor ston pa'i rgya rtsis sam gong ma'i gser rtsis kyi gzhung bod du 'gyur bas kha ba gangs can gyi yul la rtsis rig gi 'phrin las ches cher rgyas so//rtsis gzhung de dag gi bstan bya dang ngo bo/rgya bod mkhas pas mdzad pa'i rtsis gzhung ci tsam yod tshul sogs 'dir brjod na mang bar 'gyur bas gzhan dang gzhan nas shes par bya'o/// snyanangag wasnyan ngag gi byang 'phel sogs gong du bshad zin pas 'dir snyan ngag gi ngo bornom mtshan nyid de ci lta bu zhig yin tshul mdo tsam ngo sprod na/'di la gna' deng mkhas pa'i bzhed tshul mtha' yas shing 'ga' res snyan ngag ni 'di'o zhes mtshan nyid dang sdom tshig 'jog tu med do zhes kyang smra bar byed mod/mi pham snyan 'grel las/snyan ngag gi rgyun gang zhig sgra dang don gyi rnam pa brjod tshul mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i khyad par gyi yon tan dang ldan pa de la snyan ngag ces mngon par brjod do zhes dnganatshig rgyan rig pa'i sgo 'byed las/brda sprod kyi gzhung dang mthun par sbyar ba'i ngag de la snyan pa'i nyams dang ldan pas na snyan ngag ces bya'o/ /zhes dang /snyan ngag gi rtsom yig ni rang nyid gnas sa'i 'tsho ba'i skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 63

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/khor yug gi snang tshul rnams rtsom pa bo'i blo ngor 'char ba de nyid sgyu rtsal gyi lam nas mtshon par byed pa zhig yin/ zhes dang / snyan ngag gi rang mdangs gsar ba las/ rjod byed nyung yang don gyis rab phyug pa/ /rgyan gyis mdzes la nyams kyis sgeg pa dang / /sdeb sbyor legs shing snyan 'jebs ldan pa yi//tshig sbyor srog gis bzung ba snyan ngag go/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nges par byas na blo bskyed ster zhing phan 'bras che bar bsam mo// rang re bod kyi sngon byon mkhas pa dag gis mdzad pa'i snyan gzhung dag tu snyan ngag gi mtshan nyid dam ngo bo ni gtso bo rjod byed tshig gi steng nas gsungs pa las/ brjod bya don gyi cha nas 'di 'dra zhig yin dgos zhes gsal zhib cig gsungs med tshul la gzhigs na/ deng skabs mang bo zhig gis snyan ngag la mtshan nyid 'jog rgyu med ces brjod tshul dang cung mthun tshabs che bar gyur 'dug snyam ste/ snyan ngag gi brjod bya mtha' gcig tu 'di yin dgos zhes gtan 'khel thabs med pas so// sngon byon mkhas pa tsho'i zhal rgyun du/ snyan ngag shes na tshig rgyan la mkhas zhes pa'am tshig rgyan shes na snyan ngag la mkhas zhes zer ba'ang snyan ngag gi gzhung lugs dag ni gtso bo tshig gi sgyu rtsal gtan la 'beb byed cig yin pa mtshon gyin 'dug snyam/ de'i phyir brjod bya don gyi snyan ngag la mtha' yas shing rtsom pa bo'i khams dang mos pa'ang sna tshogs shig yin pas mtha' gcig tu 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes sdom tshig 'jog rkyang ma yin —66 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

mchod brjod kyi mchan 'grel dang rig gnas bcu'i ngo bo sogs/mod/ 'gro ba mi'i rigs spyi'i bsam spyod dang bstun te bshad na/klog pa bor yar skul dang phan bde ster byed sogs kyi brjod don la gzhol rgyu ni snyan ngag pa ya rabs shig gis brtson bya gtso bo yin no snyam ste / snyan tshig rig pa'i shes bya gnad bsdus las/ rmongs pa'i gnyid las sad byed 'brug gi sgra/ /spyod ngan dug sbrul tshang gtor gnam lcags thog /ya rabs snang ba'i lam ston nam mkha'i nor/ /dahādas /zhir byas pa snyan rtsom mchog tu bsngags//zhes gsungs pa phyir // yang kha cig gis don rgyan so lnga bos gtso bo snyan ngag gi brjod bya gtan la 'beb pa ma yin nam zhe na/ 'di'i skabs brjod bya don gyi nyams mi 'dra ba sna tshogs ston tshul gsungs pa las rtsom pa bo'i bsam blo dang spyir snyan ngag gi brjod don 'di 'atā zhig yin dgos tshul gsungs pa ma yin pa'i tshul de shes par bya /de/sa na snyan ngag la don gyi snyan ngag dang tshig gi snyan ngag gnyis yod pa las rang re tshos snyan ngag khrid snyan ngag sbyangs zhes pa'ang rjod byed tshig gi snyan ngag las ma 'das pas/ srol rgyun snyan ngag gi gzhung me long ma sogs la sbyangs na bsam blor bkag rgya thebs 'gro bar 'dod pa ni cung nor 'khrul zhig min nam snyam ste/da skabs rang mos snyan ngag ces pa'ang tshig gi gcod mtshams dang tsheg khyim rkang grangs sogs la gtan 'khel med par brjod don dang mthun par gang mos byed chog pa'i don yin rgyu las dmigs skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —67—

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/bsal gyis bsam blo'i rang dbang zhig stsol gyin med/spyir bsam blo'i rang dbang zhes pa phyi nang gi rgyu rkyen du ma'i khrod nas thob dgos pa zhig las rjod byed kyi tshig tsam la rag las ga na yod/tshigs bcad min gyi snyan ngag gang la'ang bsam blo'i steng nas bkag rgya yod mi srid pa'i tshul de snyan ngag pa tshos nges par du shes dgos pa'i gnas shig red snyam mo//lta ba sbyorawa 'di la rgya gar gyi dbang du byas pa'i sdeb sbyor dang bod kyi dbang du byas pa'i sdeb sbyor gnyis las/snga ma ni yi ge lci ba dang yang ba sbyar ba'i sgo nas tshigs su bcad pa'i rigs shig ste/lung las 'byung ba'i tshigs su bcad pa dang bstan bcos las bshad pa'i tshigs su bcad pa sogs dbye ba dang bshad bya mtha' med pa yod/sdeb sbyor gyi gzhung la rgya gar du phyi rol ba'i drang srong dmar ser can gyi sdeb sbyor gyi rtsa ba'i mdo dang slob dpon rin chen 'byung gnas kyi sdeb sbyor sogs gzhung mang du yod la/bod 'dir zha lu lo tsā ba'i sdeb sbyor gyi rtsa ba bsdus pa/lo chen dharma shrī'i sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas kyi 'grel ba don gsal sogs sdeb sbyor gyi skor mi nyung ba yod/gnyis pa bod skad kyi dbang du byas pa'i sdeb sbyor ni/rkang ba gcig la tsheg khyim gsum pa nas so lnga'i bar sogs su bsdebs te ngal gso dang 'degs 'jog sogs nyams pa med par byed pa dang /sum rtags dag gsum gyi dgongs don dang mthun par phrad dang rnam dbye bya tshig gi khyad par sogs nor ba —68 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

mchod brjod kyi mchan 'grel dang rig gnas bcu'i ngo bo sogs/med par sbyor ba la bya'o// ༈mngon brjodawa de yang mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos mkhas pa'i rna rgyan las/don gcig ming mang ming gcig la//don mang 'dod rgyalathog ma'i ming //rjes grub btags ming gnyis su bshad//btags ming 'dra ba rgyu mtshan dang //'brel ba rgyu mtshan du bkod las//phyi ma rgyu dang 'bras bur rgyu//phyogs la phyogs can cha shas sogs//rten la brten pa dngos ldog pas//btags sogs mngon par brjod pa'i ming //zhes gsungs pa ltar/mngon brjod ni phal cher 'dra ba rgyu mtshan dang 'brel ba rgyu mtshan sogs kyi sgo nas btags pa'i rjes grub btags ming yin zhing chos srid kyi dngos po gang la'ang mngon brjod kyis ma khyab sa med pas mngon brjod shes na ming la mi rmongs zhes grags so//de la'ang ming gi mngon brjod dang grangs kyi mngon brjod sogs nang gses sna tshogs yod/rgya gzhung bod skad du bsgyur ba la mngon brjod 'chi med mdzod dang /'dod 'jo'i ba mo sogs yod la/bod rang gis mdzad par zha lu ba'i mngon brjod legs bshad gser gyi lde mig dang /skyogs ston rin chen bkra shis kyi mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos/snar thang ba'i mngon brjod gser phreng rol ba/dge ye ba tshul khrims seng ge'i mngon brjod ming gi tshogs gsal bar byed pa blo gsal rna cha/rin spungs pa'i mngon brjod mkhas pa'i rna rgyan/dngul chu ba'i mngon brjod rgya mtsho'i chu thigs dang grangs kyi mngon brjod sogs shin tu skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —69

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/mang la deng sang slob grwa che 'bring gi slob deb la dmigs pa'i mngon brjod gsar 'grel kha shas re yod kyang ches kha tshang la don 'grel gsal ba'i gzhung ni cung nyung bar snang ngo /// sgros garawa sngon byung gtam rgyud dang lo rgyus sogs kyi nang du gsal ba'i mi sna dang lha 'dre sogs mtshon pa'i gzugs su byas te rang rang so so'i skad kyi sgo nas glu blangs pa dang bsam pa'i rnam 'gyar sna tshogs yang nas yang du zlos shing gar byed pa la zlos gar zhezlo bya ste/ zlos gar shes na skad rigs la mi rmongs zhes sngon byon mkhas pa rnams la yongs su grags so// zlos gar la mdo 'dzin pa dang /rol mo ba/chas su zhugs pa/bzhad gad pa/zlos gar ba bcas yan lag lnga tshang dgos shing srong btsan sgam po'i yan chod nas bod la zlos gar gyi rig pa 'di dar bar bshad/rim gyis skad grags che ba'i zlos gar a ce lha mo dang khams kyi ral ba/chab mdo'i bro/ mnga' ris dang 'ba' thang gi sgor gzhas/ tshig rgyag 'bras dkar/shel grong 'brong rtsed/'bag seng sogs zlos gar gyi rigs mang bo dar/rgya gar nas zlos gar gyi gzhung bod skad du bsgyur ba la/slob dpon tsan dra go mi'i 'jig rten kun du dga' ba'i zlos gar dang /rgyal bo tshul khrims nyi ma'i klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar sogs yod la/bod kyi mkhas bas brtsams par gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i zlos gar gyi bstan bcos yang dag lam du bkra shis pa'i rol rtsed ces rgya nag dang sog po/bod dang rgya gar bcas —70 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

mchod brjod kyi mchan 'grel dang rig gnas bcu'i ngo bo sogs/ kyi skad rigs bzhi'i sgo nas gtam gleng byed pa'i gzhung dang / sa paṇa gyi rol mo'i bstan bcos/ gzhan rnam thar chen mo brgyad sogs mang tsam yod do//ཿ khams 'grel las/ rig gnas che ba lnga bo shes pa la paṇa chen dang /chung ba lnga bo shes pa la paṇa chung zhes pa'i tha snyad kyang byed par grags so/ /zhes gsungs so/ / rig gnas che chung gi rnam bzhag 'di gtso bo rgya gzhung dag las phyes pa zhig ste/ gzhung la lar sgra rig pa rig gnas chung ba dang skar rtsis rig gnas che ba'i khongs su bsdus pa'ang yod la/ skar rtsis ma bgrangs par rig gnas che chung dgu ru grangs bcad pa'ang yod mod/ mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud sogs su skar rtsis rig gnas chung ba lnga'i khongs su bsdus te rig gnas che chung bcu ru grangs bcad pa 'di bzhin grags che'o/ / rgya gzhung dag tu rig pa'i gnas bco brgyad dang /sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhi sogs rig gnas kyi bye brag mang du 'byung yang rig gnas che chung bcu bor ma 'dus pa med de/khams 'grel las/sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa rnam grangs mang bo bshad pa dag kyang rig pa'i gnas chen lnga bo 'dir ci rigs par 'dus so//zhes dang / mkhas 'jug las/de yul brda sprod rtog ge dang //'tsho ba phyi nang rig ces bya//gzhan las gzhan dag rnam bshad pa//'di yi nang du 'dus zhes bya//zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro//skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —71—

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/༈ rig gnas chung ba lnga bo rig gnas che ba lnga'i khongs su bsdu ba'i dbang du byas tshe/ mngon brjod shes na ming la mi rmongs par gsungs pa bzhin ming gi rnam gzhag rnam grangs du ma'i sgo nas ston pa'i mngon brjod dang / sdeb sbyor shes na tshigs bcad la mi rmongs par gsungs pa'i yi ge lci yang gi rnam gzhag gsal zhing de nyid legs par sdeb tshul gyi sdeb sbyor ram/ yang na bod kyi dbang du byas tshe phrad dang rnam dbye'i sbyor tshul ma nor zhing tshig snga phyi 'brel chags pa phal skad kyis ma gos pa sogs kyi khyad chos dang ldan pa'i sdeb sbyor dang / zlos gar shes na skad rigs la mkhas par grags pa bzhin kha shags dang / bzhad gar/ rnam thar lo rgyus mang bo skad rigs du ma'i sgo nas ston zhing 'khrab pa'i zlos gar gsum ni gtso bo tshig gi sgyu rtsal ston pa'i gzhung yin phyir snyan ngag gi yan lag gam khongs su gtogs shing / skad cha'i sgyu rtsal rmad du byung ba ston pa'i ngag rig gi gzhung snyan ngag ni sgra rig pa'i yan lag tu 'jog pa yongs grags go/'on kyang khams 'grel las/'di nyid (snyanangaganyirig pa'i gnas lngar bsdu ba'i tshe na bzo rig pa'i nang tshan ngag bzo'i gtso bor gtogs/zhes gsungs pa ltar du 'dod mkhan yang mang ngon/spyir skar rtsis rig pa yin na nang don rig pa yin pas ma khyab mod/ rang rer yongs su grags pa'i skar rtsis sam dus 'khor gyi rgyud 'di sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la chos rgyal zla bzang sogs kyis khyim spang mi dgos par nyams su blang chog pa'i chos shig zhus pa'i ngor gsungs pa'i zab chos bla na med pa zhig yin zhing /phyi —72 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar zin 'dzin grwa la/

mchod brjod kyi mchan 'grel dang rig gnas bcu'i ngo bo sogs/dus kyi 'khor lo ri mo'i lam nas sbyangs te nang dus kyi 'khor lo dbugs kyi rgyu tshul sogs gtan la phabs/ gzhan dus kyi 'khor lo bskyed rdzogs kyi rnam gzhag gtan la 'beb byed ngo mtshar ba rgyud sde gzhan la med pa'i thun min khyad chos can yin pas skar rtsis 'di nang rig pa'i khongs su bsdu'o/// rig pa'i gnas bcu bo de dag las skabs su babs pa'i sbyang bya snyan ngag ni ches gal che zhing nges par du shes dgos pa'i bstan bcos shig yin tshul gong du'ang mdo tsam bshad zin pa ltar yin la/ 'dir sngon byon mkhas pa rnams kyis snyan ngag la gdengs 'jog dang bsngags brjod mdzad pa'i lung tshig 'ga' phyogs bsdus kyis drangs na/mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ snyan ngag gi rig pa 'di ni rig gnas mchog tu gces pa zhig ste/ nang rig pa'i sde snod thams cad kyang snyan ngag gi gzugs kho nar gnas shing /rig gnas gzhan kun la'ang 'di nyid 'jug pas/ shes bya kun la blta ba'i mig 'bras lta bu dang / zhes tshad mthon pos gdengs 'jog gnang 'dug la/ de bzhin du mdo sde bskal bzang las kyang /de bzhin gshegs pa dus mkhyen rgyal bo ni//snyan ngag mkhan tshe bde gshegs rtswa mchog la/ /tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis bstod nas kyang //dang bor byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do//zhes byang chub mchog gi sa bon grung bor 'gyur ba'i tshul gsungs pa dang / mdo las/dam pa'i chos gsal bar byed pa'i phyir snyan ngag bya'o//dkon skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —73

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/mchog gsum gyi bstod pa bya'o//de las bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes snyan ngag dam pa ni sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mngon du byed pa'i thabs dam par gsungs pa dang / khams 'grel dbyangs can ngag gi rol mtsho las/ 'o skol gyi ston pas kyang sangs rgyas skar rgyal la snyan ngag gi tshigs su bcad pa gcig gis bstod pas bskal ba bzhi khri'i tshogs bzlums par gsungs pa bzhin mthar thug gi dgos pa'i dgos pa'am nying dgos 'grub byed kyang snyan ngag yin chog pa dang / slob dpon tsan dra go mis/ rtsod 'chad ngag la ma nges pa//srid phyir mi 'khrul rtsom pa ste/ /zhes spyir mkhas blun gyi khyad par 'byed byed 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum yin yang /'chad rtsod gnyis la byang ba tsam gyis mkhas par ma nges pa'i phyir mi 'khrul ba'i gzer lta bu ni rtsom la mkhas min gyi sgo nas 'jog pa dang /snyan ngag me long ma las/snyan ngag chung ngu la'ang ngal byas mi//mkhas pa'i 'dun sa dag la 'dug tu dbang / /zhes snyan ngag la nyung tsam sbyangs pas kyang brjod pa dag cing tshig don la skyon mi 'byung bas mkhas mang gdan 'dzoms pa'i dkyil 'khor du rig pa'i bgro gleng ci dgar byed pa'i thob thang yod pa dang / snyan ngag dam pa'i rgyan ldan ni//bskal ba'i bar du gnas par 'gyur//zhes snyan ngag dam pa'i lam nas brtsams pa gang yin yang ji srid mi'i rigs kyi 'gro ba gnas pa de srid du ngag gi bcud dang sems kyi mdzes rgyan du gnas thub pa dang / sngon gyi rgyal bo grags pa'i gzugs//ngag gi rang bzhin me long thob//de dag nye bar mi gnas —74 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

mchod brjod kyi mchan 'grel dang rig gnas bcu'i ngo bo sogs/kyang / /rang nyid nyams pa med la ltos/ /zhes sngon byon rgyal blon lo paṇa sogs 'jig rten gyi mdzes rgyan du gyar ba dag gi mdzad 'phrin dang phyag rjes snyan ngag gi me long du 'armermi tshe de dag gi sku tshe'i 'du byed btang yang rmad du byang ba'i sku yon dang thugs stobs sogs dus gtan du nyams pa ༄med pa dang / rje rin po che'i rin po che gsum gyi gtam gyi sbyor ba las/ rigs lam rnam par phye ba'i rnam dpyod dang //gzhung lugs gdams par shar ba'i nyams len dang //tshig sbyor tshul la mkhas pa'i ngag gi dpal/ /sa steng 'di na rin chen rnam gsum snang //zhes 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir gzi brjid dang dngos grub kyis phyug pa'i rin po che gsum yod na de'i gcig ni ngag rig dam pa yin nges pa dang / 'jam mgon sa skya paṇa ṭi tas/rta mchog 'gro ba'i tshe na shes/ /gser dngul bzhus na shes par 'gyar//glang chen g.yul ngor shes 'gyar te//mkhas pa legs bshad rtsom na shes//zhes nges don gyi mkhas༄ pa yin min de'i brtsams chos kyi srang la gzhal na bde blag tu rtogs thub pa sogs snyan ngag dang snyan ngag sbyangs pa'i dge mtshan la bsngags pa mtha' yas pa gnang zhing / gzhan gna' deng mkhas pa mang bos snyan ngag ni rgyal khab srung byed kyi dmag dpung dang / mi'i 'tsho ba'i nying bcud/ zungs khrag gi rlabs sgra/ dus rabs kyi me long / steng gi khyab khongs su gtogs pa'i skad cha'i sgyu rtsal/ sems kyi zas yin tshul sogs bstod pa'i me tog gi phreng ba ches cher dkrigs nas yod do//skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —75

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ཿ snyan ngag la ma sbyangs pa'am ma shes na nyes skyon che tshul ni/dpag bsam 'khri shing las/ mkhas pa nyid ni med na blo gros rnams nyams mi rnams 'tsho ba don yod min//mtshungs med rgyas pa'i snyan ngag med na mkhas pa nyid ni ne tso'i klog dang mtshungs//zhes blang dor gyi gnas la mi rmongs pa'i mkhas pa med na mi'i 'tsho ba la'ang dud 'gro'i 'tsho ba las khyad du 'phags byed kyi chos med la/phul du byung ba'i snyan ngag pa med na rjod byed kyi tshig mi snyan zhing brjod bya'i don mi go ba sogs nyes skyon du ma dang ldan pa dang me long ma las/gal te sgra don snang ba yis// 'khor ba gsal bar ma byas na//'jig rten gsum po mtha' dag ni//smag rum mun pa nyid du 'gyur//zhes tshig gi 'khrul ba tshar gcod byed snyan ngag sogs sgra rig 'khor bcas dang don gyi 'khrul ba tshar gcod byed tshad ma rig pa sogs kyi 'od snang dang bral tshe khams gsum gyis bsdus pa'i skye 'gro yod do cog gi shes rab la mun pa 'khrug par 'gyur ba dang / sa skya paṇa ṭi tas/tshig kyang sdeb legs mi shes na/ /don bzang sbyor ba smos ci dgos/ /zhes don gyi gnad mi thon pa/gzhan la sgro ba bskyed mi thub pa/tshig snga phyi'i go rim 'chol ba sogs nyes skyon du ma dang ldan pa dang / bstan dar lha rams pas/rtsod la mkhas kyang rtsom la mi mkhas na//mkhas pa'i grags pa rang dang mnyam du 'chi//yi ge dag kyang snyan ngag mi ldan na//yid 'ong mdzes mas gos hrul gyon pa bzhin//zhes rtsom pa'i yon tan dang mi ldan na grags pa yun ring mi —76 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

mchod brjod kyi mchan 'grel dang rig gnas bcu'i ngo bo sogs/gnas shing gzhan phan gyi bya bzhag rlabs chen mi 'grub pa/ gzur gnas mkhas pas mthong chen mi byed cing gzhan gyi bkur ste mi thob pa sogs nyes skyon du ma dang ldan pa yin no//kau don gyi gnas lugs ma rtogs pa'i blun po u tshugs can nam rtogs kyang rang nyid kyi bsam tshul gcig bu mkhregs 'dzin byed par dga' ba'i skye bo re 'gas/ tha snyad rig gnas la sbyangs pas lta ba log 'gro zhing snyan ngag la bslabs pas rang rgyud kyi dam tshig kyang nyams 'gro bar brjod pa ni ches cher nor 'khrul du song zhing / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'/ nges don gyi skyes bu dam pa dag gi dgongs pa las ring du gyes pa zhig yin pa shes dgos te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis drin lan bsabs pa'i mdo sogs su mdo rgyud rig gnas mtha' dag la phyogs su ma lhung ba'i slob gnyer dang de don nyams su len dgos tshul gdams pa las/ sngags shes na mdo nyams su len mi chog pa dang /mdosangs na sngags rgyang phud du gtong dgos pa/ de gnyis ka shes mkhan gyis tha snyad rig gnas than tu lta dgos pa/ tha snyad rig gnas tsam shes pas mdo sngags gnyis la slob mi dgos tshul gang du'ang gsungs med la gsungs kyang mi srid pa zhig go// de'i phyir snyan ngag kyang rang rgyud kyi dam tshig nyams byed cig ga na yin te/ mdo las/ dam pa'i chos gsal bar byed pa'i snyan ngag bya'o//dkon mchog gsum gyi bstod pa bya'o//de bas bla na med skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —77

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ro/ / zhes gsungs pa ma yin nam/snyan ngag sbyang mkhan gyi nang na bsam spyod mi legs pa dang / lta ba log pa/ sdom khrims srung mi thub mkhan sogs yod pa bden yang /de ni gang zag rang rang gi skyon yin pa las snyan ngag gi skyon ga na yin te/ de ltar na mdo sngags kyi gzhung mar khu 'dra ba dag la slob mkhan tsho'i khrod du'ang de 'dra'i rigs med pa ma yin pas ha cang thal che bar ma gyur tam/ yang kha cig gis/ 'o na gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes/ zab zab man ngag zer dgu 'tshol ba dang / /thob thob mang bo'i rnam grangs gsog byed cingaka/sgra snyan sman rtsis sogs la mgo 'khor ba/ /gzhung lugs thos bsam rnal ma'i gegs yin pas//rtsa ba bor nas yal ga ma 'dzin mngan/zhes gsungs pa ma yin nam zhe na/ de ni skabs 'di'i bslab bya gnang yul ni mdo sngags kyi gzhung la slob gnyer gnang mkhan tsho yin phyir/ rang gi skabs babs sbyang bya dag dor nas gzhan zhig la a gsar byed mi rung ba'i don yin pa las/ tha snyad rig gnas la sbyang mi rung ba'i don ma yin te/ khong rang gis kyang tha snyad rig gnas mtha' dag la byang chub par sbyangs pa ma yin nam/ de'i phyir lung de skabs thob skabs thob la sbyar shes dgos pa yin/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la brtson par ma byas na// zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar mdo sngags rig gnas mtha' dag la sbyangs shing 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la dbang 'byor ba zhig dgos kyi/ deng gi phyogs re ba'i yon tan dang nyi tshe ba'i bsam blo des lag zlum brab la 'dzegs pa dang /—78— skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

mchod brjod kyi mchan 'grel dang rig gnas bcu'i ngo bo sogs/gshog g.yas chad pa'i rgod pos gnam 'phang gcod 'dod pa bzhin/ mi tshe'i don snying bzang bo len rgyu dang / mi rigs yar rgyas su gtong 'dod pa ni rmi lam ji bzhin 'bras med du 'gyur 'gro bas/ sngon byon skyes bu dam pa dag gi sku yon dang thugs brtson la mig ltos byed par 'tshal lo//ཿ snyan 'grel yang gsal snang mdzod du drangs pa'i lung /rgyal bo lang tshos dregs gyur kyang //rgyan med pa na skye bos gleng //zhes pa ni zur mkhar blo gros rgyal bo'i gsung yin te/ khong ni rab byung dgu ba'i sa sbrul (1509)lor 'khrungs shing dgung grangs bdun cu lhag bzhugs/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gzhung spyi dang khyad par du gso ba rig pa'i gzhung la 'gran zla dang bral ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur te/ rtsa rgyud dang bshad rgyud/ phyi ma rgyud kyi chu mdo yan gyi 'grel ba/ bstan bcos rnam par dbye ba mun sel sgron me/ sman gyi ro nus zhu rjes kyi re'u mig sogs gso rig gi skor dang /snyan ngag me long ma'i me long sogs rig gnas gzhan pa'i skor gyi gsung rtsom yang shin tu mang ngo //skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —79

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i sgo sogs/sdom tshig sho lo ka dang bo'i mchan 'greg/ sdom tshig la bshes gnyen rin po che'i 'bru 'grel gsal bo yod pas gzhan mang du 'grel ba'i ngal ba mi dgos kyang / gsar slob dag gi dgos mkhor dmigs te sngon 'gro'i skabs tha snyad re 'ga' zhig gi don cung go bder btang na legs par snyam mo//༈ mkhyen rab ma lus 'dus ba'i gzugs skuwa sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes de nyid gzugs sku'i rnam pa ste lha sku bzhin lag gi rnam par shar ba rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs yin pas so// ༈ mdzes cag rgya ma rdzogasawa lam rim chen mo las/rgya mtsho ni mang bo'i tshig go//zhes gsungs pa ltar mtshan dpe'i mdzes sdug gi cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa ste 'dzoms pa'i don no/// ji lta ba ni zab mo stong ba nyid kyi don dang ji snyed pa ni kun rdzob pa'i shes bya yod do cog la go dgos te/shes bya thams cad don —80 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

bstan bcos lo'ajugapa'i sgo sogs/dam bden pa dang kun rdzob bden pa gnyis su 'du'o//༈ rab 'byamasawa skabs 'dir mang tshig la 'jug mod/spyir skar rtsis kyi lugs ltar na stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag brgya la rab 'byams gcig zer ro/// rgyal kun yabawa rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs ni bskal ba 'di'i sangs rgyas stong gis dang bor thugs bskyed pa'i yul yin pa'am/ yang na dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad shes rab kyi lha rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs la brten dgos pas na rgyal kun yab ces bya'o//rte nam medawa wakun rdzob 'khrul ba'i rnam pa med pa'am rtog pa med pa ste snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang bcud thams cad lha dang lha mo'i rnam par shar ba'i blo lta bu'o//sdom tshig sho lo ka gsumapa'i mchan 'grel/( spyir rgyal khab dang mi rigs gang yin yang rang gis ming btags pa dang gzhan gyis btags pa/ sgra zur chag pa bcas gsum yod pa las/ 'phags yul dang rgya gar zhes pa ni bod kyis skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 8/—

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/phar btags pa zhig go//de yang sa thob kyi byang 'phags mang bo bzhugs sa'i yul yin no zhes zhe sa'i tshig gis 'phags yul dang /sa gnas de'i mi mang che bas gos dkar bo gyon pas sam rgya mtsho las ring du gar bas na rgya gar dang /yang na 'dod rgyal gyi ming gis rgya gar zhes 'bod pa'o// mtshangs la spyir tshangs pa la zhal gcig pa dnganagasum pa/bzhi ba bcas rigs gsum las/phyi rol ba dag gis 'jig rten mes po dang 'jig rten byed por 'dod pa'i lha tshangs pa ni zhal bzhi ba nyid yin te/'dzam bu'i gling gi yi ge thog mar bzo mkhan yin par bshad pas skye dgu'i bdag po zhes kyang bya'o//tshangs pa ni lus kyi tshad mi shes shing khyad du 'phags pa zhig ste/de'i lus kyi tshad khyab 'jug gis mar bltas/dbang phyug gis yar bltas te dpyad kyang tshad ma dpog pas tshangs pa zhes btags tshul phyi rol ba rnams la grags so//skabs 'dir 'dzin ma ste sa'i rgyal bo chen po mthu nus phun sum tshogs pa'i snyan ngag pa dge dbang la 'dra mtshungs sbyar ba'o// sdom tshig sho lo ka bzhi ba'i mchan 'grel/lta 'o chen nam bzangawa lo tsā ba chen po nam mkha' bzang bo'am sgra ba nam bzang du grags pa'i mkhas pa chen po 'di'i rnam —82 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

bstan bcos la 'jugapa'i sgosogs/thar rgyas bsdus gang yang mthong lam du ma gyur mod/sum rtags kyi 'grel ba bstan pa'i sgron me zhes pa'i gzhung rtsom pa bo khong yin tshul sbyar byang du gsal la/rje rin po cher sgra dang snyan ngag khrid cing sgra kā tsan gnyis dang snyan ngag me long ma sogs kyi blo rgyugs kyang phul tshul rje'i rnam thar du gsal bas khong dang dus mnyam pa'i mkhas pa chen po zhig yin 'dug go// sdom tshig sho lo lnga ba'i mchan 'grel/༈ mkhas btsunabazang 'owa mdo rgyud rig gnas rgya mtsho'i dgongs don mtha' dag la nang byan chud pas na mkhas pa dang /ji ltar thos pa'i don mtha' dag tshul bzhin du rang rgyud la nyams su blangs pas btsun pa/thos sgom las rnyed pa'i rnam dkar gyi yon tan thams cad bstan 'gro'i don 'ba' zhig tu legs par yongs su bsngos pa na btsun pa zhes brjod cing de dang de'i yon tan la mnga' brnyes pa'ang yin te/gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes/mang du thos pa rgya cher btsal bas mkhas//thos don tshul bzhin rgyud la sbyar bas btsun//kun kyang bstan 'gro'i don du bsngo bas bzang //zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro//skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —83

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/༈ gsang ba gsum spyir gsang gsum ni sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan khyad par can la go dgos te/sku'i gsang ba'am yon tan mtshan dpe'i dpal gyis mdzes pa/ gsung gi gsang ba'am yon tan gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cur dbang 'byor ba/ thugs kyi gsang ba'am yon tan shes bya thams cad kyi gnas lugs tshul bzhin du mkhyen pa lta bu'o//de lta bu'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa ni so so'i skye bo lta ci/'jig rten pa'i lha mthu bo che dag dang nyan thos rang rgyal la'ang med cing de dag gis dpog mi thub pa yin te/skabs gsum pa las/rgya mtsho'i klong ltar rab tu zab pa'i thugs//lha yi rnga bzhin legs par 'doms pa'i gsung //lhun po'i spo ltar mngon par 'phags pa'i sku//mthong thos dran pa don ldan mdzad pa khyod//'jig rten kun gyi sems can thams cad kyis//dus gcig nyid du the tshom don zhus kyang //de dag re re'i mdun du'ang de snyed kyi//sku dang gsung gi bkod pa dus gcig tu//mdzad pa mdzad cing rtog pa nyer zhi ba//khyod kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba yi//tshul 'di rgyal sras rang rgyal nyan thos kyis//ci tsam brtags kyang blo yi yul min na//tshangs dang dbang bo sogs kyis smos ci 'tshal//zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//: kun gsal zhags la kun gsal ni nam mkha'i mngon brjod de/ dngos po kun skye ba'i go gsal ba'am 'byed pas so//—84 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i sgosogs/des na kun gsal zhags pa ni mtshan mor nam mkhar shad kyis 'then pa'i kha dog skya bo ste 'brog pa tshos 'brug mo'i thal lam du 'bod pa de yin/ ming gi rnam grangs la/ dgu tshigs zhags pa/gnod sbyin kha rlangs/gnam gyi ska rags sogs dang /deng gi tshan rig pa tshos nyi ma'i khyim rgyud du 'bod pa de'o//ga spang rtogs sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa yongs su spangs pa'i spangs pa phun tshogs dang /ji lta ji snyed kyis bsdus pa'i shes bya thams cad kyi gnas lugs tshul bzhin du rtogs pa'i rtogs pa phun tshogs mnga' ba'i rgyal ba rnams la spangs rtogs mthar phyin pa'i sangs rgyas zhes bya'o/// sdom tshig sho lo ka lnga bas 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa rje blo bzang grags pa dpal bzang bo mchog la mchod brjod phul ba lags te/khong ni rab byung drug pa'i me bya ste spyi lo 1357lor mdo smad tsong kha'i yul du sku bltams shing dgung lo bcu drug bar du mdo smad nas bzhugs/ de nas dbus gtsang du phebs te grub mtha' ris med kyi mkhas pa mang du bsten nas mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas par gsan bsam mthar byin pa gnang /khyad par du rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis dngos su zhal gzigs shing gdams pa bstsal ba la brten nas/grub mtha' thams cad kyi yang rtse dpal ldan thal 'gyur ba'i dgongs don ma lus pa thugs su skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 83

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/chud cing nyams su bstar te dpal mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa'i grub mtha'i srol btod/ bu slob kyis sa chen khyab pa byung zhing gsung 'bum pod bcu dgu mdzad/ dgung grangs re gsum pa ste spyi lo 1419lor sku zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan to/ / rje rin po che'i rnam thar rgyas bsdus ha cang mang bas 'dir gsal bshad cher mi dgos par sems la/ mdor na/ lta ba rnam dag rtag chad mtha' las grol//sgom pa rnam dag byings rmug mun pa sangs//spyod pa rnam dag rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin bsgrubs//zhes dang / dang bor rgya chen thos pa mang du btsal/ /bar du gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par shar/ /tha mar nyin mtshan kun tu nyams su blangs/ /kun kyang bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched du bsngos//zhes pa'i sho lo ka gnyis po 'dis khong gi rnam thar gyi che ba gtso bo bstan pa'am mtshon yod snyam mo//khong la rje rgyal ba gnyis pa zhes bsngags brjod mdzad pa ni ches cher don la gnas pa'i bsngags brjod cig yin te/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ 'jig rten nga ni mya ngan 'das/ /sa yi steng du stong ba na//khyod nyid byis pa'i gzugs kyis ni//sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed par 'gyur//de tshe dgon chen rab dga' ba/ /kha ba can na yod pa yin//zhes rgyal ba rang nyid kyis nga dang 'dra ba'i mdzad pa ston tshul gyi lung bstan yod pa dang / mkha' 'gro gsang rgyud las/'jam dpal sprul ba blo bzang zhes/ /bstan pa rgyas byed ngo mtshar can//zhes rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs nyid du gsal bar lung bstan/ sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten na bzhugs —86 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar byin 'dzin grwa la/

bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i sgo sogs/pa'i skabs shig tu/ rje bla ma dang thugs rgyud gcig pa'i rgya gar gyi bram ze'i khye'u zhig byang chub sems dpa' mos pa'i blo gros dang lhan cig mnyam med shākya'i rgyal bor mjal nas sems bskyed tshe lung bstan tshul mdo sde gdams ngag 'bog pa'i rgyal bo bstan pa dwangs snyigs 'byed pa'i le'u las/ kun dga' bo/ da lta nga la shel dkar gyi/ /phreng ba ster ba'i khye'u 'di/ /ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus su ni/ /'bri dang ldan gyi sa mtshams su//dge zhes bya ba'i dgon pa 'debs//blo bzang zhes bya'i ming can 'byang //zhes pa'o/ / gzhan yang mdo lang gar gshegs pa las/ bcorā ldan 'das la klu'i rgyal bo ma dros pas dung dkar bo zhig phul ba mo 'gal gyi bu la gnang nas/ 'di khyod kyis 'gog pa rir sbos shig ma 'ongs pa na dge slong pad+ma'i ngad ldan 'dis gter nas bton pas de'i tshogs dung byed par 'gyur ro//zhes gsungs pa ji lta ba bzhin byung ba sogs lung bstan mtha' yas pa yod pa dang / sku tshe 'di'i thun mong snang tshod kyi dbang du byas na'ang / bstan pa'i yang snying mdo sngags zung 'brel gyi bstan pa phyogs mthar spel ba'i cha nas kyang rgyal ba gnyis pa'i rnam thar yar ldan du tshang ba yin no//rje rin po che ni thun mong snang tshod kyi dbang du byas na ngur smrig dge slong gi rnam par byon pa las don du na rigs gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i bdag nyid yin pa dmigs brtse ma sogs kyis kyang shes la de ltar yin pa'i sgrub byed kyang shin tu mang mod/ 'dir las dang bo ba rnams la shin tu go bde ba'i phyir rje'i bsam lhun las skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —87

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/gsungs pa ltar drangs na/ lhums su zhugs dus yab kyi gzigs snang la//lcang lo can nas gsang ba'i bdag po yis//gser gyi rdo rje 'phangs pa yum la thim//mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis khrus gsol byed pa gzigs/ /gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin dang dbyer med pa/ /zhes dang yab kyis slar yang ri bo rtse lnga nas//glegs bam khur ba'i dge slong smug tshos can/ /me tog du ma spel ba'i chos gos dang / /lha yi gos dar ser bo'i sham thabs can//gnas tshang dgos zhes khang bar bzhugs pa mthongan/rje btsuna'ajam pa'i dbyangs dang dbyer med pa//zhes dang / yum gyi snang bar nam mkha'i sprin gseb nas//spyan ras gzigs dbang ri bo lta bu zhig/lha yi 'khor gyis bskor ba spyi bo nas//thugs kur shel gyi khang bar zhugs pa la//bltams tshe lha yis shel sgo 'byed pa gzigs//mgon po spyan ras gzigs dang dbyer med pa//zhes pas kyang legs par 'grub pa yin no//gzhan yang sku tshe der rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis dngos su byin gyis brlabs tshul ni/ gsang rnam las/in dra nī la'i mdog ltar rab sngo ba'i/ /rab mdzes 'od zer lnga yi dra ba can// shin tu skum pa'i dbus su 'jam pa'i dbyangs//mngon sum gzigs pa rje btsun chos kyi rje/ /zhes dang / de nas brtsams te rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter/ /nam 'dod gzigs shing dpal ldan 'dus pa dang //shes rab pha rol phyin gzhung zab mo'i don//rgyun du gsan pa rgyal sras chos kyi rje//zhes dang /rtogs brjod mdun legs yolas kyang /de nas gdul bya'i blo mun sel ba'i phyir/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la —88 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i sgosogs/shugs drag rgyun ring gi//dad pa brtan pos gzhung lugs gdams pa ru/ /'char phyir gsol btab rgyu tshogs kun la 'bad/ /gsungs pa ltar/ 'ol kha chos lung nas bsags sbyang blos mi dpog pa gnang ste rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis dngos su zhal gzigs shing rjes su bzung / lta ba'i gnad thams cad phyin ci ma log par bstan pas ri ༵ dge lugs pa'i grub mtha' rnam par dag pa gtan la phab pa 'a/da/ sa pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus khrod grub mtha' 'then 'khyer dang bla ma bzang ngan gyi rtsod pa kha la bzung zhing / rang gi khe phan gang rung re khog la bcug nas nang 'khrug gi 'khor lo bskor cing mi bsad rta rmas kyi gtam rgyud skyo bo mi rabs nas mi rabs su bzhag myong ba ni bsub thabs bral ba'i nor 'khrul dang sangs rgyas bstan pa'i god chag mi rigs nyams rgud kyi sna 'dren gtso bo zhig yin pa sogs shes gal che ste/ bod kyi grub mtha' phal mo che'i srol btod pa bo rnams ni phan tshun thugs yid gcig tu 'dres shing thugs rgyud gcig pa/ sku che ba'i yon tan rtogs shing bsngags brjod kyi me tog 'thor res byas pa'i rnam thar bzang bo can sha stag yin pas rang re tshos de shes shing de'i rjes su slob dgos pa ni gnad kyi dam pa yin par bsam ste/ bka' thang bsdus pa las/ thub pas lung bstan mdo khams smad cig tu/ /a ti sha yi sprul ba blo bzang grags/ /zhes mnyam med jo bo chen po dang rje blo bzang grags pa gnyis thugs rgyud gcig tu bstan pa dang / rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtshos/ rig skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —89

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/'dzin grub pa'i dbang phyug pad ma 'byung / /lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan dpal ldan mar me mdzad/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /sna tshogs sprul ba'i gar mdzad de la 'dud/ /zhes slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / mnyam med jo bo rje/ rje tsong kha ba gsum sprul gzhi gcig tu bstan pa lta bu'o//rje rin po che'i sku tshe 'di'i dbang du byas na'ang gong du bshad pa ltar grub mtha' ris med kyi skyes bu dam pa bzhi bcu lhag bsten te mdo rgyud rig gnas kyis bsdus pa'i gzhung lugs rab 'byams kyi pha rol tu son pa yin phyir khong dang chos 'brel dngos thob kyi bu slob dag lta ci/ dus skabs de'i che rgu thams cad kyi gtsug rgyan du mchod cing grub mtha' ris med kyi skyes bu dam pa dag gis kyang 'jig rten gyi mig dang gangs ri'i sgron me zhig tu ngos 'dzin gnang zhing bsngags pa mdzad yod de/ bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis/thub bstan nyi ma nub rir lhung gyur cing // shes ldan rkang drug ldan pa mya ngan 'das/ /log smra 'byung bo'i bya tshogs rgyu dus 'dir/ /smra ba'i zla ba blo bzang grags pa shar/ /zhes dang / mkhas mchog ngang ba'i rgyal bo blo bzang grags//grags pa mgrin pa'i rdza rnga sgrog pa can//blo bzang mkha' lding dbang bo'i zhabs drung du/ /'jigs med bung ba gzhon nus 'di skad zhu/ /zhes dang / khyod kyi rnam thar chen po'i chen po rnams/ /ring na gnas kyang mngon sum nyid du thos/ /zhes gsungs/ 'brug pa pad+ma dkar bos/ gang dang rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan ni/ /srang la bcal bzhin lci yang ma mchis pas/ /lnga brgya ba yi —90 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i sgo sogs/gtsug rgyan du 'os pa/ / thams cad mkhyen pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / 'gran zla kun bral rje btsun tsong kha bar 'gran par bgyi ba'i mkhas rlom mang na yang //'gran zla kun bral khyod nyid gcig bu zhes/ /'gran par mi byed pad+ma dkar bos bstod/ /ces gsungs/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyis/ klu sgrub yab sras zhing gzhan gshegs pa na/ /dbu ma'i lam 'di ston pa gzhan med ces/ /sgro skur brag ri'i phung bo gzhom slad du/ /mgon khyod rdo rje'i me char lta bur gyur/ /zhes dang / thub dbang zhing 'dir khyod nyid kho nas ni/ /thub bstan gsal ba'i 'phrin las 'di 'dra na/ /thub pa'i rgyal tshab dag gis ci bya zhes/ /mi pham mgon des phrag dog mi mdzad dam/ /zhes gsungs/ de bzhin du stag tshang lo tsā bas kyang / khyod blo'i nyi ma gzhon nu'i dus kyi tshe/ /mdo dang rgyan gyi pad tshal rgyas mthong nas//bdag yid khengs pa'i ku mud lhag par zum/ /zab yangs mkhyen pa'i gter la snying nas 'dud/ / zhes dang / byang phyogs 'di na tshig tsam byang ba dkon/ /don la sgro 'dogs chod pa de bas dkon//tshig don nyams su len mkhan srid mtha' tsam/ /'di gsum mthar phyin khyod la snying nas 'dud/ /zhes dang / mdo sngags mtha' dag khyad par rdo rje'i theg /rgyud sde mtha' dag khyad par bla med don/ /rim gnyis mtha' dag khyad par sgyu lus la/ /sngon med legs bshad gter chen khyod la 'dud/ /zhes gsungs/ kurma mi bskyod rdo rjes/byang gi phyogs 'dir rgyal ba'i bstan pa la//phal cher log pa 'ba' zhig spyod pa'i skabs/ /'khrul med byi dor mdzad pa'i tsong kha ba /ri skabs bcu gnyis pa'i ma thar phyin 'dzin grwa la —91—

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ bo dga' ldan pa la bstod par bgyi//zhes sogs kyi bsngags brjod mthas yas so//de ring gi slob thun 'dir tshig tshogs cung che bar gyur kyang dgos gal zab par bsam ste mang tsam bkod pa'o//sdom tshig sho lo kurag pa'i mchan 'grel/: kun mkhyen mkhas grubawa wathams cad mkhyen pa'i sras kyi thu bo'am gtso bor gyur ba mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang bo mchog ni spyi lo 1384lor gtsang la stod du 'khrungs/ byis pa'i dus nas mkhyen rtsal dang mdzad spyod gzhan las khyad du 'phags pas mkhas grub lha dbang ba'i sku skye yin tshul kun la grags/dgung lo bdun par dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes shing mtshan la dge legs dpal bzang bor gsol/rje red 'da' ba sogs mang du bsten nas mdo sngags gnyis ku'i gzhung la gshis byin parasbyangs/dgung lo bco lnga'i thog bo dong paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal rtsod pas pham par byas shing sde bdun yid kyi mun sel brtsams/rjes su bo dong paṇa chen gyis bung ba rnam par rtsen pa'i rgyud mang zhes pa'i bsngags brjod kyi snyan tshig phun sum tshogs pa phul/dgung lo nyer gsum par rje rin po che dang mjal zhing thugs sras gcig bur gyur te thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i chos rgyun gyi gdams pa yongs —92 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/
4blo bzang chose kyi —rgyal metshan/—
9 blo bzang thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma/

bstan bcos la 'jugapa'i sgosogs/tan gyi 'byung gnas sogs gsal ba de la bka' gdams pha chos zhes bya ste/ zhu ba bo 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas yin zhing / khong bka' gdams bstan pa'i mes po yin phyir ming de ltar btags pa'o//ngog legs pa'i shes rab dang khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung gnyis kyis dri ba zhus pa'i lan du mnyam med jo bo rjes gsungs pa la zhu ba bo'i cha nas bka' gdams bu chos zhes bya tshe khu rngog gnyis ni mnyam med jo bo rje'i slob rgyud 'dzin pa'i bu dang 'dra bas so// 'di ni gtso bo lung bstan gyi skor te khyon le'u nyer gsumayod go/༈ mdo sde pad ma dkar bo las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' bstsal ba/ rigs kyi bu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas gang gis kyang gdul byar ma gyur ba'i gnas/ 'dre srin du mas gang ba'i mtha' 'khob kha ba can gyi rgyal khams der/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su dam pa'i chos nyi ma lta bu zhig dar zhing rgyas par 'dug ste/ sems can de rnams kyang thar ba byang chub kyi lam la 'god par 'gyur ro//mtha' 'khob de 'dul ba'i gnyen po ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yin no/ /de gang zhe na/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug des sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas stong gi spyan sngar smon lam btab ste/ bdag gis dus gsum sangs rgyas gang gis kyang zhabs kyis ma bcag pa'i gnas/ mtha' 'khob kha ba can gyi rgyal khams na yod pa'i sems can 'dul dka' ba de rnams thar ba byang chub kyi lam la 'khod skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar zin 'dzin grwa la/ —95

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags myu/par gyur cig mtha' 'khob de yang bdag gis 'dul ba'i zhing du gyur cig bdag 'dre srin la sogs sems can de dag thams cad kyi pha ma lta bur gyur cig 'gro ba sgrol ba'i ded dpon lta bur gyur cig mun pa sel ba'i sgron me lta bur gyur cig dus gsum sangs rgyas la sogs pa de dag thams cad kyis gsungs pa'i chos thams cad mtha' 'khob kyi yul der dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par spyar cig sems can de rnams kyis dkon mchog gsum gyi mtshajo thos te skyabs su song nas/ bde 'gro mtho ris kyi lus thob ste/dam pa'i chos la longs spyod par gyar cig bdag gis gang la gang 'dul gyis sems can rnams smi( cing grol nas/mtha' 'khob de yang rin po che'i gling lta bur spyar cig de kho na nyid du spyar cig ces smon lam btab pas/ derā smon lam gyi mthu la brten dos/dus gsum sangs rgyas gang gis kyang ma thul bar spyan ras gzigs kyis 'dul ba'i zhing khams su gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin no//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bod kha ba can gyi ljongs 'di ni 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i gdul zhing yin pas chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po sogs rgyal bo'i rnam pa dang / rje rin po che sogs bla ma'i rnam pa/rgyal dbang sku phreng rim byon sogs chos srid gnyis kyi bdag po'i rnam pa/gzhan yang sprul ba'i bkod pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyi gzugs su byon nas gdul bya'i don mdzad pa yin no// de phyir mgon po 'od dpag med kyi rnam sprul paṇa chen sku 'phreng rim byon dang /'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i sprul ba rgyal dbang sku phreng rim byon —96 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

bstan bcos la 'jugapa'i sgosogs/ni bod kha ba can gyi me tog phog pa'i lha skal gcig bu yin zhing /skyabs mgon nyi zla rnam gnyis zhes rang gi tshe srog las kyang lhag pa'i bkur sbyi byed la/gzungs mchog yi ge drug ma mi 'don pa zhig phal cher med pa'i tshod yin/ khong rnam gnyis kyi sku 'phreng rim byon gyis kyang sku srog thad la bor te bod mi rigs 'di'i chos srid rig gnas kyis bsdus pa'i 'phel rgyas kyi ched du phyag las gang mang gnang bas dus nam yang gdong dmar bod pa tshang gi sems stegs na gzim pa med pa'i gser gyi mchod me zhig tu grub yod/de'i phyir sngar yang mi rigs 'di'i bde sdug legs nyes mtha' dag khong rnam gnyis kyi thugs rje dang mdzad 'phrin la brten cing da lta'ang brten bzhin pa dang /ma 'ongs pa na'ang brten par 'gyar ba ni ldog med kyi rang gshis dang 'gyur med kyi kha phyogs shig yido nges so/// rgyal dbang sku 'breng rim byon las/1 rgyal ba dge 'dun grub/ (1391—1474)gtsang la stod du 'khrungs/rje rin po che'i dngos slob yin zhing gtsang bkra shis lhun po phyag btab/dgung grangs gya bzhi bar sku gshegs/gsung 'bum pod bdun bzhugs/2 rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho/(1476wa 1542)gtsang rta nag tu 'khrungs shing dgung grangs re bdun par sku gshegs/ri bo dge lugs pa'i sprul sku'i thog ma yin/se 'bras gtsang gsum gyi mkhan por bzhugs/gsung 'bum pod lnga bzhugs/skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —97

ngag rig sgyu 'phul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/3 rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho/(1543wa 1588)lhasa'i skyid shod du sku 'khrungs shing dgung grangs zhe drug par sog por sku gshegs/sog rgyal mal thal gyis tā la'i bla ma zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/de nas bzung sku 'phreng rim byon la mtshan de thogs/gsung 'bum pod gcig bzhugs/4 rgyal ba yon tan rgya mtsho/ 1589 1616)sog yul mkhar sngon por sku 'khrungs shing dgung grangs nyer bdun par po ta lar sku gshegs/se 'bras gnyis kyi khrir bzhugs/5 rgyal ba blo bzang rgya mtsho (1617wa 1682)lho kha 'phyongs rgyas su sku 'khrungs shing dgung grangs re drug par sku gshegs/spyi lo 1641lor gu shrī bstan 'dzin gyi rogs ram la brten nas dga' ldan pho zang zhes pa'i srid dbang 'bras spungs su btsugs/1645lor pho brang dmar bo gsar bzhengs byas/sde srid kyi go gnas kyang khong gis srol btod/dpar khang dang sman rtsis khang mang bo gsar 'dzugs dang tha snyad rig gnas bod khams yongs la dar ba'i phyag las mang du gnang /1652lor gong ma hrin kyis rgya nag tu gdan drangs te rgya bod bar mchod yon gyi 'brel ba yag po byung /gsung 'bum pod sum cu lhag bzhugs/6 rgyal ba tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho/ 1683wa 1707 lha mon la 'og ces par sku 'khrungs/dgung grangs nyer lnga ba'am yang na dgung grangs re bzhi bar gshegs par yang bshad/gsung 'bum tho re ba mang du bzhugs/ —98 skabs bcu gnyis pa 'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i sgo sogs/7 rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtsho/(1708wa 1757)khams li thang du sku 'khrungs shing dgung grangs lnga bcu bar sku gshegs/mkhas btsun bzang gsum la 'gran zla med pa lta bu byung / gsung 'bum pod bdun bzhugs/8 rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/(1756wa 1804)gtsang du sdi 'khrungs shing dgung grangs zhe bdun par sku gshegs/ gsung rtsom 9ra trī dri nga/ lung rtogs rgya mtsho/(1805 1815)lha sar sku 'khrungs shing dgung grangs bcu gcig par /sku gshegs/ rtse pho brang rgya bskyed mdzad/10 rgyal ba tshul khrims rgya mtsho/(1816wa 1837)khams li thang du sku 'khrungs shing dgung grangs nyer gnyis par sku gshegs/11 rgyal ba mkhas grub rgya mtsho/ (1838wa 1855)khams dar rtse mdor sku 'khrungs shing dgung grangs bco brgyad par sku gshegs/ lha sa'i zho ston zhes pa srol bstod/12 rgya ba 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ (1856wa 1875)lha sar sku 'khrungs shing dgung grangs nyi shu bar sku gshegs/13 rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho/(1876wa 1933) dwags por sku 'khrungs shing dgung grangs don bdun par sku gshegs/bod mi rigs kyi chos srid rig gnas 'phel rgyas sogs kyi ched du phyag las gang mang gnang /14 rgyalab bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/(1935)mdo smad sku 'bum skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —99

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/gyi nye 'dabs stag 'tsher du sku 'khrungs/ 'dzam gling zhi bde'i ded dpon dang gangs can bstan srid kyi don du sku tshe mi shigs rdo rje'i khams su brtan cing mdzad 'phrin phyogs bcur khyab bzhin pa lags so//sdom tshig sho lo ka brgyad pa'i mchan 'grel/༈rdzogs ldan mngon pa mdzod ltar na/'jig rten gyi khams 'dir mi'i 'gro ba chags nas dus yun ring bor rgyu nor sger gnyer byed pa'i lugs srol med pas/mi rnams rang bzhin gyis bsam pa bzang zhing bya spyod legs pas gzhan gyi srog gcod pa dang rdzun smra ba sogs mi dge bcu spangs te/chos/nor/'dod pa/bde ba bzhi yongs su tshang bar longs spyod pa'i skabs la rdzogs ldan gyi dus zhes bya'o//de'i yun tshad ni dus 'khor las/stong ba stong ba mkha' klu lag pa thub pa ri bong can ni rdzogs ldan gyi dus tshad yin no//zhes gsungs pa ltar mi sa ya gcig dang bdun 'bum nyis khri brgyad stong yod do//dge ba bcu'am sde bzhi las sum cha tsam zhig lus pa'i skabs la sum ldan dang /nyis cha tsam zhig lus pa la nyis ldan/cha gcig tsam las med cing 'khrug rtsod shin cargyas pa'i skabs la rtsod ldan gyi dus zhes bya'o//skabs 'dir rig pa'i gnas lnga'i 'chad // tram̐ kyā/sa dang dus su rgyas pa'i dga' ston rnam par dar ba la go — 00 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

bstan bcos la 'jugapa'i sgosogs/sdom tshig sho lo ka dgu ba'i mchan 'grel// rgyal ba sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi rang gzugs ni 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ dpal phyag na rdo rje ste rigs gsum mgon po yin la/ de dag ni ngo bo'am don la rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang ste sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang ngo bo dbyer med pa yin yang rnam pa rang rang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rang gzugs su byon phyir/sdom las/ thugs rje'i cha ni zhes sogs gsungs so//ཿ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang zhes pa ni 'og min du gsang sngags kyi chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba'i sangs rgyas kyi mtshan te/ sangs rgyas rigs brgya/rigs lnga/rigs gsum bcas thams cad la khyab cing rigs de thams cad kyi bdag po yin pas khyab bdag dbang bo dang phyag na rdo rje thogs pas na khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang zhes bya'o//khyab bdag drug pa zhes pa ni rgyal ba rigs lnga sprul ba po khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang nyid yin pas so/ /rgyal ba rigs lnga ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad/mi bskyod the/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'od dpag med/ don yod grub trī r+shadris ba rgya/'i/ khyab bdag ces pa'ang gong du bshad pa ltar rigs skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ — 01—

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/brgya sprul ba bo yin pa'i cha nas so// gzhan yang gsang 'dus smon lam las/ rigs brgya rigs lnga rigs gsum rigs gcig tu/ /'char ba'i sku yi rdo rje'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /lus dben sor sdud bsam gtan rdzogs par shog /ces gsungs pa ltar spro bsdu sna tshogs byed tshul yod do//sdom tshig sho lo ka bcu ba'i mchan 'greg༈ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi mtha' 'am mi shes pa'i gnas las yongs su 'dzin pa'am skyob par byed pas na yongs 'dzin zhes bya'o// / kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i yongs 'dzin khri chen rnam bzhi ni/ khri ngag dbang blo gros rgya mtsho/ thor rgod pa don 'grub rgya mtsho/ lcang skya ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan/ nyi thang ba shes rab sbyin pa bcas so//ga su skarasdigaza' rnams rgyu ba'i yul gyi skar ma yin pas na rgyu skar zhes bya ste/ dus 'khor gyi lugs su rgyu skar nyer brgyad ni nam mkha'i go lar khra btab pa bzhin brtan por g.yon skor gyis gnas shing / de la sgra gcan g.yas skor dang gza' gzhan rnams g.yon skor gyis skyod par 'dod do/ / zla 'dzin nyi 'dzin dang gza' skar —102 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i sgo sogs/'phrod sbyor zhes pa'ang rgyu mtshan 'di la brten nas byung ba zhig go//༈ bdud rtsi sbyin skabs 'dir zla ba'i mngon brjod de/'jig rten khams la tsha gdung gi sdug bsngal sel byed bsil ba'i rang bzhin gyi 'od zer spro bas so//sdom tshig sho lo ka bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pa'i mchan 'grel/ sdom tshig sho lo ka bcu gcig pas sgra tshad spyi dang khyad par du snyan ngag gi dge mtshan brjod pa yin la/ tshul 'di gong du 'grel ba'i mchod brjod skabs rgyas par bshad zin pa ltar ro// sho lo ka bcu gnyis pas ni rang re'i sbyang bya'i snyan ngag gi sdom tshig 'di ni rgyal dbang lnga bas (1617 1682)spyi lo 1647 lor brtsams pa'i dbyangs can dgyes glu gzhir bzhag tshul bstan pa yin no//༈ gna' deng gi mkhas par rlom pa mang bo zhig gis tha snyad rig gnas ni thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang 'thob byed kyi rgyu ru mi 'gro zhing lhag par snyan ngag la sbyangs na sred pa 'phel zhing dam tshig nyams byed kyi rgyu ru 'gro bar bshad pa ni gang zag re 'ga'i rgyud tshod la dpag ste snyan ngag gi ngo bo gleng ba zhig skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —103

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/yin pas mi 'thad tshul gong du yang bshad zin pa ltar yin la/dbyangs can dgyes glu las kyang / tha snyad rig pa 'di rnams phyi rol bas kyang thos bsam du bya bas na snying bo med do snyam na/ khyod rang rnams kyis nyams su len pa'i phyag rgya chen po de'i lhag mthong gi rten gzhir gyar ba'i zhi gnas de la goms pa'i phyi rol ba ji snyed cig 'byung zlos/ khyod rang rnams kyi zhi gnas de yang spang byar mi 'gyar ram/ nged kyi zhi gnas la skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed so'es kyi khyad par yod do zhes smra na/ nged cag tha snyad mkhan po rnams kyi tha snyad rig ṅge la'ang theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed kyi rtsis zin pas bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur 'gro'o zhes smra na ji skad zer/ zhes gsungs/ de'i phyir kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas kyang snyan ngag gi gzhung ni bstan bcos su bgrangs shing /bstan bcos la thar lam phyin ci ma log pa mi ston pa zhig med de/rnam bshad rigs pa las/nyon mongs skyon rnams ma lus 'chos pa dang //ngan 'gro'i srid las skyob byed gang yin pa//'chos skyob yon tan phyir na bstan bcos te//gnyis po 'di dag gzhan gyi lugs la med//ces gsungs pa ltar ro// bstan bcos kyi nges tshig ni legs myur gyi skad dod la shāsnyi zhes bya ste/ 'chos pa'i skad dod la shā sa na dang /skyob pa'i skad dod tra ya gnyis mtshams sbyar ba'o// de yang rgyu nyon mongs dug gsum las bslab pa gsum ldan du 'chos shing /'bras bu ngan 'gro dang srid pa'i sdug bsngal las skyob pa'i 'chos skyob kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pas na bstan bcos zhes bya ba —104 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i sgosogs/yin no// bstan bcos yin na bka' yin pas ma khyab kyang bka' yin na bstan bcos yin pas khyab tshul sogs kyang shes gal che'o//sdom tshig sho lo ka bcu gsumapa'i mchan 'grel/ཿ sho lo ka 'dis ni tshad ma sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa phyi nang thun mong gi bstan bcos yin par khas 'che ba'i stag tshang lo tsā ba sogs bod snga rabs pa kha cig gi 'dod tshul sun 'byin pa yin te/rje rin po che'i sngags rim chen mor/des na sde bdun la sogs pa'i rigs pa'i bstan bcos rnams ni rang gi ston pa sangs rgyas dang /de'i bstan pa lung rtogs gnyis dang / de dag tshul bzhin du nyams su len pa la tshig tsam min pa'i gus pa chen po bskyed pa'i thabs mchog tu shes par byos shig ces gsungs shing / de bzhin du mkhas grub rje sogs kyi gzhung mang bor gtan tshigs rigs pa dang nang don rig pa gnyis la mu bzhi bzhag gnyis ku'i yin par tshad ma mdo 'grel dang bcas pa bzhag pas stag tshang lo tsā ba sogs kyis dgag gzhag mang du mdzad do// de la dbyangs can dgyes glu las/ 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal bo tsong kha ba chen pos/tshad ma rnam 'grel gyis thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam bstan par bzhed pa la/ stag tshang lo tsā bas rig gnas kun shes rtsa 'grel du dgag pa mdzad pa ni/lo tsā ba mkhas pa chen po yin pas dgongs pa skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 105

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/can gyi gsung yin mchi/de ltar min na/sa paṇa gyis/chos kyi grags pa'i gsung rab dri ma med ces 'gyar byang du mdzad pas/gsung rab yin phyin sde snod dang /de'i jogongs 'grel gang rung las ma 'das shing /de yin phyin thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam brjod byar mi byed pa mi srid pas don med kyi dgag pa mi mdzad par zhu/zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs don dang mthun par/ kun mkhyen /pa // ñcha/gang dag gzhan gyi bstan pa ston pa dang //zhes sogs ༈ bstan la bstan pa spyi tsam pa ni rang rang gi grub mtha'i lam srol 'byed mkhan gyi ston pa des bstan pa'i gzhung don cha tshang ba der go dgos shingananang ba'i bstan pa ni bcom ldan 'das kyis gdul bya rnams la bstan pa'i lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid can gyi dam pa'i chos de la zer ba yin te sngar bshad zin pa ltar ro//: stonas ston pa spyi tsam pa ni rang rang gis blos dpyad nas sdug bsngal las thar byed dang /bde ba thob byed kyi 'dod tshul/de sgrub byed kyi gtan tshigs kyi rigs pa bkod pa'i gzhung sna tshogs brtsams pa la brten nas lam srol gsar du 'byed pa bo zhig la go dgos shing /nang ba'i ston pa ni skyon kun zad dang yon tan kun rdzogs pa'i mthar thug gi skyabs gnas shig la go dgos te/khyad par 'phags bstod las/ bdag ni ston pa gzhan spangs nas//—106 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

bstan bcos la'ajug pa'i sgosogs/bcom ldan khyod la skyabs su mchi/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na khyod//skyon mi mnga' la yon tan ldan//zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//༈ mdo 'grelawa skabs 'dir slob dpon phyogs glang gis mdzad pa'i tshad ma kun btus la mdo dang /dpal chos kyi grags pas brtsams pa'i tshad ma sde bdun la 'grel ba zhes bya ste 'di dag gi skor yang gong du bshad zin to//༈ gu stegs la mu zhes pa mtha' dang /stegs ni sdod sa'i stegs bu'i don yin pas/lta ba ngan pa'i mu la sdod sa'i stegs byed pa zhes phyi rol ba rnams la nang ba rnams kyis zur za'i ming btags pa zhig tshegrub mtha' rin phreng du/ltab ngan pa'i mu lastegs 'cha' ba//zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//: byi rol ba phyi nang tsam gyi khyad par ni dkon mchog gsum skyabs gnas yang dag tu khas len mi len gyis 'byed pa yin te/mnyam med jo bo chen pos/phyi ba nang ba skyabs 'gro'i khyad//ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro//'di dag gi skor la bshad bya mang yang snyan t+na/ hā /zlozlo don bsgrib par 'gyur bas gzhung chen mo rnams las skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ — 07

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/sgo de dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos dngos/snyazugangag lus sogs// sdom tshig sho lo ka bcu bzhi ba nas snyan ngag gi gzhung dngos la 'jug pa yin te/ rtsa ba me long ma las/lus ni re zhig 'dod pa yi//don gyi rnam bcad tshig gi phreng //zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rtsom pa bos gang brjod par 'dod pa'i don gyi rnam pa'am ngo bo de nyid rjod par byed pa'i tshig gi phreng ba'am ngag gi rgyun zhig la snyan ngag gi lus zhes bya ba yin no/ / rgya gar dang bod gnyis gang yin yang snyan ngag gi lus ni tshigs bcad de rkang bar bcad pa dang lhug pa ste rkang ba'am tshigs su ma bcad pa dang de gnyis spel ma ste gsum kho nar 'dod cing / sngon rgya nag gis tshigs bcad lhug gnyis su 'dod do/ / deng sang rgya nag gis/ snyan rtsom/ lhug rtsom/ sgrung rtsom/zlos gar rtsom rig glog brnyan rtsom rig ces brjod bya rjod byed gnyis kyi sgo nas lnga ru 'byed la/ (rtsom lus lnga ru dbye stangs 'di rgya nag la'ang lnga bzhi'i las 'gul gyi rjes tsam nas gsar du dar bar bshad)nub phyogs yo rob pa tshos gna' bo'i ke ri si'i (lko )mkhas dbang ya lis si tod kyis spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo sum brgya yas mas su mdzad pa'i snyan ngag rig pa zhes pa'i bcing lugs kyi rjes su 'brangs te snyan —108 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

snyan ngag gi lus sogs/ngag gi lus la/ dung sems mtshon pa'i rtsom rig(yid kyi 'gyur ba brjod pa)don gyi byung ba brjod pa'i rtsom rig(don brjod snyan ngag)'khrab gzhung ngam zlos gar rtsom rig ces brjod bya don gyi sgo nas gsumadu phyes/ u ru si'i com rig smra ba pa'i lin su ci zhes pas kyang / snyan ngag gi lus la rigs gsum kho na ste/ de las mang bar ma byung la 'byung yang mi srid do//zhes bshad skad do// da skabs rang re'i snyan ngag pa mang bos kyang snyan ngag gi lus kyi dbye ba 'byed stangs ni rgya nag gam nub phyogs pa'i lugs de legs par smra ba'am/ legs bshad rtsom lus sogs de las kyang mang ba zhig tu dbye bzhin 'dug mod/ rtsom rig gang yin yang rjod byed kyi tshig la tshigs bcad lhug spel ma gsum las ma 'das shing / de snyan ngag gi lus dang / brjod don thams cad la srog ces rgya bod sngon byon mkhas pa'i bzhed srol de la khyad du 'phags pa'i sdom tshig gi rang bzhin dang ldan no snyam ste/ brjod bya mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas snyan ngag gi lus kyi dbye ba 'jog 〉khan tshor thug med du 'gyur ba'i skyon zhig rang shugs kyis 'bab ༈ sngar byung bod kyi rtsom lus dang de'i ngo bo legs par shes pa'i steng shar nub mkhas pa'i bzhed tshul gyi rtsom lus la nang byan chud par byas na ni yag thog la rgyan gyi dpe ru 'gyar bas 'dir de dag gis 'dod pa'i rtsom lus kyi ngo bo mdo tsam bstod na/rgya nag gis 'dod pa'i rtsom lus lnga las/ 1 skabs 'di'i skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ — 09

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/snyan rtsom ni sngar bshad pa ltar spyir rtsom rig la sgra yangs dog gnyis yod pa'i phyi ma'i dbang du byas nas go dgos shing / snyan rtsom gyi khyad chos brtse dung zab cing rang gshis ldan pa/ gcig sdud che zhing 'char sgo yangs pa/ sgra nyams dod cing sgrig gzhi bar mchong che ba'i thog nas spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba mngon par mtshon nus pa zhig la snyan rtsom zhes bya zhing / snyan rtsom skor gleng ba zhes par/ snyan rtsom ni dbyangs kyi 'dregs 'jog mngon par gsal ba'i rtsom rig tshad ma zhig la zer/ zhes 'byung / de la rnam pa'i cha nas tshigs bcad dang da lta ches cher dar ba'i rang mos sam nges med bcad rtsom gnyis yod la/ nang don gyi cha nas dung sems mtshon pa'i snyan rtsom dang /don brjod snyan rtsom gnyis su dbye bzhin 'dug go/ / gong gsal ltar sgra dog 'jug gi dbang du byas na/ snyan rtsom yin na rtsom rig yin pas khyab kyang rtsom rig yin na snyan rtsom yin pas ma khyab po//2 com lus gnyis pa lhug rtsom ni 'og tu tshig lhug 'chad pa'i skabs su ngo sprod par bya'o//2 sgrung rtsom ni nang don mtshon rgya che zhing / 'bri tshul rang dbang dang ldan pa/ spyi tshogs mtshon shugs che zhing / mi sna'i rang gshis mngon par gsal ba/ mi sna'i sems khams dang khor yug sogs zhib tshags che ba/ byang rim cha tshang ba/ dbyangs kyi 'degs 'jog de 'dra mngon gsal rā che ba/ gar stegs dang dus tshod kyi tshad bkag —110 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

snyan ngag gi lus sogs/med pa zhig yin pas mi sna dang byung rim/ khor yug bcas ni sgrung rtsom la med du mi rung ba'i grub cha zhig yin par gleng / rang res sgrung rtsom mam brtsams sgrung 'di rtsom lus shig tu 'dod pa ni gsar bshad cig yin mod/ sgrung rtsom 'bri srol ni ches snga mo'i dus nas yod de/ gling rje ge sar rgyal bo'i sgrung dang / gzhon nu zla med kyi gtam rgyud/ bya mgrin sngon zla ba'i rtogs brjod/ gtam pad ma'i tshal gyi zlos gar/ bya sprel gtam rgyud sogs sgrung rtsom ma yin zhes su zhig gis smra/ sgrung rtsom la rnam pa'i thog nas/ zin tho'i sgrung rtsom dang / yig bskur gyi sgrung rtsom/ gtam gleng gi sgrung rtsom sogs yod la/ nang don gyi cha nas brtse dung mtshon pa/ skyi g.ya' ba/ dmag 'khrug nyes bsags/ rjes lus/ 'phel rgyas/ phugs bsam sogs mang du yod chog cing / rgyun ldan gyi dbye tshul ni/ sgrung rtsom ches thung ba dngan(skar ma gcig gi sgrung rtsom mam sgrung thung yig brgya ma yang zer/)sgrung thung / sgrung 'bring / sgrung ring bcas bzhi ru dbye bzhin 'dug go/ /sgrung rtsom gyi srog shing gtso bo ni mi sna yin zhing / phyi rnam bkod 'bri/sems khams bkod 'bri/ sbyor ba bkod 'bri sogs 'bri thabs sna tshogs yod do//4 rang re bod kyis zlos gar gyi ngo bo ji 'dra zhig la 'dod pa dang de'i gzhung lugs ci yod sogs mdor bsdus shig gong du bshad zin pa ltar yin la/ snyan ngag me long ma las/ gang yang mtshams sbyor yan lag dang / /'jug pa'i yan lag mtshan nyid sogs/ /lung gzhan dag tu brjod 'di yang / /rgyan nyid du ni bdag skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ — 11—
