ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/cag 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar rgya gar du zlos gar gyi bstan bcos bha ra ta sogs mang bo yod cing / der mtshams sbyor gyi yan lag lnga dang / 'jug pa'i yan lag bcu drug rgyan byed pa sogs mtshan nyid sum cu rtsa drug sgeg pa'i yan lag sogs mang bo zhig gsungs shing de dag thams cad kyang snyan ngag gi rgyan du 'dod pa las lus su ma bzhag kyang deng skabs shar nub rgyal khab mang bos zlos gar rtsom rig ces rtsom lus shig tu 'dod pa'i dbang du byas na/ 'jar pan gyi zlos gar gzhung lugs smra ba ho'u kru'u kun kri rmu yis/ zlos gar ni mi'i gzugs dbyibs brten bya byas te gar mkhan/ 'khrab gzhung / gar khang / lta mkhan bcas rgyu rkyen gnyis zung 'dzoms pa'i 'jig rten mngon gyar gyi zlos gar rang bzhin dang / mi'i mthong tshor dang thos tshorjo brgyud nas yid sems 'gugs pa'i 'gul skyod sgyu rtsal zhig yin zhes pa'i sdom tshig cig bzhag yod pa ltar re zhig go chog par 'dod la/ de la bden dngos gtso bor 'bri ba'i gtam brjod zlos gar dang / bsam don gtso bor 'bri ba'i zlos gar zhes rigs gnyis su dbye ba'am dbye ba 'byed stangs gzhan dang gzhan yang mang / gar mkhan dang / 'brab gzhung / lta mkhan/ 'khrab ra bcas ni zlos gar gyi rtsa ba'i rgyu rkyen bzhi yin par bshad do//u ru si'i rtsom pa bo kor er cis/ 'khrab gzhung ni rtsom rig las ches dka' kheg che ba'i rnam pa zhig ste/ rgyu mtshan ni zlos gar gyis 'khrab ston khrod kyi mi sna so sos rang nyid kyi skad cha dang 'gul skyod la brten nas rang nyid kyi khyad chos tshur —1 2 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

snyan ngag gi lus sogs/snang byed pa'i blang bya 'don pa las/ rtsom pa bo'i gsal 'debs mi mkho ba red/ces brjod 'dug go//de ltar na rang re bod la mtshon na gong gsal gyi khyad chos 'dzoms pa'i zlos gar rtsom lus smra ba dang brtsams chos ni phyogs gang thad nas skas rim dang bo'i tshad du yod ces bdag gis 'dod do// ra glog brnyan rtsom rig ni rtsom pa bo mchog gyar zhig gi bsam blo dang smyug rtsal gcig bus mi chog par mdzes zlol rig pa dang sgra bskyed rig pa/rdzas 'gyur rig pa/'phrul chas rig pa sogs 'dzoms dgos pa du ma zhig yod pas spyir 'dzam gling la dar nas yun ring ma 'gor zhing khyad par du rang re bod la mtshon na sta gon gyi tshad tsam red snyam/'o na ji 'dra zhig la glog brnyan rtsom rig zer zhe na/rtsom rig gzhung lugs gnad bsdus las/rtsom rig gi cha nas bshad na brnyan gzugs rtsom rig ni deng rabs kyi tshan rig lag rtsal gyi mthu nus las byung ba'i sgyu rtsal gyi rnam pa gsar ba zhig ste rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi rigs khyad par ba zhig yin/zhes brjod pa ltar te/ rtsom rig gi mi sna'i snang brnyan dang yul ljongs sogs klog mkhan rang gi rtog dpyod la brten nas myong mi dgos par ltad mo ba rang gis dngos su mthong thos byas pa la brten nas myong rol phun sum tshogs pa byed thub pas rtsom lus gzhan las khyab rgya che zhing sgyu rtsal khyad du 'phags pas 'dzam gling rang bzhin gyis 'phel rgyas su 'gro bzhin pa lags na/rang res kyang glog brnyan rtsom rig gi gzhung lugs gsar rtsom dang / mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —113

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/glog brnyan rtsom rig gang mang zhig gsar bskrun byed dgos pa ni dus su babs shing bshol thabs med pa'i las 'gan gtso bo zhig go//༈ a ri'i rtsom pa po sa khi zi rdor gyis/ snyan ngag ni mi yi dbang bor 'jigs skul byed cig dang / mi gsod rmas thub byed cig tu ngos 'dzin gyin yod/ ces dang / u ru si'i rtsom gzhung smra ba pe len si cis/ mi rigs gang zhig yin yang snyan ngag ni mi rigs de nyid mtshon par byed pa'i me long lta bu zhig yin/ zhes bshad myong la/don dngos kyi cha nas kyang snyan ngag ni mi'i rigs kyi blo gros kyi nying bcud dang sems kyi mdzes pa/ ngag gi sgyu rtsal/ 'tsho ba'i snang brnyan phyogs bsdus kyis mtshon pa'i tshon ldan brnyan 'phrin ngo ma zhig yin zhes brjod chog yon kyang deng skabs mang bo zhig gis/ nub phyogs snyan ngag pa sa thes/ snyan ngag 'bri ba ni zer 'don byed pa yin la/ther 'don byed pa ni 'gyar ldog gtong ba zhig red/ ces dang / de bzhin du nye rabs mkharā dbang dge chos dang don 'grub rgyal sogs kyis sun 'byin dang dgag sgrub rang bzhin gyi rtsom yig re 'ga' bris pa'i rjes su zhib dpyod med par 'brangs khul gyis rtsom rig zer ba sdigs dmod gtong byed cig tu ngos 'dzin bzhin pa ni phyogs lhung gi lta tshul zhig ste/ snyan ngag pa kor er cis/ rtsom rig gi 'os 'gan ni spyi tshogs steng gi mi bzang don bzang gi bya ba rnams phyogs bsdoms kyis khyab bsgrags byas te mi ya rabs kyi rigs la bsngags brjod dang sngon bskul byed rgyu dang / mi ngan don ngan gyi bya —114 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

snyan ngag gi lus sogs/bar mtshang 'byin dang ther 'don/ spyod pa ma rabs kyi rigs la ngan brjod dang dgag pa byed rgyu de yin/ zhes dang / rgya nag gi rtsom pa bo lu'u zhun gyis/ sgyu rtsom gyi 'gan 'khri ni hur brtson dang yar bskyed/ lag len bsgrub pa'i bya spyod la phan rkyen ster rgyu de yin/zhes dang / snyan rtsom rig pa'i shes bya gnad bsdus las/ rmongs pa'i gnyid las sad byed 'brug gi sgra/ /gshis ngan dug sbrul tshang gtor gnam lcags thog /ya rabs snang ba'i lam ston nam mkha'i nor/ /dgongs gzhir byas pa snyan rtsom mchog rtu bsngags/ /dri ngan 'thul ba'i khyi lud bsreg pa dang / /g.yang sar 'khrid pa'i the'u rang lam mkhan dang / /dran rig smyo byed dug gi khu ba rnams//mi gtsang phyags lud lta bu'i dor bya yin//zhes gsungs pa ltar blang dor gyi gnas la mi mongs pa'i sgo nas phyogs su ma lhung ba'i rtsom rig gi dbu ma'i lam la bsnyeg ci thub byed rgyu ni shin tu gal chen po red snyam/ don 'grub rgyal sogs kyi 'dod pa ngo ma yang de yin te/ kho'i bstod pa bklag pa'i 'char snang las/ deng rabs rtsom gyi lha lam ngor/ /sgyu rtsal 'phur mda' bgrod pa'i tshe// bstod pa'i bong bu la zhon te/ /mkha' la 'phags 'dod ngal ba'i rgyu/ /zhes dang / a khu 'brong gi dbang bo rnams/ /gser las grub ces bstod mkhas pa'i/ /ri bong blo ldan 'di dag gi/ /gtam la cha 'jog ci zhig mchis// zhes dang /bstod pa byas na los chog ste/ /ha cang bstod pa thal che na/ /zhes sogs bstod smad thal che ba'i mtha' gnyis dang bral dgos tshul sogs mang du brjod yod pa'i phyir ro//skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —115

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ ༈ gnyis pa zhar byung 'khrul sel gyi skabs kun mkhyen sdom tshig las/ tshigs bcad las gzhan rgyun chags med pa'i phyir/ /rgyun chags zur du 'byed pa shin tu 'khrul//zhes gsungs pa ni sa skya paṇa ṭi ta'i sdeb sbyor me tog chun por/tshigs su bcad dang rkyang ba dang //rgyun chags zhes bya rnam pa gsum//tshig gi sbyor ba byed 'dod pa'i//mkhas pa rnams kyi 'jug ngogs yin/ /zhes dang / rgyun chags pa de'ang gnyis te/ rgyun chags bcad pa dang ma bcad pa'o/ / de la rgyun chags bcad pa ni 'dir tshigs su bcad pa'i bye brag yin pas tshigs su bcad pa nyid kyi nang du bshad par bya'o/ / rgyun chags ma bcad pa ni/ sdeb sbyor gyi mtshan nyid lci yang la sogs pas phye la/ bya ba ston pa'i sgra yod pa/ rkang ba bzhir ma bcad pa ste/ de skad du yang sdeb sbyor gyi tshoms las/ rkang ba dag gis ma bcad pa//gang la yi ge sbrel legs yod//bya ba'i tshig gis gsal byas pa//de ni rgyun chags las gzhan min/ /zhes 'dod pa'i phyir ro// zhes gsungs pa de la zur za ba ste/sdeb sbyor gyi gzhung du bstan pa'i rgyun chags ni tshigs bcad kho na ste rgyun chags yin na tshigs bcad yin pas khyab phyir rgyun chags tshigs bcad las zur du 'byed pa 'khrul ba yin tshul bsgrubs pa'o//yang sdom las/ rgyun chags ma bcad sdeb sbyor bzhin yin na//rkang bas gcod dgos rang gi tshig dang 'gal//zhes gsungs pa ni/sa paṇa mkhas 'jug las/ rgyun chags ma bcad pa ni sdeb sbyor rgyun —116 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

snyan ngag gi lus sogagachags dang 'dra la/ zhes gsungs 'dug pas rkang bas ma bcad pa'i rgyun chags shig yod pa de sdeb sbyor bzhin yin na/ me tog chun por/ sdeb sbyor la rkang bas gcod dgos par gsungs pas sa paṇa rang gi brtsams chos mkhas 'jug dang me tog chun po gnyis la nang 'gal yod par bsgrubs pa'o//yang sdom las/ gang yang rkang bas ma bcad lhug pa la/ /sdeb sbyor bsta mi 'byung tshigs bcad la//rkang bzhi mi dgos mngon pas rgyas 'geb pa//zhwa dpe lcam la 'geb pa kho mar zad//ces gsungs pa ni/ sdeb sbyor gyi gzhu/ gang du'ang rkang bas ma bcad pa'i tshig lhug la yi ge lci yang gi rtags mi 'byung zhing / yang tshigs bcad la rkang ba bzhi mi dgos pa'i sgrub byed du mngon pa kun btus kyi lung /tshigs su bcad pa ni rkyang ba dang / gnyis pa dang gsum pa dang /bzhi ba dang / lnga ba dang / drug pa rnams su yod do/ /zhes pa'i lung drangs shing des rgyas 'geb byed pa ni zhwa dpe lham 'geb kyi dpe kho nar zad pasami 'thad tshul bsgrubs pa'o//rgyun chags la tshigs su bcad ma bcad gnyis yod med sogs kyi skor la dpang lo tsā ba dang zur mkhar ba/ lnga ba chen mo sogs dngan yang sa paṇa dang snar thang ba/ rin spungs pa/mang thos klu sgrub/sa skya ngag chos sogs sngon byon mkhas par bzhed tshul mi mthun pa gnyis yod 'dug la/ phal cher zhig gi gsung dngos lag la son dka' bas zhib phrar ma nges mod/ rang gi rmongs blor shar tshod kyis dogs gcod mdo tsam zhus na/ sa paṇa gyis me tog chun por rgyun skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 117

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/chags la bcad ma bcad gnyis yod pa dang tshig lhug la'ang yi ge lci yang gi rtags 'god dgos par gsungs pa de sdeb sbyor rin 'byung dang snyan ngag me long ma sogs kyi dgongs don gzhir bzhag ste bshad pa yin na mkhas 'jug dang nang 'gal yod par ma zad yongs su grags pa'i snyan gzhung dang sdeb sbyor gyi gzhung don dang yang mi mthun la/ sdeb sbyor gyi tshigs bcad la rkang ba bzhi mi dgos pa'i sgrub byed kyi lung don de yang mi 'byor te/ sdeb sbyor gyi lugs la/rkang ba zhes pa bod kyi tsheg khyim lta bur go dgos pas/ rkang ba gcig pa'i dpe la/ blo/ mchog rgyal/ gyur/ lta bu dang / rkang ba gnyis pa'i dper/ dpal ldan/ shes bya/ kun mkhyen/ khyod ni lta bu 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ / de'i phyir dpe de yang zhwa dpe lham 'geb du song 'dug pas/ dbyangs can dgyes glu dang kun mkhyen sdom tshig las bkag pa gnad du song mod/ phran gyis bsam na/ sa paṇa gyi sdeb sbyor me tog chun por gsungs pa ni spyir rgya gar na rgyun chags ma bcad pa zhig 'bri srol yod de/ de ni tshigs su ma bcad pas tshigs bcad spyi dang mi 'dra/ lci yang gis spras pas rkyang ba'am lhug pa spyi dang mi 'dra bar gsungs la/ de lta bu'i rgyun chags ni bod 'gyur gyi snyan ngag dang sdeb sbyor dag tu med pa lta ci/ rgya gar rang la'ang sdeb sbyor gyi gzhung la shin tu mkhas pa kha cig la rgyus yod pa tsam yin tshul/ me tog chun po rang gi gzhung du'ang / 'di lta bu'i sdeb sbyor ni/ deng sang rgya gar na sdeb sbyor ba ches che ba mang du thos pa 'ga' zhig la grags pa tsam du zad kyi/ thams cad la grags pa ma yin la/ sbyor —118 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

snyan ngag gi lus sogs/ba'ang ches shin tu nyung bar snang ngo / /zhes dang / 'dir skabs ma yin pas rnam par dbye bar ma byas so/ / zhes gsungs la/ khams 'grel du si tu'i lung drangs par/ shin tu grags chung zhing sbyor ba nyung ba ma gtogs/ daṇa ṭa kur grags pa'i sdeb sbyor rgyun chags ma bcad pa zhig rgya gar na'ang yod pa yin 'dug kyang / gzhung 'di dang sdeb sbyor rin 'byang sogs la ni bsgrig tu med/ ces gsungs so/ / des na sa paṇa sgye sdeb sbyor me tog chun por rgyun chags la bcad ma bcad gnyis yod tshul gdams pa de rgya gar gyi sdeb sbyor ba kha cig gi lugs dang / yang gzhung der sdeb sbyor la rkang bas gcod dgos par gsungs pa ni yongs grags sdeb sbyor gyi lugs ltar bshad pa gzhung don cha tshang la bltas na ra 'phrod thub pas mkhas 'jug dang nang 'gal med par ma zad sdeb sbyor gyi gzhung shin tu mang bo la gzigs rgya che ba'i rtags su 'dug go snyam/ yang snyan ngag sogs kyi gzhung nas bstan pa bzhin du spyir tshigs bcad kyang nges par du rkang ba bzhi ldan zhig yin dgos pa'i nges pa med de/ rgya bod mkhas pa'i brtsams chos khrod na rkang ba gsum can dang drug can sogs ci rigs shig 'byung bas/ sa paṇa gyis spyir tshigs bcad la rkang ba bzhir ma nges pa'i sgrub byed du mngon pa kun btus kyi lung de drangs par byas na mkhas mang gi dgongs pa gcig tu 'bab cing don dngos dang yang mthun par snyam ste/(phran gyi bsam tshul 'di'i rgyab rten la rin spungs pa'i mi 'jigs seng ge'i nga ro sogs kyang yod do//)tshul 'dir mkhyen rgya yangs shing mos pa yod pa dag gis skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ — 19

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/gzu bo'i blos dpyad par 'tshal lo//༈ rgya gar la sdeb sbyor gyi dbang du byas pa'i tshigs bcad sgrig stangs kyi cha nas dbyangs kyi yi ge bgrang ba dang gsal byed kyi yi ge bgrang ba gnyis yod la/ rtsa ba me long ma las/ de yi spros pa mtha' dag ni/ /sdeb sbyor gzhung du nges par bstan/ /rig de snyan ngag rgya mtsho ni//zab mo brgal 'dod rnams kyi gru//zhes rgya gar ba la mtshon na rig pa de ni snyan ngag gi rgya mtsho zab cing rgya che ba brgal bar 'dod pa dag gi gru dang gzings lta bu yin par gdams mod/bod la rgya gar ji bzhin du lci yang gi sgo nas tshigs bcad sgrig stangs med pas/ kun mkhyen sdom tshig 'dir yang / dang bo rab gces spros pa gzhan du tshol//zhes de yang rig pa'i sgo 'phel ba la rab tu gces pa ste bzang mod/bod kyi snyan ngag bshad pa'i skabs la mkho gal mi che bas rgyas par skabs gzhan nas 'tshol zhing shes dgos par gdams pa'o//yang gsal snang mdzod du/sdeb sbyor gyi rig pa de yang snyan ngag gi skabs 'dir rab tu gces shing mkho bas zhes pa ni rgya gar gyi dbang du byas te gsungs pa'o//༷ spyir tsheg khyim gsum ldan gyi tshigs su bcad pa nas tsheg khyim lnga bcu drug cu rkang ba gcig tu byas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa'ang yod la/ de la bod rang gi sdeb sbyor gyi dbang du byas na/ snyan rtsom gyi rnam pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dang / glu tshig gi rnam pa/ mgur tshig gi rnam pa/ 'bel gtam gyi rnam pa sogs nang gses rigs —120 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

snyan ngag gi lus sogs/mang du yod/༈ bod 'gyar gyi sdeb sbyor dang snyan ngag gi skabs nas bstan pa'i tshigs b.rād dam sho lo ka yin na rkang ba bzhi ldan yin pas khyab/ tshig lhug gi dbang du byas na sho lo ka gcig ni tsheg khyim so gnyis la byed/ bzhed tshul mi mthun pa re yod mod grags che ba'i dbang du byas na sho lo ka sum brgya bam po gcig tu brtsi'o/ / sho lo ku'am shu log ni tshigs su bcad pa'i don te/ bod rang la tsheg khyim gyi grangs ka sogs sdeb tshul la sna tshogs shig yod kyang / gsar du rtsom rig la 'jug pa bo rnams la mtshon na thog mar tsheg grangs nyung ba'i rigs la 'bad dgos shing / rim gyis tsheg grangs mang bo la'ang goms par bya ste/ sa skya'i bka' 'bum khrod rkyang ba gcig la tsheg khyim nyis brgya nas sum brgya'i bar byas pa'ang yod do/ / bam po zhes pa ni rnam grangs mang bo phyogs gcig tu 'dus pa'am bsdoms pa'i don te/ chun po dang rigs 'dra'o/ / rgya gzhung dag tu bam po zhes pa'i brda chad 'di med mod/ bod kyis rgyud rtsom/ rgya nag gis mdo rtsom zer ba ltar gzhung la bsre bslad dang chad lhag mi 'byung ba'i ched du bod btsan po'i dus skabs su rang re'i sngon byon lo paṇa dag gis gsar du bsnan par bshad do// yongs grags su sho lo ka sum brgya ste tsheg khyim sum stong brgya dang nyi shu la bam po gcig tu brtsi la/ sho lo ka sum brgya lnga la bcu bam po gcig dang bzhi brgya la bam po gcig tu byas pa'ang yod do/ / sngon byon mkhas pa'i zhal rgyun du/ bam po sngon dang le'u mjug/rtsom ming gang yin sngon laltos//skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —121—

ngag rig sgyu 'phul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/rtsom mkhan gang yin mjug la ltos/ /zhes 'byang ste/ tshul 'di lta bu'ang nges par du shes dgos pa'i gnas yin sne//lu bod mi rigs ni tshigs bcad snyan ngag ches cher dar zhing de la do snang dang gtsigs 'dzin byed mkhan zhig yin pas/ yi ge ma dar ba'i yar sngon gyi stag ri gnyan gzigs sogs kyi skabs su'ang /rmi bzang ni rta bzang zhig /nyin zhing ni phag tshal na//mtshan zhing ni bying bar mchis//dgra'am ni zun ci mang // zhes dang / chab chab ni pha rol na//yar chab ni pha rol na//phyi'i bu ni phyi'i bu ste//lha yi ni sras po bzhugs//zhes sogs mang du byung bas kyang mtshon thub po// 'on kyang kha cig gis bod kyi snyan ngag yin na tshigs bcad yin pas khyab pa dnganatshigs bcad dang snyan ngag gnyis khyab mnyam du'ang smra bar byed mod/ snyan rtsom rig pa'i shes bya gnad bsdus las/ tshigs bcad yin la snyan ngag min pa dang //snyan ngag yin la tshigs bcad min pa'ang yod//snyan rtsom yin min ngo bo'i sgo nas 'byed/ /tshigs bcad snyan ngag khyab mnyam 'dod pa 'khrul/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar de gnyis khyab mnyam du 'dod pa ni shin tu 'khrul ba yin no/ /de gnyis khyab mnyam yin min mu bzhi'i sgo nas kyang nges pa rnyed sla ste/tshigs bcad yin la snyan rtsom ma yin pa ni sum rtags rtsa ba lta bu/snyan com yin la tshigs bcad ma yin pa ni lhug rtsom snyan ngag dang (kha cig gis de ni lhug rtsom yin pa las snyan rtsom min par brjod srid mod/ngas ni snyan rtsom yin min ngo ngo'i sgo nas 'jog pa las tshigs su bcad ma bcad tsam —122 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

snyan ngag gi lus sogs/gyis 'jog gin med//deng gi rang mos snyan ngag gam nges med bcad rtsom lta bu/ gnyis ku'i yin pa/ zhang zhung bas brtsams pa'i rā ma ṇa'i gtam rgyud dang / slob dpon dpa' bo'i skyes rabs so bzhi ba lta bu/ gnyis ku'i gang yang ma yin pa/ dbyangs gsal lta bu 'jog srol yod de/ dpyad pas 'jug par 'tshal lo//༈ tshigs bcad snyan ngag 'bri srol sngon rgya gar nag sogs su'ang ches cher dar mod da lta bod ma gtogs rgyal khab dang mi rigs gzhan na 'bri mkhan ches nyung bar snang la/ da lta'i bod rtsom tshigs bcad snyan ngag tu rlom pa mang bo zhig kyang rkang bar bcad pa tsam las tshad ldan snyan ngag cig tu bgrang thabs med pa klog rol byed mkhan dag la shin tu gsal ba bzhin no// 'di ni rtsom pa bo dag gis nges par du do snang byed dgos pa'i gnas gal chen zhig yin te/ bod mkhas pas/ 'di na grong ba rnams kyi tshig /rang dgar rkang bar bcad pa la/ /snyan ngag mkhan du 'dzin pa rnams//kye ma 'khrul ba'i mtshang re che/ /zhes thugs shin tu ma rangs pa'i gsung gnang yod pa bzhin yin no/ / des na tshigs bcad sdeb stangs dang / ngal gso'i 'degs 'jog sogs legs por shes na rtsom lus gang gi sgo nas rtsom rig la 'jug kyang skad cha mnyen zhing 'jibs pa sogs kyi khyad chos la rang shugs kyis dbang 'byor ba yin phyir/ 'dir dpe mtshon 'ga' 'god par bya'o//skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ — 23

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/cheg khyim gsum la/sngon las zab//dmigs 'dun gcig /gling ga 'dir//lhan cig 'dzoms//lta bu dang /yang na/brjod bya zab// rjod byed snyan// mdzes pa'i nyams//lhun gyis grub//lta bu'o//tsheg khyim bzhi ba/phyi yi chas gos//gcig mtshungs min yangan/sha rus khrag rgyun//gcig las grub yod//lta bu dnganayang na/lo rgyus glegs bam//—124 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

snyan ngag gi lus sogs/dal gyis bklags tshe//sngon byon mes po'i//mdzad rjes rtogs byung //lta bu'o//cheg khyim lnga ba la rigs gnyis yod de/1 gangs dkar bo'i ljongs kyi//bod mdo dbus khams gsum//sems a long sbrel gnas//nged shes rig gling yin//lta bu dang /yang na/chos mdo sngags dar sa//byams snying rje che sa//bod kha ba can po//lho 'dzam gling rgyan red//lta bu'o//2 srol rgyun rmang gzhi brtan// gsar byang rig pas mdzes//gangs jo'i lo rgyus la//dbu khyud gsar ba bris//lta bu dang /skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —125

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/yang na/sngon smon las kyis ded//rigs zhen zab mos bskul//slob gso'i khur chen de//rang rang phrag tu blangs//lta bu'o//tsheg khyim drug la/gsol ba lha la btab yod//'dun ma bod la bcangs yod//gangs ri'i dbu 'phang bstod pa'i//'gyur med dam bca' bzhag yod//lta bu dnganayang na/ dkyus ring spyan gyi mdangs la//brtse chen gzi byin 'khyud pa'i//smra ston tshangs sras lha mo//'dab brgyad snying la bzhugs shig/lta bu'o//—126 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

snyan ngag gi lus sogs/tsheg khyimabadugal porigs gsum yod de/1 chol gsum gzhon skyes g.yu sbrang tshogs//shes rig pad ma'i tshal la rtsen//thu stod btsan po'i stobs dpung che//yang bskyar ngom pa'i rten 'brel 'grigs//lta bu dnganayang na/rma klung bu mo sgeg pa'i 'gram//rang byung brag ri mdzes pa'i 'gram//shes rig nor bu'i slob gling zhes//don ldan mtshan gyi snyan pa 'bur//lta bu'o//2 sngon byon rgyal blon dang lo paṇa//thugs stobs brag ri la bcol 'dug/gsar skyes shes yon pa'i sde dpungan/mdun skyod spobs sems kyis brtas yod//yang na/ lta bu dnganam bos blo gsal gyi bung ba//ma lus chol gsum nas 'bur yongan/ma bsgrigs las mthun gyi dge slob//skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 127—

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ma bcos dam tshig gis sbrel yod//lta bu'o//3 sgra snyan ngag mngon brjod zlos gar//rtsis dkar nag bzo gso nang rig/deng rig gsar 'bum sde'i mngar kha//gang mkho mkho sbyang yul 'di yin//lta bu dnganayang na/nang snga langs rtsa tshig blor 'dzin//dgong 'phyi nyal dpe mang blta klog/dus rgyun par lus sems do dam//kho brtson ldan slob ma'i khyad chos//lta bu'o//tsheg khyimabargyad ba 0rigs gsum yod de/1 rigs zhen khrag rtsa drag tu rgyas shengan/lhag bsam zla ba'i rang mdangs rdzogs pa'i//gzhung lugs 'bum mkhyen bshes gnyen du ma//skal ldan slob bu'i mgon du bzhugs yod//lta bu dang /—128 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

snyan ngag gi lus sogs/yang na/rigs zhen mthon po'i ri rtser chas tshe /la rgya'i ki sgra rgyang la bskur 'dod//nges 'byung rnal mas sems rgyud brlan dus//g.yang spang mtshams kyi ri khrod dran 'ong //lta bu'o//2 phyi'i kun spyod ya rabs tshul dang ldan//nang bsam blo gna' deng gzhung la mos//dus rgyun par thos brtson mi lhod pa'i//khyed mthar phyin 'dzin grwar re ltos zab//yang na/ lta bu dang /rdza lhun chags sprin gyi stod gos can//lha gnyan po a mye khyung mgon red//chos bshad sgrub rgyal mtshan mthon po can//dgon dga' ldan bkra shis 'byung gnas red//lta bu'o//3 mi rigs kyi dar rgud snying la gzan//nang 'khrug gi 'khor lor zhen pa log/gnya' gnon gyi 'og nas am gtsigs bsdams//skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ — 29

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/rang sems kyi me long khyod tshor bstan//lta bu dnganayang na/dus rabs kyi 'pho 'gyar glog las skyen//tshan rig gi ngo mtshar sto las 'gongs//bod pa yi 'grul bzhud rta la bcol//rjes lus kyi mtshang ngan yang yang thob//lta bu'o/ /tsheg khyim dgu nga la rigs gsuzasayod de/1 rigs zhen gad rgyangs mtho ba gdong lnga'i khyu//bden don gangs dkar ri las glal ba'i sgra//ma bzod zug rngu 'byin pa'i spyang mo'i tshogs//gang na mya ngan tshig gi sbyor bar brtson//yang na/ lta bu dang /ngo mtshar bcu phrag rig pa'i dbyig gi nor//gangs ri'i bang mdzod rgyan du rdzogs pa'i gtam//phyogs kyi bu mo'i mgrin glur brdzus pa'i mthus//gling bdun gzur gnas dran dbang khri 'bum bkug/lta bu'o//2 nga tsho mdun skyod kyi lam sne phra mor//—130 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

snyan ngag golus sogs/'gal rkyen phra rags kyi bu yug 'tshub kyang / /gzhom med spobs sems kyi gom shugs brtan na//gangs ljongs gsar ba yi rdzogs ldan bsu nges//lta bu dang /yang na/phyi nang 'phel rgyas kyi rlabs thugs rgod pas//cher rlom chu srin 'ga' bag la zha yang //phrag dog zug rngu yi ca co gnyom po//rigs mthun khor yug na rtag par sgrog skad//lta bu'o//3 gdong dmar bod pa'i 'phel rgyas kyi gzhi rtsa//gna' deng zung 'brel slob gso la rag las//'gag med tshe srog phra mo yi rgyu ba//rang gi skad dang yi ge las mi 'dug/yang na/ lta bu dang /byams ldan pha ma rgyang ring du bzhag cing //skyid pa'i pha sa dran yul du bskyur nas//rwa rgya'i rdul dmar 'tshub klong du 'ong don//mi tsher mdzes sdug snod pa yi ched yin//lta bu'o//skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —131—

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/tsheg khyim bcu ba la rigs gsum yod de/1 sngon byang gi lo rgyus me long la mjal tshe /khengadro dregs kyi ri nas 'bab thabs shig mi 'dug/da lta yi rang rigs nyams rgud la bltas pas//'gyod gdung gi rma kha sos thabs shig ma byungan/lta bu dang /yang na/dus rabs kyi 'pho 'gyur ji 'dra zhig rgod kyangan/rang nor gyi byin rlabs rgyun 'dzin la brtson bzhin//gsar byang gi shes rig nang 'dren la spro ba//sprel srir+sha gyi gdung rgyud bod pa yi khyad chos//lta bu'o//2 lag gser smyug phra mo 'khyug 'khyug gis rtsen te//khas la rgya gleng ba'i jig nyams kyis mi chog/phyi'i dgra dpung dmar bo'i kha gtad du langs shing //nang mthun sgril dpal be'u'i gser ris la brtson dgos//yang na/ lta bu dang /shar rgya nag thang gi rgyal khams kyis mtshon pa'i//phyogs rgyal khab che phra stobs dpung gis bcom mdzad//bod gdong dmar mi dbang srong btsan gyi phyag rjes//—132 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

snyan ngag gi lus sogs/bsub ma thub rma rgyal gangs rtse na 'tsher 'dug/3 dal brgyad 'byor bcu yi mi lus rin chen 'di//rgyu dpe gang la'ang bsam kyang rnyed par dka'//dgos 'dod rin chen gyi bgo skal thob pa'i tshe//don med chud zos su shor na yid re phangs//lta bu dnganayang na/mi tshe'i snying bo de mtha' med yon tan yin//bde skyid rtsa ba 'ang nang sems nyid las byungan/nang bstan rig gzhung la sbyangs pa zab pa'i bur//ma rtogs log rtog gi sgo mo rang 'gag yin//lta bu'o//zag khyim bcu gcigal la rigs gnyis yod de/1 spyi mthun las kyis grub pa'i gangs dkar gyi zhing khams//ma brtsigs gnam la gzengs pa'i ri tshogs kyi rngam brjid//ma khrid lhod kyis 'bab pa'i brgyad ldan gyi chu bo//sum rtsen ngo mtshar brkus pa'i yul mchog de gang yin//yang na/ lta bu dang /pha mtha' mig gis mi zin spang thang gi rgyan char//skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —133

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/rta nor lug gsum bag yangs rtse dga' yis myos 'dug/tshan rtsal 'phul gyis bzhengs 'dra'i slob gling gi khor yug/yig rigs sna tshogs klog pa'i dbyangs rta yis khyab 'dug/lta bu'o/2kha ba'i dar rgud phrag la babs pa'i phyi rabs pa//blo dang lang tsho'i bkrag mdangs 'tsher ba'i gzhon skyes tshogs//ma 'ongs mi tshe'i mdzes rgyan 'tshol zhing rang rigs ched//thag thag dus tshod mda' rtser 'grogs te slob la brtson/ /yang na/ lta bu dang /yun ring shes rig bdud rtsis bskyangs pa'i slob bu dag/sbyangs 'bras rin chen rgyan du thogs te phebs shul na//mi rtag sgyu ma'i rang mtshang ston la ches dpa' ba'i//rlung 'tshub khrod kyi sdong lo ser bos skyo ba byin//lta bu'o//3 'bad 'bad dung dung gis bsgrubs pa'i 'khor ba'i phun tshogs//sdug bden zo chun bzhin 'khor ba'i zel thag yin 'dug/sha rus khrag rgyun gyis 'brel ba'i gnyen nye mdza' bshes//thar ba'i them skas la 'dzegs pa'i 'gal rkyen yin 'dug/yang na/ lta bu dang /than thun rig pa yis tshim pa'i blo chung grogs pos//—134 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

snyan ngag gi lus sogs/zab brling gzhung lugs kyi rgya mtsho'i pha mtha' mi mthongan/shag shag 'bab sgra yis khengs pa'i rdza chu sil ma//rma 'bri'i mchod yon gyi klong na grag med 'gul med//lta bu'o//tsheg khyim bcu gnyis la la rigs gnyis yod de/1 lus sgyu ma'i phung bor sna tshogs rgyan cha yis zas kyangan/nang yon tan med na rgyal mtshan khog stong dang 'dra bas//yul gnyen nye dran pa'i skyo bar bzod sgom zhig byas te//dus da lan yong ba'i nying dgos 'grub pa la brtson cig/yang na/ lta bu dnganabaka' mdo rgyud kun la sbyong blo med pa zhig min ga/thob go sa'i stegs bur spyan 'dren ma byas pa min yangan/sems skya mo thogs sa'i kha ba gangs can pa'i ched du//sdug thod la blangs pa'i las shig nga cag gis bsgrubs yod//'o2 g.yu ral gnam 'phang du gzengs pa'i sder chags kyi rgyanā hā////sto mtha'i mya ngan gyi thang na ngan g.yo yis brdzangs skad//mi ring mi thung gi gtam rgyud skyo bo yi rang mdangs//gsal ler rtogs pa yi blo ldan ga tshod cig yod mngan/lta bu dnganaskabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 135

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/yang na/sprin dkar leb mo yi bang rim brtsegs pa yi gdan la//brtse 'dzum lhug lhug tu grol ba'i tshangs chen gyi sras mo//dga' dad 'gran bzhin du 'phel ba'i 'dab brgyad kyi snying la//ngo mtshar ngag rig gi dga' ston zad med cig rtsol dang //lta bu'o//tsheg khyim bcu gsumalathugarigs gnyis yod de/1 sna tshogs lta ba'i klong nas rang gi mi tshe'i dmigs 'dun bor//hol rgyugs 'ur zing ngang nas rang gshis gtsang mar gyes phyag phul//ci med cang med bu lo rang sde'i rigs la snang sems 'bar//dus rabs nyer gcig 'di la skyo gdung gtam rgyud ji 'dra'i mngan/yang na/ lta bu dnganarigs pa'i seng chen gang mang phrag dog dug gi mda' mos bkum//rigs smra'i khyu mchog phalacher bzod med bas mtha'i nags su bskrag/rigs kyi ded dpon dag kyang g.yo ldan wa mos g.yog tu bkol//rigs mthun sde 'di bsam gyin skyo ba'i mchi ma sems la lhungan/lta bu'o//2 gna' deng zung 'brel gyi thabs mchog nga tsho'i dmigs 'dun yin la//mi rigs yar rgyas kyi las don nga tsho'i bgo skal yin pas//—136 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

snyan ngag gi lus sogs/chol gsum bod mi yi dpung dang dam nas dam du sgril te//chos rgyal srong btsan gyi snying stobs myur bar 'tshol du chas 'gro//lta bu dang /yang na/thag thag dus tshod kyi 'khor lo mgyogs pa rlung la bskyon 'dra//lo zla nyin zhag gi res mos nyag phran stong nas shor 'dra//rnam g.yeng sgyu ma yi khrod nas gser mdog mi tshe zad nye//rnam gsum le lo dag dor nas mi tshe'i snying bo len rigs//lta bu'o//tsheg khyim bcu bzhi ba ni gong gi tsheg khyim bdun pa gnyis bsres pa lta bu las gzhan med pas snyan 'grel dag na'ang logs su dpe brjod bzhag med do//tsheg khyim bco lnga ba/rang gathosabasamacamagyisabazhagastemirigasaslob gso'ichedadu 'dur//rtsolamedamaphogashar lagayugs te slong mo'ibartulazhugar+sādang du blangag/chen po stong gi thugs la ma shar gangs ljongs slob gso'i shing rta ba//'jigasamedargyalamatshanaphyagarjesamathonapojo zlarabazhengag/lta bu dang /skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —137

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/༷༷gispya/rigagaglogalasamyuX zhibarangagashi bzangabobragalasabartag/sdom/zlozaragasamig/sna/tshos4daskadagasumasaba'ilotsā ga//gangasari'irgyanadangabadagaga'adre badz+ratholakhrimasargyamatshor bstod/zhes pas mtshon te shes par bya zhing tshigs bcad ring bo'i rigs la'ang goms par bya'o// / rtsa ba me long ma las/grol ba dang ni rigs dang mdzod//'dus pa zhes bya de 'dra yi//tshigs bcad rgya che sanas bcings cha shas rang bzhin phyir ma brjod//ces brjod bya don dang 'brel ba'i tshigs bcad la rigs grol mdzod 'dus bzhi yod tshul tsam gsungs pa las/re rer dpe brjod bzhag med do//de yang dpang lo chen pos/grol ba ni tshigs bcad gcig gis don rdzogs pa rang dbang can tshigs bcad gzhan la mi ltos pa ste/zhes gsungs pa ltar brjod bya'i don gang rung zhig tshigs bcad gcig gi nang du rdzogs par ston thub pa zhig ste/bla ma phal cher gyi sku bstod sho lo ka gcig can lta bu de yin pas gzhan dang nor dogs med/rigs dang 'dus pa gnyis brjod bya'i yul gcig yin dgos pa'i cha nas 'dra yang /rigs la bya tshig gcig gis chog cing 'dus 38 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

snyan ngag gi lus sogs/par du ma yod/ rigs la rjod byed sho lo ka 'ga' res chog cing 'dus pa mtshan nyid par sarga'am le'u'i bdag nyid can zhig dgos pa mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yin no//rigs mdzod gnyis la sho lo ka du ma dgos pa'i cha nas 'dra yang /brjo1 bya ༵༵ gcig dang bya tshig du ma dgos min gyi cha nas khyad par ma/ da 'a/shā/ gnyis la bya tshig du ma dang ldan dgos pa'i cha nas khyad par med kyanganamadzod ni deng sang gi thol rtsom ltar brjod bya sna mang la sbyor rung zhing rjod byed sho lo ka bcu yas mas shig 'tsham la/'dus pa mtshan nyid par le'u'i rang bzhin can zhig dgos par ma zad brjod bya rgya che ba'i cha nas gcig yin dgos te/ dper na/brjod bya byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa ston zhing rjod byed la le'u bcu yod pa'i spyod 'jug dang / brjod bya shes rab gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don ston zhing / rjod byed la skabs brgyad yod pa'i mngon rtogs rgyan lta bu'o//ཿ kha cig gis rgyal dbang lnga ba'i lugs ltar 'dus par le'us ma bcings pa'i dpe brjod cig 'jog pa mi 'thad tshul yang gsungs mod/ gzhan gsum dang ma 'dres shing 'dus pa'i mtshan nyid phal cher rdzogs pa'i dpe brjod cig bzhag pa la dge mtshan las gnod pa ci yang med do/ / rtsa bar yang / de lta bu'i tshigs bcad dag ni sarga'am le'us bcings pa'i bstan bcos kyi rgyun la skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —139

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/gnas pa'am cha shas kyi rang bzhin la yod pas logs su dpe brjod mi dgos par gsungs pa las dpe brjod 'jog rgyu med ces ma gsungs so//༈ bstan pa'i sgron me'i dpe brjod las/ grol ba'i skabs kyi dpe brjod dang bos dbyangs can mar bstod pa cha tshang zhig tshigs bcad gcig gis rdzogs par byas pa dang / dpe brjod gnyis pas dbyangs can mar dngos grub zhu ba'i brjod don cha tshang zhig tshigs bcad gcig gis rdzogs par byas pa'o//rigs kyi dpe brjod las/brjod bya dbyangs can ma la dad pa 'phel ba'i tshul gcig po rjod byed shol ka gsum gyis brjod de mjug tu dang ba 'phel zhes pa'i bya tshig gcig gis gong sgros thams cad kyi don gsal bar byas pa'o//mdzod kyi dpe brjod las/ brjod bya dbyangs can ma'i zhal ras dang spyan/zhal gyi sgo/sku'i nyams sogs du ma zhig rjod byed shol ka dang bya tshig du mas brjod pa'o//'dus pa'i dpe brjod la le'us ma bcings kyang / brjod bya 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi phyag gcig bu'i khyad chos de/ rjod byed bya tshig dang shol ka du mas brjod yod pas/ snga ma gsum dang mi 'dra zhing 'dus pa'i khyad chos phal cher ldan par byas yod pa yin no//༈ de yang sarga chen po'am snyan ngag chen po yin na/ rtsa ba me long ma las/ shis brjod phyag bya dngos po ni/ /nges par bstan —140 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

snyan ngag gi lus sogs/pa'ang de yi sgo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sngon 'gro shis brjod phyag bya dngos po nges bstan gsum mam gang rung re dang /(thol rtsom tsam re la sgo gsum sogs sbyar na cher mi 'tsham mo)brjod bya sde bzhis mtshon pa'i snyan ngag gi srog ji snyed/tshig gi nyams las yid kyi 'gyur ba bskyed nus pa/ sgra don gab tshig dang bcas pa'i rgyan phun sum tshogs pas spras pa/ tshigs bcad lhug spel ma ci rigs dang ldan zhing le'u'i bdag nyid can zhig nges par dgos par gsungs te/ rgyal bo dge dbang gi rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing dang / slob dpon dpa' bo'i skyes rabs so bzhi ba/sa paṇa gyi legs bshad rin po che'i gter/ rje rin po che'i 'jam dbyangs bstod sprin rgya mtsho/ zhang zhung ba'i rā ma na'i rtogs brjod/ gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i chu shing bstan bcos lta bu'o//mdor na snyan ngag chen po la ni/ bstan bcos kyi sgo rnams tshang ba/ brjod bya'i don mi nyung zhing rgya che ba/rjod byed kyi tshig ha cang rgya mi che zhing nyan spro ba'i khyad chos dag 'dzoms dgos pa yin no// 'dir zhar byang du shes dgos pa zhig ni gong du bstan pa'i snyan ngag chen po rnamadro ni snyan ngag gi bstan bcos yin gyi snyan ngag gi gzhung lugs ma yin la/ rgyan gyi bstan bcos dang snyan ngag gi bstan bcos gnyis la'ang khyad par chen po yod do// / tshangs sras bzhad sgra las/ snyan ngag chen po zhes bya ba ni/sarga'am le'us bcings pa ste/ le'u gnyis yod pa yan chad kyis bcings pa la snyan ngag chen po zhes bya la/ mkhas pa la las le'u bcu skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —/41—

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/drug gi rang bzhin can gyi gzhung chen po yin dgos par gsungs kyang mtha' gcig tsam nges so//zhes gsungs/༈ snyan ngag spyi don las/dga' skyo sogs kyi kun slong g.yos nas phyi lus ngag tu ma shar ba ni 'gyur ba yin la/ de nyid stobs rgyas nas phyi'i lus ngag tu shar ba ni nyams so/ / zhes gsungs/snyan ngag gi skabs yin na nyams sna tshogs brjod pa la brten te pha rol klog pa bo'i rgyud la 'gyur ba bskyed dgos so//༈ spyir sde bzhi la/rgyal thabs kyi sde bzhi dang /chos srid kyi sde bzhi/ nyan thos sde bzhi bcas go tshul mang bo yod de/ dang bo ni/dmag dang khrims/ dpal 'byor dang mnga' thang bcas so /gnyis pa/chos nor 'dod pa thar ba bcas so//gsum pa/ gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba/ phal chen pa/ mang bkur ba/ gnas brtan pa bzhi'o// snyan ngag gi brjod bya yin na chos srid dam rgyal thabs kyi sde bzhi kho nar sbyor mi dgos te/ sdom tshig tu'ang sde bzhi sogs zhes sogs sgra sbyar yod pa ltar sngon gyi byung ba dngand lta'i gnas babs/ ma 'ongs pa'i dmigs 'dun/ dga' skyo chags snang gi 'tsho ba/ dus kyi 'gyar ldog chos dang 'jig rten/rtog btags kyis bzhengs bsgrujo byas pa/rig byed gtam rgyud sogs mdor na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i brjod bya ji snyed cig mchis pa thams cad snyan ngag gi srog gam —142 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

snyan ngag gi lus sogs/brjod byar gzung 'os so/ / de'i phyir snyan ngag pa'i sems khams ni 'jig rten cha tshang zhig gis grub dgos la/ snyan ngag pa'i smyug rtser 'jig rten mes po'i rdzu 'phral de yang ldan dgos par 'dug go// stoḥ dus rabs nyi shu ba'i dus mjug dang nyer gcig pa'i dus 'go ste dus rabs gnyis kyi bar mtshams kyi 'ur zing chen po'i g.yo skyom khrod nas/ ches mang bo zhig yod tshad 'dor ba'am yod tshad hril gyis len dgos pa'i 'khrul snang gis bzi bar gyar bas/da lta kha cig gis bstan bcos chen po la 'jug pa'i sgo/ to shis brjod dang phyag bya/ 2ngo bo nges bstan nam lus mdor bstan/ 3rtsom par dam bca' ba/4snod ldan nyan bskul/ 5bstan bcos de'i dgos chos brjod pa/ 6bar chad mi 'byang ba'i phyir 'dod gsol byed pa sogs mi dgos par thad kur ga(nga don gang yin la 'jug dgos te/ 'di ni sla la tshegs chung ba/ dgos med kyi bya bas dus tshod 'phro brlag tu mi gtong ba sogs kyi dge mtshan dang ldan tshul shed kyis smra bar byed mod/bya ba gang zhig bsgrubs kyang sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi go rim dang de'i dgos pa re brjod rgyu yod pa bzhin/gong gsal bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i yan lag de dag la dge mtshan du ma dang ldan zhing bod rig pa'i thun min khyad chos shig tu'ang gyur yod gshis snyan ngag chen po'am bstan bcos tshad ldan rtsom pa la 'jug pa'i tshe ni de dag nges par sbyor dgos te/skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 143—

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/1 gis brjod dang phyag bya/ / shis brjod dang phyag bya ba ste mchod brjod kyi skabs su/ rgyal ba sras bcas spyi dang khyad par du gzhung lugs gang dang gang zhig thog mar brtsams pa dang / bar du spel ba/ tha mar rgyud 'dzin sogs byas pa'i sngon byon mkhas pa'i bka' drin dran pa dang / shes nas rnyed pa'i dad dung gis bka' drin gzo ba/ rtsom pa bo rang nyid mkhas pa'i rjes 'brangs kyi skyes bu dam par rtogs pa/ gzhung don mthar phyin pa la bar chad kyis mi tshugs pa sogs dgos pa du ma dang ldan la/khyad par du phar phyin bsdus pa las/skyabs song bsod nams gzugs mchis na//stong gsum 'di yang sdod du chung / /zhes dang / mdo rgya cher rol ba las/ bsod nams rnam smin bde ster sdug bsngal thams cad sel//bsod nams ldan pa'i mi yi bsam pa rnams kyang 'grub/ /bdud bcom nas ni byang chub myur du reg par 'gyur/ /mya ngan las 'das zhi ba bsil ba'i dngos po 'thob ces dang / lha las phul byung gi bstod pa las/ gang zhig snying nas dad dam dga' ba dang / /the tshom gyis sam gzhan gyi ngor yang rung / /gang zhig thub dbang la ni phyag bgyi ba/ /des ni lha yi lus sogs dpag med thob/ /ces dang / sa paṇa mkhas 'jug las/ bstan bcos byed pa'i dam pa yis/ /ston pa la ni mchod brjod bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ yul khyad par can la mchod brjod byas pas tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs shing don gnyis bde blag tu 'grub pa/—144 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

snyan ngag gi lus sogs/klog pa bos kyang rtsom pa bo de nyid skyes bu dam par rtogs te dga' bzhin 'jug pas bstan bcos don du 'gyur ba dang / gser phreng las/yul khyad par can sher phyin la phyag 'tshal bas bsod nams dpag med rgyud la skye la de'i mthus bsod nams ma yin pa las rnam par log nas bar chad zhi ste rtsom pa mthar phyin par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes phyi nang gi 'gal rkyen phra rags las rnam par rgyal tshul gsungs pa ltar dge mtshan du ma dang ldan pa'i phyir ro //2 ngo zo nges bstan/༈ ngo bo nges bstan nam lus mdor bstan ni/ mkhas 'jug las/ bshad sla ba dang gzung bde zhing //bstan bcos la'ang rtsod bral phyir//mkhas pa la las bstan bcos lus//bsdus te thog mar 'god par mdzad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ lus rnam gzhag la/'chad pa bos 'chad sla ba/nyan pa bos gzung bde ba/bstan bcos la nges pa bskyed sla ba bcas dgos pa chen po gsum yod pa dang /bstan bcos kyi spyi khog 'char ba'i me long lta bu'ang yin te/brjod bya ngos zin pa dang / go rim mi 'khrug pa sogs kyi dgos pa dang yang ldan pa yin no// ga shis brjod phyag bya dngos po nges bstan gsum gyi ngo bo mdor bsdus tshe ci lta bu zhig yin zhe na/ tshig rgyan rig pa'i sgo 'byed las/ dang bo shis brjod ni/ dge legs su byed pa'i tshigs skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —145

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/bcad smon tshig dang phyogs mtshungs pa zhig yin zhing / gnyis pa phyag bya ba ni rang rang so so'i gang la dad pa yod pa'i lha dang bla ma lta bu la gus 'dud byed pa yin la/gsum pa dngos po nges bstan ni/rang gis gang brtsams pa'i bstan bcos de'i brjod don mdor bsdus nas bstan pa yin pas/ bstan bcos spyi'i sngon 'gro thun mong ba khang ba'i nang la 'jug pa'i sgo lta bu yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// bod mkhas snyan 'grel las/ rnam pa gsum po de ni bstan bcos kyi sgo yin pas dang bor brjod pa yin/'o na bstan bcos kyi sgor de gsum ga tshang ba mtha' gcig tu nges par dgos sam zhe na ma yin te/ zhes gsungs pa ltar gsum ga nges par du 'god dgos pa'ang min no//de lta bu'i sgo gsum po yin na phan tshun 'gal ba yin mi dgos te/ sa paṇa mkhas 'jug las/ mchod bstod 'dud ba'i bdag nyid can//shis par brjod sogs mi 'gal te//thams cad du yang ston pa yi//che ba 'ba' zhig ston phyir ro//zhes dang /de dag tshig tha dad kyang don mi 'gal te ston pa'am 'dod pa'i lha'i yon tan brjod par mtshungs pa'i phyir ro//zhes gsungs pa ltar te/sgo gsum gyi yin par tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi mchod brjod lta bu 'jog chog go/ / sgo gsum gyi dpe brjod rang cag gi khrid bya'i gzhung du gsal ba ltar ro//—146 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

snyan ngag gi lus sogs/3 rtsom lar dam bca' ba/ཿ rtsom par dam bca' ba ni 'chad na mi dgos shing mi 'chad na don med do snyam na ni ma yin te/ shes rab sdong bu las/dam pa rnams ni khas 'che mi bya zhing / /gal te dka' bas khas ni blangs gyur na//rdo la ri mo bris pa lta bur ni//shi yang gzhan du byed par mi 'gyur ro//(tshigs bcad 'di la tshig ris kyi 'gyur mi 'dra ba mang tsam 'dug)zhes dang / ya rabs rnams ni srog ni gtong gi dam bca' min//zhes gsungs pa ltar bstan bcos kyi 'gor rtsom par dam bca' ba la ni/ dgos don/ bsdus don/ tshig don bcas dgos pa chen po gsum dang ldan pa yin te/ dang bo ni/ gzhung de rtsom par spro ba rgyas pa/ rtsom pa bo de nyid brtsam bya'i don la nang byan chud par nges pa rnyed pas mchog tu rtogs pa/ gzhung don bde blag tu mthar phyin pa sogs kyi dgos pa dang ldan zhing / gnyis pa ni/las dang byed po bya ba gsum ste/ gang brtsam na bstan bcos/ gang gis na byed pa bo'am rtsom pa bos/ ji ltar brtsam na rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang rung gi sgo nas so// gsum pa ni/ gang 'chad rgyu'i tshig la 'jug pa rnams so/ / de'i phyir mkhas 'jug las/ dam bca' ba dang skul tshig sogs//'chad phyir spro ba ston pa ste//mchog rtogs 'grub pa'i rgyur 'gyur bas//khas len pa la 'gal ba med//ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gzhan yang rgya yig thog dang bod tshig thog ces pa'i mi rigs rang bzhin gyi khyad chos shig kyang ngang gis skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 147

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/thon yod par sems so//4 snod ldananyan skul// sdod ldan gdul bya'i mtshan nyid sogs gong du bshad zin pa ltar lags la/ de lta bu'i snod ldan gyi skyes bur brtsam bya'i bstan bcos de 'chad na don du 'gyur phyir gzhung der brtson par skul ba dang / mtshan nyid dang mi ldan pa dag kyang mtshan ldan gdul byar 'god pa sogs ni sdod ldan nyan skul gyi dgos pa yin no//5 dgos chos brjod la/ 1 paṇa ṭi ta zla ba mngon dga'i zhal nas/ bstan bcos dag ni thams cad dang / /las ni ci yang rung ba yi/ /ji srid dgos pa ma smras pa/ /de srid du ni ci zhig 'dzin/ /zhes dang / mkhas 'jug las/bstan bcos dam par bstan pa'i phyir//ston pas thog mar dgos pa bstan// yongs su rtogs pas de mthong na//dpyod pa la yang cis mi 'jug /ces gsungs pa ltar/ bstan bcos kyi klad du dgos 'brel gyi ngag bkod pas/ bstan bcos kyi grags pa yun ring bor gnas pa/ brtsams pa'i dge mtshan dang ma brtsams pa'i nyes skyon mthong ba/ dpyod ldan dag gzhung don der myur bar brtson cing brtag dpyad byed pa sogs kyi dgos pa dang ldan no//—148 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

snyan ngag gi lus sogs/6 'dod gso byed la/ / bstan bcos rtsom par bar chad mi 'byung ba'i phyir 'dod gsol byed pa dang / 'phrin las rgyas pa/gdul byar don du 'gyur ba'i phyir smon pa sogs kyang kha g.yang dang stong 'dang tsam ma yin pa'i tshul lung rigs gnyis char gyis brjod du yod mod/shin tsamang bar 'gyar bas sngon gyi slob dpon nag mo'i khol sogs kyi byang ba las ngozlo pa rnyed par bya'o// sto/ rtsa bar/lus ni re zhig 'dod pa yi//don gyi rnam bcad tshig gi phrengaka/zhes rjod byed tshig gi phreng ba de nyid snyan ngag gi lus yin tshul bstan pa las/ brjod bya'i don de nyid srog yin zhes dngos su ma gsungs kyang /zur mkhar blo gros rgyal bos/skyes bu'i lus srog rgyan gsum dper byas nas/ brjod bya sde bzhis bsdus pa'i don rnams srog dang /rjod byed kyi tshigs bcad lhug spel ma gsum lus dang /don rgyan sgra rgyan gab tshig rnams rgyan du bstan pa yin no//'di lta bu'i 'jog mtshams khong du ma chud par rigs pa gzhan gyis rgyas bkab na bstan bcos chud 'dza' bar 'gyur ro//zhes dang / dbyangs can dgyes glu las/ lus dang rgyan yang rab tu bstan//zhes pas srog shugs la bstan yod de/ dper na srog ldan gyi skyes bu lus mdzes pa la rgyan gyis spras pa bzhin tu/sde skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —149

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/bzhi sogs kyi brjod bya'i srog dang ldan pa'i snyan ngag gi lus bcad lhug spel ma la/ don rgyan sgra rgyan gab tshig gi rgyan gyis rnam par spras so zhes kho bo'i slob dpon gyis/ grangs can lo tsā ba 'jam dpal rdo rje'i bzhed pa yin no zhes ngom bshad du mdzad la/zhes brjod bya'i don la srog ces bzhed pa ni shin tu legs te/ rtsa bar dngos su bstan ma bstan gang yin yang snyan ngag la brjod bya rjod byed gnyis yod pa ni mang du smra mi dgos pa'i don zhig yin la/snyan gzhung me long mar snyan ngag gi srog ces dngos su ma bstan pas spyir snyan ngag la srog med pas ma khyab pa ni mang du rtsod mi dgos pa'i gnas shig go// rtsom gyi legs nyes gtso bo'ang bsam blo'am brjod bya'i steng nas 'jog cing / de la srog gi tha snyad 'dogs mkhan rang re bod gcig pu min par 'dzam gling gi snyan ngag spyi'i kha phyogs shig yin 'dug ste/ nub phyogs kyi rtsom pa bo grags can tan tan gyis kyang / rtsom gyi dge ni bsam blo'i khrod du yod cing /mdzes chos ni snyan ngag tshigs bcad lhug gi rgyan sbyar ba'i thog tu yod/ ces dang /u ru su'i rtsom rig pa kor er cis/ brjod bya'i srog ni rtsom pa bo'i lag len las byang zhing / 'tsho ba dngos kyis kho la dran bslangs pa las byung ba'i drosam blo zhig red/ ces dang / nye rabs kyi rtsom pa bo dgu rong don grub rgyal gyis kyang / bem po'i lus la srog zhugs tshe/ /rnam par shes pa'i mtshan nyid ldan//rjod byed tshig la don stong tshe/ /srog med rtsom gyi bem po nyid/ /ces brjod pa ltar ro//ngas gong du rtsom yig tshad ldan yin min de gtso —150 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

snyan ngag gi lus sogs/bo rtsom pa bo'i bsam blo'am brjod bya'i steng nas 'jog ces pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ deng skabs 'dzam gling na ming du grags pa'i no pe ur ( r+sā7)rtsom rig gi gzengs skyes thob myong mkhan rnams kyis kyang rtsom yig gi kha phyogs sam brjod snying zhi bde dang 'dra mnyam sogs gtso bor byas yod par bshad/ tshul 'dir bsam na rang re bod kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir de 'dra'i gzengs skyes thob 'os pa mi nyung ba zhig byon 'dug kyang / de dag 'gran rtsod dang grags skam la sogs la mos pa med phyir ched du 'gran rtsod du ma zhugs pas 'dzam gling na ming du grags pa'i bod rig rtsom pa bo /sprangs skyes dang lag rtags mthon po can zhig ma byung ba yin no de ltar rtsom rig gi dge mtshan gtso bo brjod bya'i steng na yod kyang rjod byed tshig gi sgyu rtsal yang mi mkho ba ma yin te/ de gnyis ni lus dang grib ma 'grogs pa dang chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa ltar gcig grogs su gcig 'ong ba zhig nges par du dgos te/ snyan rtsom rig pa'i shes bya gnad bsdus las/ la las tshig dang la las don la sred/ /'ga' zhig tshig don gnyis char gal chen 'dzin/ /rim bzhin gling bu'i sgra dang gcer bu'i lus/ /'phyor sgeg rgyan ldan mdzes ma dpe ru 'os/ /zhes gsungs pas kyang tshig don gnyis ka rgyu spun ltar gal che tshul bstan pa yin no//skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga /5/—

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ / skabs 'dir bod mkhas snyan 'grel las/ rgya gar mkhas pa'i gsung rgyun can gyi mkhas pa thams cad lus rgyan gnyis las mi bzhed par gsal yang / gso ba rig pa'i bag chags mthu brtas pas (zur mkhar ba la go dgos)ji skad du/ srog gi dbang bos ma bzung ba'i//mi ro bzang yang su zhig len//zhes pa lta bur dgongs mod kyi/ shing rta dang / shing rta'i rgyan/ gzhal med khang ba dang / de'i rgyan zhes pa dang / gser gyi ska rags nor bus brgyan pa zhes pa sogs/ srog dang mi ldan pa'i dngos po du mar rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i rnam gzhag mthong phyin/ skyes bu'i lus srog rgyan gsum kho na dang bstun dgos pa'i nges pa ga la yod/ lus yin phyin srog dgos par nges na ni mig la sogs pa'i dbang bo gzhan yang ci'i phyir mi dgos/ gos med pa'i gcer bu la rgyan yang mi mdzes shing mi 'tsham pas so//zhes sogs snyan ngag la srog mi 'dod pa'i sgrub byed mang du bkod cing / 'brug khams sprul sogs mang bo zhig gis kyang de bzhin du 'dod mod/ shing rta'i lus dang gzhal med khang gi lus zhes brjod srol zhig (tshig zin la thon med kyang snyan ngag gi lus de shing rta sogs kyi lus la dpe blangs pa'i dgongs don ni shin tu gsal)bod la yod med kyang mi shes shing / srog shugs su bstan pas mig sogs dbang bo gzhan yang bstan dgos na shing rta'i lus dngos su bstan pa'i thugs la lhu lag dang 'khor lo sogs kyang shugs bstan byed dgos pas de gang yin gsung dgos par 'gyur ba dang / go la zlum po yin pa'i rtags kyis shes bya thams cad zlum por sgrub pa —152 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

snyan ngag gi lus sogs/dang mtshungs dper gyar ba dang / snyan ngag gi skabs 'di'i dpe len sa de yang nges thor sems med bem po zhig yin dgos pa'i sgrub byed ci zhig yod pa/ bstan bcos gzhan gang la'ang dngos thugs brgyud gsum nas bstan pa yod na snyan ngag la ci'i phyir yod mi chog pa/ rgya gar mkhas pa'i gsung rgyun can thams cad kyis snyan ngag la srog mi 'dod na smon 'gro yab sras dang lnga ba chen mo sogs snyan ngag me long gi khrid rgyun dang gsung rgyun tsam yang med pa'i mkhas rlom can du thal ba dang / gos med pa'i gcer bu la rgyan yang mi mdzes shing mi 'tsham mo zhes yul khams gcig dbang btsan par byas pa sogs gnod byed mang du 'byang ngo snyam/ des na/kun mkhyen sdom tshig 'dir/ sngon byang gtam bang sde bzhi la sogs pa/ /brjod bya'i don ni srog yirno de yi phyir/ /lus la tshig don gnyis su 'byed rnams 'khrul/ /zhes 'jam kha ba dang / snar thang ba/dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba sogs kyis rtsa ba dang bstun ci thub kyis srog ces pa'i tha snyad cig gtan nas mi 'dod kyang / tshig gi lus dang don gyi lus zhes gnyis su phyes pa de la zur za gnang ba ni rmad du byung ba'i legs bshad cig ste/khong rnams kyis snyan ngag la rjod byed las gzhan pa'i brjod bya zhig don gyis khas blangs 'dug pas lnga ba chen mo sogs kyi dgongs pa dang rtsa ba'i cha nas mthun par ma gyur tam/ des na snar thang ba sogs kyis don gyi lus dang sgra'i lus gnyis su dbye ba ni sgra'i brjod rigs kyi dbye ba tsam yin gyi don gyi lus yin na lus ma yin pas khyab ste/ snyan ngag skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la / —153

ngag rig sgyu 'phul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/gi srog dang don gyi lus gnyis don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin zhe na mkhas mang dgongs pa gcig tu bsgril ba'i dpyad brjod byed stangs shig dang 'dzam gling spyi'i rtsom rig 'phel rgyas kyi kha phyogs dang yang mthun pa zhig red snyam mo//1 grong khyer dang rgya mtsho sogs la sbyar ba'i dpe brjod 'di dag ni rtsa ba me long mar dngos bstan bcu drug gam bcu bdun zhes 'byung ba dag dang rjes mthun par mdzad pa zhig ste/ 'di ni rtsom rtsal byang chub pa'i thabs shig yin gshis nges par du pho nya 'gro 'ong sogs bcu drug por sbyor dgos pa'i nges pa med par brjod bya sna tshogs tshogs su sbyar chog la/ rjod byed rkang ba ring thung dang glu tshig mgur tshig gang gi sgo nas bris kyang 'gal ba med de/ rtsa ba me long ma las/ gang zhig yan lag 'gas dman yang / /gal te sbyar rnams phun tshogs kyis//de rig mgu bar byed pas na//'di ni snyan ngag skyon ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / tshig rgyan rig pa'i sgo 'byed las/ snyan ngag thog mar sbyong ba'i las dang bo ba rnams gong gsal gyi nang don de dag rtsom gzhir bzung nas sbyong brdar byas na/ rim gyis snyan ngag gi nyams 'gyur ldan pa'i tshig sbyor sna tshogs rtsom pa la mkhas par 'gyur ba dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas gong gsal gyi nang don de dag la snyan ngag gi nyams dang ldan pa'i tshig sbyor ji ltar byed tshul thad snyan ngag thog mar sbyong ba'i las dang bo ba rnams kyi blo sgo 'byed pa'i ched du brjod bya'i —154 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

snyan ngag gi lus sogs/rnam grangs tsam zhig bshad pa yin no//zhes gsungs/khrid bya'i gzhung du gsal ba'i grong khyer rgya mtsho sogs kyi mchan 'grelas shas// nyi ma'i dmag chogasawa skabs 'dir nyi ma'i 'od zer la go dgos// rta snang can nyi ma'i mngon brjod de phyi rol rig byed kyi gtam rgyud du nyi ma ni shing rta zhig gi steng du yod pa dang / shing rta de/rlung dang yid mgyogs mdog lnga ba//de bzhin thig le can dang ni//nges brjod shin tsargyal mtshan dang //ri bo 'joms rnams nyi ma'i rta//zhes rta mchog bdun gyis 'dren zhing / rta dbus ma'am gtso bo de nyid kyi kha dog ljang khu zhig yin par bshad do// ༈ sku 'dzin spyir chu 'dzin dang chu 'thung zhes pa sprin gyi mngon brjod yin yang / sprin gnas yul nam mkha' yin pas chu 'thung zhes pa nam mkha' la go ba'i skabs kyang yod do//༈ ra lhawa rgyal khab dang rgyal khab gyi bar sogs phan tshun la ngag 'phrin sogs skyel len byed mkhan gyi ming yin te bang chen pa skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga /35

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/yang zer/la las mdun na 'don dang don gcig par byed mod/mdun na 'don gyi tha snyad 'di rgya gar nas bsgyur ba zhig ste rgyal bo'i mdun du skar ma'i rtsis dang rig byed 'don mkhan dag gi ming yin/bod kyi bla bon dang dbu bla zer ba dang phyogs 'dra/skabs 'gar blon po la go dgos pa'ang yod do// / rten 'brel dbu ma'i lta ba gtan la 'bebs byed du/gcig du bral gyi gtan tshigs/rdo rje zegs ma'i gtan tshigs/yod med skye 'gog gi gtan tshigs/mu bzhi skye 'gog gi gtan tshigs/rten 'brel gyi gtan tshigs bcas lnga yod pa las/rtag chad kyi mtha' ( gnyis bsal nas dbu ma'i lta ba rgyud la skyed par byed par rten 'brel gyi gtan tshigs 'di las lhag pa med pa'i phyir/rigs pa'i rgyal bo rten 'brel chen mo'i gtan tshigs zhes bya'o//gtan la 'bebs tshul ni/myu gu chos can/bden par med de/sten 'brel yin pa'i phyir/zhes pa lta bu ste rgyas par gzhung chen mo rnams nas shes par bya'o// byu/ dbyad 'dog lta ba thos sgom dang dpyad sgom zung gis ṭā dīkā par gtan la phabs pa'i stong nyid kyi lta ba'am dbu ma'i lta ༈ dngos 'dzin ging chos thams cad bden par dngos su 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin gyi blo'o//— 56 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

snyan ngag gi lus sogs/byu / gzhug ma'i semasawa thog ma'i sems te rang bzhin gyis bden par ma grub pa'i sems kyi ngo bo la bya'o//myu/ pha rol gi bde'i glingabasgrib gnyis zad par spangs pa'i zhi ba myang 'das te sangs rgyas kyi sa la bya'o//kau spyir snyan ngag la nyams 'don tshul dang sgyu rtsal spras stangs sna tshogs pa shig yod pa las/ thog mar 'dren pa yon tan gyis//nye bar bkod nas de yis ni/ /dgra la gnod pa byed ces pa'i//lam 'di rang bzhin mdzes pa yin//zhes rtsa ba me long mar gsungs pa bzhin/thog mar rang phyogs kyi 'dren pa ste rgyal bo lta bu la dpa' mdzangs 'byor phyug sogs kyi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan tshul nye bar bkod nas/ rgyal bo de yis pha rol dgra sde'i dpung tshogs tshar gcod pa'i tshul brjod pa'i snyan ngag gi nyams 'don tshul 'jig rten na rang bzhin gyi mdzes pa tsam por mchog tu brtson pa'i rgya gar gyi snyan ngag pa bha ma ha zhes pa zhig byang zhing de'i rjes 'brang rgya bod kyi snyan ngag pa'ang mang bo yod lag/ rigs dang brtson 'grus thos sogs kyis//dgra bo la'ang bsngags byas nas//de las rgyal phyir 'dren pa ni//khyad 'phags brjod pa'ang bdag dga' skyes//zhes slob dpon dbyag pa can rang nyid ni thog mar pha rol bo'i che ba 'don pa gtso thor byed pa'i rtsom stangs la thugs dgyes skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —/57

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/mod bha ma ha'i rtsom stangs kyang mi bzhed pa ma yin no//rtsom stangs phyi ma gtsigs 'dzin byed pa'i rtsom pa bo'ang shin tu mang ngon /༈ snyan rtsom rig pa'i shes bya gnad bsdus las/nang nyams mi rigs dbang gis khyad yod min//tshig sbyor skad rigs dbang gis khyad med min//rang rtsom la ni gzhan skad shan zhugs pa//brda sprod lugs la blo mig ldongs pa'i rtags//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ brjod don zla ba lta bu ston par mi rigs kyi dbang gis khyad par med mod/tshig sbyor sdeb lugs dang tshig rgyan sbyor lugs sogs la ni mi rigs rang rang gi khyad chos thun mong mon pa yod de/dper na/ rta 'do ba dang / mdzo khyung dkar/ seng dkar mo/khyi rgya li/stag sha ra/ sman bu mo/ sdug nag po/ sems skya mo sogs bod kyi thun min skad cha'i sgyu rtsal mang bo zhig skad rigs gzhan gyis ji bzhin sbyor dka' ba lta bu'o// 'dis skad rigs gzhan dag la'ang thun min gyi khyad chos yod pa shugs las rtogs dgos/de lta'i ngo mtshar skad cha'i sgyu rtsal la byang chub pa yin na rjod byed tshig gi cha nas klog mkhan khri stong gi dran 'dzin 'gugs pa'i snyan ngag gi nyams dang ldan par 'gyur ro//yang de nyid las/rdul phran gcig las rdul kun grub tshul shes//me long gcig la gzugs brnyan 'bum phrag 'char/ /don gnad lkog 'byin tshig sbyor gcig gis kyang //sa spungs rdo spungs shu loka 'bum las lhag / ces dang /me tog gsar skyes gcig las dbyar —158 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

snyan ngag gi lus sogs/dus shes/ /shing lo ser bo gcig las ston dus shes/ /snyan rtsom bzang bo tshig nyung don 'dus pa/ /rdul phran gcig tu gzugs khams 'doms pa bzhin/ /gsungs pa ltar tshig nyung la don gyi gnad 'dus pa/ dpe 'byor la don gsal ba/ zar zur gang rung zhig nas dmigs 'dun dang kha phyogs/ dar rgud dang bde sdug 'pho 'gyur dang re skul mtshon pa/ kha dam zhing brjid nyams che ba/ kha gsal zhing lhod nyams kyis phyug pa sogs snyan ngag gi nyams 'don tshul la mtha' med pa yod do//dga' skyo sogs nyams brgyad thon tshul ni thog gi don rgyan gyi skabs su 'chad do//tshig smug gam cigacomabashad spa༈ mang bo zhig gis rang re la sngon lhug rtsom zhes pa'i rtsom lus 'di med par brjod kyang / bcad lhug spel gsum gyi ya gyal tshig lhug ni lhug com ma yin zhes su zhig gis bsnyon par nus/ de'i phyir gna' snga mo'i dus nas bod la ngag thog lhug rtsom byang ba blon po ru las skyes kyis rang gi ma yum la bton pa'i dri ba ldang / myang tsang ku sogs kyis bskyal ba'i bro tshig seng go mi chen dang khyung bo spung sad zu tse gnyis kyi shags tshig sogs kyis mtshon nus la/ rim gyis bod la yi ge yod par gyur bas/ bod btsan po'i dus su bzos skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —159

ngag rig sgyu 'phul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/pa'i khrims yig sogs yig thog lhug rtsom yang mang du byang la de ston byed kyi gzhung yang yod de/ me long ma las/ rkang ba rād pa'i tshig rgyun ni//lhug pa brjod pa dag dang gtam//zhes pa de yi rab dbye gnyis//zhes dang / brjid pa tshig sdud mang bo nyid//'di ni lhug pa dag gi gsos//zhes lhug rtsom gyi ngo bo dang khyad chos/ming tsam gyi dbye ba sogs kyang legs par bstan yod par ma zad/ lhug rtsom la'ang don rgyan so lnga dang / sgra rgyan/ gab tshig gi rgyan bcas kyang re rer sbyor du yod de/ dper na/ bcu drug lang tsho'i dpal yon rdzogs pas chu skyes pad ma'i mdzes pa pham par byed pa'i tshangs dbang lha yi sras mo lta bu rgyu'i dpe dang / lung rtogs bstan pa'i pad tshal mdzes par byed pa'i dran dbang ngang mo'i khyu tshogs lta bu bsdus shing ma bsdus pa'i gzugs rgyan yin pa ltabu'o//'on kyang tshigs bcad rtsom stangs legs par shes na tshig lhug rtsom stangs zhor la byang bar dgongs te sngon byon mkhas pas rgyas bshad ma gnang bar mngon no// gna' bo'i lhug rtsom dang da lta'i lhug rtsom gnyis rtsom lus kyi gzhi 'dra ba tsam las nang don dang rnam pa/sgyu rtsal dang thabs bkod sogs la khyad par med pa ma yin mod/ 'di ni 'phel rgyas kyi rgyun mthong snang tshul zhig yin pas sngon bod la ci yang med par brjod pa la dga' ba'i rigs dag 'drog langs dgos don ye nas med do//ngas sngar skad cha'i lang tsho'i gleng brjod du'ang 'bri myong ba ltar/da lta nga tshos 'bri bzhengs byed bzhin pa'i lhug rtsom ni srol rgyun gyi rtsom lus tshig lhug gi rnam par gzhi bcol zhing / da lta'i rgyal khab — 60 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

snyan ngag gi lus sogs/dang mi rigs gzhan gyi lhug rtsom 'bri stangs las kyang legs cha blangs pa'i gna' deng zung 'brel gyi sgyu rtsal rtsom lus shig ste/rjod byed rkang bas ma bcad cing tshig tshogs nyung ba/ brjod bya rgya che zhing tshad bkag med pa/ dga' skyo'i nyams 'gyar gsal zhing rtsom stangs la rang dbang ches cher ldan pa zhig go//'es 'dod do//mdor na sngon bod la lhug rtsom 'bri srol yod med sogs rtsod gzhi che yang 'dir mang bar 'gyur bas gzhan dang gzhan nas shes par bya dgos la/rtsom pa bo bu'u pa'o zho zhes pas/skad cha drang mor bshad pa dang don dag ngo ma gleng ba/ bya dngos dang tshor 'du bden par 'bri ba ni gna' nas da lta'i bar lhug rtsom gyi srol du gyar yod/ ces pa'i sdom tshig la bsam gzhig dang / deb ther dopyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs sogs bklags na bod la sngon lhug rtsom 'bri srol yod med kyi rtsod pa rang thugs kyis zhi bar 'gyar nges te/ dgu rong don grub rgyal gyi/ mnyen 'jam rtswa'i sh+lau sgra bklags pa'i 'char sgo las kyang / lhug rtsom 'bri srol ni rang re la gna' snga mo nas yod mod/'on kyang deng rabs kyi dus dang mthun la/ mi rigs rang gi khyad chos kyang yod pa'i lhug rtsom ni dkon zhes brjod 'dug pa ltar ro//deng skabs lhug rtsom la rjod byed tshig gi cha nas/ lhug rtsom snyan ngag dang lhug brjod lhug rtsom gnyis su 'byed la/ brjod bya don gyi cha nas don brjod lhug rtsom/ yid brjod lhug rtsom/ lugs brjod lhug rtsom gsum dang / nang gses kyis/ zhor zin/ snyan zhu/skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —16 —

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/gleng gzhi dang mjug gtam/ nyin tho/ ljongs rgyu'i zin tho/ lo rgyus/zin bris thor bu/ sdom tshig bsgrags gtam/ dgod gtam/tshan rig rtsom thung /lhug pa chung ngu /lhug rtsom spel ma sogs mang du dbye bzhin 'dug go//lhug rtsom rtsom lus 'dis don gnad gcig rtsal du 'don pa la gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa'i khyad chos shig thon thub ste/don phran mang bo med par don gyi byang rim gcig rtsal du 'don pas so//de'i phyir snyan ngag pa lis gojo then gyis/snyan ngag 'phrul dgos la zang rtsom dam dgos/lhug rtsom ni nges par du lhug par brjod dgos/gal te dpe zhig gis gsal bor bshad na/snyan ngag ni mu tig nang bzhin gong bu cha tshang bar dgos la/sgrung rtsom ni bzo bkod cig dang 'dra bar che chung gang yang rung ba zhig sgrig gzhi cha tshang zhing bkod pa'i tshags zhib pa/lhug rtsom zhes pa ngas bltas na/lhung lhung du 'bab pa'i chu rgyun zhig dang 'dra bar ri 'bur la bzur zhing grog rong brgyud nas bzhur sa thams cad la bzhur zhing / mthar rgya mtshor 'bab pa yin no//zhes bshad do/// rgya gar gyi snyan ngag pa bha ma has tshig lhug gam lhug rtsom la rtsom pa bo'i cha nas gnyis su dbye ste/tshig lhug gang zhig rgyal bo lta bus rang nyid la bstod pa byas pa ni brjod pa dang /tshig lhug gang zhig bram ze sogs gzhan gyis rgyal bor bstod pa byas pa lta bu ni gtam du 'dod do//'on kyang slob dpon dbyug pa can gyis ni de —162 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

snyan ngag gi lus sogs/ltar mi bzhed de/ rtsa bar/ de phyir gtam dang brjod pa zhes/ /ming gnyis dag gis rigs gcig mtshon//zhes gtam dang brjod pa ni don gcig ming gi rnam grangs su bzhed la/ lnga ba chen mos kyang /de'i phyi ra gtam dang brjod pa zhes pa ni/ dper na/ gdong lnga ba dang kha lnga ba zhes pa'i ming gnyis dag gis seng ge'i rigs gcig mtshon pas so//zhes rjod mkhan la stos pa'i dbye ba mi bzhed do//'o na sngon lhug rtsom mam tshig lhug la don gyi dbye ba gtan nas mi bzhed pa yin nam zhe na ma yin te/ paṇa ṭi ta rig byed rgya mtsho'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i 'jam dbyangs kha che ba dang / paṇa chen dge 'dun dpal sogs kyis lhug pa'i snyan ngag gang zhig sngon byung gtam rgyud las brtsams pa ma yin pa'i rigs ni brjod pa dang /lhug pa'i snyan ngag gang zhig sngon byang gtam rgyud las brtsams shing brjod pa shas che ba ni gtam zhes ldang gi lhug rtsom gyi dbye ba dang cha 'dra ba zhig gsungs so//spel ma bshad la/ ཿ snyan ngag gi lus la gsum du phyes pa'i spel ma ni/ rtsa bar/spel ma zlos gar la sogs te//de dag rnams ni gzhan na rgyas/ /lhug pa tshigs bcad rang bzhin gang //tsas (spel ma'am 'dres ma)zhes ni mngon par brjod/ /zhes bcad lhug spel ma la skad rigs bzhi ka 'dus pa'i zlos gar gyi rnam bzhag dang / skad rigs gcig la skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 163

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/brten pa gnyis yod par gsungs te/ khams 'grel las/ saṃ skṛ ta dang / rang bzhin dang / zur chag dang / sha za'i skad de skad rigs bzhi spel ba'i spel ma dang / tshigs bcad lhug spel ba'i spel ma ste gnyis ka 'dir snyan ngag gi lus gsum par bzhag pa yin/ zhes gsungs/ skabs 'di'i bcad lhug spel ma zhes pa ni tshig lhug skabs kyi brjod bya tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa ste/ brjod don gcig pa zhig dgos par gsungs te/ skyes rabs so bzhi ba dpa rnyi tsha ye shes rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i ston pa'i rnam thar lta bu'o// khams 'grel las/ gzhan bod kyi 'grel ba phal cher du/ tshigs bcad lhug spel mar yod pa gang zhig skad rigs chen po bzhi 'dres pa zhes tshigs bcad lhug spel ba dang skad rigs bzhi spel ba gnyis ka gzhi gcig la tshang dgos shing /ma tshang na lus gsum pa mi grub pa lta bu'i bshad sgros byang yang /de 'drar ma nges pa skyes rabs so bzhi ba 'di'i mtshan gzhirno 'jog pas kyang shes la/ zhes gsungs/tshigs bcad lhug spel gsum por skad rigs bzhis bcing du yod pa'ang shes dgos so//༈ skad rigs bzhi snyan ngag gi lus su bzhag pa la/ rin spungs snyan 'grel las/ ṭīka mdzad snga ma rnams lus skad rigs kyi dbye ba bzhir bshad pa dang / sbyor tshul gyi sgo nas gnyis su bstan pa/ zhes bzhed kyang / skad rigs bzhi ni/ snyan ngag rjod byed kyi sgra yin pas lus su mi 'gyur/ zhes gsungs par/ khams 'grel las/ rjod byed kyi sgra yin pas lus su mi 'gyur na bcad lhug spel ma gsum po yang —164 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

snyan ngag gi lus sogs/rjod byed kyi tshig yin pas der thal/zhes gnad la khel ba'i dgag pa zhig gnang yod do//1 rgya gar gyi dbang du byas pa'i skad rigs bzhi'i ngo bo ni rang cag gi khrid bya'i gzhung na shin tu gsal bas rgyas bshad mi dgos la/ zur chag gi skad dang 'brel ba'i gtam rgyud cig yod 'dug ste/khams 'grel las/ zur chag ni sngon lha khyab 'jug gis rgya gar gyi yul phran zhig tu ba lang skyong ba'i rdzi bo byas shing / char chen po babs pa'i tshe ri bo btegs nas ba lang gi khyu rnams bsrung bar byas pas/khyab 'jug dang bram ze rnams kyis ba lang gi bdag por bskos pa'i gtam rgyud dang / des khyab 'jug gi ming la'ang go bin da ba lang gi rdzi zhes grags pa ste/ dus der khyab 'jug ba lang ji'i tshul bstan pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ yul der ba lang la sogs pa'i phyugs shin tu mang zhing / yul de ba rnams kyi mi blun zhing skad kyang shin tu ma dag par smra bas/ de nyid zlos gar dang snyan ngag rang lugs kyi zur chag tu bzhag ces gsungs so//༈ khams 'grel las/rgya gar du yul la skad rigs bzhi ka tshang zhing snyan ngag kyang dar bas de 'dra'i rnam pa shin tu mang bo zhig yod 'dug kyang /bod la snyan ngag ha cang ma dar zhing /skad rigs bzhi'i dbye ba'ang med pas de der sbyar ba'i bstan bcos 'ga' zhig gi ming tsam spros kyang rnam pa gsal bar mi 'char bar snang ngo //zhes skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ — 65

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/gsungs/de der sbyar ba'i bstan bcos dkon pa bden du chugs kyang bod kyi dbang du byas pa'i skad rigs bzhi'i dbye ba med par gsungs na 'thad par ma mthong ste/rgya gar dang phyogs thams cad nas gcig mtshungs min yang /skad rigs bzhi'i dbye ba ches gsal bor yod de/snyan ngag gi rang mdangs gsar ba las bod rang la mtshon na skad rigs kyi nang gses dbye ba de dag yod de/bod mkhas mang rnams kyis khas len zhing smra med pa'i ba2 sbyod kyi dgongs don dang ches cher mthun pa)legs par sbyar ba'i rig gzhung rnams legs sbyar skad du brtsi zhing khams gyi dum bu gcig gtogs pa'i dbus gtsang ba gtsor byas pa'i skad dang /khams kyi dum bu gzhan zhig gtogs pa'i a mdo'i skad ni rang bzhin pa'i skad yin/zhes dang /zur chag pa'i skad la/mi rigs rang gi skad zur chag pa dang gzhan gyi skad zur chag pa gnyis yod/ces dang zlos gar dnganaglog brnyan gyi 'khrab gzhung /kha shags sogs 'dres ma'i skad kyis brtsams pa mang /zhes dang /thon mi'i zhal lung las/bod rang gi skad kyi dbang du byas na/de la'ang legs sbyar gyi skad dngagayul mi rang bzhin pa'i skad/zur chag gi skad/sha za'i skad de bzhi ga tshang ngo zhes sngon byon mkhas pa'i gsung sgros las 'byung ngo //zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//snyan ngag skabs kyi skad rigs bzhi bar 'dres ma'i skad 'jog pa dang /spyir skad rigs bzhi bar sha za'i skad 'jog pa mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yin pa'ang shes dgos so//sngon 'gro'i skor gyi zin bris rdzogs so// ris 57nyin/— 66— skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

don rgyanasbyi bshad/le'u gnyis ba/don rgyan spyi bshad/ga las dang bo ba dag la bsam ste sngon 'gro'i skabs lo rgyus dang mchan 'grel sogs gang dgos tshig tshogs la ma 'dzems par lhug 'bri byas pa yin la/ da nas bzung le'u bar mtha' gnyis dang thun mong min pa'i rgyan bcu bcas la ci nus kyis rgyan gyi dogs gcod dang dka' gnad gsal bshad/ sa bcad kyi sgo nas ngo sprod pa tsam las mngon brjod kyi bshad pa dang mchan 'grel sogs sgo sam ngos su 'god rtsis min pas/ slob khrid dngos kyi skabs blo rtse gcig sgrim gyis nyan pa dang rang rang la blo rten gang mkho zin bris su 'debs par 'tshal// snyan ngag gi le'u gnyis pa dang gsum pa la thun mong ba'i rgyan zhes bya ste/ rgyan gyi ngo bo dang rab dbye sogs la rgya gar lho shar gyi mkhas pa'i bzhed tshul mi mthun pa med par gcig gyar yin pas so//bkol rgya ches che ba'i cha nas spyi'i rgyan zhes kyang byam//skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —167—

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu// rtsa bar/snyan ngag mdzes par byed pa yi//chos rnams rgyan zhes rab tu brjod//zhes gsungs pa ltar/sgra don ci rigs kyi sgo nas bcad lhug spel gsum gyi lus de nyid mdzes par byed pa la snyan ngag gi rgyan zhes bya la/ der thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i rgyan gnyis yod pa las/thun mong ba'i rgyan la don rgyan dang /sgra rgyan/gab tshig gi rgyan bcas gsum yod/brjod bya don gyi 〈nyams mi 'dra ba gtso bor ston pa'i cha nas don rgyan dang /rjod byed tshig gi nyams mi 'dra ba gtso bor ston pa'i cha nas sgra rgyan/sgra don ci rigs kyi sgo nas brjod don gab pa'am sbas nas ston pas gab tshig gi rgyan zhes bya ste/gab tshig gi rgyan 'di yang don rgyan dang sgra rgyan gnyis su don gyis 'du ba yin no//dang bo don rgyan la rtsa ba'i dbye ba so lnga dang nang gses yan lag dang bcas pa rgyan nyis brgya dang gsum tsam/(rtsa bas dngos bstan gyi dbang du byas pa yin)sgra rgyan la khyon don brgyad tsam/gab tshig la rgyan bcu drug bcas yod de sngar sngon 'gro'i skabs su'ang mdo tsam ngo sprad zin to//don rgyan so lnga'i dang bo rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan la drang brjod kyi rgyan dang /gzhan rnams la 'khyog brjod kyi rgyan zhes kyang bya'o// ཿ rgyan gyi bstan bcos mtsho byang dgyes pa'i 'dzum zer las/deng sang rgyal khab phyi nang gi ches rtson thon gyi rtsom rig nying bcud yod zer mkhan rnams kyi ljags rtsom phal cher kyang tshig rgyan snyan — 68 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

don rgyan spyi bshad/ngag gi rig pa spyi dang /khyad par don rgyan gang rung gi bka' drin las khra ta'i ro thag dgung la bsnyegs pa las/don rgyan 'di dag dpag tshad 'bum phrag gi sa nas 'phangs te tshugs thub kyi mdzad rjes rlabs po che bzhag yod pa ma mthong ngo //don rgyan 'di nyid kha gsal zhing go la/ 'du che zhing blo bskyed ster phul che ba'i dge mtshan dang ldan par ma zad/ brjod bya'i cha nas grub mtha' dang bstan bcos la ma ltos par gang zhig brjod kyang mi 'tsham pa med pas na thun mong ngam spyi'i rgyan zhes pa don la gnas pa lta bu'o//zhes mkhyen rgya yangs pa'i gtam zhig bstsal yod pa ches cher bden par bdag gis sems so /skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —169

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/dang 'o rang bzhinabarjod pa'i rgyan// rtsa bar/ dngos po rnams kyi rang bzhin dang //gnas skabs sna tshogs dngos gsal byed/ /de ni rang bzhin brjod pa ste/ /(don rgyan so lnga las)dang bo'i rgyan yin rigs sogs dper//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ brjod bya'i don gang yin pa de'i rang bzhin/ byed las snyod chos sogs sgro btags dang skur 'debs kyis ma gos shing / thugs bstan dang 'ud brjod kyis ma bslad la/ dpe 'god dang gzugs 'god sogs kyang mi byed par/ drang bo'i ngag gis tshig zin la thon par byas te snyan ngag gi nyams dang ldan par brjod pa la rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan zhes bya'o/ / 'brug khams sbrul sogs kyis ming gi rnam grangs la rigs kyi rgyan zhes kyang zer ro//ཿ 1 rigs rang bzhin brjod pa'i skabs kyi rigs zhes pa rigs rus kyi rigs dang /('jam dbyangs kha che ba)rigs dang rang bzhin don gcig pa/('ju mi pham pa)rigs can spyi la khyab pa'i rigs (smon 'gro yab sras)bcas bzhed tshul gsum yod pa las/rang lugs kyis phyi ma ltar khas len pa yin te/ dgyes glu las/chos gang la'ang de'i gnas lugs drang bor brjod pas rang dang 'dra ba'i rigs can kun la khyab la rigs rus kyi rigs ni ma yin no//zhes dang / rigs gter las/ rigs de gzhan sel las gzhan —170 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan/min//zhes dang /tshad ma rnam 'grel las/ dngos po rigs mthun pa rnams kyi 'dra ba nyid gang yin pa de rigs yin no//zhes sogs kyi dgongs don dang yang mthun pas so//rigs kyi go don gsal zhing rgyas pa tshangs sras bzhad sgrar gsungs pas nges par du lta klog byed dgos so// / 2 bya ba rang bzhin brjod pa'i skabs tshangs sras bzhad sgra las/ 'dir bya ba'i rang bzhin brjod dgos pa'i phyir/ rnam dbye gnyis pa dang gsum pa sogs kyi phrad ci rigs sbyor dgos shing /byed pa bo dang /bya ba'i yul/bya ba gsum nges par du tshang bar byed dgos/zhes gsungs mod/bya ba'i rang bzhin drang bor brjod yod phyin tshig zin la phrad de gnyis nges par du thon dgos don mi 'dug snyam ste phrad dang rnam dbye bsdus pa shin tu mang ba'i phyir ro// / 3 yon tan rang bzhin brjod pa'i skabs dgyes glur gzugs sgra dri ro sogs 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga kho na la sbyor dgos tshul gsungs par mkhas mang gis khyab chung ba'i skyon yod par gsungs la/ tshangs sras bzhad sgrar/spyir yon tan 'jog tshul la du ma yod kyang / 'di'i skabs kyi yon tan ni skyon yon gyi yon tan kho na la go rgyu min par chos rang rang gi gshis lugs rang chos su grub pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam 'gyur ram nus pa zhig yod pa de thams cad 'dir yon tan du 'jog dgos/ zhes gsungs/skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —171

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/dper na/ dug btsan pa dang / zho skyur ba/ 'o ma mngar ba byams sems che ba thams cad 'dir yon tan no//rgyan 'di la byed las kyi yon tan ston pa'i phyir rnam dbye gsum pa'i phrad cig tshig zin la thon dgos/zhes kyang gsungs so/// 4thun min gyi rdzas sam khyad chos shig brjod pa la brten nas de ldan gyi khyad gzhi drang bo'i ngag gis gsal bar ston par byed pa zhig la rdzas rang bzhin brjod pa zhes bya'o// kha cig gis rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan bzhi ka rigs can kun la khyab pa'i rgyan du gsungs pa mi 'thad de/rdzas brjod pa'i dper/mgrin sngon lag na thod pa ni//gnas pa zla ba'i cod pan dang //snum zhing dmar ba'i ral ba can//khyu mchog rgyal mtshan 'khrungs par gyur//zhes mgrin pa sngo zhing lag na thod pa thogs pa/zla ba'i rgyan cha spras pa/ral ba'i kha dog dmar ser du yod pa/lag pa g.yas par lha rnams kyi bsod nams las 'khrungs pa'i khyu mchog gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba bcas thun mong min gyi rdzas sam khyad chos lngas de ldan gyi khyad gzhi dbang phyug gcig bu la go ba las dbang phyug gi rigs la mi go la der rigs kyang med pa'i phyir ro//༈ rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan 'di ni rgya bod kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis ches gtsigs 'dzin byed cing bkol rgya che ba'i rgyan zhig yin phyir/ rtsa bar/ rigs dang bya ba yon tan rdzas/ /rang bzhin 172 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan/brjod pa 'di 'dra ni//bstan bcos kun la rgyal srid nyid//snyan ngag la'ang 'di dag 'dod//ces rgyal bo'i mnga' thang ji bzhin du bstod cing bsngags so// rgyan 'dir mkhas pas bzhed tshul mang yang rgyal dbang lnga ba'i lugs de legs par bdag gis sems so//bzhed tshul la la ltar na rgyan bzhi ga rang gi rigs spyi la khyab pa'i rgyan du thal ba'i skyon 'byung ba dang / 'ju mi pham pa'i bzhed tshul ltar rigs dang rang bzhin don gcig tu byas na rgyan dang bor thun min gyi khyad chos 'di zhes logs su 'jog rgyu med pa dang / sa skya ngag chos sogs kyi lugs ltar rgyan dang bor rigs rus kyi rigs su go na 'og gi gsal byed rgyan gyi skabs nas 'byung ba'i rigs brjod dang zlos shing /rtsa ba me long ma'i rigs rang bzhin brjod pa'i dpe brjod kyang dpe brjod du 'gro dka' ba sogs kyi skyon dang ldan pa'i phyir ro//'di dag gi dogs gcod dang rtsa tshig gi 'gyar gang zhig 'grig min sogs rang cag gi khrid bya'i gzhung na shin ce gsal bas 'dir mang bo 'bri mi dgos so// 2008 6 23skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —173

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/gnyis la dbe rgyag rtsa bar/ ji lta ji zhig ltar mtshungs par//gsal ba gang du rtogs byed pa//de ni dpe zhes bya zhes gsungs pa ltar dpe dang dpe can gnyis tha dad dang so sor bkod de khyad gzhi dang bad chos sogs dngos thugs ci rigs nas mtshungs par sbyor phyir metshungs gsal gyi sgra dang ldan pa'am don gyis mtshungs par ston pa'i rgyan zhig la dpe rgyan zhes bya'o// de la brjod bya'i dpe don sbyor tshul gyi sgo nas 'khrig pa me ste so gnyis dang /mtshungs gsal gyi sgra sbyor tshul gyi sgo nas thub pa ri ste don bdun yod do//1 chos dbe/ dpe dang dpe can gnyis la chos dang chos can gnyis su phyes pa'i chos gnyis mtshungs pa'i tshul tshig zin la dngos su thon zhing mtshungs gsal gyi sgra dang ldan pa zhig la chos dpe zhes bya'o//2 dngos dpe/༈ dpe dang dpe can gnyis kur chos dang chos can gnyis su phyes pa'i chos can gnyis mtshungs pa tsam mtshungs sgras brjod de mahāngs chos thugs las rtogs par byed pa zhig la dngos dpe zhes 474/—/ skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

dpe rgyan/ 1 chos dpe dang dngos dpe gnyis gang yin yang dpe don mtshungs par brjod pa'i cha nas 'dra yang /mtshungs chos tshig zin la dngos su thon min gyi cha nas mi 'dra'o//⑫ / bstan pa'i sgron me'i dngos dpe'i dpe brjod dang bo'i skabs dpe can gsang bdag gi zhal khyim nag pa dang / dpe char sprin gyi rang mdangs nag pa/ spyan dang glog dmar 'khyug stangs myur zhing dmar ba'i mtshungs chos shugs la ston pa dang / dpe brjod gnyis pa'i skabs dpe can rgyal ba'i gsung gis sgrib gnyis 'joms pa dang / dpe bdud rtsis nad rigs sam skom pa'i gdung ba 'joms pa/ yang / dpe can lam nyams su blangs pa la brten nas sa lam gyi rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la 'khrungs pa'am gong du 'phel ba dang / dpe lha'i dbang bos bdud rtsir rol te bde skyid dam lus stobs gong du 'phel ba'i mtshungs chos dag tshig zin la dngos su ma thon par thugs las go bar byas pa'o//3 ba ga pa'i dpe/༈ dpe don gnyis sbyor tshul go ldog ste dpe can dpe dang dpe dpe can gyi tshul du sbyar te khyad chos 'dra ba'i sgo nas mtshungs par ston pa zhig la bzlog pa'i dpe zhes bya'o// 'di ni sbyor lugs tsam las don la dpe don go ldog pa min te/tshangs sras bzhad sgra las/ de yang dpe dpe can gyi sbyor tshul tsam las don go bzlog pa skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —175

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/min no//zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/des na dpe don gnyis mtshungs par ston phyir dpe don go ldog pa'i tshul gyis brjod pa tsam yin no//4phan tshun gyi dbe/༈ dpe don gnyis kyis gcig gis gcig la mtshon res byas pa'i sgo nas khyad 'phags kyi mtshungs chos ston par byed pas na) phan tshun gyi dpe zhes bya'o// 5 des pa'i dme/༈ dpe can de bzang ngan ci rigs kyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa'i khyad chos can zhig yin pa ston phyir/de'i mtshungs zlar 'os pa'i dpe gcig bzhag pa de las gzhan pa'i dpe med par nges pa ste thag bcad pas na nges pa'i dpe zhes bya'o//6 nges med kyi dpe/ cadape can khyad par du 'phags pa der dpe gcig bzhag pa de kho na ma yin par dpe gzhan pa'ang yod chog pa'am yod nges par brjod pas na nges med kyi dpe zhes bya'o//7 bcas la'i dbe/༈ dpe can de'i dpe zhig bzhag nas/de'i tshig zin la khyad chos gcig gis mtshungs par sbyar ba kho nas cha thams chad du —176 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/
