dpe rgyan/mtshungs par brjod pa min par/khyad chos 'di dang 'di lta bu'i sgo nas kyang mtshungs tshul yod pa thugs la ston pas na bsdus pa'i dpe zhes bya ste/mtshungs chos gzhan dag bsdus pa'o//8du byung gi dbe/༈ dpe can de nyid phul du byung ba'am khyad par du 'phags tshul ston phyir/ dpe don gnyis gnas yul lam kha dog dang dbyibs gzugs sogs khyad chos gcig gi sgo nas mi mtshungs pa tsam las/ gzhan mi mtshungs pa'i chos gtan nas med ces 'jig rten grags tshod las 'das pa'i 'ud chen pos brjod pa zhig la phul byung gi dpe zhes bya'o//rgyan 'dir 'gyur la lar khyad par gyi dpe zhes pa'ang yod do//dpe don gyi khyad par med pa ma gtogs phul byung gi rgyan zhes 'og tu'ang 'byung ngon/9 rab brtags kyi dpe/ / dpe can de'i mtshungs dper gyar ba'i dpe zhig gis mtshungs tshul ston pa yin mod/ brjod stadros kyis dpe la de lta bu'i bsam pa med bzhin du yod do zhes sgro btags te mtshungs dpe gzhan 'dren pa zhig la rab btags kyi dpe zhes bya'o/ / 'di la rab rtog gi dpe zhes bris pa'ang yod/ rgyan 'dir sbyor lugs kyi dbang gis mtshungs sgra tshig zin la ma thon na yang chog go// dpe sems med bem po zhig la sgro btags na legs par gsungs/skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —177

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/10 rmad byung gi dbe gi/༈ dpe don gnyis po mtshungs chos shugs las rtogs shing /tshig zin la dpe can ngo mtshar ba ston phyir brtag pa mtha' bzung gi tshig bkod de dpe la mi srid pa'i khyad chos ngo mtshar ba du ma zhig 'dzoms dgos par brjod pa zhig la rmad byung gi dpe zhes byas//11 snangs ba'i dbe ṣ+ka༈ dpe don gnyis ha cang 'dra drags pas gnyis na'i khyad par 'byed ma thub par mgo bongs rmongs su brjod pa zhig la rmongs pa'i dpe zhes bya'o/// rmongs pa'i dpe'i skabs/ khams 'grel dang bod mkhas snyan 'grel/ rin spungs snyan 'grel/ tshig rgyan rig pa'i sgo 'byed sogs gzhung 'ga' rer/ dpe can mthong bas dpe ru 'khrul ba dang slar yang dpe can du 'khrul bar brjod pa zhig dgos par gsungs mod/ dpe dpe can gnyis ha cang mtshungs pas mtshungs chos shugs las rtogs phyir mtshungs gsal gyi sgra mi sbyor la/ tshig zin la dpe can dpe ru 'khrul ba skad kyis brjod dgos pa rgyan 'di'i khyad chos yin pa las/ dpe dpe can gnyis ka gang yin ngo ma shes pa tsam zhig rgyan 'di'i ngo bo min pas/ dbyangs can dgyes glu dang kun mkhyen sdom tshig sogs su gsal ba'i lugs de kho na 'thad —178 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

do dpergyun/༈ rmongs pa'i dpe'i skabs khams 'grel las/ kha cig gis phan tshun gyi dpe dang dbye ba med par 'gyar ro snyam du bsam pa byang 'dug mod/ phan tshun dpe ni dpe dajo dpe can brje len gyi tshul du dper 'god res byas nas mtshungs par brjod pa dang /'dir (dpe )dpe can gnyis po so sor dbye ba ma phyed par rmongs pa skad du brjod pa'i khyad par ches che ba ma go bar zad la/ zhes gsungs/12 the tshom gyi dbe/myu/ dpe don gnyis ha cang 'dra mtshungs su gyur bas de gnyis gang yin cha ma 'tshal bar blo rtse gnyis ldan gyis brjod pa zhig la the tshom gyi dpe zhes bya'o//13 gtaga'abebs kyi dme/༈ dpe la med pa'i dpe can gyi thun min khyad chos shig rtags sam rgyu mtshan du bkod nas dpe ma yin par dpe can yin tshul la nges pa rnyed skad kyis brjod pa zhig la gtan 'bebs kyi dpe zhes bya'o//gtan la 'bebs pa'i dpe dang /gtan la phebs pa'i dpe/gtan la 'bab pa'i dpe/ sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i dpe/ rtogs pa'i dpe/ the tshom sel ba'i dpe/ nges pa rnyed pa'i dpe sogs ming gi rnam grangs yin mod so so'i sgra bshad mi 'dra'o// rgyan 'di ni skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 179

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/dpe dang dpe can gnyis ha cang mtshungs pas rgyu mtshan zhig la ma brten par so sor 'byed mi nus par ston pa dgos pas mtshungs chos thugs la rtogs par byas kyang chog gong gi rmongs pa'i dpe dang the tshom gyi dpe gtan 'bebs kyi dpe gsum brjod gzhi gcig la sbyar na legs te/ rmongs pa'i dper dpe don gyi khyad par ma shes par 'khrul bar thag bcad pa dang / the tshom skabs dpe don gnyis gang yin la the tshom pa/ gtan 'bebs skabs so sor ma 'dres par nges pa rnyed skad kyis brjod dgos pa'i phyir ro//༈ zhe tshom gyi dpe'i skabs tshangs sras bzhad sgra las/dpe 'di dang gong gi rmad byung gi dpe de dpe can las cung zad dman pa'am de la mi do ba zhig 'jog pa 'dra yang / rmad byung skabs dpe de la yon tan de 'dra zhig med pa gzhir bzung ba'i steng nas gal te yon tan de 'dra zhig yod srid na dpe can dang mtshungs zhes brjod pa dang / 'dir dpe de la mi ldan pa'i khyad chos dpe can la yod par nges pa rnyed de the tshom bcad nas gtan la 'bebs pa lta bu'i khyad par yod/ ces gsungs/—180 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

dpe rgyan/14 sbyar ba'i dbe/byu / spyir mi rigs gang yin yang rang rang gi skad la gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i thun min khyad chos re yod pas rgya gar skad la yod pa'i khyad chos dag bod skad la med pa dang / de bzhin bod skad la yod pa dag kyang rgya gar skad la med pa mang bo yod/ de'i phyir rgyan mang bo zhig gi nang du sbyar ba'i rgyan zhes pa zhig 'byang ba ni rgya gar gyi skad cha'i sgyu rtsal gtso bo zhig yin tshod 'dug zlo/ rgya gar gyi skad la phun sum tshogs shing ngo mtshar ba'i khyad chos rang shugs kyis 'byang bas don rgyan mang bo zhig gi nang du bsam bzhin thon par byes pa'am rang thugs kyis byung ba mang bo zhig yod kyang /bod skad la ji bzhin mi 'tsham pas sngon byon mkhas pa tshos snam bu'i thags la za 'og gi ri mo'i dpe ru gsungs pa ni shin tu thugs mad do// de'i phyir bod skad la sbyar ba ji bzhin zhig 'byang dka' yang / sngon byon mkhas pa tshos blo sgo 'byed phyir rgya gar ldang rigs 'gros kyi dpe ba/da zlong du mdzad do// de yang sbyar ba la sgra sbyar dang don sbyar ga sdo nga tā pasgra la zlor/ ni sgra gzags gcig gam ming gcig dpe don gnyis kur sbyar du yod par༄ ma zad de gnyis ku'i dngos ming yin pa zhig dgos te/ dper na/ mi yi seng ge zhes pa sangs rgyas dang khyab 'jug gnyis ku'i dngos ming yin pa dang / sgra gzugs kyang gcig yin pa lta bu'o//skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —181—

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/gnyis pa/ don sbyar ni don nam rgyu mtshan zhig brjod na dpe don gnyis kur sbyor du yod pa tsam las de gnyis ku'i dngos ming yin mi dgos te/ dper na/ dri bral dkar bo lta bu/ dpe can dbyangs can ma dang dpe zla ba gnyis ga'i mdzes dpal la sbyor rung ba yin yang / de gnyis ku'i ming dngos min pa bzhin no//sbyar ba'i rgyan 'di 'og nas kyang lan mang 'byung yad rgyan rang rang gi ngo bo mi 'dra ba las sgra sbyar dang don sbyar byed tshul la khyad par med pas skabs 'dir nges par byed pa gal che'o/ / bod mkhas pa sogs kyis sgra zor dog pa'am rtsa bar bstun ci thub kyis sbyar rgyan phal cher sgra sbyar byed dgos par 'dod kyang / rgyal dbang lnga ba sogs kyis sgra zor yangs pa'am bod skad dang bstun ci thub kyis don sbyar gtso bor byed do//༈ dpe don gnyis kur sbyar rgyu'i mtshungs chos gnyis las mi nyung zhing de yang don sbyar gyi sgo nas mtshungs sgra dang ldan par byas pa zhig la sbyar ba'i dpe zhes bya'o//༈ rtsa bar/ bsil zer can gyi 'gran zla dang //dpal dang ldan dang dri bzang gis/ /khyod kyi gdong ni pad+ma bzhin/ /zhes pa 'di ni sbyar ba'i dpe/ /zhes gsungs te/ dpe can bud med mdzes ma'i gdong de dkar zhing gsal ba'am mdzes pa'i cha nas bsil zer —182 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

dpe rgyan/can te zla ba'i 'gran zlar gyar ba dang / gzhan yid 'phrog par byed pa'i mdzes dpal dang ldarno pa/ zhal sgor lhan skyes kyi dri bzang ste dri zhim dang ldan pa bcas khyad chos gsum gyis dpe pad+ma bzhin no zhes dpe don gnyis don sbyar gyi sgo nas mtshungs par sbyar zhing mtshungs gsal gyi sgra dang yang ldan par byas pa'o/ / zhes rang lugs kyis 'dod de/ sdom las/ gnyis las mi nyung don sbyar mtshungs sgra sbyar///lha /ji / mi nyung don la sbyar dgos sbyar ba'i dpe//zhes gsungs 15mnyam nyid kyi dbe/༈ sgra gcig la gcod mtshams mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis dpe don gnyis por so sorasbyar te don tha dad du go rgyu yod pa'am/ yang na sgra don gang rung gi sgo nas dpe don gnyis kyi mtshungs chos gcig tsam mtshungs sgras dngos su mtshungs par sbyar ba zhig la mnyam nyid kyi dpe zhes bya'o//༈ gong gi mtshan nyid phyi ma ni sgra zor yangs pa'i dbang du byas pa ste dpe brjod rang cag gi khrid bya'i gzhung du bkod pa ltar dang /snga ma ni rtsa bar/skyed tshal phreng 'di bu mo bzhin//mdzes ldan sā la kā na na/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di ni dpe can bu mo dang dpe skyed tshal gnyis la sbyar dgos pa las/ dpe la sbyar tshe/ sna la spos dkar gyi shing / kā na na nags kyi don yin pas/ skyed tshal spos dkar shing gi skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —183—

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/nags kyi mdzes ldan pa zhes par 'gyur/dpe can bud med la sbyar tshe/sa bcas pa/a la ka lan bu/ā na na gdong ste/bu mo gdong lan bu dang bcas pas mdzes so//zhes par 'gyur/'di ni sgra tsam 'dra ba'i sgo nas mtshungs parasbyar ba las brjod bya don steng na mtshungs pa'i chos med pa'i rgyan zhig go zhes bod mkhas sogs kyis gsungs so//rtsa ba'i dpe brjod ji bzhin bod skad kyi steng nas 'ong thathos med kyang /bod mkhas sogs kyis phyogs 'gro'i dpe brjod 'jog srol btod pa bzhin/ snyan ngag spyi don las/ lang tsho yol ba'i mdza' grogs rgan po khyod//lo mang thal ba'i sdong skam rjes 'gro ste//kha dog mi sdug gnyer mas yongs khebs 35 //rigs mthun gzhan gyi gral nas phyung bas so//zhes gcod mtshams mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis dpe can gyi skabs su tshig phrad kyi shing dang /dpe'i skabs su rtsi shing gi shing la go ba lta bu'i dpe brjod 'di gsungs so//sgra gcig bu de dpe don gnyis kur mnyam nyid dam khyab mnyam du 'jug pas na mnyam nyid kyi dpe zhes bya ba yin no//༈ mnyam nyid gyi dpe dang sbyar ba'i dpe'i khyad par gsung skabs/kun mkhye)na sdom ni5ga tu/la las ba sa zhes pa ni 'jam kha ba dang bya gshong ba sogs kyi bzhed tshul la zur za ba ste/de rnams kyis snga mar sbyar ba'i dbe mtshungs chos sngon la brjod nas dpe gsal byed kyis bstan pa yin la/'dir ni mnyam nyid kyi dpe gsal byed sngon la brjod pas mi 'dra/zhes gsungs/ba951 — 84 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

dpe rgyan/mas dra sa zhes pa bod mkhas sogs kyis sgra sbyar dang gcod mtshams mi 'dra ba kho nas 'byed dgos par gsungs pa la zur za ba'o/ / kha ci nga bsres zhes pa ni rin spungs pa'i bzhed par zur za ba ste/ khong gi snyan 'grel las/ 'dir ma zad thun mong rgyan gyi sbyar ba kun la'ang tshigs bcad kyi dbang gis na sgra don mtshungs pa can gyi rkang pa gcig las mang ba zhig nges par dgos te/ zhes sbyar rgyan thams cad dpe rgyan du 'dod pa lta bu zhig gsungs pas so/ / gzhan sa skya ngag chos kyis rgyan snga ma mnyam nyid dang phyi masbyar rgyan du 'dod par snang ngon/16mid pa'i dbe/༈ dpe can khyad par du 'phags pa ston phyir dpe gnyis sogs la (rtsa ba'i dpe brjod gzhir bzhag)la smad pa'am yang na dpe'i khyad chos la smad de dpe can dang cha thams cad nas ji bzhin mi mtshungs tshul brjod pa zhig la smad pa'i dpe zhes bya'o//tshangs sras bzhad sgrar 'di la dpe gnyis nges par dgos so zhes gsungs/17bsngags pa'i dme/ dpe can phul du byung zhing ngo mtshar ba ston phyir dpe mchog tu gyur ba 'ga' zhig la bsngags pa brjod de dpe can dang mtshungs pa tshig zin la dngos su thon pa zhig la bsngags pa'i dpe zhes bya'o//skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —185

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/18 brjod 'dod kyi dbe/༈ dpe don gnyis mtshungs zhes brjod na skyon yon ci yod pa'am dpe la skyon yon ci yod kyang de la mi lta bar kho bos mtshungs zhes brjod par 'dod ces thugs la dpe don gnyis kyi khyad chos snadro /shā tan mtshungs par brjod pa zhig la brjod 'dod kyi depe ༈ 'di'i dpe brjod la rtsa bar/ yon tan ldan nam skyon gyar yang / /zla ba khyod gdong mtshungs zhes pa/ /brjod 'dod bdage gi yid la yod//ces pa brjod 'dod dpe zhes rigs//zhes gsungs par 'grel tshul mi mthun pa gnyis byung 'dug ste/ sngon gyi snyan 'grel phal cher dang tshangs sras bzhad sgra sogs su/ dpe la skyon yon ci yod kyang zhes skyon yon zhes pa dpe la sbyar ba dang / rang cag gi khrid bya'i gzhung dang snyan ngag spyi don sogs su dpe dang dpe can gnyis mtshungs par sbyar na skyon yon ci yod kyang zhes 'grel yod kyang bdag gis mtshan nyid bzhag tshe 'dam nga can du byas pas gang zhig 'grig min dpyad/ bstan pa'i sgron me'i dpe brjod de snga ma'i lugs ltar byas 'dug go//rgyan 'di brjod 'dod kyi dbang du ཿsa pa yin yang spyir dpe don mtshungs pa zhig nges par du dgos —186 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

dpe rgyan/19 'gal ba'i dber/༈ dpe don gnyis gnas sa'am rten sa tha dad pa dang yang na dbyibs gzugs sogs rnam pa mi 'dra tshul brjod de mtshungs pa shugs las rtogs pa'am mtshungs pa tsam tshig zin la thon pa zhig la 'gal ba'i dpe zhes bya'o/ / bod mkhas snyan 'grel dang khams 'grel du skabs 'di'i 'gal ba de gcig tha dad kyi 'gal ba'i steng nas bsgrubs 'dug kyang /snar thang ba dang lnga ba chen mo sogs kyis/dpe don gnyis kyi gzugs phan tshun rnam pa tha dad du 'char ba'i 'gal ba tsam zhes gsungs so// 'di la'ang dpe rigs mi 'dra ba gnyis tsam dgos so// / gong gi brgyad pa phung byung gi dpe dang bcu dgu ba 'gal ba'i dpe gnyis gnas sa'am rten sa tha dad pa dang / yang na dbyibs gzugs sogs rnam pa mi 'dra ba tsam las mi mtshungs tshul med pa skad du brjod dgos pa'i cha nas 'dra yang / phul byung gi dper de las gzhan pa'i mi mtshungs tshul med pa 'ud chen pos brjod dgos pa dang / 'gal ba'i dper dpe don gnyis 'gal ba tsam brjod de mtshungs chos shugs las rtogs pa'am mtshungs pa shārdo /ga zin la thon yang 'ud brjod byed mi dgos pa'i khyad par skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —187

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/20 dgag la'i dbe/༈ dpe'i khyad chos 'ga' zhig la smad de tshig zin la khyad 'phags kyi dpe can dang gtan nas mi mtshungs tshul brjod kyang mtshungs pa'i khyad chos shugs las rtogs thub pa zhig la dgag ga'i dpe zhes bya'o//༈ bcu drug pa smad pa'i dpe dang nyi shu ba dgag pa'i dpe gnyis gang yin yang ngo gdong nas dpe la smad pa ltar brjod pa'i cha nas 'dra mod/ smad pa'i dper ji bzhin mi mtshungs pa las gtan nas mi mtshungs tshul brjod mi dgos shing / dgag pa'i dper tshig zin la gtan nas mi mtshungs par brjod de mtshungs pa'i khyad chos thugs las rtogs thub pa zhig dgos pa mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ro//21 rto bstod kyi dbe/ dpe can gyi khyad chos cung dman zhing dpe'i khyad chos khyad 'phags shig bkod nas/spyir yin na dpe don dman lhag lta bur 'dug mod/kho bos ni dman lhag med par mtshungs zhes brjod pa skad zhig la ngo bstod kyi dpe zhes bya'o/ / 'di la mdzes pa'i dpe dang mtshungs pa'i dpe zhes kyang zer/—188 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

dpe rgyan/22 de nyid brjod la'i dme/ ga dpe don gnyis ha cang 'dra drags pas khyad par 'byed dka' mod brtags shing dpyad pas tshig zin la dpe can ngos zin pa skad kyis yin lugs ltar bden par brjod de mtshungs chos shugs las rtogs par bya ba zhig la de nyid brjod pa'i dpe zhes hā/ /mi/ //sa la/ sbyor lugs kyi dbang gis mtshungs sgra tshig zin la / nyer gnyis pa de nyid brjod pa'i dpe dang bcu gsum pa gtan 'bebs kyi dpe gnyis/ dpe ma yin par dpe can yin pa ngos zin pa skad kyis dpe can gtan la 'bebs dgos pa'i cha nas 'dra yang /gtan 'bebs kyi dper dpe can gyi thun min khyad chos shig rtags su 'god dgos la/ de nyid brjod pa'i dper mtshungs chos thugs las rtogs par byas te/tshig zin la dpe can gyi de nyid brjod pa ste gtan la phabs pa tsam gyis chog go//23 thunamong minala'i dpe/༈ dpe phal ba zhig bkod de des dpe can la ji bzhin mtshungs mi thub pas dpe can de'i dper rang nyid 'god pa las 'os med par brjod pa zhig la thun mong min pa'am rjes 'gro med pa'i dpe zhes bya'o//skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ 189

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/༈ bstan pa'i sgron me'i dpe brjod du dpe can sangs rgyas kyi thugs gcig bu las dpe phal ba logs su mi gsal la/ dpe brjod gzhan dang gzhan na'ang de ltar bris pa re 'dug mod/ rtsa bar/ ji lta ji zhig ltar mtshungs par//gsal bar gang du rtogs byed pa//de ni dpe zhes bya/ zhes gsungs pa ltar dpe rgyan la sbyor lugs sna tshogs yod kyang / dpe dang dpe can gnyis ni rnam pa thams cad du tha dad dang so sor yod dgos te/ mtshungs rgyu'i dpe can dang mtshungs yul gyi dpe gnyis mtshungs par ston pas dpe rgyan zhes btags pa'i phyir ro// skabs 'di'i rtsa ba'i dpe brjod du'ang / zla ba pad+ma dag gis ni/ /mdzes pa las 'das khyod kyi gdong / /bdag rang nyid dang mtshungs par gyar//zhes don gyis zla ba dang pad+ma dpe ru bkod yod cing / rang sgrod kyi gdong dpe ru bkod pa ni dpe btags pa ba yin no// de'i phyir tshangs sras bzhad sgrar yang / dpe khyad 'phags shig bkod nas des kyang dpe can la mtshungs mi nus pa/ zhes dang / tshig rgyan rig pa'i sgo 'byed las/ dpe can de yi khyad chos la bsngags pa'i dpe 'ga' zhig dngos su bkod nas des kyangadape can de'i khyad chos yongs su rdzogs par mtshon mi nus pas na dpe can rang nyid kho na rang gi dper brjod pa zhes gsungs so//—190 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

dpe rgyan/24 byung min gyi dab/༈ 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir sngar byung ma myong ba'am 'byung mi srid pa mdzes sdug yod tshad phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa lta bu'i dpe zhig bzhag ste dpe can dang mtshungs par ston pas na 'byung min gyi dpe'am byung min gyi dpe zhes bya'o//25grid mi gyi dbe/༈ dpe las byung ba'i khyad chos mi srid pa zhig dang dpe can gyi rdotā rnodro spra /da pa gnyis mtshungs par ston pa zhig la srid min gyi ༈ 'dir dpe las byang ba'i khyad chos mi srid pa zhes brjod pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ rtsag ba las/ zla ba'i gzugs las dug bzhin dang //tsan dan las ni me bzhin du//zhal 'di las ni tsub mo'i tshig/shās pa srid pa min pa'i dpe//zhes khyad chos kho nar sbyar ba'i phyir ༈ dpe rgyan nyer bzhi ba dang nyer lnga ba'i skabs sngon byon 'grel mdzad rnams la bzhed tshul sna tshogs shig yod de/sa skya ngag chos kyis snga mar srid min kyi dpe dang phyi mar 'byung min gyi dpe skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —191—

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/zhes gsungs la/ 'ju mi pham pa dang / bod mkhas/ rin spungs pa/'brug khams sprul sogs kyis snga mar byung min gyi dpe zhes dus 'das pa lasbyar zhing / phyi mar srid min gyi dpe'am yang na 'byang min gyi dpe zhes 'byang dngos mi srid pa zhig la sbyor dgos khyor rnam dbye lnga ba'i phrardo cig kyang nges par thon dgos par gsungaso mod/ rgyan 'di gnyis kyi khyad par gtso bo ni/ rgyan snga ma byung min gyi dper/ dpe de 'dra zhig sngar byang ma myong la/ phyis kyang 'byung mi srid pa ltabu zhig dang dpe can byed 'phags gnyis mtshungs par sbyor ba yin la/rgyan phyi ma srid min gyi dpe ni/ dpe'i khyad chos mi srid pa zhig dang dpe can gyi khyad chos mi srid pa gnyis mtshungs par sbyor phyir rnam dbye gsum pa dang lnga ba sogs kyi phrad ci rigs re'ang tshig zin la thon dgos pa ni mi 'dra ba'i khyad par gtso bo yin par snang ngon/26 mang ba'i dbe/༈ dpe can gyi khyad chos phun sum tshogs shing ngo mtshar ba ston phyir khyad chos de ldan gyi dpe gcig ma yin par du ma zhig bkod de tāshā can gyi khyad chos gsal bar byed pa zhig la mang ba'i dpe zhes —192 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

dpe rgyan/27rnam 'gyur gyi dme/༈ dpe can gyi rnam 'gyur gsal phyir dpe khyad 'phags gang yang rung ba zhig gi nang nas dpe can de tshur bton pa'am thon pa 'dra ba'i skad kyis brjod pa zhig la rnam 'gyur gyi dpe zhes bya'o//༈ khams 'grel las/ rnam 'gyur zhes pa ni ngo bo gser lta bu la rnam 'gyur gyi gnas skabs rna rgyan dang /gdub bu dang /ska rags la sogs pa'i khyad par tha dad pa ltar 'dir yang rnam 'gyur gyi gnas skabs mi mo'i gdong gi rnam par snang ba ma gtogs ngo bo dpe zla ba dang pad ma dag yin par brjod pa'i tshig sbyor ro//zhes shin tu gsal bar gsungs so//28 phreng ba'i dbe/༈ dpe can gcig gi khyad chos ngo mtshar ba de ston phyir dpe mang bo zhig bkod pa yin yang /sbyor lugs kyis mtshungs gsal gyi sgra mang bos dpe dag las snga ma snga ma dpe dang phyi ma phyi ma dpe can gyi tshul du phreng bar bkod pa zhig la phreng ba'i dpe zhes bya'o//29 ngag don gyi dbe/༈ dpe dang dpe can gnyis kyi khyad gzhi dang khyad chos sogs rim bzhin 'jal ba'am mtshon du yod pa'i ming tshig yi ge'i bdag skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —/93

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/nyid can gyi ngag gi phreng ba rgyun mar spel zhing byed can drug las gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i phrad ci rigs gtso bor thon par byas pa'i (drug brgyad gnyis kyi phrad kyang thon mi chog pa ma yin)rgyan zhig la ngag don gyi dpe zhes bya'o// lke( spyir snyan ngag gi rgyan gang yin yang ngag don du ma grub pa zhig med de/ mi pham snyan 'grel las/ ngag don zhes pa dper na tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan pa'i dpe rnams brjod bya'i don tshan gcig brjod pa'i ngag gi rgyan la zer ba yin te/ yi ge du ma 'dus pa las ming dang /tshig du ma 'dus pa las ngag gi rgyun 'byung ba yin pa'i phyir ro//zhes gsungs/ des na ngag don gyi rgyan 'dir dpe dpe can gnyis kyi khyad gzhi dang khyad chos rnams phan tshun rim pa bzhin du mtshungs par sbyor du yod la/ dpe don gnyis kur bya byed las gsum gyis zel phyir byed can drug ste rnam dbye dang bo dang gnyis pa/ gsum pa/ bzhi ba/ bdun pa/ lnga ba bcas kyi phrad sogs gang rung re nges par tshig zin la thon dgos phyir/ dgos chos kyis ngag don gyi dpe zhes ming btags pa yin la/ mtshungs gsal gyi sgra sbyor tshul gyis bzhin sgra gcig pa'i dpe dang / bzhin sgra du ma'i dpe gnyis yod do//—194 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

dpe rgyan/30tham dngos ma'i dpe/༈ sho lo ka gcig gi byed snga mar dpe can gyi khyad gzhi dang khyad chos bkod cing phyed phyi mar de'i dpe ru 'gro 'os pa'i zla bo zhig gi khyad gzhi dang khyad chos bkod kyang mtshungs gsal gyi sgra mi sbyor bar dpe don gnyis kyi mtshungs pa'i khyad chos shugs las rtogs pa zhig la zla bo dngos po'i dpe zhes bya'o//༈ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi skye bo gso thigs dang /rang re'i bod kyi legs bshad rtsom rig phal che ba/dmangs khrod kyi gtam dpe sogs mang bo zhig rgyan 'di'i lam nas brtsams yod pas ches bkol rgya che zhing ngo mtshar ba'i rgyan zhig go//31mtshungs sbyor gyi dpe/༈ dpe lhag pa dang dpe can dman pa yin yang de gnyis kyi bya ba'i cho ga rigs gcig tu bsdus te/mtshungs gsal gyi sgra med par rdzu/drir+sha shāsbyi shād chos shugs las ston thub pa zhig la mtshungs sbyor ༈mtshungs sbyor gyi dpe dang ngo bstod kyi dpe gnyis gang yin yang dpe mchog cing dpe can dman pa zhig 'god dgos pa'i cha skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ 193—

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/nas 'dra yang /ngo bstod kyi dper dman lhag yod kyang med pa ltar mtshungs so zhes mtshungs sgra dang ldan dgos shing /mtshungs sbyor gyi dper dpe don gnyis bya ba'i cho ga rigs gcig tu bsdus te mtshungs pa shugs las rtogs dgos phyir dpe don dman lhag gi khyad sdor+sha dro spyu zin la dngos su mi brjod la/mtshungs gsal gyi sgra yang mi 32rgyu'i dpe/ ca dpe can gyi dbyibs gzugs dang byed nus sogs rgyu mtshan 'di dang 'di lta bus dpe de dang mtshungs so zhes mtshungs gsal gyi sgras dpe don gnyis mtshungs par sbyor ba la rgyu'i dpe zhes bya'o//myu/ rgyan 'dir rtsa bar he tu zhes 'byung ba rgyu 'bras dang / rgyu mtshan/ gtan tshigs sogs du ma la 'jug pas/ si tu yab sras kyis rgyu 'bras dang /smon 'gro yab sras kyis rgyu mtshan du 'grel to//rgyan 'dir mtshungs gsal gyi sgra med na 'og gi rgyu'i gzugs can dang 'dres par 'gyur ro//༈ rtsa bar sbyor tshul gyi dbang gis/bsdus pa'i dpe dang /rab btags kyi dpe/rmongs pa'i dpe/the tshom gyi dpe/ gtan 'bebs kyi dpe/dgag pa'i dpe/de nyid brjod pa'i dpe/zla bo dngos po'i —196 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

dpe mtshungasasbyoragyidapebs////dgulamatshungs gsal gyi sgra dngos su med do//1 rtsa bar/ gzugs can dpe yi rnam rtog rnams//mtha' yod ma yin de yi phyir//blo ldan rnams la phyogs tsam bstan//ma brjod rjes su dpag par bya//zhes gsungs pa ltar zhib tu dpyad na dpe rgyan gcig pur dbye ba mtha' med pa thong la/khams 'grel du/sbyar rgyan gyi zla bo dngos po'i dpe/ mi mthun pa'i dpe/ sngon med pa'i dpe zhes rgyan gsum la dpe brjod bkod 'dug cing / sngon byon mkhas pa gzhan gyi brtsams chos khrod du'ang dpe rgyan so gnyis su ma 'dus pa'i dpe rgyan mang du 'byung ngon/dab rgyan gyi skyonayonadang mtshungs sgra/ཿ snyan gzhung me long ma sogs rang re'i snyan ngag gi gzhung thams cad du dpe rgyan skabs dpe don rtags 'dres dang / mang nyung / mtho dman sogs kyi skyon yon ngos 'dzin dang / mtshungs gsal gyi sgra rnams dpe rgyan gyi mjug tu bkod 'dug mod/spyir mtshungs sgra de rnams ni dpe rgyan gyi skabs lag len la 'debs shing bkol spyod byed dgos pa sha stag yin gshis/ thog mar dpe don skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 197

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/sbyor tshul gyi skyon yon ngos zin pa dang mtshungs gsal gyi sgra rnams kyang legs par khong du chud par byas rjes/ dpe rgyan sbyor tshul dngos la zhugs na go rim dang mthun zhing gsar slob dag la'ang go ba bskyed sla ba sogs kyi dge mtshan dang ldan no snyam ste bdag go rmongs blo'i dbang du gyur yod na mthol zhing bshags so//kau dpe don gnyis mtshungs pa gsal byed dam go byed du gyur byi r+sha ñcha spya dro smra gyi sgra'am tshig rgyan zhig la mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi ༈ dbyangs can dgyesatwar rtsa bas dngos bstan gyi mtshungs sgra re gsum du gsungs kyang kun mkhyen sdom tshig 'dir sde tshan gnyis pa'i mjug gi chos mthun dang / chos thun mong ba/ grib ma 'dra ba gsum so sor bgrangs pa dang / sde tshan bzhi ba'i rjes su 'gro 'ching gcig tu sbyar bas re drug rin spungs pas bsnan pa'i cha sogs bcu gcig bcas khyon don bdun du 'dod la/ bod mkhas sogs kyis rtsabs dngos bstan re lngar 'dod do//'brag khams sprul rin po ches de'i steng du rgya 'grel las gsungs pa'i 〈pe brjod lnga bsnan te bdun cur bzhed pa sogs grangs 'dren tshul mang bo yod do//rtsa ba me long mar mtshungs sgrar sde tshan phyes med kyang rgya 'grel nas sde tshan gnyis dang bod kyi mkhas pa tshos sde tshan bzhi ru phyes par gsungs/sde tshan bzhi ni/ dpe don gsal bar byed pa nyer gnyis/ 'dra ba'i —198 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

dpe rgyan/don gsal bar byed pa bco brgyad dam nyi shu/dpe rgyan gsal bar byed pa bco lnga/rgyan khyad par du 'phags pa dgu'am bcu'o//( spyir sum cu ba'i rtsa ba las/tshigs su bcad pa'i mtshams sbyor rnams//cung zad bsdus pa yod na'ang //zhes dang /snyan ngag me long ma las/brjid pa tshig sdud mang bo nyid//'di ni lhug pa dag gi gsos//gsungs pa ltar snyan ngag gi tshigs bcad lhug skabs gang yin yang tshig sdud byed tshul la mkhas dgos pa rtsa ba'i cha rkyen yin la/de lta bu'i tshig sdud la rgya gar du dbye ba drug gsungs pa'i nang gi 'bra mang bo'i tshig sdud ni don gzhan ston byed kyi bsdu ba yin yang /gasnyan ngag gi skabs 'dir bshad pa'i 'bru mang bo'i tshig sdud 'di dpe don gnyis mtshungs par sbyor byed kyi sgra bsdus te don gyis mtshungs par sbyor ba yin pas/khyad gzhi dang khyad chos gnyis phan tshun gzhi mthun du sdud pa'am yang na ming tshig dag gi cha shas bsdu ba'i phyogs na yod par mngon no//'on kyang khams 'grel las don gzhan ston byed du bsdu ba'i bsdu bar gsungs so//rgyan 'di ni dpe sngon dang dpe can mjug la sbyor dgos te/tshul 'di dpe don mtshungs par sbyor ched yin la 'og gi gzugs rgyan dang mi nor ba'i khyad par 'byed byed kyang yin no// rgyal dbang lnga ba'i lugs la rgyan 'dir bdag sgra'i phrad cig kyang dgos pa thun min gyi khyad chos yin tshul kun mkhyen sdom tshig 'dir gsungs pa bzhin no//2008 7 15skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ 199

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/gsum la gzugs rgya rdzo/ don rgyan gsum pa gzugs rgyan ni lud kyis brjod pa thal mi che la snyan ngag gi nyams phun sun tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i rgyan zhig ste/rang re'i sngon byon mkhas pa phal mo che'i brtsams chos kyang gzugs rgyan gyi lam nas brtsams 'dug go//rtsom pa bo gang yin yang rang rang la thun min gshis ka dang khyad 'phags kyi rtsom gshis re yod de/dper na/rje rin po ches/rgya mtsho'i klong ltar rab tu zab pa'i thugs//lha yi rnga bzhin legs par 'doms pa'i gsung //lhun po'i spo ltar mngon par 'phags pa'i sku//zhes sogs dpe rgyan gyi lam nas brtsams pa mang la/mkhas grub rjes/khyod ni rnam dpyod lus mdzes shing //dar dir legs bshad mgrin pa'i dbyangs//ma lus mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog pa/ /rin chen rig pa'i do shal 'chang //zhes sogs gzugs rgyan gyi lam nas bris pa mang ngo //de bzhin du kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rtsom gshis la rgya gar shar ba'i rtsom nyams shugs che zhing / kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i rtsom gshis la rgya gar lho ba'i rtsom nyams rang shugs kyis thon pa /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i rtsom gshis la klog pa bo'i yid 'gugs stobs che zhing 'bol rtsom gyi rnam pa gzengs su thon pa/gis steng blo bzang dpal ldan gyi rtsom gshis la rab btags dang —200 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

gzugs rgyan/phul byang sogs 'ud nyams che zhing / mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phe〉 gyi rtsom gshis la chu dwangs mo'i dang gi de'u bzhin brjod don kha gsal yang phal skad kyis ma gos pa'i khyad chos ldan pa/ mkhas dbang tshe tan zhabs drung rin po che'i lhug rtsom la lhung lhung 'bab pa'i chu phran ji bzhin tshig nyams bde zhing sdeb 'phrod pa/ brjod don rdzogs par ston thub pa sogs kyi khyad chos dang ldan pa/rdo sbris dge bshes rje shes rab rgya mtsho'i rtsom gshis la gtan tshigs kyi rang bzhin mang zhing /sgra rgyan spyi dang khyad par du bya dka' ba'i rtsom rtsal blos mi dpog pa lta bu/ slob dpon thon mi gnyis pa rje btsun dmu dge bsam gtan rgya mtsho'i rtsom gshis ni rang bzhin brjod pa dang /gzugs rgyan thugs che zhing gtso bo brjod don zab la kha gsal ba'i khyad chos dang ldan pa sogs rang rang gi thun min gzi byin dang ldan pa sha stag go/ / rgyal khab dang mi rigs gzhan dag la'ang gzugs rgyan gyi sbyor tshul 'di dar khyab che bar mngon/ / rtsa bar/ tha dad snang min gyur ba yi/ /dpe nyid dag ni gzugs can 'dod//ces gsungs pa ltar/ dpe don gnyis khyad gzhi dang khyad chos ci rigs kyi sgo nas mtshungs pa rgyu mtshan du byas pa'am de la bsam nas/dpe can de nyid dpe'i ngo bor bkod pa ste tha dad du snang ba ma yin par gcig tu sgro btags nas brjod pa'i dpe rgyan gyi rigs su gyur ba zhig la gzugs can gyi rgyan zhes bya'o//skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —20/—

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ཿ khams 'grel las/ dpe can dpe'i gzugs su bkod pas gzugs can nam/ dpe can dpe'i ngo bor bkod pas ngo bo can nam/ dpe'i tshul du bkod pas tshul can gyi rgyan zhes bya ste/sdospyor tshul mi 'dra ba'i dpe rgyan gyi sde tshan logs pa zhig go/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dpe can gyi khyad chos ston phyir dpe don gnyis gcig (sgro btags te brjod pa las/don la dpe rgyan gyi rigs su gtogs so//'on kyang sngon song dpe rgyan so gnyis dang gtan nas mi 'dra ste/ tshangs sras bzhad sgra las/ gzhung 'dir bstan gyi gzugs rgyan dang dpe rgyan gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ dpe dang dpe can tha dad du bkod nas de gnyis 'dra bar sbyor ba dpe rgyan dang /dpe can dpe'i ngo bor bkod nas de gnyis gcig tu sgro btags par sbyor ba la gzugs rgyan zer/zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//༈ gzugs rgyan ni dpe can de dpe'i gzugs su 'god dgos phyir dpe can sngon dang dpe mjug tu sbyor dgos la/ gong du song zin pa'i 'bru mang bo'i tshig sdud skabs dpe don gnyis kyi mtshungs sgra bsdu phyir dpe sngon dang dpe can mjug la sbyor dgos pas nor dogs med/ gzugs can gyi rgyan 'dir dpe don gyi bar du rnam dbye drug pa'i phrad cig nges par du 'ong yang tshig gi sbyor lugs kyi dbang gis skabs 'gar bsdus pa'ang yod de sdeb sbyor gyi cha nas bshad na gzugs rgyan thams cad rnam dbye drug pa'i phrad bsdus ma —202 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

gzugs rgyan/bsdus gnyis su 'du ba yin no// de ni tshig sdud drug las/ las 'dzin gyi bsdu ba ste khyad gzhi dang khyad chos gnyis phan tshun gzhi mthun du sdud pa'i bsdu ba yin no//'di'i skabs kyi drug pa'i phrad bsdus ma bsdus zhes pa ni/dpe don gnyis kyi bar du 'ong ba'i rnam dbye drug pa kho na la go dgos so//༈ dpe can gyi khyad gzhi dang khyad chos gnyis las khyad gzhi gang gi'ang gzugs su ma bkod par tshig zin la thon pa'i khyad chos tshang ma dpe gang rung gi gzugs su bkod pa zhig la cha shas /sbyo/ ṅgi can zhes bya'o//skabs 'dir cha shas dang khyad chos don ༈ yan lag gzugs can la rtsa ba'i thugs bstan lta bur gyur ba'i yan lag gnyis gzugs dang gsum gzugs sogs yod pas/mtha' dag gzugs can dang 'dra ba lta bur snang mod/ rgyan 'di gnyis kyi khyad par ni/mtha' dag gzugs rgyan skabs dpe can gyi khyad gzhi kho rang gzugs su 'god dgos par ma zad dpe can de'i khyad chos tshig zin la thon pa yongs rdzogs kyang gzugs 'god byed dgos la/yan lag gsum gzugs can sogs gang yin yang yan lag can nam khyad gzhi kho rang gzugs 'god byed mi dgos shing /yan lag gsum tsam gzugs 'god byas pa'i shul du'ang tshig zin la thon pa'i khyad chos gzugs su ma bkod pa zhig nges par du yod skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar byin 'dzin grwa la/ —203—

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/dgos so//ཿ lnga ba chen mo dang rin spungs pa'i lugs la yan lag gzugs can 'dir bdag sgra'i phrad cig kyang dgos par gsungs la/ de ni/ rtsa bar/ mdzes ma myos pa'i mkhur tshos dmar/ /mig gi ut+pal sngon po can/ /khyod kyi gdong gis skye bo ni/ /'dir yang dmar ba'i rang bzhin byas/ /zhes bdag sgra'i phrad can zhes yod pa la dgongs par mngon yang / bod mkhas sogs kyis de ni tshig gi sdeb sbyor la rang thugs kyis thon pa yin gyi/ rgyan 'di'i thun min khyad chos su mi 'thad tshul gsungs so// yan lag gnyis gzugs gsum gzugs sogs ni phyis 'byung mkhas pas blos dpyad 'bras yin gyi me long dngos bstan gyi gzugs rgyan nyi shur mi 'du'o//༈ cha shas gzugs can dang yan lag gzugs can gnyis kyi khyad par la bzhed tshul mi mthun pa mang du yod pa dag tshangs sras bzhad sgra las shes par bya zhing / rang lugs ni/ cha shas gzugs can skabs/khyod gdong mchu yi yal 'dab g.yo lta bu'i byed las kyi tshig dang ldan dgos shing / yan lag gzugs can skabs/ mig gi ut+pal sngon po can/ lta bu'i bdag sgra'am ldan rkyen zhig nges par du yod dgos/ yang cha shas gzugs can skabs tshig zin spa thon pa'i khyad chos tshang ma gzugs su 'god la/ yan lag gzugs can gyi skabs yan lag gsum gzugs lta bu yin yang / gzhan gzugs su ma bkod pa'i yan lag tshig zin la thon pa zhig kyang nges par du —2yo skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

gzugs rgyan/yod dgos pas/kun mkhyen sdom tshig tu/cha shas gzugs dang 'di gnyis khyad par ni//tshig der yan lag gang gsal gzugs byas pa//cha shas gzugs so 'dir ni lhag mi dgos//zhes gsungs so//bod mkhas sogs mkhas pa kha cig gis/cha shas zhes pa dpe can de'i khyad chos gang rung la go chog cing / yan lag ni nges par du rkang lag lta bu'i yan lag la go dgos par gsungs pa mi 'thad de/des na/ rtsa ba'i yan lag gzugs can gyi dpe brjod du gsal ba'i mdzes ma'i mig kyang ngo gdong gi cha shas tsam las/khong gis bzhed pa'i yan lag dngos ma yin pa'i phyir ro//༈ 'jam grags kyis bstan pa'i sgron me'i dpe brjod 'grel skabs/'di gong gi mtshan nyid dang mthun par bdag sgra'i phrad mi gsal ba ni/mtshan nyid mdzad pa bo dang dpe brjod mdzad pa bo gnyis gang zag so so ba yin pa'i skyon yin nam snyam/zhes brjod kyang /bstan pa'i sgron me'i dpe brjod kyi bde ldan zhing gi gtso zhes pas bdag po'amaldan pa'i rkyen gsal bor go nus pa yin no//༈ gzugs rgyan brgyad pa dang dgu bar 'os pa'i gzugs can dang mi 'os pa'i gzugs can nam/yang na ldan pa'i gzugs can dang mi ldan pa'i gzugs can zhes zer te/dpe can de'i gzugs su 'god rgyu'i dpe nyi 'od dang pad+ma dag lhan cig tu 'grogs 'os pa lta bu gzugs su bkod pa ni dpe'i cha nas ldan pa dang 'os skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —205

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/pa zhes bya la/snang mun gnyis dang me chu lta bu'i lhan cig tu 'grogs mi 'os pa dag gzugs su bkod pa ni dpe'i cha nas mi 'os pa dang mi ldan pa zhes bya'o//des na rgyan 'di gnyis ni gzugs su 'god rgyu'i dpe la bsam ste ming btags pa'o//'brug sprul rin po che sogs kha cig gis rgyan 'di gnyis yan lag gzugs can gyi bye brag tu 'dod kyang /bod mkhas dang lnga ba chen mo sogs kyis de ltar mi bzhed pas 'dir yang de ltar ro//༈bcu ba mi mnyam pa'i gzugs can la gzhung 'ga' rer brten pa mi mnyam pa'i gzugs can yang zer/ rgyan 'di'i rtsa ba'i dpe brjod du/smin ma'i 'khri shing gar byed pa//zhes gzugs can 'phar ma zhig yod pas/khams 'grel sogs phyis kyi snyan gzhung mang bor yang 'phar gzugs byas pa yod la/ snyan ngag spyi don las kyang /tshems phreng gangs ri'i 'od zer lta bu'i gzugs can 'phar ma byas shing /'ga' re gtan nas gzugs su ma bkod par mtho dman gyi tshul du bkod pa ni bcu ba dang /zhes gsungs mod/dbyangs can dgyes glu sogs su 'phar gzugs byed dgos tshul zur tsam yang ma gsungs shing / 'phar gzugs kyi rgyan ni 'og nas 'byung la/rgyan 'dir gzugs 'god mi mnyam pa byed pa gtso bo yin bas nges can du 'phar gzugs byed mi dgos par sems te/rin spungs snyan 'grel las/ 'di la gzugs can gnyis mthud kho na ma yin yang 'dra ste/zhes dang /tshangs sras bzhad sgrar yang 'phar gzugs 206 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

gzugs rgyan/byed min 'dam ga can du gsungs so//༈ bcu gsum pa rgyu'i gzugs can skabs mtshungs gsal gyi sgra mi sbyor te/rgyu mtshan gang rung zhig gis bsgrub pa'i cha nas rgyu'i dpe dang khyad par med kyang /mtshungs sgra yod med kyi sgo nas khyad par 'byed dgos pa'i phyir ro//tshangs sras bzhad sgra las/'di la dpe can gyi dngos po'i khyad chos rnams/dpe can rang gi khyad gzhi gtso bo gcig po de la 'brel dgos shing /dpe la dngos po gcig gi steng du 'brel dgos pa'i nges pa med/ces gsungs/༈ bcu bzhi ba sbyar ba'i gzugs can ni gzugs rgyan dang sbyar rgyan gnyis bsres pa zhig ste/ 'brug sprul dang dung dkar tshang sogs kyis sgra sbyar kho na byed dgos par gsungs kyang / rtsa bar/grogs mo khyod kyi gdong pad ni// zhes dpe can bud med mdzes ma'i gdong pad+ma'i gzugs su dkod/ rā dza haṃ sas nyer spyad 'os zhes sgra sbyar/dri zhim bung bas don gnyer 'os//zhes don sbyar byas yod pas rang lugs kyis sgra don gnyis ka sbyor dgos par 'dod de/kun mkhyen sdom tshig las/khyad chos 'ga' zhig sgra dang la lar don//sbyar nas dpe don sor 'god sbyar ba'i gzugs//zhes gsungs so//bod mkhas pa dang rin spungs pas kyang sgra don gnyis kur sbyor dgos par 'dod do//༈ bco lnga ba dpe'i gzugs can dang dpe rgyan spyi'i skabs gang skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 207

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags myu/yin yang mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra dang ldan dgos par 'dra yang /dpe'i gzugs can skabs thog mar dpe can de nyid dpe gang rung gi gzugs su bkod rjes/ slar yang gzugs su bkod skra'i dpe phal ba de dpe dngos dang mtshungs par sbyar ba skad du byed dgos pas/de 'dra'i sbyor tshul zhig sngar song dpe rgyan so gnyis po gang du'ang med pas dpe rgyan spyi dang mi 'dra'o// ca dpe can de dpe'i gzugs su bkod kyang dpe don gnyis mi mtshungs pa'i khyad chos gang rung zhig brjod de gzugs su bkod pa de nyid las phyir ldog pas na ldog pa'i gzugs can zhes bya'o//༈ bcu drug pa ldog pa'i gzugs can skabs kyi rgyal dbang lnga ba'i dpe brjod de gzugs su bkod pa med pas dpe brjod du 'gro dka' zhes tshangs sras bzhad sgrar gsungs la/de bzhin du bstan pa'i sgron me'i dpe brjod kyang gzugs rgyan du mi 'gro bar smra mkhan 'dug mod/rgyal dbang dang bstan pa'i sgron me'i dpe brjod gang yin yang / 'dod ldan 'dod pa'i dbang du song ba de ri dwags dra rgyar tshud pa dang /rgyal rnams mchod pa'i dpal la rol ba yang lha rnams lha'i dpal 'byor la rol ba'i gzugs su don gyis bkod yod pas gzugs rgyan du mi 'gro ba'i dogs pa ye nas gnang mi dgos so//'on kyang rtsa ba'i dpe brjod 'jog stangs dang cung mi mthun zhe na de ni bden pa'i gtam du zad do snyam/—208 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

/ ldogapa'igazagasaca/zu//shā//gapa'igazags can gnyis gang yin yang gzungs su bkod pa las phyir ldog the'am gzugs su 'god mi 'os pa lta bu'i nyams shig thon dgos tshul gyi cha nas 'dra tsam yod kyang ldog pa'i dper rtsa bar/'di ni gang ba ma yin yangan/'di ni rtag tu dkyil 'khor rdzogs//zhes dpe don gnyis kyi thun min khyad chos re rtags su bkod de gzugs su bkod pa las phyir sdog dgos pa dang / 'gog pa'i gzugs can skabs dpe can gyi thun min khyad chos shig gzugs su bkod pa des gzugs su bkod pa'i dpe gtso bo de'i khyad chos dang mi mthun pas gzugs su 'god mi thos par 'gog par brjod pa zhig dgos pa mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yin/ 'gog pa'i gzugs can la khams 'grel sogs su smad pa'i gzugs can zhes kyang gsungs te/dpe can gyi thun min khyad chos der smad pa'i tshul (don gyis bstod pa byas pa zhig yin )gyis dpe dang mi mtshungs par brjod dgos pas so//'gog pa'i gzugs can 'di la dngos thugs ci rigs nas dgag sgra'i phrad cig kyang thon dgos par gsungs/༈ dpe don gnyis ku'i yul dang yul can la skyon yod pa mnyam pa'i tshul gyis brjod pa zhig la mnyam 'jog gzugs can zhes bya ste/gzugs 'god byed tshul ni rgyan spyi dang 'dra'o//dgyes glur dpe don gyi skyon mnyam par ston pa zhes gsungs so//skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga —209

ngag rig sgyu 'phul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/༈ gzugs rgyan nyi shu ba bsnyon dor gzugs can dang de nyid brjod pa'i dpe gnyis gang yin yang dpe don gnyis phan tshun ha cang 'dra drags pas khyad par 'byed mi thub pa lta bu'i nyams shig phrothon dgos pa'i cha nas 'dra tsam yod kyang / de nyid brjod pa'i dpe ni/ rtsa bar/ 'di ni bzhin nyid pad+ma min/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/dpe ma yin par dpe can kho rang ngos zin pa'am yin pa skad du brjod dgos la/ mtshungs chos shugs nas rtogs thub/ bsnyon dor gzugs can rmi dpe can la bsnyon 'ding ste dpe yin par brjod de don la gzugs 'god byas pa yin pas khyad par che ba shar nub lta trī byi sda /sa// snar tshul gyi dbang gis rgyan gnyis kur mtshungs gsalagyi ཿ snyan ngag la mkhyen pa'i blo mig yangs shing mos pa che ba rnams kyis legs par dpyad na 'jig rten khams kyi brjod bya la mtha' med pa bzhin du rtsa bar ma bstan pa'i gzugs rgyan yang mtha' med pa 'byung ste/ dpag bsam 'khri shing du/ rab brtags gzugs can dang gtsug na nor bu'i rtogs brjod du/ don gzhan bkod pa'i gzugs can/ bsngags thos bsngags bstod las sngon med gzugs can/ rin spungs snyan 'grel du 'jigs rung gzugs can sogs rgyan 'dres mar bkod pa shin tu mang la/ snga ma gsum la khams 'grel du dpe brjod kyang bzhag yod do//de'i phyir kun mkhyen sdom tshig las/de bzhin gzugs can nyams ldan tshogs//—2 0 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

gzugs rgyan/mkhas pas brtags nas rab sbyar ba/ /dbang phyogs sa 'dzin phrag gong gi/ /nyin byed rjes 'gro 'byung bar bshad//ces gsungs so/ /gzugs rgyan ni snyan ngag pa rnams kyis sha thang du 'bad cing snying gi gces nor du 'dzin 'os pa zhig yin no//skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar zin 'dzinagrwa ga 21 —

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/bzhi bgasalabyed kyi rgyan/༈ rigs dang bya ba yon tan rdzas sogs gang rung gsal bar ston byed kyi tshig gcig rkang ba'i thog mtha' bar gsum gang rung na gnas pa des sho lo ka gcig po'i ngag sbyor lhag ma rnams kyang gsal bar byed nus pa zhig la gsal byed kyi rgyan zhes bya'o/ / de la rtsa bas dngos bstan gyi dbye ba bcu gnyis las med kyang kun mkhyen sdom tshig 'dir yon tan brjod pa bar gyi gsal byed dang / rdzas brjod pa bar gyi gsal byed gnyis bsnan pas khyon dbye ba bcu bzhi yod do/ / rgyan de dag thams cad kyang gnas gsum gyi gsal byed dang / phreng ba'i gsal byed/ 'gal don gyi gsal byed/ don gcig gsal byed/sbyar ba'i gsal byed lnga'i nang du 'du'o//1 rigs brjod gsal byed spyi dang khyad par du rigs brjod pa tha ma'i gsal byed dang rigs rang bzhin brjod pa gnyis 'dra ba lta bur snang yang / rang bzhin brjod pa'i skabs rigs can kun la khyab pa dang drang bor brjod pa gtso bo yin la/ rigs can gsal byed skabs rigs brjod kyi tshig des gzhan dag gsal ba dang rigs kyi byed las la sbyar ba gtso bo yin zhing / 'khyog brjod kyi nyams kyang 'dres chog pa mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yin te/ tshangs sras —212 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

gsal byed kyi rgyan/bzhad sgrar/byed pa bo rigs de'i bya ba dang khyad chos sogs brjod pa'i tshig gi nyams/ rang bzhin brjod pa la ltos na cung zad 'khyog pa'i rgyan gyi phyogs su gtogs pa zhig yin/ zhes gsungs so// / drug pa bya ba brjod pa bar gyi gsal byed dang 'og nas 'byung ba'i yul la bsnyon dor gyi rgyan gnyis kur bod mkhas pa sogs kyis dogs slong re gnang 'dug mod rgyan 'di gnyis la cha shāḥ trī // /sa 'dra ba'i gnas med pas dogs gcod mi dgos ཿ phreng ba'i gsal byed dang phreng ba'i dpe gnyis don snga phyi'i 'brel ba phreng ba'i tshul du 'god dgos pa'i cha nas 'dra tsam yod kyang /dngos thugs ci rigs su thon chog cing gnas la nges pa med pa'i gsal byed kyi tshig gcig gis sho lo ka gcig po gsal thub pa phreng ba'i gsal byed dang /snga ma snga ma dpe dang phyi ma phyi ma dpe can gyi tshul du bkod de/ don gyis dpe 'gas dpe can gcig mtshon ༵༵ byed pa phreng ba'i dpe yin pas rgyan 'di gnyis la khyad par ཿ sbyar ba'i gsal byed ni don gyis rgyan gnyis bsres pa zhig ste/sbyar gzhi gnyis la sbyar chos mthun pa kha shas kyis sbyor du yod cing /gsal byed kyi tshig gcig gis sho lo ka gcig po'i brjod don gsal skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —213

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/thub pa zhig nges par du dgos so// des na bstan pa'i sgron me'i dpe brjod skabs/sbyar gzhi nam mkha' dang rgya mtsho gnyis kur sbyar chos kha dog sngon po dang mtha' med pa gnyis kyis sbyar te༈mjug tu gnas zhes pa'i gsal byed kyi tshig gcig gis gsal bar byas yod pa lta bu'o//༈ rtsa bar/ rnam pa 'di nyid kho na yis//gsal byed la ni rnam rtog pa//lhag ma rnams kyang rjes mthun par//mkhas pa rnams kyis rtogs par bya//zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar gsal byed kyi rgyan yang rang gi rnam dpyod kyi rtsal la brten te mang du dbye chog pas/rat+na shrī'i mchan 'grel du dpe'i gsal byed dang /rab rtog gsal byed/'gog pa'i gsal byed bcas rgyan gsum gsungs pa si tu paṇa chen hā/ /sdir+sha /ji khams 'grel du dpe brjod dang bcas te bkod —214 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

bskor ba'i rgyan/lnga ba bskor ba'i rgyan/༈ rjod byed sho lo ka gcig gi thog mtha' bar gsum gang rung du don gcig la tshig mi 'dra bar bzlas pa'am don mang bo la tshig 'dra bar bzlas pa/ yang na tshig don gnyis ka bzlas kyang zlos skyon mi 'byung ba zhig la ni bskor ba'i rgyan zhes bya'o// la/ bskor ba'i rgyan la khams 'grel du bzlas pa'i rgyan zhes kyang gsungs la/ de'i dang bo'i don bskor skabs/ rtsa bar/ ka dab ni rnam par rgyas//ku ṭa dzod ma rab gsal/ /kun+da l+ya ni rab cabye//ka ku bha yang gyes par gyur/ /zhes pa las 'phros te bod mkhas dang 'brug khams sprul sogs mang bo zhig gis/ don mi 'dra ba du ma'i khyad chos gcig tshig mi 'dra ba du mas bskor dgos te/ dper na/ rtsa ba'i tshig ka daspa ni tshogs can gyi shing (rin spungs snyan 'grel du pad ma'i tshal zhes gsungs)dang / ku ṭa dzod ni dug mo nyung gi shing / ka l+ya ni chu shing / ka ku bha ni a dzu na zhes pa'i shing du 'grel/ dbyangs can dgyes glu sogs su/ rtsa ba'i ka daspa sogs bzhi bo tshig mi gcig kyang don dug mo nyung gi shing yin pas/ brjod bya'i don gcig ming mi 'dra ba du mas brjod cing de'i khyad chos lta bu don gcig kyang rjod byed kyi tshig mi 'dra ba du mas bskor ba zhig la don bskor du bzhed skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —2/5

ngag rig sgyu 'phul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/pa yin no// dug mo nyung gi shing zhes pa ni shing gzhan la 'khris nas skye zhing me tog ser chung / 'bras bu de tso'i lce 'dra ba/ sman du bkol chog pa/ rma chu'i 'gram rgyud sogs su skye ba'i rtswa rtsam sa bonamonag po can zhig la ngos 'dzin zhes tshig mdzod dag tu 'byung la/ gser thang du de las gzhan zhig gsungs pas dpyad dgos/—216 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

'gog pa'i rgyan/drug pa 'gog pa'i rgyas ga don gang rung zhig sgrub par thabs sam rnam grangs gang rung gi sgo nas dngos shugs ci rigs su 'gog par byed pa de ni 'gog rgyan gyi ngo bo yin la/ rgyan 'di ni bod skad bshad stangs khrod lan mang 'byung zhing sgyu rtsal gyis phyug pa/chod che ba sogs khyad chos phun sum tshogs pa zhig go//༈ 'gog rgyan dang bo 'das pa 'gog par bzhed tshul gtso bo gnyis yod de/sa skya ngag chos kyis rtsa ba'i dpe brjod kyi mda' lngas kun las rgyal mi srid snyam pa'i blo de da lta ba 'gog par 'gyar te/da lta rang rgyud la yod pa'i chos mngon gyar ba yin pa'i byirno zhes sgrub byed bkod pa dang khong gi dri tshig dobyangs can mgrin brgya'i nga ror yang / sngar byung 'gog rgyan 'chad tshe rnam bshad 'ga'//mda' lngas kun las rgyal gyar mi bden par//'dzin pa'i blo nyid 'gog ces ca co'i 'khun/dī/ shing snye ma'i khur gyis non min nam//zhes sogs gsungs so/ / rin spungs pa dang lnga ba chen mo/ bod mkhas pa sogs mkhas pa phal mo ches/ de ni 'das pa'i lo rgyus la brten nas byung ba'i blo yin pas blo'i 'dzin stangs la 'char zin pa'am byung zin pa'i cha nas btags phyir byung ba 'gog pa zhes skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzinagrwa la/ —217

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/gsungs te/ gtso bo 'das pa'i bya bar brten pa'i 'khrul ba'i blo 'gog pa zhig go/ / de'i phyir rgyan dang bor byang ba 'gog pa'ong zer te byang zin gyi bya ba gang rung zhig mi bdesna snyam pa'i blo 'gog pas so/sto/ lnga ba chen mo sogs kyi bzhed tshul 'di shong dpang rnam gnyis kyi dgongs par gnas so tshangs sras bzhad sgrar bsngags brjod kyi me tog 'thor ba'ang ches cher don la gnas par sems so//༈ 'gog rgyan gnyis par mngon gyur ram da lta ba 'gog pa'ang zer te/ mig gis mthong bzhin pa dang rna bas thos bzhin pa lta bu'i bya ba mngon gyar ba zhig 'gog pas so/ / 'di ni don gyis bstod pa byed pa'i khyon zhig yin/ ༈ 'gog rgyan gsum par 'byung 'gyur ram ma 'ongs pa 'gog pa'ang zer te/da lta'i byed stangs sogs la bltas na ma 'ongs par 'byung 'gyur ram 'byung nges kyi don zhig 'gog pas so//༈ ma gus pa dang rjes gnang gis 'gog pa gnyis la dgag tshig dngos su ma smras kyang / 'gog byed tsam smras pa'i shugs kyis dgag bya de bkag par go dgos pa zhig yin no// de'i phyir rgyan 'di gnyis la ngo gdong nas bya ba de mi 'gog pa lta bu zhig yin yang /rjes gnang gi skabs don gyis thabs gzhan gyi sgo nas bkag yod pa dang /ma gus pa'am ma rangs pa'i tshig gis 'gog pa'i rgyan ni skad —2 8 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

'gog pa'i rgyan/cha'i nyams las bya ba de bsgrub par mi 'thad pa'i tshul gsal bor thon pas don gyis bkag yod pa zhig dgos pa mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yin no//dper na/ rgyan dang bor/rtsa bar/gal te gshegs na gshegs par mdzod//khyod nyid bgrod pas bdag la ni//gdung ba yun ring 'byung mi 'gyur//'di la khyod ni dogs mi 'tshal//zhes rjes su gnang ba ltar byas kyang don gyis khyed dang bral bas bdag yun ring mi 'gor bar 'chi bar nges tshul gyi thabs gzhan zhig brjod de bkag yod pa dang /rgyan phyi mar/rtsa bar/bdag ni gson re stobs dang ldan//nor gyi bsam pa stobs ldan min//mdza' bo gshegs sam bzhugs lags sam/ /rang gi gnas skabs smras pa lags/ /zhes bya ba de bsgrub par ma gus pa'i tshul 'chi ba la mi dga' ba'i tshig nyams kyis bkag yod pa lta bu'o// ga tsub mos 'gog pa dang khro bas 'gog pa gnyis gang yin yang bya ba de 'dra zhig bsgrub par mi 'thad pa'i tshig btsan po dang ngan pa zhig brjod pa'i cha nas 'dra tsam yod kyang /rtsub mo'i skabs bya ba de 'gog phyir tshig rtsub mo dang chod can smras pa tsam las khong nas khro ba min la/ khro ba'i skabs bya ba de bsgrub par snying nas mi tā/ kā ༵ /nga khong nas khro ba skyes te 'gog dgos pa'i khyad par / mya ngan gyis 'gog par snyan gzhung la lar snying rjes 'gog skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga lha mi

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/pa zhes kyang 'byang / de ni rgya gar gyi skad la/ a nu kro sha zhes pa myu ngan gyi skad dojo dngos yin la/ snying rje'i skad dod dngos min yang snying brtse ba'i don zhig kyang yod pas yin par gsungs/ 'jam dbyangs kha che bas/ dgra bo'i nye du la sogs pas bltas na mya ngan yin la/ phyogs su ma lhung bar gzu bos bltas na snying rje yin/gshed ma'i phyogs kyis bltas na ni nga rgyal lam dregs pas 'gog pa'o gsungs pa skabs don dang ma 'brel snyam mo//sa mya ngan gyis 'gog pa dang 'gyod pas 'gog pa gnyis gdung sems dang skyo ba'i rnam pas bya ba de 'gog pa la 'dra tsam yod kyang /mya ngan gyi tshig dang 'gyod pa'i tshig gis khyad par 'byed dgos pa tshangs sras bzhad sgrar gsungs la/ snga ma gzhan gyi bya ba dang phyi ma rang gi bya b.rasbyor dgos pa'ang 'byed chos gtso bo zhig yin snyam/ ཿ the tshom gyis 'gog pa dang gtan 'bebs kyi dpe gnyis kur brjod 'dod kyi don de ngos zin pa'am nges pa rnyed pa lta bu'i cha nas 'dra yang / gtan 'bebs skabs dpe can gyi khyad chos shig rtags su bkod de/ dpe don khyad par 'byed kyang shugs la mtshungs par ston dgos pa dang / the tshom gyis 'gog par don gyi khyad chos shig rtags su bkod de the tshom pa'i blo 'gog dgos pa mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yin no//220 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

'gog pa'i rgyan/1 kun mkhyen sdom tshig las/ phra zhib rigs pas ma bshad pa//gzhan yang brtags nas mkhas pas sbyor//gsungs pa ltar rtsa bas dngos bstan ma yin pa'i phyin ci log gi 'gog pa dang / nges pa'i 'gog pa/ rab dwangs kyi 'gog pa zhes khams 'grel sogs su 'gog rgyan gzhan dang gzhan yang bkod pa mang ngon /skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ 221

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/bdun la don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyabag don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan ni skad cha'i sgyu rtsal dang tshig gi nus pa ches cher thon pa'i rgyan zhig ste/ rgyan 'dir bsgrub bya sngon la bkod pa dang / sgrub byed tshig nus pa can rjes su 'god pa/ sgrub byed de yang bsgrub bya las don gzhan zhig yin dgos pa bcas khyad chos gsum nges par du tshang dgos/ 'di la rtsa bas dngos bstan gyi dbye ba brgyad yod do//༈ sngar bshad zin pa'i zla bo dngos po'i dpe dang rgyan 'di gnyis snga mar brjod don dngos dang phyi mar de dang phyogs mtshungs shig 'god dgos pa'i cha nas 'dra tsam yod kyang / zla bo dngos po'i dpe ni tshig zin la mtshungs par ma brjod kyang mtshungs pa shugs las rtogs thub pa zhig nges par dgos la/ don gzhan bkod pa ni bsgrub bya de'i sgrub byed du 'gro nges pa zhig dgos pa las/ khyad chos mtshungs mi mtshungs la gtso bor mi ltos so//myu/ 'gog rgyan nyer gnyis pa don gzhan 'gog pa dang kun khyab kyi don gzhan bkod pa gnyis don gang rung zhig bkag pa'i cha nas 'dra tsam yod de/ snga ma'i dpe brjod la/ rtsa bar/ thams cad mnan yang khyod kyis ni/ /rnam gnon tshim pa med pa mtshar/ /'on kyang —222 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan/bsreg bya 'bar ba la//tshim pa dag ni nam zhig mthong //zhes rgyal bo 'dod sred can gyis thams cad dbang du bsdus kyang yid tshim pa med pa dgag bya/ de'i 'gog byed du me rtses bya dngos gang zhig bsregs kyang tshim ba med tshul gyi don gzhan zhig brjod de ya mtshan pa'i blo bkag par bstan la/rgyan phyi mar yang /rtsa bar/legs ldan 'gro ba rnams kyi mig/nyi ma dang ni zla ba yang //nub par 'gyur ba nyid la ltos//nges pa la ni su zhig 'gongs//zhes skye dgu'i mig tu gyar ba'i nyi zla gnyis la nub pa'am rgud pa yod pa de dgag bya dnganardo'i 'gog byed du bya dngos yod do cog de'i rang bzhin yin tshul gyis bkag pa lta bu'i sgo nas phyogs mtshungs su gyar yod do//'on kyang zhib par dpyad na/rgyan 'di gnyis kyi ngo bo rgetan nas mi 'dra ste/rgyan snga ma dgag bya de'i 'gog byed du don gzhan zhig bkod de bkag pa yin la/ rgyan phyi ma ni 'gog pa gtso bo min par snga ma'i sgrub byed du kun la khyab pa'i sgrub byed nus pa can zhig bkod de kun khyab kyi khyad chos thon dgos pa gtso bo yin pa'i phyir ro//ཿ kun khyab kyi don gzhan bkod pa'i skabs rtsa ba'i dpe brjod kyi tshig rkang snga phyi rje ba bo ni gung thang bde ba'i blo gros tshang yin la/mkhas pa mang bo zhig gis kyang lugs de mchog tu 'dzin yang /nyi zla gnyis la 'char nub dang skye 'jig yod pa de chos thams cad la skye 'jig yod pa'i sgrub byed du 'gro zhe na cung 'thad par dka' bas/bdag gis ni nyi zla gnyis la 'char nub yod pa bsgrub bya dang de'i skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —223

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags gyu/sgrub byed du 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad mi rtag pa'i rang gshig las ma 'das par bkod pa de shin tu legs par 'dod de/snga ma'i bzhed srol ltar na kun khyab kyi mtshan nyid tshang dka' tshul/khams 'grel las/gzhung tshig snga phyi'i go sa rje ba bo'i thog ma gung thang bde blo yin yang/ de la khungs dang rgyu mtshan ci yang ma bshad/ ces sogs mang du gsungs kyang 'dir tshig mang bar 'gyur bas gzhung de las shes par bya'o/// rgyan gyi bstan bcos mtsho byung dgyes pa'i 'dzum zer las/rkang ba mtha' ma sngon du bkod nas bshad srol 'di grangs chen lo tsā ba'i gsung rgyun yin zhes slob dpon mkhas pa'i gsung ngo zhes ngom bshad gnang ba ni gzhung lugs chen mo brgya phrag la nang byan chud pa'i nyams su 'dug pa las rkang ba bzhi ga gang 'god la rmongs pa ga la yin zhes sogs mang du smras 'dug mod/ yongs grags su gung thang bde blo dang rgyal dbang lnga ba'i lugs bzhin gzhung tshig snga phyir bsnol zhing de ltar du dpe brjod bzhag na kun khyab kyi mtshan nyid mi tshang bar gsungs pas rang rang gi blo gros kyi rtsal la brten nas mtha' dpyad par zhu'o//༈ 'gal ba'i don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan gyi skabs bsgrub bya sgrub byed gnyis ka spyir 'gal yang skabs der mi 'gal ba'am dngos po'i gnas tshod dang mthun pa zhig dgos te/ dper na/—224 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan/bstan pa'i sgron me'i dpe brjod kyi bstan don ltar gdod ma nas rang rgyud la rgyun chags su gnas pa'i bdag 'dzin de nyid mtha' bral dbu ma'i lta ba shar sgom tsam byas pas kyang sel thub par brjod tshe/spyir rgyun ring gi bya ba zhig dus thung ngu'i yun la bsgrub mi thub kyang skabs 'dir bsgrub thub pas mi 'gal bar brjod pa lta bu'o//sgrub byed la'ang rigs 'dra/༈ 'gal ba'i don gzhan bkod pa'i skabs/ rtsa bar/gnyis skyes dbang bo skyon ldan yangan/zhes sgrastar zhig byang mod/ de ni zhar ram shugs la thon pa las nges par du sbyar ba khyod dgos pa min tshul khams 'grel dang tshig rgyan rig pa'i sgo 'byed sogs su'ang de ltar gsungs pa bdag kyang de ltar du 'dod do// gong gisbyar ba yin na/bsgrub bya sgrub byed gnyis kur 'jug pa'i sgra sbyar zhig nges par du dgos kyang / rgyan 'dir bsgrub bya skyon yon gnyis ldan zhig dang sgrub byed kyang de mtshungs shig bkod pa tsam gyis chog go/// mi 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa'i skabs nyi zer gyis grang ba bskyed pa lta bu'i bsgrub bya mi 'os pa zhig bkod nas/ sgrub byed ni/spyir btang gi dbang du byas na sngar bkod pa'i las de mi 'os kyang /lus can 'ga' zhig gi ngor 'os so zhes sgrub byed cig 'god dgos pas/ bsgrub bya mi 'os kyang sgrub byed 'os pa zhig tu don gyis 'gyur skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 223

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/brgyad bskog la can gyi rgyas༈ dpe don gnyis sgra don ci rigs kyi sgo nas mtshungs par brjod kyang khyad chos gang rung zhig gis mi mtshungs par bstan te mtshungs pa las slar ldog pas na ldog pa can gyi rgyan zhes bya'o/ /dpe don gnyis mi mtshungs par so sor 'byed par byed pas na rgyan 'di la 'byed byed kyi rgyan zhes kyang bya'o// 1 ldog pa can gyi rgyan gyi mtshan nyid la/rtsa bar/sgra 'jug pa'am rtogs pa yis//dngos po gnyis ni mtshungs gyar pa//de yi dbye ba brjod pa gangan/de ni ldog pa can zhes brjod/sto/ces gsungs pa ltar/dpe don gnyis mtshungs par sbyor byed kyi sgra'i 'jug pa gzugs gcig pa'am/ mtshungs chos thugs las go ba'am rtogs pa/ skabs thob kyis mtshungs par rtogs thub pa de ni ldog rgyan gyi ngo bo yin la/rgyan gyi dbye ba 'byed tshe dpe don gnyis tshig zin ladangos sumatshungs par ston pa'i sgras zin mtshungs pa'i ldog pa can dang / mtshungs chos shugs dang skabs thob kyis rtogs pa'i rtogs pa mtshungs pa'i ldog pa can/ mtshungs chos shugs dang skabs thob kyis rtogs la 'byed chos la'ang 'dra ba'i cha yod pa'i 'byed chos mtshungs pa'i ldog pa can nam mtshungs pa'i ldog pa can/ mtshungs chos thugs —226 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

ldog pa can gyi rgyan/dang skabs thob kyis rtogs la dpe don gnyis kyi 'byed chos kyang rigs 'dra bas rigs mthun 'byed pa'i ldog pa can bcas rtsa ba'i dbye ba bzhi yod la/ de'i dang bor/ nang gses dbye ba lnga dang /gnyis par gnyis/ gsum par gnyis/ bzhi bar gcig ste khyon rtsa bas dngos bstan gyi sdog pa can bcu yod do//( rgyan 'dir dpe don gnyis nges par du dgos pas kha cig gis dpe rgyan las logs su med do zhe na/dpe don gnyis yod pa tsam gyis dpe rgyan du 'gyur na gzugs rgyan dang don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan sogs mang bo zhig dpe rgyan du thal bas mi 'thad la/dbyag pa can yang rgyan gyi rab dbye la rmongs par 'dod dgos so//dedro na ldog pa can gyi rgyan gyi skabs dpe don mtshungs par brjod pa gtso bo min par/ mtshungs pa las ldog pa ste mi mtshungs par brjod pa khyad chos gtso bo dnganadape rgyan ni mtshungs par brjod pa gtso bo yin pas khyad par shin tu che'o/ /༈ gcig sdog skabs rtsa ba'i dpe brjod du sgra sbyar byas yod kyang /de ni rgya gar skad kyi khyad chos las rang shugs su thon pa yin gyi rgyan 'di'i khyad chos ma yin no//༈ 'gal ba'i dpe dang gnyis kyi ldog pa can gang yin yang dpe don gnyis kyi gnas sa'am brten sa tha dad pa dang yang na ngo skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ 227

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/bo dang khyad chos mi 'dra ba gnyis kyis mi mtshungs par brjod pa'i cha nas 'dra yang / 'gal ba'i dper mtshungs pa shugs las rtogs dgos shing dpe yang 'ga' zhig 'god chog la/ gnyis kyi ldog pa can la mtshungs pa tshig zin la thon kyang mi mtshungs pa'i khyad chos brjod pa gtso bo yin no// ༈ dgag pa'i dpe dang 'gog pa can gyi ldog pa can gnyis kur dpe'i skyon brjod de dpe can dang mtshungs pa 'gog pa dang dgag sgra dang ldan dgos par 'dra yang / dgag pa'i dpe tshig zin la dpe don mtshungs pa bkag nas mtshungs chos shugs las rtogs dgos pa dang / 'gog pa can gyi ldog rgyan la thog mar dpe don sdushāngs par sbyar ba las ldog dgos pa gtso bo yin pas khyad par ༈ dpe can gyi khyad chos shig rtags su 'god par gtan 'bebs kyi dpe dang gtan tshigs kyi ldog pa can gnyis 'dra tsam yod kyang / gtan 'bebs kyi dper the tshom pa'i blo de bkag nas shugs la mtshungs par brjod pa gtso bo yin la/ gtan tshigs can gyi sdog par rtags su bkod pa'i khyad chos des mi mtshungs tshul brjod dgos pa khyad chos gtso bo'o//༈ gcig gi ldog pa can dang gtan tshigs kyi ldog pa can gyi —228 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

ldog pa can gyi rgyan/rgyan gnyis dpe la med pa'i dpe can gyi khyad chos lhag pa zhig bkod de mtshungs pa las phyir ldog dgos par mi 'dra ba med kyang /dpe'i skyon brjod pa dang gtan tshigs sam rgyu mtshan ston pa'i tshig 'god dgos min gyis khyad par chen po yod do//༈ 'gog pa can gyi ldog pa dang gtan tshigs kyi ldog pa can gnyis kur/ thog mar mtshungs par sbyar ba/ dpe'i skyon brjod de mtshungs pa las stsog pa/dgag sgra dang ldan pa bcas kyis 'dra yangana'agog pa'i ldog par dpe don mtshungs pa bkag pa tsam gyis chog la/gtan tshigs kyi ldog par rgyan rang gi khyad chos thon phyir/gyar phyir/yin stabs/yod gshis lta bu'i rtags sam gtan tshigs skyo sgra nges par thon dgos pa mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ro// ༈ 'gal ba'i dpe dang rten gyi ldog pa can gnyis dpe don gnyis gnas sa'amarten sa tshimatshungs par brjod par 'dra tsam yod kyang 'gal ba'i dper/dbyangs can lha mo'i zhal dang ston ku'i zla//yid 'ong mdzes sdug rdzogs pa'i kun da rnams//ngo mtshar kun dga'i dpyid du gcig gyar kyangan/zhes dpe don mtshungs par ston pa gtso bo yin la/ rtenag gyi ldog pa can ni/rtsa bar/khyod kyi gdong dang pad+ma ste//'di gnyis kyi ni khyad par yang //pad+ma chu las skyes pa dang //khyod gdong khyod la brten pa'o//zhes gnas sa'am rten sa'i khyad par gyis mi mtshungs par brjod pa gtso bo yin la dpe yang skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar zin 'dzin grwa la/ —229

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/gcig gis chog go// /ཿ phul byung gi dpe dang rten ldog gnyis kyi khyad par tshangs sras bzhad sgra las/ phul byung gi dpe la dpe dang dpe can gnyis gang du mthong ba'i gnas tha dad pa tsam ma gtogs sgo kun nas mtshungs zhes dpe don phan tshun mtshungs pa gtso bor ston pa dang /'di la 'byed byed rten tha dad pa'i khyad par bkod nas/phan tshun mtshungs pa shugs bstan dang mi mtshungs pa gtso bor brjod pa yin no//zhes gsungs/ / ldog can gyi rtsa ba'i sa bcad bzhi ba rigs mthun gyi ldog par/rtsa bar/rin chen snang bas mi 'phrogs shingan/nyi ma'i 'od kyis mi bzlog pa//lang tsho las byang na chung gi//mun pas lta ba 'gog par byed//ces 'dod ldan gyi : bo zhig mdzes ma'i lang tsho'i mdzes sdug gis myos te rmongs pa'i mun par gyur ba dang spyi'i mun pa gnyis mun pa'i rang bzhin du gyur ba ste byed las kyi sgo nas rigs su mthun kyang /rin po che'i 'od snang gis kyang sel mi thub pa dang nyi ma'i 'od kyis kyang mi ldog pa'i khyad chos de ni 'byed byed dpe spyi'i mun pa'i ma yin par dpe can rmongs pa'i mun pa'i yin pa skad du brjod pa lta bu zhig dgos so/// rigs mthun gyi ldog pa 'di dpe can gyi khyad chos kyis mi mtshungs par 'byed pa'i cha nas gong gi gcig ldog dang gtan —230 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar zin 'dzin grwa la/

ldog pa can gyi rgyan/tshigs kyi ldog pa sogs la 'dra tsam yod kyang / khyad chos rigs mthun pa zhig dgos min gyi cha nas khyad par chen po yod do//khyad chos rigs mthun pa zhig yin na rtsa ba'i dpe brjod ltar nges par dpe can lji khyad chos de gzugs 'god lta bu zhig byed mi dgos par /sna ma/ tshi/ ga las/ 'dir ni mtshungs kyang 'byed byed sgra yod pas//dpe rgyan skyon gyis reg min de bas na//ka ye sbrug 'thum ma mdzad bya gshong ba/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ sa skya'i mkhas pa chen po mang thos klu sgrub pa la zur za gnang ba zhig ste/mang thos pa'i gsung dngos la mjal skal ma ldan yang / dbyangs can dgyes glu las/'dir zla ba dang ngang ba gnyis dkar ba'i sgo nas mtshungs chos su bstan kyang (mtshungs chos ma zin la 'byed byed kyi sgras dngos su zin pa'i rtsa ba'i dpe brjod la bshad kyin yod/)slar mi mtshungs par ldog yod pas dpe rgyan gyi skyon ga la 'jug klu sgrub pa khyed 'di skor la spugs 'thums po rang zhig byung 'dug pa khyed rang gi sku tshe rjes ma jo nang ba'i bstan pa la zhugs nas lta sgom thams cad zas gtsang gi sras po dang mi mthun pa'i gu yangs po zhig mdzad pa la smon lam btab pa 'dra'o//zhes gsungs pas mang thos pa'i dgongs pa de zur tsam rtogs thub par 'dug go// 'dir dpe rgyan dang rigs mthun ldog pa'i khyad par 'byed phyir lnga ba chen po'i lung tsam drangs pa las/phran gyis jo nang ba'i lta sgom thams cad zas gtsang sras po dang mi mthun tshul ga la shes te mi shes so//skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —231—

ngag rig sgyu 'phul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ (dgung grin pa canagyi rgyan/༈ brjod tshul gyi dbang du byas na srid pa tsam las rgyu rkyen zhig med par 'bras bu grub pa skad du brjod pa'i rgyan zhig la srid pa can gyi rgyan zhes bya'o/ / spyir rgyu med pa'i 'bras bu mi srid kyang /lkog gyur dang shin tu lkog gyur gyi rigs su gyur ba'i rgyu/skye bo phal bas mngon sum du rtogs mi thub pa'i rigs la rgyu med pa zhes snyan ngag pas sgro btags pa tsam mo//༈ 'brug sprul rin po ches/ srid rgyan la nang gses dbye ba gnyis las mi 'dod par/ rtsa ba'i dpe brjod dang bo gnyis ni brjod bya tha dad pa yin yang rgyan tha dad pa min par rgyu gzhan cung zad ston pa'i srid pa can nam rgyu'i ngo bo la sbyar ba'i srid pa can dang / gsum pa 'bras bu'i ngo bo lasbyar ba'i srid pa can zhes 'dod de/ dpe brjod snga phyi 'di gnyis la rgyan tha dad pa'i dbye ba ci yang med/ rgyan de gang la sbyor ba'i yul gyi sbyar gzhi'am brjod bya tha dad pa tsam kho na ste/ rgyan gcig la dpe brjod gnyis mdzad pa yin par gzhung rang las kyang gsal zhes sogs mang du gsungs so//'on kyang bod mkhas dang lnga ba chen mo sogs mkhas pa phal mo ches rgyan tha dad pa gsum du 'dod pa ni shin du legs te/ slob —232 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

srid pa can gyi rgyan/dpon dbyug pa can gyis rgyan gang la'ang dmigs bsal gyis dpe brjod gnyis re ma bzhag par srid rgyan la dmigs kyis bsal dgos don med la/ brjod bya dang rjod byed ci rigs kyis rgyan tha dad par mi 'byed na don rgyan mang bo zhig rgyan ma yin par ma zad/phan tshun 'dres dogs kyang yod de/tshangs sras bzhad sgrar/rgyan rang rang gi nang gses kyi brjod bya'i sgo nas/ brjod bya cung zad tha dad pa tsam gyis/rgyan tha dad du 'jog pa yod de/dper na ldog pa can gyi skabs/sgras zin mtshungs pa'i ldog pa can la brjod bya'i sgo nas rgyan tha dad pa lngar phyes pa dang / rtogs pa mtshungs pa'i ldog pa can la gnyis dang / 'byed byed mtshungs pa'i ldog pa can la rgyan tha dad pa gnyis su dbye ba sogs du ma yod pa'i phyir dang /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro//des na srid rgyan gsum ga 'bras bu rang gi ngo bo la sbyar dgos pa'i cha nas 'dra yang /rgyan dang bor rgyu med par phyi'i dbyar dgun sogs dus kyi ngo bo ston pa dang /rgyan gnyis par rgyu med par nang gi lang tsho ste rgan dar gzhon gsum gyi ngo bo'am/byams snying rje dang khong khro phrag dog sogs che min gyi gshis lugs ston pa/rgyan gsum pa ni phyi nang gang la'ang stos pa med par rgyu med pa'i 'bras bu rang gi ngo bo tsam ston pa zhig dgos so//skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 233

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/bcu babacas brjod kyi rgyag ༈ bsdus brjod kyi rgyan dang gab tshig gi rgyan/sbyar ba'i rgyan 'ga' re bcas ni rtsom pa bos gang brjod par 'dod pa'i brjod don dngos thad kur mi ston par/khyad chos dbyibs gzugs sogs dang ha cang 'dra mtshungs su gyar ba'i dpe gzhan zhig brjod de go bar byed pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi tshajo cung mtho ba'i rgyan zhig ste/ 'dod gtam dang gsang ba'i bya ba/ ku re dang rtsed mtshar bcas la bkol na shin tu 'tsham pa zhig go// ༈ bsdus brjod kyi rgyan la yul dbus 'gyur gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis sgra tsam gyi rgyan yang zer zhes rin spungs snyan 'grel du gsungs so/ / rtsa bar bsdus brjod kyi rgyan la dbye ba bzhi gsungs pa las/rgyan dang bo ni spyi'i bsdus brjod dang /phyi ma rnams de'i bye brag gam yan lag tu 'gyur ro// bsdus brjod kyi rgyan dang gab tshig gi rgyan gnyis ka brjod bya gab pa ste sbas pa'i cha nas 'dra tsam yod kyang /gab tshig gi rgyan la dpe can las gzhan pa'i dpe zhig 'god dgos pa'i nges pa med la/ bsdus brjod kyi rgyan la nges par dpe can las gzhan pa'i dpe zhig 'god dgos shing dpe can de bsdus pa'i tshul gyis brjod dgos pa mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yin/—234 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

phul byung gi rgyan/bcu gcig la dulabyung gi rgyag/ rtsa bar/ phul du byung bar brjod pa 'di//rgyan gyi dam pa yin te dper//zhes dang /ngag gi dbang bos mchod gyur ba//phul byang zhes 'di brjod pa 'di/ /rgyan ni gzhan pa rnams la yang / /r+shacig bu dpung gnyen mchog tu mdzod//ces dang / 'ju mi pham pa'i snyan 'grel las/ dpe rgyan sogs rgyan gzhan la'ang bul byung gi nyams 'dres na ches mdzes par 'gyur tshul gsungs pa ltar phul byang gi rgyan 'di ni 'jig rten na grags pa'i gnas tshul gyi mtshams zlos brgal ba'i lud nyams chen pos brjod don de nyid ches phul du byang bar brjod dgos pas/ gang brjod par 'dod pa'i don de'i chod chos phun sum tshogs shing ngo mtshar ba ston byed la phul du byung ba'i rgyan zhig yin zhing / rtsom pa bo'i snyan ngag sgyu rtsal la byang ba'i khyad chos ngom byed cig dang /klog pa bor tshad las 'das pa'i tshor ba dang spro snang ster byed cig kyang yin te/ da lta'i drag rtsal la sbyar ba'i glog brnyan mang bo zhig kyang rgyan 'di'i lam nas 'khrab yod bye/ /da mo ba khri stong gi dran 'dzin dbang med du 'phrog bzhin pa ༈ dpang lo'i snyan ngag ṭīka las/rang bzhin gyi rgyan ji lta ba skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzinagrwa la/ —233

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/bzhin gyi dngos po'i ngo bo brjod par yang khyad par brjod pa'i sgo nas phul byung gi rgyan dang ldan na mdzes kyi/ mi ldan na snyan ngag gi rgyan du mi 'gyur na/ 'khyog por brjod pa dpe dang gzugs can la sogs pa lta ci smos/ zhes gsungs par rin spungs snyan 'grel du rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan dang phul byung gi rgyan gyi gzhi mthun yod par 'grel te/ mtshan gzhir sangs rgyas byang sems kyi bstod pa lta bu bzhag pa dang / snyan gzhung la lar rang bzhin brjod pa ni phul byung tsam po bar 'dod pa sogs byang bas/kun mkhyen sdom tshig tu/lud byas 'ud bral 'dir gci| ma dmigs phyir/ /rang bzhin brjod dang phul byung gzhi mthun 'khrul/ /zhes zur za gnang ngo / /dpang lo'i dgongs pa ni/ rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan la'ang phul du byung ba'i snyan ngag gi nyams dang ldan dgos shing / dngos po'i khyad par gcig lta bu'ang brjod tshul sna tshogs pas brjod dgos pa'i don te/ rtsa bar/ dngos po sna tshogs dngos gsal byed//ces gsungs pa ltar ro/// phul byung gi dpe dang phul byung gi rgyan gnyis kur 'ud nyams thon dgos pa'i cha nas 'dra tsam yod kyang / phul byung gi dper 'ud nyams de 'dra mi che zhing dpe don gnyis ku'i mtshungs chos du ma nges par du tshig zin la thon dgos pa dang / phul byung gi rgyan la dpe don gnyis dgos pa'i nges pa med par gtso bo dpe can nam don gyi khyad chos thon phyir 'jig rten grags tshod las —236 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

phul byung gi rgyan/brgal ba'i 'ud gtam brjod dgos pa yin no//༈ zhe tshom pa'i dpe dang the tshom phul byung gi rgyan gnyis kur the tshom pa'i blo zhig skyes pa skad du brjod dgos pa'i cha nas 'dra tsam yod kyang /the tshom pa'i dper dpe dang dpe can gyi khyad par ma shes par the tshom skyes pa zhig dgos la/ the tshom phul byung la/ dper na/dka' thub pa zhig gi che ba brjod phyir/ zas dang gnyid la brten bzhin yod med la the tshom skyes pa skad du brjod pa las dpe nges par du 'god mi dgos pa'i khyad par yod do// / nges pa'i dpe dang nges pa phul byung gnyis kyang gong dang 'dra bar dpe 'god byed dgos min gyi khyad par yod par ma zad /nges pa'i dpe'i skabs su dpe gcig po las gzhanapa'imatshungasadape zhig med par nges pa skad kyis brjod dgos la/ nges pa phul byung gi skabs yul zhig la 'ud chen pos the tshom skyes skad de la slar the tshom skye mi dgos par nges pa rnyed tshul brjod pa zhig ste gtan 'bebs kyi dpe dang yang sgo 'dra tsam yod do//myu/ 'ju mi pham pa'i snyan 'grel du/nges pa phul byung ni the tshom phul byung gi bye brag tu gsungs pa mi 'thad de/de gnyis brjod gzhi gcig la sbyar bas spyi bye brag tu 'gyar na/dngos dpe sogs dpe rgyan so gcig po chos dpe'i bye bram tu 'gyar te/ brjod gzhi bud med kyi mdzes chos kho narasbyar ba'i phyir ro/sto/skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 237

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ ga bzhi ba ngo mtshar phul byung skabs/ dgyes glu las/ gzhung gi tshig zin gtso bor byas nas grags pa phul byung zhes 'chad 'dug na'ang / rgya chung bar mngon zhes sngon 'grel 'ga' la zur za gnang ba ni ches cher don la gnas te/ rtsa bar/khyod kyi grags pa'i phung bo ni//dpag nus min yang 'dir shong ba//sa skyong srid pa gsum gyi ni//khongs dag e ma shin tu yangs//zhes rgyal bo zhig gi grags snyan la sbyar yod kyang / de ni mtshan gzhi tsam yin pa las spyir dpe can gyi khyad chos ngo mtshar ba gang la'ang sbyar chog pas snyan grags kho na la sbyar na rgya chung bar gsungs pa'o//ཿ phul byung gi rgyan gyi skabs 'dir/ kun mkhyen sdom tshig las/mdzes rgyan skabs su lag pa lta bu zhig /ces sogs gsungs pa ni/dgyes glu las le'u dang bo'i skabs kyi mdzes pa'i rgyan dang skabs 'di'i ngo mtshar phul byang gnyis kyi khyad par bstan pa'i don tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa rū/ rgyan 'di gnyis kyi khyad par zhib phra le'u dang bo'i thun min rgyan gyi skabs su bshad na 'grig par mngon no// kun mkhyen sdom tshig las/ rgyan 'dres sgro na dpe rgyan so gnyis dang //zhes sogs gsungs pa ni/ dgyes glu las 'grel ba snga ma rnams su ldog pa'i phul byang sogs mang du sgro ba'i dpe brjod mdzad 'dug kyang /tshig tshorgos che ba tsam du zad cing / rgyan 'dres —238 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

phul byung gi rgyan/par spro bar shar na dpe rgyan so gnyis dang sbyar ba'i phul byung 'ong bas mtshon te/ bstod smad kyi rgyan 'dres pa khri phrag brgal ba 'byang ba'i phyir blo gros kyis dpogs pa las brjod par mi nus so//snas dpang ṭīka sogs 'grel ba snga ma rnams su bzlog pa'i phul byung /dpe'i rjes su song ba'i phul byung /gzugs can dang ldan pa'i phul byang /rang bzhin brjod pa'i phul byung / ting nge 'dzin gyi chos dang then pa'i grags pa phul byung / don gzhan bkod pa'i phul byung /sngon med phul byung /rab rtog gi phulabyung / 'gog pa'i phul byung /rab spel gyi phul byung sogs rgyan 'dres ma mang bosar ba'i tshul der //shā dro /zlos pa'i tshul gsungs pa'i don rnams tshigs bcad du skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —239

ngag rig sgyu 'phul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ rdzobacu gnyis blo rab rtogagi rgyas༈ rab rtog gi rgyan ni brjod bya sems ldan nam sems med kyi dngos po gang yang rung ba zhig gi gnas tshul lam rnam pa dngos de rab rtog gsal byed kyi sgra dang ldan pa'i sgo nas rnam pa gzhan zhig gi ngo bor sgro btags nas brjod pa'i 'khyog brjod kyi rgyan snyan ngag gi nyams phun sum tshogs pa thon byed cig ste/rtsa ba me long ma las/sems ldan rab rtog dang /sems med rab rtog ting 'dzin rab rtog gam bzhin sgra can gyi rab rtog bcas gsum gsungs so//rgyan 'dir dpe don gnyis su 'byed du med cing /bzhin dang 'dra sogs 'byung yang de ni skabs thob sbyor tshul gyi dbang gis mtshungs sgra min te rab rtog gam sgro 'dogs gsal byed kyi phrad tsam yin no/// rgyan 'di'i sgyu rtsal ni tshigs bcad lhug dang sgrung rtsom sogs gang la'ang sbyor rung zhing /deng skabs brjod bzhin pa'i 'char yan ring lugs kyi snyan ngag ces pa'ang sbyor tshul rgyan 'di dang phyogs mtshungs pa zhig go snyam/de yang 'char yan ring lugs kyi rtsom stangs der/mi rnams kyi bsam pa'i re 'dod ltar sgyu rtsal gyi snang brnyan bsgrun pa'i phugs bsam ring lugs kyi khyad chos yod pa/sgro btags dang 'khyog brjod sogs bsam bkod phun sum tshogs —2slo skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin spu la/

rab rtog gi rgyan/pa'i thabs rtsal dang ldan pa/ rtsom pa bo'i bsam blo'i brtse dung mngon gsal du thon pa sogs kyi khyad chos dang ldan pa zhig ste/mdor na dngos yod ring lugs kyi rtsom stangs la 'tsho ba bskyar mtshon byed pa dang / 'char yan ring lugs kyi rtsom stangs la 'tsho ba bskyar bskrun byed pa'i khyad chos dang ldan par bshad/ 'di dag gi skor la bshad bya mang yang 'dir de tsam gyis 'thus par byas so//ma tshangs sras bzhad sgra las/ rab rtog gi rgyan la/ brjod bya'i dngos po de rang gi gnas tshul ji lta ba bzhin du gnas pa'i tshul ni/rab rtog gi sa bon yin zhing / de la brten nas dngos po de'i bya ba'i gnas tshul gzhan zhig tu sgro btags te 'khyog por brjod pa la rab rtog ces zer bas na/ rab rtog gi rgyan 'di'i skabs su sgro 'dogs tshul khyad par ba zhig dgos par gsungs/zhes gsungs/༈ rab rtog gi rgyan gsum dogs gcod dang bcas pa bstan pa'i mjug tu/ rtsa bar/ snyam dang dogs dang nges dang 'dra/ /min nam zhes pa la sogs pa'i/ /sgra yis rab rtog gsal bar byed/ /bzhin gyi sgra yang de dang 'dra//zhes rab rtog gsal byed kyi sgra drug dang sogs khongs nas rtog go// rnam par rtog go//chos mthong ngo //ji lta ba'o/ / min nam/ cis ma yin/ ji ltar min lta bu'ang rab rtog gsal byed kyi sgra yin par bstan to/ / gong du dpe rgyan gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar rab rtog gsal byedakyi sgra 'di dag kyang rab skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —24 —

ngag rig sgyu 'phul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ skortog gi rgyan gyi thog mar bkod nas ngos zin par byas na legs te/rgyan dngos gzhi'i skabs su bkol dgos pa sha stag yin pas so/// ting 'dzin rab rtog gi dpe brjod la rtsa bar/mun pa lus la 'byag pa bzhin//mkha' 'di mig sman char 'beb bzhin//zhes 'di zlong ngo rab rtog gi//mtshan nyid ldan pa shin tu mang //zhes 'byang bas/ khams 'grel las/zhes pa 'di yang ngo'i sgras sems merdo rab rtog gi bye brag yin gsungs pa shin tu legs te/rab rtog gsal byed kyi sgra'i khyad par tsam las sems med kyi chos shig sems ldan gyi chos gzhan zhig gi ngo bor sgro btags te brjod pa la khyad par med pas so// don 'di la bsam na rab rtog gi rgyan thams cad ting 'dzin rab rtog las ma 'das mod/snga ma gnyis la brjod bya don dang phyi ma gcig bur rgyan gyi ngo bo'i sgo nas ming btags pa'o//rgyan 'di la ting 'dzin rab rtog ces brjod don rgya gzhung du sa ma rnyi'am sa ma ti zhes pa mnyam bzhag gam ting nge 'dzin gyi don du 'jug pas yin te/sems med kyi khyad chos shig sems ldan gyi khyad chos su mnyam pa nyid du sgro btags te bzhag pa'am brjod pas na ming yang de ltar btags pa'o/ // rtsa ba me long mar ting 'dzin rab rtog skabs bzhin sgra zhig yod pas rgyan de dpe rgyan du thal bar 'dod pa'i log rtog 'gog ched bshad pa mang bo zhig gnang zhing /kun mkhyen sdom tshig sogs —242 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/
