ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/so gcig la lhanacig brjod pa'i rgyabal / brjod don gang gi yon tan dang bya ba tha dad mi dad ci rigs lhan cig tu gnas pa'am byas par ston pa zhig la lhan cig brjod pa'i rgyan zhes bya'o// der dbye na/ yon tan dang / bya ba tha dad pa/bya ba gcig pa'i lhan cig brjod pa gsum yod do/// lhan cig brjod pa'i rgyan gyi dang po yon tan lhan cig brjod pa'i skabs rtsa bar/ da ni mtshan mo 'di dag rnams/ /bdag gi dbugs dang lhan cig ring //zla ba'i rgyan ldan ma rnams kyang / /bdag gi lus dang lhan cig skya/ /zhes gsungs par 'grel mdzad phal mo ches ring ba dang skya ba de yon tan tu bzhed mod/ rin spungs snyan 'grel/ ṭīka mdzad snga ma rnams kyis ring ba dang skya ba dag yon tan brjod pa'o//zhes pa las gzhan pa'i nus pa bstan du med pas na/ yon tan kyi brjod ngos ma zin snyam mo/ /zhes mtshan mo dang dbugs gnyis ring ba/ zla 'od kyis nam mkha' dang chags pa'i spu long dkar ba'am skya ba de yon tan ma yin pa lta bu zhig gsungs par/ dgyes glu las/ 'dir rin spungs pas nyes par bshad bzhin du/ snar thang bas legs par bshad pa la sun 'byin pa ni ma dag pas dag pa la 'phya ba'o/ /zhes dgag pa mdzad pa bzhin du rang 310 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

lugs kyis kyang 'dod do// / bya ba tha dad pa'i lhan cig brjod pa'i rgyan gyi skabs su'ang /rin spungs snyan 'grel las/ las rgyu dang grub 'bras lhan cig brjod pa'i rgyan no//'o na rgyu 'bras lhan cig pa mtshar ba'i rgyu dang khyad par med do zhe na/ mtshar ba ni chags pa'i nyams la rgyur btags shing / 'bras bu 'dod pa skyes pa yin la/ 'di ni chags pa'i las la mthun rkyen gyi rgyu dang / 'bras bu 'dod gzer lhan gcig tu brjod pas khyad par che'o/ /zhes yongs grags dang mi mthun pa'i 'dod tshul zhig gsungs par/ dgyes glu las/ rin spungs pas 'di la rgyu 'bras lhan cig pa gsungs na rgyu rgyan skabs kyi de dang mi 'dra ba'i dbye ba dgos pas 'jog rgyu mi rnyed la/khyed kyi legs par bshad pa 'di la skabs 'gar btsad rtags ma mdzad cig ces dgag pa mdzad yod do//༈ bya ba gcig pa'i lhan cig brjod pa ni dngos po 'ga' zhig gis bya ba gcig lhan cig tu byas pa zhig dgos kyang /snar thang bas rdzas brjod du 'chad pa ni rtsa ba'i dgongs pa las ring du gyes pa ste/rtsa ba'i dpe brjod du/khu byag sgrogs pa'i skal bzang dang //nags kyi rlung ni dri bzang dang /sto/dpyid nyin skye bo'i kun dga' rnams//lhan cig dag tu 'phel bar gyur//zhes de gsum gyis skye bo'i yid kyi dga' ba gcig bu 'phel bar byas tshul bstan pa las rdzas brjod skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —311—

pa'i phyogs tsam na'ang med pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i phyir dbyangs can dgyes glu las/ snar thang bas 'di la rdzas brjod du 'chad pa ni 'khrul ba'i rang mtshang ngo zhes gnad la khel ba'i gsung skyes shig gnang dgos byung 'dug go//

so gnyis la yongs bzhes kyi rgyanamyu/ rtsa bar/don rnams bsnol ba gang yin pa//yongs brjes yin te/zhes gsungs pa ltar/rtsom pa bos gang brjod par 'dod pa'i dngos po de'i yon tan dang las sogs thob bya gang rung zhig dang phan tshun bsnol ba'am go sa brjes pa'i tshul gyis brjod pa zhig la yongs brjes kyi rgyan zhes bya'o//'di la rtsa ba me long mar nang gses kyi dbye ba ma mdzad kyang /kun mkhyen sdom tshig las/de la'ang dge sogs dbye ba kho bo 'dod//ces dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum gyi don can gyi dbye ba phye chog par gsungs la/rang cag gis rdzutā ṭā/ /sdon gyi dpe brjod re 'jog thub mod 'dir shin tu mang skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —313

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/so gsumal gis brjod kyi rgyas༈ rang gzhan gyi yid la mngon par 'dod pa'i yul gang rung zhig bsgrub pa'am don du gnyer ba sogs la bar chad med par bde blag tu gang bsam 'grub par smon pa ni shis brjod kyi rgyan ste/ rtsa bar/ ngag yid spyod yul ma yin pa'i/ /snang ba dam pas khyod la srungs/ /zhes dang / rgyal dbang lnga ba chen mos/ ngag gi 'dod pa 'bad med du//'jo ba'i dbyangs can lha mo des//blo gros rgyas pa'i dngos grub kun/khyol ba'i bkra shis dga' stonastsol//ces gsungs pa lta bu'o// dbye na phul byung gi shis brjod sogs rgyan thams cad lasbyar rung bas mang du 'byung bar gsungs go /ga so gsum pa shis brjod kyi rgyan nas bzung ste ngo bo tha dad pa'i don rgyan gyi mjug bsdus par 'dod de/ 'og gi rab spel ni bshad zin pa'i rgyan 'ga' bsres pa las ma 'das la/ dgongs pa can gyi rgyan yang rgyan thams cad la khyab pa'am de las logs su 'jog tu med pa'i phyir ro/ /tshangs sras bzhad sgra las/ mtshams 'dir shis par brjod pa'i rgyan gyis mjug bsdus nas don rgyan shākya /sa zu zlo du bshad pa yin zhes gsung rgyun las 'byung ngo //zhes la/rdo skabasabacu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

shis brjod kyi rgyan/༈ rtsa bar/ rjes 'gro med dang the tshom can//dag ni dpe rnams nyid la bstan//dpe yi gzugs can dag kyang 'dir//gzugs can rnams la nges par bsgrags//rab rtog cha shas 'di yang ni//rab rtog dag gi dbye ba nyid//ces gsungs pa ltar/rgya gar gyi snyan gzhung 'ga' rer rjes 'gro med pa'i rgyan dang /the tshom gyi rgyan/ dpe'i gzugs can/rab rtog cha shas zhes rgyan 'ga' logs su gsungs mod/dbyug pa can gyis thun mong min pa'i dpe dang /the tshom gyi dpe/dpe'i gzugs can/rab rtog gi rgyan dag tu bstan zin par dgongs te logs su ma gsungs so//skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 315

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/so bzhi ba rab spelagyi rgyag༈ sngar bshad zin pa'i rgyan du ma tshig gi sbyor ba'am ngag gi rgyun gcig la bsres nas brjod don rdzogs par ston pa zhig rab spel gyi rgyan zhes bya la/ der bsgrub bya sgrub byed snga phyir bkod pa rang dbang can ma yin par bsres pa'i rgyan rnams phan tshun la ltos pa'i sgo nas don rdzogs par ston pa zhig la gcig la gcig ltos kyi rab spel dang / brjod don ston par bsre bya'i rgyan rnams phan tshun gcig la gcig mi ltos par rang dbang thob pa'am stobs 'dra mtshungs su gnas pa'i stobs mtshungs rab spel gnyis yod do/ / rgyun bkol gyi rtsom yig phal cher zhig rab spel gyi las nas bris yod pas 'di ni ha cang rgyugs che ba'i rgyan zhig go//༈ rab spel rgyan gyi skabs mi 'jigs seng ge'i nga ro dang khams 'grel sogs gzhung 'ga' rer rgyan gnyis tsam bsres pas chog par gsungs mod/ rgyan gnyis tsam bsres pa ni sbyar ba'i dpe dang /dpe'i gzugs can sogs sngar yang mang du byung zhing de dag la rab spel gyi don mi tshang ste/ 'jam dbyangs kha che ba sogs mkhas pa mang bos rgyan gnyis bsres pa ni spel ma tsam dang /gsum bsres pa nas rab spel gyi don tshang bar gsungs pa ji bzhin lags shing / rtsa bar —3/6 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

rab spel gyi rgyan/yang /tha dad rgyan rnams bsres pa yis//zhes mang tshig 'byung zhing dpe brjod kyis kyang nges pa rnyed sla ba'i phyir ro/// rtsa bar gcig la gcig rten las stobs mtshungs rab spel la dpe brjod dngos su ma gsungs mod/rat+na shrī'i rgya 'grel du/lus phra nu ma dud pa dang / /mig g.yo khengs byed bud med rnams//rnam 'gyar med pa zang rtsi bzhin//snyan pa nyid du smra bar gyis//zhes stongs mtshungs rab spel gyi dpe brjod mdzad pas bod kyi 'grel mdzad rnams la'ang dpe brjod 'jog srol byung ngon//sa skya ngag dbang chos grags kyis/rang bzhin brjod pa dang 'khyog brjod gnyis bsre dgos kyi/ 'khyog brjod kho na stong phrag tsam bsres kyang rab spel du mi 'gro gsungs pa ni shin tu ma dgongs pa ste/rang bzhin brjod pa yin na rab spel gyi mtshan nyid tshang zhing ma yin na mi tshang ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yang med la/ rtsa ba'i dpe brjod du yang / mdzes ma khyod kyi bzhin gyi dpal//pad+ma dag gis 'gog par byed//mdzod dang yu ba phun tshogs pa//'di la bya dka' ci zhig yod/ /ces dpe rgyan dang zol bstod don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan gsum bsres pa las rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan bsres med pa mngon sum yin pa'i phyir ro//skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 317

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/so lnga ba dgongs la can gyi rgyan/༈ snyan ngag mkhan po'i bsam pa ste thog mtha' bar gsum gyi snyan ngag 'grub par byed pa'i rtog pa de nyid phyogs bsdoms kyis bkod pa zhig la dgongs pa can gyi rgyan zhes bya'o// ༈rang cag gi khrid bya'i gzhung gi sdom tshig las/khyad par chos bzhi'i bsam pa'i dbang byas nas/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ rtsa bar/dngos po yis ni tshig rnams kun//phan tshun phan par byed pa nyid//don dang bral ba'i khyad par rnams//ma byas gnas su bsngags pa dang //brjod rim stobs las dngos po ni//zab mo dag kyang gsal ba ste/ /zhes pa'i chos bzhi la dgongs pa ste/ rjod byed tshig gis brjod don mtshon tshe se'u bcu ba'i ngag tu ma song bar phan tshun 'brel zhing 'gal zlas ma gos pa zhig dgos phyir ngag de'i tshig rnams phan tshun ltos shing 'brel ba/brjod don gyis stong ba bya rog so rtog lta bur ma song zhing tshig gi nyog mas ma bslad par tshig nyung don 'dus kha gsal mthil rtogs shig phyir dgos don dang bral ba'i tshig min pa/ brjod yul gang der bstod smad thal che ba'i mtha' gnyis su ma lhung bar don dngos kyi dbus lam du drangs te ston dgos phyir bstod pa'i gnas dang mthun par bsngags pa/ go —3 ci skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

dgongs pa can gyi rgyan/rim 'khrugs shing lung rigs kyi sgrub byed med pa/mkhas blun sus kyang go mi thub la brjod don ji bzhin mtshon pa'i tshig gi sgyu rtsal med pa sogs ma yin par zab pa dang rgya che ba'i brjod don dag kyang sdeb legs shing spro snang gi sgyu 'phrul dang ldan par dngos po zab mo'ang gsal nus pa bcas chos bzhi bo ni snyan ngag mkhan rnams kyis 'bad cing brtson dgos pa'i gnas gcig bu lags so//༈ dgongs pa can gyi rgyan gyi skabs/ dbyangs can dgyes glu las/ me long dang mtshungs me long gzhung lugs la/ /mkhas pa'i gsung bzhin mkhas pa'i go 'phang dag /mngon gyur phyir na mngon gyur nga rgyal dag/spangs te log rtog spangs nas 'di brtsams so//zhes dpe brjod logs su mdzad pa shin tu legs te/ /rgyan snga ma thams cad la snyan ngag pa'i dgongs pa'am bsam blos khyab pa bden yang / snyan ngag pa'i bsam blo spyi sdom gyi tshul du bkod pa'i rgyan gzhan na med pa'i phyir dang /don rgyan so lnga'i grangs dang yang mthun pa'i phyir ro// de'i phyir rin spungs snyan 'grel las kyang /dgongs pa can zhes pa'i rgyan ni/tshig nyi tshe ba rang gang gi brjod bya ma yin la/snyan ngag gi bstan bcos re re'i don yongs su rdzogs pa tshigs bcad gcig gnyis kyis kyang brjod nus pa dngos po nges bstan kho na dang /shis brjod dang dngos po nges bstan lhan cig tu bshad pa lta bu/ zhes mkhyen rtsal rdzogs pa'i gsung zhig gnang 'dug go//skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —319

ngag rig sgyu 'phul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/༈ dgongs pa can gyi rgyan la logs su dpe brjod 'jog dka' zhes 'brug sprul dang bod mkhas sogs mang bos bzhed la/ khong rnams kyis dpang lo'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos pad+ma dkar bo/snyan ngag me long gi rgya cher 'grel ba gzhung don gsal ba rnams khongs su drangs mod/ gzhung gzhan gnyis la dngos su mjal skal ma ldan la rin spungs pas ni rgyan kun gyi khyab byed du gsungs pa las dgongs pa can la logs su dpe brjod 'jog mi chog tshul ma gsungs so// ngag gi dbang phyug gi 'grel bar/ 'dir gzhung gi rgyun la yod pas/tshigs bcad gcig dang gnyis la sogs pa'i yul la yod pa yin par bsal lo/ /zhes gsungs kyang / de ni dgongs pa can gyi rgyan zhes pa tshigs bcad la lar yod la la lar med par mi bzhed par 'grel dgos par snyam ste/de ltar min na sho lo ka ci tsam yod na da gzod dgongs pa can gyi mtshan nyid rdzogs kāswā /zhung gi rgyun 'grub pa'i sa mtshams kyang 'jog dgos par ༈ dpang lo chen pos/ 'di ni rgyan thams cad kyi yang rgyun du gyur ba ste/ dang bo dang bar ba dang tha ma rnams su rgyun la rjes su 'jug pa'o//zhes dang snyan ngag spyi don las/'di ni sho lo ka re re gnyis gnyis tsam gyis dpe brjod mi 'grub pas/ 'dir snga ma dag gi 'gros ltar gyi dpe brjod 'god rgyu ma byung la/gal te mtshan gzhi 'god na snyan ngag spyi don 'di lta bu'i gzhung cha tshang bar bkod na 320 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

dgongs pa can gyi rgyan/shin tu 'tsham par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs/ bzhed tshul 'di dag thams cad kyang rgyan snga ma rnams dang ma 'dres pa zhig 'jog tu med pa'i don yin dgos te/ de lta min na/sho lo ka gcig gnyis can zhig dgongs pa can min na brgya nyis brgya can yang dgongs pa can yin don med pas/dgongs pa can yin na le'u'i bdag nyid can zhig gam gzhung zhig yin dgos par thal ba'i skyon dang /sho lo ka gcig can gyi chos dpe dang dngos dpe lta bur dgongs pa can gyis ma khyab pas rgyan kun gyi khyab byed du gsungs pa'ang mi 'grig pa sogs dpyad bya mang bo yod mod/bshes gnyen rin po ches rang cag gi khrid bya'i gzhung du mtha' dpyad zhib mo gnang 'dug pa ltar lags pas 'dir bdag gis mi nus bzhin du nyog bshad byed mi dgos/des na tshigs bcad than thun re bris nas snyan ngag pa dang rtsom pa bor rlom pa'i gzhi med kyi nga rgyal spangs te snyan ngag gi bstan bcos chen po'i rgya mtsho thos bsam dang dpyad 'jog myong stobs sogs kyis legs par brgal bar 'dod pa'i dpyod ldan gzur gnas don gnyer dang ldan pa dag gis yang gsal snang mdzod du bkod pa'i dogs gcod sogs la zhib mo'i blos dpyad de ngag rig sgyu rtsal la nang byan chud par byos shigaskabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 321—

ngag rig sgyu 'phul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/le'u gsum pa/sgra rgya ཿ rjod byed tshig gi nyams mi 'dra ba gtso bor ston zhing rgya gar lho shar gyi mkhas pa rnams kyi bzhed tshul thun mong du gyur ba'i rgyan zhig la sgra rgyan zhes bya'o/ / ( spyir rgya bod gnyis kyi skad rigs mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis snyan ngag me long ma'i le'u gsum par bstan pa'i sgra rgyan 'di bod skad la de 'dra'i rgyugs mi che zhing don ston tshabs zhan pa sogs kyang yod mod/ rig pa'i sgo 'phel ba'i phyir du sngon byon mkhas pa tshos dpe brjod cha tshang 'jog pa'i phyag srol yod pa bzhin/ rang cag gis kyang phyag srol bzang bo de rgyun 'dzin byed 'os mod/spyir bod la mtshon na snyan ngag gi gzhi rkang legs po zhig chags min ni gtso bo le'u gnyis pa'i skabs kyi don rgyan so lnga la sbyangs pa nang byan chud min la rag las phyir/ 'dir dogs gcod sogs zhib phra byed pa'i ngal ba mi bsten par gzhung gi spyi khog la go ba chags thabs kyis 'thus par sems so//gzhung gi spyi khog ji ltar chags par byed ce na/ sa bcad ni —322 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

sgra rgyan/rta rgyugs pa na rta la dkyus sa ston pa ltar gzhung gi spyi khog nges par mkho gal che zhing / rgya gar dang bod sogs 'ga' re ma gtogs mi rigs gzhan gyi rig gzhung la med pa'i thun min gyi khyad chos can zhig kyang yin par gsungs pas/le'u gsum pa'i skabs kyi sgra rgyan 'di gtso bo sa bcad kyi sgo nas gtan la dbab par bya'o//ཿ thun mong ba'i rgyan gnyis pa sgra rgyan la/ zung ldan dang / bya dka' ba'i khyad par gzhan dang / dbyangs sogs nges pa'i bya dka' ba dang bcas rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum yod/tshig sbyor gang du yi ge gzhan gyis bar chod pa dang /bar ma chod pa ci rigs kyi bdag nyid can/ yi ge mang du 'dus te/ mgo 'dogs 'bul rten/ dbyangs sogs tsheg khyim gcig la gang yod 'dra bar bskor ba'i rgyan zhig la zung ldan gyi rgyan zhes bya'o//de lta bu'i zung ldan gyi rgyan la dbye na/ bya sla ba rkang ba dang bo na yod pa'i zung ldan/ bya dka' ba gnas gzhan na yod pa'i zung ldan/mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan/kun tu zung ldan/ bsres pa'i zung ldan/bzlog pa'i zung ldan dang drug yod/tshigs bcad gcig gi rkang ba re re'i thog mar tsheg khyim 'dra ba zung bskor ba'am thon par byas pa'i ngag gi sgyu rtsal zhig la bya sla ba rkang ba dang bo na yod pa'i zung ldan zhes bya'o//de la ma chod pa'i zung ldan dang /chod pa'i zung ldan/chod cing ma chod pa'i zung ldan dang gsum yod/skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ 323

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/rkyang ba bzhi ga'i thog mar bkod pa'i zung ldan rigs mi 'dra zhing bar du yi ge gzhan gyis ma chod par bskor ba zhig la ma chod pa'i zung ldan zhes bya'o/ / de la rtsa bas dngos bstan gyi nang gses dbye ba bco lnga yod do//rkang ba'i thog mar bkod pa'i yi ge'i tshogs pa'am bskor bya zung ste gnyis kyi bar du yi ge gzhan mang bo 'byung ba zhig la bya sla ba rkang ba'i thog mar bkod pa'i bar chod zung ldan zhes bya'o/ /der rtsa bas dngos bstan gyi nang gses dbye ba bcu gsum yodado//tshigs su bcad pa gang gi rkang ba'i thog mar zung ldan gnyis bskor ba'i bar du yi ge gzhan mang bos bcad kyang zung ldan rang gi bar du yi ge gzhan gyis ma chod pa zhig la bya sla ba rkang ba'i thog mar bkod pa'i chod cing ma chod pa'i zung ldan zhes bya ste/ rtsa bas dngos bstan gyi dbye ba gsum yod do//tshigs su bcad pa'i rkang bzhi'i dbus mtha' ci rigs su yi ge 'dra ba ste zung bskor byar byed pa'i tshig gi sgyu rtsal zhig la bya dka' ba gnas gzhan na yod pa'i zung ldan zhes bya'o// der dbye na rkang bzhi'i dbus na yod pa/ mtha' na yod pa/ bar mtha' gnyis na yod pa/ thog bar gnyis na yod pa/ thog mtha' gnyis na yod pa/gnas gsum ga la yod pa bcas drug yod la/ de dag re rer yang chod pa dang ma chod pa'i zung ldan gnyis re yod pas khyon bya dka' ba gnas gzhan la yod pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan la nang gses dbye ba bcu gnyis yod do//—324 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

rkangabagonga'ogagimatha'arnyisna/gnyis0zung gi ya re bskor zhing rkang ba bzhi ku'i skor byed kyi tshig mi 'dra bar byas pa zhig la mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan zhes bya ste/ sngon byon mkhas pa'i brtsams chos khrod mang du 'byung ba'i rgyan zhig go//rgyan 'di la nang gses dbye ba med/tsheg khyim zung tsam bzlas pa ma yin par rkang ba gcig gam tshigs bcad phyed/yang na tshigs bcad gcig ci rigs lan gnyis su bzlas pa zhig la kun tu zung ldan zhes bya'o//tshul 'di gsol 'debs dang bstod bskul re'i skabs ched dmigs lta bus 'don pa yod srid pa las bod skad kyi nang du rgyun bkol dang / bod kyi mkhas pa'i brtsams chos khrod rgyun mthong gi rgyan zhig min no//bzhi ba kun tu zung ldan 'di la rkang ba bzlas pa dang /tshigs bcad bzlas pa/ zung ldan chen po bcas rtsa ba'i dbye ba gsum dang / de'i dang bo rkang ba bzlas par byed bzlas yang dag sbyor ba dang / gzhan rkang ba bzlas pa gnyis/byed bzlas yang dag sbyor ba la nang gses dbye ba gsum yod/gnyis pa rkang ba bzlas pa la lan gcig bzlas pa/lan gnyis bzlas pa/lan gsum bzlas pa dang bcas gsum yod/ de'i dang bo lan gcig bzlas par nang gses dbye ba drug lan gnyis bzlas par nang gses dbye ba gsum/ lan gsum bzlas par nang gses dbye ba med/ gong gi gnyis pa tshigs bcad bzlas pa dang gsum pa zung ldan chen po gnyis la rgyan re rer dang gses dbye ba med/ des na kun tu zung skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzinagrwa ga 325

ngag rig sgyu 'phul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ldan 'di la khyod dpe brjod 'jog dgos pa'i rgyan mi 'dra ba bco lnga yod do//kun tu zung ldan gyi rtsa ba'i gsum pa zung ldan chen po la ni rkang ba gcig gi nang du'ang bskor bya zung ste gnyis bskor dgos pas gong gi rkang ba bzlas pa'i nang tshan lan gsum bzlas pa dang khyad par chen po yod de/ lan gsum bzlas par rkang ba bzhi 'dra bar bskor ba tsam las rkang ba gcig gi nang du lan gnyis bskor mi dgos pa'i phyir ro// de'i phyir kun mkhyen sdom tshig las/ der bzlas lhag /med do 'di dang rkang ba gsum bzlas pa'i//zhes sogs kha gsal gyi dogs gcod 'di gsungs pa lags so//zung ldan lnga ba bsres pa'i zung ldan ni don rgyan so lnga'i nang gses rab spel gyi rgyan dang cha 'dra bar/bya sla ba'i zung ldan dang /bya dka' ba gnas gzhan na yod pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan 'ga' bsres mar bkod pa'i rgyan zhig la bya'o/ / 'di la dpe brjod gcig po las nang gses kyi dbye ba med/tshigs bcad gcig slar yang lugs ldog gis bkod de tshigs bcad gnyis su grub pa'i sgo nas don tha dad du ston pa'am/tshigs bcad phyed dam rkang ba gcig ci rigs lugs ldog gis bkod de don tha dad dam so sor go rgyu yod pa'i rgyan zhig la zung ldan drug pa bzlog pa'i rgyan zhes bya'o//rgya gar la mtshon na rgyan 'di ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i ngag rig sgyu rtsal zhig lags pas/ rgyan 'di'i lam nas brtsams —326 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

sgra rgyan/pa'i brtsams chos grags can dang rgyan 'dir rtsom rtsal 'bar ba'i snyan ngag pa grags can yang mang du byon myong bar grags mod/rang re bod la ni rigs pa 'phel ba'i sgo'am srol rgyun tsam mi nub pa'i ched du dpe brjod re 'jog srol 'dug na'ang /lhod cig cig gi sgyu rtsal dang / zad mtha' med pa'i snyan ngag gi ro mchog cig thon thob rgyu ni shin tu nas kyang dka' bar snang ngo // 'di la rgyun srol ltar dpe brjod re 'jog 'dod tshe/ phrad dang rnam dbye ming gi cha shas sogs spong ci thub kyis ming tshig dag mthar chags su bsgrigs na/lugs ldog tu bkod pa'i tshe cung phan bskyed che bar mngon/ rgyan 'di la rkang ba bzlog pa dang / tshigs bcad byed bzlog tshigs bcad bzlog pa bcas me long dngos bstan gyi dbye ba gsum yod do//de ltar sgra rgyan la rtsa ba'i dbye ba gsum phyes pa'i dang bo zung ldan gyi rgyan la khyon nang gses re gsum tsam yod do//༈ gnyis pa bya dka' ba'i khyad par gzhan bstan pa ni/tshig gi sbyor ba snyan ngag la ma sbyangs pa rnams kyis ji bzhin brjod mi shes shing cung zad sbyangs pa rnams kyis kyang klog pa bo'i yid 'gugs shing snyan ngag gi sgyu rtsal mtho shos su slebs dka' ba/snyan ngag pa chen po rnams kyis sbyar na ni rjod byed kyi tshig la sbrul dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'thab stangs kyi brjid nyams 'dzoms pa/sa dgra sogs bkra mi shis pa rnams zlog par byed pa/bkra shis rten 'brel gyi rang bzhin 'dzoms pa/ klog pa bo'i mig yid spro ba'i gsos su skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —327

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags myu/'gyur ba sogs ngag rig gi sgyu rtsal phun sum tshogs pa zhig la bya'o//de la rtsa bas dngos bstan gyi dbye ba/ ba lang gcin dang / byed 'khor/kun 'khor bcas gsum yod do//ba lang 'gro bzhin du gcin btang ba'i rjes shul gyi ri mo dang dbyibs mtshungs pas ba lang gcin dang /phyogs gnyis tsam sgra gzugs gcig par 'khor thub pas byed 'khor/ phyogs bzhi gar sgra gzugs gcig par 'khor thub pas kun 'khor zhes bya'o/ / ba lang gcin gyi kun 'khor la gzhung la lar glang bo'i 'gros zhes ming btags yod pa mi 'thad tshul/khams 'grel las/bod 'grel mang bor glang bo'i 'gros zhes bkod pa ni shin tu mi 'thad de/glang bo zhes pa glang chen kho na'i ming yin na de la go'i sgra 'jug pa'i skabs gtan nas med pa la/ 'di'i rgya dper go zhes ba lang gi skad dod dngos su 'byung ba 'gal zhing zhes gsungs so//༈ de yang kun bzang 'khor lor grags pa'i rtsom stangs 'di la rten 'brel gyi gnad bun sum tshogs pa yod pas rang re'i sngon byon mkhas pa dag gis ches cher do snang byed pa'i rgyan zhig yin/me long dngos bstan du rigs mi 'dra ba gsum tsam las med kyang rgyan thams cad me long ma'i nang du 'du ba'i nges pa med la/bod rang la'ang ngag rig smra ba mang du byung ba/mi rigs dang rgyal khab gzhan nas kyang nang 'dren byas yod rkyen kun 'khor 'bri srol rigs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs shig byung zhing / bod kyi gtsug lag khang —328 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

sgra rgyan/grags can dang dgon sde rig gnas dar sa dag gi 'du khang sgo 'byor sogs su sngon byon mkhas pa'i blo gros kyi rtsal las thon pa'i kun 'khor sna tshogs shig da dung yang mjal du yod la/ bla chen dpon chen khri la 'khod pa'am bkra shis dga' ston gyi yo lang chen po'i skabs su der bstun gyi kun 'khor 'bri srol yod pa sogs bod dar kun 'khor 'di la dpyad gzhi'i rin thang bla med cig ldan no snyam/ ju/ shin tu grags che ba ni/ paṇa ṭi ta rig byed rgya mtsho'i gsung las rnyed par grags pa'i kun 'khor zlum po 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad kyi dbyibs can/ rtsibs re re nas nang du 'khor zhing mu khyud re re nas g.yas su 'khor chog pa khyad chos du ma can/shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur bar grags pa'i kun 'khor gru bzhi ba/ (khams 'grel las/'jam dbyangs kha che'i 'grel bar shong ston gyis bzhed par grags pa be+e dar bha'i lugs yin par grags pa'i kun 'khor dbyibs gru bzhi ba can dang / paṇa ṭi ta rig byed rgya mtsho'i gsung las rnyed pa yin zer ba kusmi ra'i lugs su grags pa'i kun 'khor dbyibs skum po/zhes ldog ste gsungs pas dpyad/)bod kyi mkhas pas sbyar ba'i kun 'khor bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi dbyibs tshang ba/ gzhan yang grub mtha' mi 'dra ba dang dus babs mi 'dra ba/ mi'i 'char sgo mi 'dra ba sogs las thon pa'i kun 'khor yang bgrang gis mi lang ba zhig yod pa las grags che ba dgu yod tshul tshig rgyan rig pa'i sgo 'byed sogs las gsungs skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 329

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/shing /re re'i dpe brjod paṇa chen sku phreng brgyad pa'i gsung tshangs sras dgyes pa'i rol mor gsal tshul gdams yod do/// khams 'grel las/ kun 'khor ni spyir dpung tshogs yan lag bzhi ldan la 'thab stangs mi 'dra ba bzhi yod pa las/ sbrul dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'thab stangs la dpe blangs par gsungs shinganade'i tshul ni/ 'grel ba 'dod 'jo'i lung khams 'grel du drangs pa las/dpung tshogs mtha' dag phan tshun du 'gro zhing 'ong bas rjes su 'khor zhing 'jug pa ni sbrul lo// dpung tshogs rnams dkyil 'khor gyi bkod pas brkyangs te thams cad du 'jug cing sbrul gyi lus dang 'dra ba ni dkyil 'khor gyi 'thab stangs can no//zhes gsungs/ bod kyis dpal be'u'i 'thab stangs dang rgya nag gis spar kha brgyad kyi 'thab stangs la dpe blangs pa'i kun 'khor snyan ngag kyang yod srid do//༈ dbyangs bzhi dang skye gnas brgyad ming gzhi'i yi ge ci rigs nges pa can byas te ngag gi sgyu rtsal dang ldan zhing brjod don zab mo ston thub pa'i rgyan zhig la sgra rgyan gsum pa dbyangs sogs nges pa'i bya dka' ba zhes bya'o//dbyangs nges pa dang /gnas nges pa/ yi ge nges pa gsum por/ dang gses dbye ba gcig tu nges pa/gnyis su nges pa/gsum du nges pa/ bzhi ru nges pa bcas khyon bcu gnyis yod cing /spyir sgra rgyan gyi zung ldan dang /bya dka' ba'i khyad —330 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

sgra rgyan/par gzhan bstan pa/ dbyangs sogs nges pa'i bya dka' ba dang bcas khyon sgra rgyan mi 'dra ba bdun cu don brgyad tsam yod do/// snyan ngag gi dbyangs nges pa'i skabs 'dir gi gu sogs bzhi bo gang yang med pa la dbyangs a nges pa'i rgyan zhes rang res kyang ming 'dogs mdzad 'dug mod/de ni rgya gar gyi dbyangs bcu drug gam bcu bzhi bo'i thog ma a yig gis nges par byas pa la dbyangs a nges pa zhes zer ba bzhin bod kyis kyang ming de ltar btags pa tsam las bod rang gi lugs sam skad kyi gdangs la dbyangs bzhi las lnga mi 'dod tshul dang / a srog zhugs dang ma'i gdangs kyis khyab pa gnyis mi 'dra tshul sngar khyed cag la sum cu ba khrid tshe mang du bshad zin pa ltar ro//༈ dbyangs nges par byed pa dang ka sogs gsal byed sum cu bo mgo mjug bar gsum ci rigs su lugs 'byung ldog sogs gang rung gis nges par byed pa'i bya dka' ba'i rtsom srol 'di ni snyan ngag me long ma bod skad la ma bsgyur ba'i yar sngon nas bod rang la rtsom srol yod pa thon mi'i yig phud du grags pa sogs kyis shes la/khyad par bod kyi ka rtsom 'di ni bod kyi thun min khyad chos mtshon pa'i rtsom stangs khyad par ba zhig yin pas rang cag gis nam yang gtsigs 'dzin dang dar spel du gtong dgos pa'i gnas shig go/ /skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 331

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/lta gna' deng gi snyan ngag gang la sbyangs kyang rang gi skad yig gi lam nas rtsom pa la 'jug tshe mi rigs de'i thun min skad yig gam brda sprod kyi chos nyid gzhir 'jog dgos pa ni gzur du med pa'i don dngos shig lags pas/ gnyis pa skye gnas nges pa'i skabs 'dir yang rang re bod kyis bod rang gi skad gdangs sogs dang mthun par/ khog pa/ mgrin pa/ rkan/ lce/ sna/ spyi bo/ so/ mchu bcas skye gnas brgyad dang / dog pa/phye ba/phrad pa/ btsum pa/ lci ba/yang ba bcas byed pa drug gnas dang byed pa/rlung dang rnam pa rtog pa bcas yi ge skye ba'i rgyu bzhi bcas kyi ngo bo dang go rim/skye gnas sgra gdangs drag zhan rtsom gzhir 'jog pa smos med yin la/ de ltar gzhir bzhag na gos chen thang la bting 'dra'i tshig gi lhod cha dang /bod rigs bu mo'i 'gram pa dmar ba lta bu'i mi rigs rang gi thun mong skad cha'i chos nyid cig thon rgyu yod nges mod/ rang re'i snyan gzhung dag tu ni de ltar ma yin par rgya gar gyi tsan dra ba'i gzhung sogs dang mthun par skye gnas lnga'am drug tu bsdus pa sogs kyis ni bod kyi skad cha'i sgyu rtsal zhig thon dka' bar snang ngo snyam ste tshul tā// /phyod pa'i blo mig yangs pa tshos thugs zhib gnang bar / kun mkhyen sdom tshig las/ mgrin rkan lce rtse so mchu spyi bo rnams//ci rigs skye gnas nges te gnas nges so//zhes gsungs pa ni gtso bo rgya gar ba'i lugs ltar byas pa zhig ste/snyan ngag gi skabs —332 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

sgra rgyan/'dir de dag gi ngo bo legs par shes pas bod skad la phan skyed de 'dra mi 'dug mod/ rang re'i mdo rgyud rig gnas mang bo zhig gi gzhung dang legs sbyar gyi skad gnyis 'brel 'dug pas skad gdangs de dag por 'ong ba la phan bskyed che bar mngon no// des na snar thang ba'i sngags bklag thabs las/ a ku ha ṅka nam mkha'i khams//mgrin pa'i gnas las skye ba yin//btsu ya sha rlung gi khams//lce rtse so rkan dag las skye//ṛ ṭu ra ṣa me yi khams//spyi bo dag las skye ba yin//u pu wa pi chu yi khams//mchu yi gnas las skye ba yin//t+pa tu la sa sa yi khams//lce rtse so las skye ba yin//zhes gsungs te/ kā la ba'i lugs gzhir ba zhag na rgya gar gyi dbyangs gsal zhe bdun dang /ḍa ma ru'i dbyibs can gyi yi ge ṅka r+ṇa gnyis dang / glang chen myos bum dbyibs can tha tha gnyis bcas khyon 4ge nga gcig las/a ā ka khā ga gha nga ṅka r+ṇa ta bcas yi ge bcu ni 'byung ba nam mkha'i khams las skye zhing /skye tshul mgrin pa'i gnas las dbugs bskyod pa dang lhan cig tu skye ba yin no//i 6tsa tsha dza dzhanya ya sha bcas yi ge dgu ni 'byung ba rlung gi khams las skye zhing / skye tshul lce rtse dang rkan gnyis sbyar ba las skye'o//ṛ rī ṭa ja ḍa nye ṇa ra ṣa bcas yi ge dgu ni 'byung ba me'i khams las skye zhing /skye tshul lce rtse spyi bo'i phyogs su steng du yar bkug nas rkan la sbyar ba las skye'o// u u pa pha ba bha ma wa dzi tha bcas yi ge bcu ni 'byung ba chu yi khams las skye zhing /skye tshul yas mas kyi mchu dkyil sbyar ba las skye ba yin no// bla thā ta tha da dha na la sa bcas yi ge dgu ni'abyung ba sa'i khams las skye zhing /skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzinagrwa ga 333

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/skye tshul lce rtse so la sbyar ba'i gdangs las skye ba yin no//e i gnyis ni i sī dang khams mthun la/o e gnyis ni u u dang khams mthun no//bod kyi yi ge'i skye gnas sogs 'dir bshad mi dgos te/sngar sum rtags kyi skabs su khyed cag gis mang du sbyangs zin pa ltar ro//༈ rgya gar gyi dbang du byas na'ang snyan ngag gi skabs dang spyir sgra rig pa'i skabs gnyis kyi yi ge'i skye gnas kyi ngos 'dzin cung mi 'dra bar snang la/de bzhin du bod kyi mkhas pa snga ma tshos kyang sum rtags dang snyan ngag gi skabs kyi yi ge'i skye gnas dang byed rtsol drag zhan gyi ngos 'dzin mi mthun par gsungs pa ni ha cang bsam dka' ba'i gnas shig ste/snyan ngag kyang sgra rig pa'i yan lag gam brda sprod byed nyid las ma 'das na skye gnas sogs sum rtags dag gsum gyi skabs dang khyad par zhig 'byung don ye nas med pas so//'di dag gi skor la dpyad pa re zur du spro thos/phyag len la skye gnas nges pa'i skabs ming gzhi'i yi ge rnams nges pa can yin pas chog ste/sngon rjes dang mgo 'dog sogs la ltos mi dgos par bzhed do//'di yang rgya gar ba'i lugs la bstun pa'am des shan shugs thebs pa zhig yin snang ste/bod kyi dbang du byas na sngon rjes mgo 'dogs sogs yod med kyis sgra gdangs dang skye gnas sogs la'ang khyad par che ba rang cag la thun mong snang grub yin pas so//༈ yang gsal snang mdzod du bkod pa'i gnas nges pa'i dpe 334 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

brjodanasa'ogagigabatshigaskyonasgra///dngabacasapa'i dpe brjod ni bshes gnyen rin po che rje btsun dmu dge bsam gtan rgya mtsho mchog nyid kyis mdzad pa zhig ste/ bstan pa'i sgron me'i dpe brjod de rtsom 'phror lus yod pas so// ca gsum pa yi ge nges pa la gsal byed nges pa zhes kyang bya ste/rgyan 'dir sngon gyi mkhas pa'i phyag srol la ming gzhi'i yi ge kho na nges pa can du byas pas chog par bzhed la/sngon rjes sogs ci yang med par ming gzhi rkyang ba nges can byed dgos par 'dod mkhan yang snang mod/ tshangs sras bzhad sgra las/ gsal byed nges pa'i skabs la las sngon rjes mgo 'dogs sogs dang bral ba'i ming gzhi kho na yin dgos par bshad kyang / rgya skad la de 'dra 'ong yang bod skad la tshig sbyor snyan mo mi 'byang ngo / / 'on kyang sngon rjes mgo 'dogs sogs yod kyang de me+e nges pa med par ming gzhi kho na dbang btsan par byas na 'grig tshul 'di ni lnga ba chen po'i dgongs pa'ang yin tshul sogs gsungs te rgyas par gzhung de nyid las shes par bya'o//byu / gzhung lugs spyi dang khyad par du snyan ngag gi gzhung la nang byan ma chud cing rtsom rig gi dge mtshan nam khyad chos ma rtogs pa'i skye bo la las dbyangs gnas yi ge nges pa'i rtsom stangs la spro snang zhan cing khyad chos med par rlom pa/ don gyi zab tshad chung ba skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —335

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/sogs kyi skyon brjod par byed mod/ ngag rig rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son cing mdo rgyud gnyis kur rang dbang du longs spyod pa'i kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas yi ge sna gcig re'i nang du'ang mdo sngags kyi gnad thams cad bsdu thub par gsungs la/bshes gnyen rin po che khong gis kyang ming gzhi'i yi ge gcig gis nges par byas pa'i rjod byed sho lo ka gcig gi nang du brjod bya bshes gnyen bsten tshul gyi chos skor cha tshang bar bsdus pa'i rtsom rtsal rmad du byung ba zhig rang cag gi bgo skal du bstsal ba ni/zha zha zhum zhum zhabs zhu zhu//zhwa bzhin zhu zhing zhim zhim zhu//bzhed gzhung zhu zhes zhi zhing zhu//gzhung bzhin zhu zhing zhib zhib zhu//zhes pa'o//'di'i tshig 'grel gzhan dang gzhan du'ang 'dug mod/bshes gnyen rin po che'i zhal lung ji bzhin tshig 'grel tsam bris na/rang nyid mtshan ldan bla ma'i drung du song ste/ sgyid pa zha zha dang sems nga rgyal med par zhum zhum gyi rnam pas sku bsnan sogs ci byung yang zhabs zhu ni tshul bzhin du zhu zhes sbyor bas bsten tshul gyi chos skor cha tshang zhig bstan/mtshan ldan gyi bla ma de nyid la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bzung ste mgo'i zhwa bzhin du sems gnas dgu'i bsten tshul sogs tshad dang ldan par brtsi bkur tshad med zhu zhing zas gang zhim zhim sogs zang zing gi mchod pa'ang ci 'byor bul te thugs mnyes par nu ba ste byed ces gtso bo bsam pa'i bsten tshul gyi chos skor cha tshang —336 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

zhig bstan/ bla ma bsten zhes pa'ang sku drung du bsdad pa dang phyag 'tshal ba mchod pa phul ba tsam ma yin la/chos zhu zhes pa'ang mnyam gcig tu gleng mol byas pa'am 'das song gi lo rgyus tsam dris pa ma yin pas/ mgon po khyod kyi bzhed gzhung ngam sngon byon mkhas pas bzhed pa'i mdo sngags rig gnas kyi dgongs don ngo ma de bum pa gang byo'i tshul gyis lhag lus med par zhu zhes lan gcig lan gnyis tsam ma yin par yang dang yang du zhi zhing dul ba'i ngag gis zhu dgos so zhes bshes gnyen bsten tshul spyi dang khyad par du chos zhu skabs kyi ngo bo cha tshang zhig bstan/dpe khrid dam chos zhu stangs kyang dpon pos 'bangs la bka' bstsal ba'am/rgyang bzhud mgron pos lam 'dri ba/ bsam med byis pas pha mar gna' gtam 'dri ba lta bu ma yin par/tshad ldan gzhung nas thog mar brtags shing bar du lus srog longs spyod dang bcas pa 'bul ba'i chod sems brtan pos zhu dgos par gdams pa bzhin legs par zhu zhingan gang zhus pa'i don kyang wa skyes smug long du 'grim pa bzhin 'tham 'thom du ma song zhing tshig gi ngo gdong tsam gyis yid tshims ma sla bar dngos shugs brgyud gsum dang drang nges kyi khyad par sogs rigs pa'i gsang tshig mtha' yas pa dag zhib zhib ste zhib cing phra ba'i sgo nas zhu dgos so zhes rgyal ba'i gsung rab zab cing brling bas slob gnyer byed stangs sam dam chos kyi dgongs don 'tshol stangs skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —337
dīlha//byirngo/rdodhiḥlca//rdo/ratacanganan tan byed dgos zhes thugs brtse raba'i sgo nas legs par gdams pa'o// ri —338 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa 'a/

gab tshig gi rgyan/ga mig gi rgyas( spyir rgya gar lho shar gyi mkhas pa spyi'i bzhed tshul gcig tu gyur ba'i thun mong ba'i rgyan la/ don rgyan dang sgra rgyan/ gab tshig gi rgyan bcas rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum gyi phyi ma gab tshig gi rgyan ni/dpe 'god dang gzugs 'god/ rab btags dang bsdus brjod tsam gyis bsgrib bya sgrib pa ma yin par/ gab bya'i don de nyid gab byed kyi don gzhan nam tshig gi sgyu rtsal ngo mtshar ba'i lam nas gab par byas pa zhig la gab tshig gi rgyan zhes bya'o//de la dbye na/ spyir sbyor ba bo'i blo gros kyi rtsal la brten te mtha' yas pa 'byung chog cing / bod kyi mkhas pas sbyar ba'i thun min gab tshig kyang grangs med pa zhig mchis mod/ me long dngos bstan la/ 1 kun tu tshogs pa'i gab tshig na sa byed kyi gab tshig rim pa dang bral ba'i gab tshig 4rab bcom gyi gab tshig 5 mthun gzugs kyi gab tshig 6 6ba mo'i gab tshig7 grangs kyi gab tshig no rab btags kyi gab tshig 9 ming du 'dus pa'i gab tshig 10 sgrib pa'i gab tshig 11 mthun pa'i sgra'i gab tshig 12 rmongs pa'i gab tshig 13 yongs 'phrog gi gab tshig 14 gcig sgrib kyi gab tshig 15 gnyis sgrib kyi gab tshig 16 yongs 'dres kyi gab tshig bcas bcu drug yod do//skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 339

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ ༈ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇa ṭi ta'i zhal nas/rgya mtsho chu yis mi ngoms shing //rgyal bo'i bang mdzod nor gyis min//'dod yon spyad pas mi ngoms te/ /mkhas pa legs bshad kyis mi ngoms/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yod tshad rigs pa'i lam nas gtan la 'bebs par spro ba'i mkhas pa rnams ni shes bya rig pa'i gnas gang la'ang 'bad pas brtson cing yang dag par rtogs par byed de/ ji skad du/rgyal sras rnams kyis mi slob pa'i//dngos de gang yang yod ma yin//zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar ro/ / de ltar na rtsa ba me long ma las/rtsed mo'i mdun sar bzhad gad dngan/ de shes tshogs su smra ba dngan/pha rol kun tu rmongs byed la//gab tshig dag ni nyer mkho ldan//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rigs pa smra ba mang bo gdan 'dzoms pa'i dbus su rtsed mo'i rnam pas ngag rig gi sgyu rtsal ngom ste dbang med kyi bzhad gad slong ba/ gsang tshig gang rung rang dang thun mong bar gyur ba'i pha rol bor tshogs kyi dbus su ngag gi thabs 'phul la brten te brjod don ston pa'am gab tshig la byang ba'i grogs dang rig pa'i rol rtsed spro ba/ snyan ngag spyi dang khyad par gab tshig gi rgyan la ma byang ba'i pha rol bo dag rmongs shing 'khrul ba/ ngo tsha zhing skyi g.ya' ba'i gnas su 'god pa/ nga'o snyam du mkhas pa'i nga rgyal gyis ches cher sbos pa rnams la 'ju byed gyi bdud rtsi sman sbyor gcig chog gi rgyan la'ang rnam dpyod dang ldan pa'i mkhas pa rnams sha thang thang gis brtson cing sbyong bar byed do//—340 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

gab tshig gi rgyan/de lta bu'i gab tshig gi rgyan 'di la ngos 'dzin byed stangs sna tshogs shig 'dug ste/ la las gab tshig dang khed gnyis don gcig ming gi rnam grangs su bzhed pa dang / 'ga' res lde'u dang gab tshig gnyis don gcig ming gi rnam grangs su byed do//bshes gnyen rin po ches ni sgrung lde'u bon gsum gyi ya rgyal lde'u zhes pa de ni deng sang dmangs khrod du rgyun 'byams su dar ba'i khed dang don gcig yin la/ de dang gab tshig gnyis ni bstan byed kyi gzhung dang / tha snyad/'byung khungs/ngo bo bcas khyad chos bzhi'i sgo nas mi 'dra tshul drang srong tshangs thig ces par gsal bshad mdzad yod pa ltar lags te/khed dang lde'u ni bod rang sa nas sngon byon mes po dag gi rgyun ring 'tsho ba'i nyams myong dang blo gros kyi rtsal las thon pa dnganagab tshig ni rtsa ba me long ma las bstan/ ches gna' snga mo'i dus nas bod kyi rig pa'i rol rtsed 'di'i ming la lde'u'am khed ces pa las gab tshig mi zer la/me long mar gab tshig ces pa las lde'u dang khed ces pa'i tha snyad btags med/ lde'u'am khed 'jog stangs 'di bod rang sa nas byung zhing byung ba'i dus kyang ches snga ba rgyal rabs nyer bdun gyi ring la chab srid sgrung lde'u bon gsum gyis bskyangs par bshad pas kyang dpog thub la/ gab tshig gi rgyan 'di'i rtsom stangs kyi 'byung khungs rgya gar yin la de bod du dar ba ni shong lo chen po'i skabs yin pa kun la gsal/ lde'u'am khed ni phyugs ji dang byis pa yan chad kyis kyang shes pas shin tu go sla ba dmangs khrod rtsom rig gi ru ma lta bu yin la kha skad dang tshig lhug gtso che/ gab tshig ni skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 341

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/snyan ngag pa rnams kyi sger chos lta bur gyur cing rjod byed kyi tshig snyan la brjod bya'i don zab pa/ nges par snyan ngag gi rgyan du 'gyar dgos shing / tshigs bcad kyis nges pa/ bsam bkod kyis phyu| pa sogs sgyu rtsal rtsom rig gi khongs su gtogs pa zhig nges par du r+shaswākā ༵ sdo /ba tshig dang lde'u (khed)gnyis mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rtsa bar yang / gab tshig ngan pa'am ltar snang bcu bzhi bo 'dor dgos par gsungs pa ni de dag brjod bya dngos gab byed gzhan zhig gis sbas par byas pa lta bu'i cha nas 'dra yang rgyan gyi khyad chos dang sgyu rtsal mi tshang bas gab tshig tu ma bgrangs pa yin la/snyan ngag spyi don gyi mjug tu'ang dpyi sa rin po che blo gros rgya mtshos dmangs khrod kyi khed mang bo zhig gab tshig lam du drangs pa bkod yod pa des kyang khed dang gab tshig gnyis la khyad par chen po yod pa shes thub pa lta bu'o/ / des na mkhas dbang tshe tan zhabs drung rin po ches gab tshig ces pa ni blos btags kyi 'dra bzhag sna tshogs pas skung tshig bshad pa la/ da lta phal skad du khed zer ba 'di dang 'gro phyogs 'dra'o//zhes dang / bsdus brjod dang rab btags/sbyar ba sogs dang cha 'dra ba'i gab tshig 'di nyid snyan ngag gi rgyan gyi gras su bzhag nas gab tshig gi rgyan zhes ming btags pa yin/zhes gsungs pa ltar du gzung rigs so//༈ gab tshig gi rgyan bcu drug gi sgra bshad dam ngos 'dzin —342 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

gab tshig gi rgyan/dang nang gses dogs gcod sogs la gsal bshad byed dgos sa re 'ga' 'dug mod/ shin tsamang bar 'gyar bas re zhig bzhag go//dpe brjod kyi go don ni rgyan gyi bstarno bcos mtsho byang dgyes pa'i 'dzum zer dang / 'jam dbyangs grags pas bring pa'i yang /spral snang mdzod kyi dpe brjod 'grel ba sogs las shes par skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ 343

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/skyon selabacu/ rang cag gi khrid bya'i gzhung 'dir thog mar sa bcad blangs tshe/ bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i sgo dang / sgo de dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos dngos bshad pa gnyis dang / phyi ma la lus rgyan skyon sel gsum du phyes yod phyir 'dir rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa skyon sel zhes gsungs so// kun mkhyen sdom tshig las/ gang yang sngar bshad rnams la skyon 'di bcu//spangs te yon tan rab rgyas bgyid 'dod la/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i snyan ngag gi rgyan gang la'ang 'dir bstan skyon bcu dang / dpe rgyan skabs dpe don rtags 'dres mang nyung mtho dman shor ba sogs brjod bya rjod byed gnyis char nas mi mdzes pa dang mi legs pa/ mi 'phrod pa dang mi 'byor ba sogs skyon chung ngu zhig yin yang nges par du spong ci thub la brtson dgos te/ rtsa bar/ de phyir snyan ngag dag la skyon//chung bar gyur kyang ci zhig ltar/ /btang snyoms mi bya lus mdzes kyang / /skyon gcig gis ni skal ngan 'gyur//zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//skyon bcu bo gang yin yang rgyan ngos 'dzin dang dpe brjod 'jog pa sogs lag len dngos kyi khrod spong dgos pa zhig yin gshis/ snyan ngag gi sngon 'gro'i skabs nas legs par ngos zin par byed dgos pa zhig —344— skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

skyon sel/ste/ches mtha' mjug tu skyon bcu nang gses dang bcas pa rtsa bas dngos bstan gyi skyon bco lnga bor sbyong ba la ni go rim nyams pa'i skyon nam gdul bya 'khrid pa'i thabs go ldog tu phyin pa min nam snyam ste dpyod ldan gzu bor gnas pa dag la rmongs blor 'char tshod dbang btsan par byas te gros gzhi tsam bston pa lags so//༈ 'dir skyon sel zhes gsungs pa ltar rtsa ba'i dngos bstan gyi skyon dag la'ang snyan ngag pa mkhas pas sbyor tshul shes pa'am stabs legs stes dbang gi rnam par sbyar na skyon du mi 'gyur tshul dang /yang rtsa bas dngos bstan gyi skyon bcu bo gang rung yin na khyod la dmigs bsal skyon med kyi sbyor tshul yod pas ma khyab pa sogs gzhung dngos su shin tu gsal bar gsungs pas gzhung lugs cha tshang dang zhib rgyas su sbyong mkhan dag la mang du ngo sprod mi dgos par sems mod/ 'dir sgra bshad tsam byas na/༈ skyon sel bcu las/ 1 bya rog so rtog dang byis pa se'u bcu ba'i ngag yang na/ sems rnal du mi gnas pa smyon pa'i lab brdol lta bur gyar ba'i tshig sbyor dag la don nyams zhes bya'o//tshig sbyor des dorno re ston srid kyang snga phyi mi 'brel ba dang skabs don ma yin pa sogs kyis skyon du gyur ba yin te/ khams 'grel las/ lcags kyi thur ma lta bu sogs so so'i thad kur rang rang gi don tsam re yod kyang / de rnams phan tshun gcig la gcig mi ltos pa'i rang dbang can/ se'u 'bru bcu/khur ba drug ces pa lta bu/ zhes gsungs/ smyon skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —345

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/pa dang byis pa'i lab brdol lta bu snyan ngag pas skyon du mi 'dzin yang snyan ngag la dmigs bsal min te/ tshig rgyan rigs pa'i sgo 'byed las/ 'di snyan ngag rtsom pa la skyon chen po yin pas dmigs bsal med/ ces gsungs pa ltararo// 2 nga'i ma mo gsham yin dang slob sbyong byed ma myong ba dag mkhas pa yin zhes pa lta bu'i rang tshig snga phyi 'gal ba brjod byar byas pa la ni don 'gal gyi skyon zhes bya'o/ / 'di la chags pa dang nad/ yang na skyo sdug sogs kyi dbang gis tshig snga phyi 'gal ba lta bur brjod na skyon min te/ dper na/ don rgyan so lnga las skabs min bstod pa'i rgyan ltabu'o//sa 3 dgos pa gzhan ci yang med par don dag gcig sgra don gang rung gis a long yang long dang a bskyar yang bskyar gyis brjod pa zhig la don gcig pa'i skyon zhes bya'o/ / 'on kyang brgyad stong 'grel chen du drangs pa las/ ngo mtshar ba dang rtsod pa dang //khro dang zhum dang nges bzung dang / /dad dang dga' ba rnams la ni/ /tshig gcig la ni lan gnyis brjod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ dga' ba'i rgyan dang / nyams ldan gyi rgyan/ khyad par du bskor ba'i rgyan dang zung ldan gyi rgyan drug sogs kyi lam du drangs pa la ni don gcig pa'i skyon gyis zhar yang gos pa med do//—346 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

skyon sel/lta 4 spyir blo thag chod cing don nges pa can yin yang / sbyor lugs kyi sgo nas de'i ldog zlar gyar te yid gnyis kyi dra ba gcod mi thub pa'i khar da dung dogs pa dong the tshom slong bar byed pa'i ngag sbyor zhig la the tshom gyi skyon zhes bya'o/ / rtsa bar the tshom gyi skyon la a rā ta zhes thag ring ba dang nye ba gnyis kur 'jug pa'i don can gyi tshig 'dam nga can bkod de the tshom slong ba lta bu la bshad cing dgyes glu sogs snga 'grel phal cher du'ang de kho na bzhin gnang 'dug mod/ 'dod sred rgyas shing gnyen po ma bsten pa'i skye bo'i mig la mdzes ma'i byad bzhin yid du thong mi 'ong the tshom skyes pa skad du brjod pas chog tshul rang cag gi khrid bya'i gzhung du gsal ba ltar byas na bod skad kyi chos nyid dang yang shin tu mthun pas legs so/ / the tshom gyi skyon sel lam dmigs bsal la/ dpe don gnyis ha cang 'dra mtshungs su gyur bas khyad par ma nges par the tshom skyes pa skad du brjod pa'i the tshom gyi dpe dang / gzhan rab rtog gi rgyan sogs la the tshom gyi nyams dang ldan na snyan ngag gi rgyan du 'gyar ba las skyon du mi 'gyar ba sogs mang ngo / / de ltar don nyazlos/ don 'gal/ don garāg the tshom bzhi ni brjod bya don gyi dbang du byas pa'i snyan ngag gi skyon du 'gyur tshul bstan pa yin no//༈ 5tshig don snga marasbyar ba'i go rim dang kha dog rnam grangs sogs dang phyi mar sbyor ba gnyis mi mthun par go rim 'chol ba zhig la rim pa nyams pa'i skyon zhes bya'o// dmigs bsal la tshig skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar byin 'dzin grwa la/ —347

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/sna bsdu ba dang sdeb legs pa/brjod don nges sla ba sogs kyi ched du 'bad pas dkrags te brjod pa ni snyan ngag gi skyon du 'gyar ba lta ci/sgyu rtsal gyi zlos stangs ngo mtshar zhig lags te/dper rno gong du song zin pa'i rim pa dang bral ba'i gab tshig gi rgyan bzhin no// 1 6 sum rtags dag gsum gyis bsdus pa'i brda sprod gzhung lugs dang mi mthun zhing / bod spyi skad las ring du gyes pa/ skad gsar bcad sogs kyi sgrig srol dang mi mthun par thob thang sogs snang ba gang dran gyis sbyor zhing phal skad ci rigs sbyar ba zhig la sgra nyams pa'am sgra dman pa zhes bya'o// dmigs bsal/ dper na/tshig phrad gzhan dbang can cing sogs kyi skabs su sa mthar shes thob kyang / khong du chud pa'i shes pa dang mi nor ba'i ched du zhes sbyor chog par gdams pa ltar sbyor ba ni snyan ngag gi skabs su'ang tshig skyon du mi 'gyur ro//bod kyi snyan 'grel phal cher du sgra nyams dang de'i skyon sel rgya gar ba'i sgra gzhung ltar rnam dbye dang rkyen byings sogs dang 'gal na skyon dang dmigs bsal la brtag pa'i cho ga las bstan pa bzhin sbyar na skyon du mi 'gyur tshul gsungs kyang / des bod kyi sgra nyams dang skyon sel la nges pa rnyed mi thub par 'dug go/ / / 7 gong 'og gi tsheg khyim cha ya mi mnyam pa'am rkang grangs mang nyung shor te do mi mnyam par sbyar ba zhig la ngal gso nyams —348 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

skyon sel/pa'am gcod mtshams nyams pa zhes bya'o// 'di yang gtso bo rnam dbye dang rkyen sbyor min gyi khyad par dang / tshig mtha'i khyad par sogs skyon dang dmigs bsal gnyis ka rgya gar ba'isdeb sbyor gyi dbang du byas te gsungs 'dug mod/ bod kyi dbang du byas na'ang gong 'og gi gcod mtshams mi 'dra ba'am rkang grangs mang zhung shor tshe 'dir bstan gyi skyon du bzhag chog ste/ tshangs sras bzhad sgrar/ rang cag bod kyi brda sprod kyi dbang du byas na sdeb sbyor gyi gzhung nas bshad pa ltar gyi ngal gso bzhag tu med kyang /tshigs bcad lhug gi bar dang mthar ngal gso sbyar ba yod do/ /zhes gsungs/bod kyi dbang du byas pa'i dmigs bsal ni/ dper na/bstan pa'i sgron me'i ke la sha'am rdza ri smug po yi mgul du//sogs bya dka' ba'i snyan rtsom dang / rje btsun mi la'i mgur 'bum phal cher/ snyan ngag spyi don du bkod pa'i sngo rtsi shing gzhon nu'i phon po dgun mal nas ldang zhing sogs mgur glu'i rigs lta bu gcod mtshams mi 'dra ba dang rkang grangs mi mnyam pa dag ni snyan ngag gi sgyu rtsal zhig las skyon du nam yang mi 'dzin pa yin rna//༈ ratshigs bcad kyi rkang bar ring thung shor te 'theng bo ltar do mi mnyam par gyar cing /tshig gi sgros mi gtsang ba/brda sprod kyi spyi 'gros dang mi mtshun par sbyar ba zhig la bod skad kyi dbang du byas pa'i sdeb sbyor nyams pa zhes bya'o//skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —349

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/tshig rgyan rig pa'i sgo 'byed las/ 'di yang tshigs bcad snyan ngag la skyon chen po yin pas dmigs bsal med par gsungs/rgyan 'di yang snga 'grel tshang mar rgya gar ba'i sdeb sbyor gyi dbang du byas te/ yi ge lci yang gi chad lhag sogs byung na sdeb sbyor nyams pa yin tshul 'ba' zhig gsungs mod/ tshangs sras bzhad sgra las/ sdeb sbyor lci yang gi sbyor ba 'di bod kyi yi ge la ma byang bas/ bod skad kyi dpe brjod dag la mkho mi che'o//zhes gsungs|/ ( sgra gzhung dag nas bstan pa ltar dbyangs ma i sogs mtshams sbyor dgos sar rang 'dod kyis mtshams ma sbyar bar bkod pa zhig la mtshams sbyor nyams pa zhes bya'o//rkang ba gong 'og gi mtha' dang 'og ma'i 'gor a i lta bu'i dbyangs 'byung yang rkang bas bcad phyir mtshams ma sbyar yang chog pa ni dmigs bsal yin no// snyan ngag spyi don las/ 'di rgya gar gyi dbang du byas na sdeb sbyor nyams pa ma gtogs bod la ji bzhin par med ces gsungs pa ni thugs shin tu mad de/ sngar bkod dpe brjod rnams kyang rgya bod kyi skad zags ma sha stag yin pas mtshon no// de'i phyir tshangs sras bzhad sgra las/ 'dir yang sdeb sbyor gyi yi ge lci yang dang / ka tsān gyi gzhung nas bshad pa'i sgra'i mtshams sbyor tshul sogs bod yig tu mi mkho zhing /bod rang la yod pa'i brda rjod pa'i rnam gzhag dang mi 'gal ba gzhir bzung ba'i steng tshig sbyor gang la'ang tshig don gyi cha la skyon dang bral zhing / rang tshig snga phyi —350 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

skyon sega'abrel chags pa/phal ba'i yul skad kyis ma bslad pa'i snyan tshig gi sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa/mi rigs rang gi rig gnas kyi khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa mtshon thub pa zhig dgos/zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi dgongs don la brtson par rigs so//de ltar rim pa nyams pa dang /sgra nyams pa/ngal gso nyams pa/sdeb sbyor nyams pa/mtshams sbyor nyams pa bcas ni rjod byed tshig gi dbang du byas te skyon sel byed tshul bstan pa yin no// / 10 skyon sel bcu bar nang gses yul dus/ sgyu rtsal lung rigs bcas drug phyes pa gang yin yang skyon dang dmigs bsal gnyis ka cung go sla la/ rang cag gi khrid bya'i gzhung du'ang shin tu gsal bar gsungs pas 'dir rgyas bshad dang bskyar bshad kyi ngal ba bsten mi dgos par semasaso//mdor na ngag rig dam pa'i sgyu rtsal la brten nas rang gi dga' skyo'i tshor ba glu ru len zhing /dus rabs gsar rnying gi mgrin tshab pa byed 'dod pa/ khor yug gnyid las dkrogs shing bden don gyi smyug rtse 'khyug 'dod pa/ mi'i rigs kyi bsam blo'i sne khrid cing rang mi rigs la ji srid bskal ba'i bar du la rgya'i rdo ring brtan por 'dzugs 'dod mkhan dag gis ni/rtsom rig gi dpal la rol zhing rtsom rig lcags kyus klog mkhan khri stong gi dran 'dzin dbang med 'gugs pa la zhugs tshe/ tshig don gnyis kur skyon gyi cha dag cing nang 'gal med la/tshig zhung zhing don 'dus pa/ don la zab skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —351—

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/tshad che zhing tshig la sgyu rtsal gyi rang bzhin ldan pa sogs la 'bad cing brtson nas rang sems kyi mdzes sdug dang phyi rol gyi sgyu rtsal zung du khrelabar rigs so zhes pa'i bcos min snying gi 'phar sgra 'di rigs dang las kyis bsdus pa'i don gnyer can khyed cag la lhug por smras pa lags so//le'u gsum pa'i sa bcad dang rgyan phal cher gyi ngo bo/ dogs gcod dka' 'grel dang bcas pa kha gsal go bde'i tshul gyis bshad zin to// // d+ku lha nyin—352 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

thun mong min pa'i rgyan/le'u dang 'o/lha shar thun mong minaba'i rgyan bcu/lta rang re gangs can bod kyi ljongs 'dir byon pa'i nges don mkhas pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyis rgyan gyi bstan bcos sam snyan ngag gi gzhung lugs chen mo me long ma'am de'i dgongs 'grel gyi snyan gzhung gang khrid kyang / thog mar rgya gar shar lho'i mkhas pa rnams kyi bzhed tshul gcig mthun nam thun mong du gyur bas dgag bzhag gi spros pa sogs mi che phyir go sla la/ bod rang gi skad cha'i chos nyid dang yang shin tu mthun tshabs che bas sbyang sla ba sogs dgos dbang du ma la dmigs te le'u gnyis pa dang gsum pa gnyis khrid tshar rjes phyir 'khor te snyan ngag gi sngon 'gro dang rgya gar shar lho'i mkhas pa rnams kyi bzhed tshul thun min du gyar ba'i rgyan bcu sogs 'khrid pa'i phyag srol yod do//tshul 'di sne gdul bya 'khrid pa'i thabs rmad du byung ba zhig kyang yin par gsungs/ 'on kyang snyan ngag gi rang mdangs gsar ba zhes par/ rgyan rig dang ngag rig gi gzhung la 'jug tshe thog mar le'u dang bo 'di nyid sbyang dgos/de min na gzhung 'di'i byed por rim pa dang bral ba'i rtsom skyon yod par 'gyur/sngon la don rgyan sogs sbyangs rjes slar phyir 'khor nas skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —353

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/le'u dang bo sbyor ba ni/ dper na sngon la sum rtags sogs sbyangs rjes slar yang dbyangs gsal dag la sbyong ba lta bu'o// zhes brjod cing bzhed tshul 'di 'thad ldan du 'dzin pa'i deng rabs bod kyi yon tan pa'ang re mang zhig yod snang ngon/tshang mas mkhyen gsal ltar dbyag pa can ni gna' bo'i rgya gar gyi rtsom pa bo grags can zhig yin snang / khos snyan ngag me long ma'ang rgya gar ba'i skad cha'i spyi 'gros ltar brtsams pa zhig yin gshis rgya gar ba'i dbang du byas na le'u gsum ga mthar chags su yokhrid par go rim bsnol dgos na rtsom pa bor rim pa dang bral ba'i rtsom skyon yod pa bden mod/ bod kyi dbang du byas tshe skad cha'i chos nyid dang rgyugs che min/ go dka' sla sogs gang la bsam yang go rim dkrags nas khrid srol 'di la gnod pa las phan pa che ba'i dge mazlon zhig nges par du yod pa yin no//tshul 'dis bod 'gyar gyi snyan ngag me long ma khrid thabs kyi cha nas kyang bod kyi khyad sdus ldan pa'i snyan gzhung zhig tu gyar zin pa'ang mtshon thub po/ /'on kyang snyan ngag gsar slob pa lgog la mtshon na sngon 'gro'i skor thog mar nges par du shes dgos par bsam ste bdag gis slob gling 'di dang gzhan dag nas kyang snyan ngag re khrid khul byas tshe thog mar sngon 'gro'i skor khrid cing / de nas le'u bar mtha' gnyis khrid rjes phyir 'khor te le'u dang bo'i thun min gyi rgyan bcu bo khrid khul byas pa yin te/ 'grig min sgye rabs dpyod ldan pa tshos kha tshon gcod dgos pa yin no/ /—354 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

thun mong min pa'i rgyan/ de yang rtsa ba me long ma las/bstan bcos snga ma rnams bsdus shing //sbyor ba rnams kyang nyer mtshon te//ji ltar nus bzhin bdag gis ni//snyan ngag dag gi mtshan nyid bya//zhes dang /'on kyang rnam rtog sa bon ni/ /sngon gyi slob dpon rnams kyis bstan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar le'u dang bo'i skabs kyi thun mong min pa'i rgyan bcu bo ni dbyag pa can gyis me long mar gsar du srol btod pa zhig ma yin brjo sngon nas rgya gar shar lho gnyis kur grags che zhing rgyas pa'i bstan bcos bha ra ta zhes par yang gsal bar bstan yod pa zhig ste/ de nyid las/sbyar ba rab dang mnyam nyid ting nge 'dzin//snyan nyid gzi brjid tshig ni shin tu gzhon//don yang gsal dang rgya che mdzes pa ste//'di dag snyan ngag rnams kyi yon tan bcu//zhes me long mar bstan pa'i go rim mi 'dra ba tsam las gsal bar gsungs yod pa'i phyir ro/ /༈ da lta 'dzam gling gi mkhas pa rnams la yongs su grags pa ltar rgya gar ni sa sgang ril mo 'dir shes rig dar snga ba'i rgyal khab cig yin gshis/rtsa bar/ phan tshun dbye ba phra mo can//tshig gi lam ni du ma yod//ces gsungs pa ltar/ snyan ngag gi rgyan ngos 'dzin thad gcig bur yang phra zhib kyis phyes na mtha' yas pa zhig yod 'dug pas mtha' dag khong du chud pa'am lag len du bstar rgyu ni ches cher dka' mod/de la be+e dar bha dang ni//go ḍa'i lam ni gsal bar brjod//ces gsungs pa ltar shin tu grags che ba'i rgya gar shar skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 335

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/lho'i mkhas pa'i bzhed tshul tsam zhig ni snyan ngag me long mar gsal bshad gnang yod pa dag rang cag gi skabs babs sbyang byar gyur to// dbyag pa can ma byon pa'i yar sngon gyi ches snga mo'i dus shig nas rgya garno gyi shar lho'i mkhas pa rnams la rtsom gshis kyi cha nas bzhed tshul mi mthun pa'am mi 'dra ba zhig byung zhing / de dag tshur bsdu na rgyan bcu tsam gyi nang du 'du phyir thun mong min pa'i rgyan bcu zhes bya'o//rgya gar la sa phyogs kyi sgo nas rtsom gshis mi 'dra ba yod pas/ rgyal bo dge dbang lta bu lho phyogs pa'i lugs 'dzin pa dang / slob dpon dpa' bo lta bu shar phyogs pa'i srol 'dzin pa'i (khams 'grel sogs las slob dpon dpa' bo ni lho phyogs pa'i srol 'dzin gyi snyan ngagapar gsungs)snyan ngag pa grags can mang du byon par snang ngon/'on kyang bod kyi dbang du byas na kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa lta bu rtsom gshis kha dam zhing brjid che ba'i rtsom pa bo dngan rje blo bzang grags pa dang / rgyal dbang lnga ba lta bu rtsom gshis kha gsal zhing lhod nyams kyis phyug pa'i rtsom pa bo du ma byang mod/ de dag ni shar phyogs tsong kha ba dang nub phyogs sa skya ba snas sa phyogs kyi sgo nas khyad par byung ba ma yin la/ dbus phyogs pa'i rtsom gshis dang mdo khams kyi rtsom gshis zhes gnyis su'ang 'byed du med/ gong gsal gyi rtsom gshis kyang gtso che ba'i cha nas bshad pa las rtsom pa bo de dag la lugs gzhan gyi rtsom stangs las bris pa'i bka' rtsom med pa'ang ma yin no/ /des na bod kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis rgya gar shar lho'i mkhas pa'i bzhed srol gnyis ka khas len zhing sbyong ba dngan—356 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

thun mong min pa'i rgyan/bod rang la sa gnas kyis byes pa'i bzhed tshul mi mthun pa med pa 'dis kyang bod 'gyur gyi snyan ngag me long mar ngos 'dzin dang des shugs rkyen thebs tshul yang rgya gar dang thun min gyi khyad chos shig ngang gis thon 'dug go/ / ཿ bai dar bha zhes pa ni lho phyogs kyi snyan ngag pa'am mkhas pa dang /gau ḍa ni shar phyogs kyi yul dang de'i mkhas pa'am snyan ngag pa ston phyir bod skad kyi bdag sgra'i phrad sbyar ba yin par gsungs so//gung thang bde blos 'di dang mi mthun pa zhig gsungs kyang snying bos dben tshul khams 'grel du gsal/ / rtsa bar/sbyar ba rab dwangs mnyam nyid dngan/snyan dang shin tu gzhon pa dang //don gsal ba dang rgya che dngan/brjid dang mdzes dang ting nge 'dzin//yon tan 'di dag bai dar bha'i//'di dag phal cher bzlog pa ni//go ḍa ba yi lam dag yin//zhes rgya gar na'ang khyab che zhing kun gyis dga' mos byed pa ni lho ba'i lugs yin la shar phyogs pa'i rtsom gshis 'dzin mkhan yod pa'ang don gyis bstan to//snyan 'grel bur shing las/phal cher gyi sgras/snyan pa dang don gsal ba dang /brjid pa rnams kyi mtshan nyid spyi tsam zhig tha mi dad cing /ting nge 'dzin ni lam gnyis ku'i thun mong gi yon tan no// zhes gsungs pa ltar/le'u dang bo'i skabs nas bstan pa'i rgyan bcu bo gang rung yin na/rgya gar shar lho'i mkhas par bzhed tshul thun min skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —357—

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/du gyur bas ma khyab ste/ don gsal gyi rgyan dang /(shar ba kha cig gis 'dod pa'i don gsal zhig yod)ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyan gnyis la sbyor tshul lam bzhed tshul mi mthun pa med pas so// 1 mi pham snyan 'grel las/ don rgyan rnams snyan pa'i yon tan gyi khongs su 'du zhing / zung ldan sogs rjes khrid las 'phros pa yin/zhes dang / snyan ngag gi rang mdangs gsar ba las/ le'u snga ba 'di nyid phyi ma dag gi sngon 'gro yin pas 'di nyid sbyangs pa legs na rmang gzhi brtan pa'i phyir le'u phyi ma gnyis la 'jug pa bde zhing /mdzub ston gyi gzhung lugs yod par 'gyur/ zhes kyang 'byung ba ltar spyir dbyug pa can gyis me long ma 'di rtsom tshe thun min gyi rgyan /cu bo le'u bar mtha' gnyis kyi spyi don lta bur gsungs par mngon / thun min gyi /na lha cung la/sa mang bo zhig yi ge 'jam rtsub dang lci yang gi sgo nas shar lho'i bzhed tshul gtan la dbab dgos shing / yi ge 'jam rtsub ngos 'dzin skabs tsan dra ba'i yi ge'i mdor/dang bo dang/gsum pa dang / lnga ba dnganamathar gnas rnams ni srog chung ba rnams so//zhes rgya gar gsal byed kyi sde ba dang bo ka tsa ṭa ta pa rnams dang /sde ba gsum pa ga dza ḍa da ba/sde ba lnga ba nga nya na nga ma/mthar gnas kyi yi ge ya ra la wa ste bcu dgu bo la srog chung dang —358 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

thun mong min pa'i rgyan/'jam pa dang lhod pa dang mnyen pa'i yi ge zhes bya la/ sde ba gnyis pa kha tsha ṭha tha pha rnams dang /sde ba bzhi ba gha dzha rte dha bha/ dro ba'i yi ge sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa bcas yi ge bco lnga bor srog chen dang rtsub pa dang dam pa dang gyong ba'i yi ge zhes bya'o//rgya gar ba'i yi ge 'jam rtsub 'byed stangs 'di gzhir bzhag ste/bod kyi gsal byed sum cu las/ ka ga nga ca ja nya/ ta da na/ pa ba ma/tsa dza wa/ 'a ya ra la a bcas yi ge nyi shu bor 'jam pa dang srog chung gi yi ge/ kha cha tha pha tsha zha za sha sa ha bcu ni rtsub pa'i yi ger 'dod do//rang re'i sum rtags kyi gzhung thams cad na ka ca ta pa tsa lnga bo ni rjod pa'i tshe na rlung thugs drag cing rtsub pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis pho'i yi ger 'dod par bzhed tshul mi mthun pa gtan nas med cing klog pa'i tshe na'ang dngos su myong bas grub thub pa zhig yin la/ de bzhin du ma ning dang mo gnyis byed rtsol ran stod kyis bzhag pa ni gzhar yang bsgyur du med pa'i rdo rje lta bu'i sdom tshig cig red do/ /'on kyang snyan ngag gi skabs 'dir ka ca ta pa tsa lnga bo 'jam pa dang lhod pa'i yi ger bzhag cing 'phul 'jug 'go 'dogs sogs dang ldan na sbyor ba lci bar 'gro tshul gsungs pa ni ra mgo lugasbyar lta bu zhig ma gyur tam snyam du bdag gis sems te/ snyan ngag ni brda sprod byed dam skad cha'i sgyu rtsal dang 'bral thabs med pas bod kyi yi ge 'jam rtsub bam sgra drag zhan gyi dbye ba rgya gar bas ngos 'dzin dang mthun par rigs 'gros mi byed par/ mi rigs rang nyid kyi brda sgrod gzhung lugs dang mthun par sbyar na dge mtshan che bar mthong skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzinagrwa la/ —359

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ste/ khams 'grel las/bod rang lugs mkhan po thu mi'i sum rtags la byang bar byas rjes/ bod rang gi yi ge brjod pa'i tshe na srog gi rlung kha nas 'byin shugs che chung la ltos pa'i srog che chung gi dbye ba phyes nas dper brjod sbyar na legs par bzhed do/ /zhes dang /rin spungs snyan 'grel kyang rgya gar gyi yi ge dngos dang 'dra ba bod yig la mi 'byung yang /skye gnas dang sgra mtshungs pa'i dbang du byas te sbyor chog par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ // le'u dang bo'i rgyan bcu bo phal cher le'u phyi ma gnyis kyi spyi don nam sngon 'gro yin pa'i dbang du byas na/lho ba'isbyar bar lci ba mang zhing lhod pa nyung ba dang shar ba'isbyar bar stod pa mang zhing lci ba nyung ba/ yi ge bskor ba rjes khrid byed dgos pa bcas khyad chos gtso bo rjod byed tshig gi steng nas thon dgos pas zung ldan dang gnas nges sogs sgra rgyan gyi spyi bshad lta bu yin no//le'u gnyis pa'i skabs kyi sbyar ba dang skabs 'di'i sbyar ba gnyis ming 'dra yang don mi 'dra ste/le'u gnyis pa'i skabs sgra don ci rigs kyis sbyor dgos shing / 'dir ni yi ge 'jam rtsub kyis sbyor ba'i phyir ro//yang skabs 'di'i lci ba dang sdeb sbyor gyi lci ba gnyis mi 'dra ste/snga ma sbyor ba lci ba dang phyi ma yoge lci ba'o/// snyan ngag gi rang mdangs gsar ba las/ be+e dar bha'isbyar ba dang / go ḍa ba'i sbyar ba zhes 'byung khungs kyis btags na/phyi thog —360 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

thun mong min pa'i rgyan/rnams la ming gis go ba len stangs kyi thog nas rnyog rdzob 'ong ba dang / ming gis 'bod dka' ba/ sngags yig bod yig gi gral du mi mdzes pa sogs kyis/ rgyan bcu bor don mthun gyi ming / lci ba'i sbyar ba dang / lhod pa'i sbyar ba sogs su btags na dge mtshan che bar bshad pa phal cher mkhas pa'i gtam du 'dug kyang / shar lho'i bzhed pa ngos 'dzin dka' ba'i skyon zhig kyang rang shugs kyis 'bab po//de'i phyir bdag gis phyogs gnyis ku'i legs cha blangs khul gyis lho ba'i rdziba'isbyar ba dang/shar ba'i lhod pa'isbyar ba zhes ming gsar du btags na legs par snyam ste/lho ba dang shar ba zhes pas rgya gar lho shar gyi bzhed pa'i rgyan ngos 'dzin bde zhing /lci ba'i sbyar ba dang lhod pa'i sbyar ba zhes pas ming gis don mtshon pa ste rgyan gyi ngo bo rtogs sla ba'i khyad chos dang yang ldan no//2 ra dwangs/ / lho ba'i lugs kyi rab dwangs la grong tshig gis ma bslad na'ang chu dwangs mo'i nang gi de'u bzhin brjod don gsal zhing go sla ba zhig dgos pas rang bzhin brjod pa'i gtsos don rgyan spyi 'gros kyi khyad chos ldan zhing de'i ldog zla shar ba'i rab dwangs ni nges tshig gis brjod pa tsam las 'jig rten na yongs su ma grags pa'i tha snyad kyi lam du 'dren pa zhig dgos phyirasbyar rgyan dang bsdus brjod kyi rgyan/ srid pa can gyi rgyan/ khyad par du gab tshig gi rgyan sogs kyi skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 361

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/'phros gzhir brjod chog don mthun gyis ming btags na/lho ba'i grags don rab dwangs dang shar ba'i nges tshig rab dwangs zhes bya'o/// lho ba'i lugs ṭ+wā /snazlo ༵/ la tshigs bcad kyi yi ge byed 'jam zhing byed rtsub pa ste 'jam rtsub drel khal gyi do ya mnyam pa lta bu zhig dgos par 'dod cing shar ba'i lugs su rkang ba gcig rtsub cing gzhan gsum 'jam par 'dod pas lho shar gnyis kus rgyan 'di rjod byed tshig gi steng nas 'jog phyir sgra rgyan spyi dang bye brag gnas nges pa'i spyi don lta bur song ngo / /don mthun gyis ming btags na/ lho ba'i mnyam nyid dang / shar ba'i mnyam nyid kyi sdog zla zhes bya'o/ // lho ba'i lugs kyi mnyam pa'i rgyan gyi skabs rat+na shrī'i rgya 'grel las 'jam pa'i 'jam pa 'jam pa'i bar ma/ 'jam pa'i rtsub pa ste dbye ba gsum/ bar ma de bzhin du phye bas drug rtsub pa la'ang phye bas dgu ste so sor dpe brjod dang bcas pa mdzad kyang / khams 'grel las/ bod kyi skad la sbyor mi btub cing don gnyer nyung bas nyer mkho chung ba dang /yi shes kyang 'jigs te 'dir rtsa ba'i dbye ba tsam las ma bkod do// zhes gsungs/ shar ba'i mnyam pa'i skabs khams 'grel las dgag bzhag mang bo gnang mod bod kyi dbang du byas na mkho gal chung bar sems pas 'dir mi 'god do//—362 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

thun mong min pa'i rgyan/( spyir snyan pa'i byin nā kār+sha/ don gnyis cha nas phul du byung ba'i nyams dang ldan dgos tshul lho shar gnyis kus 'dod cingan dbye na sgra'i nyams dang / don gyi nyams/ gnyis ka la grong tshig spang ba dang gsum/ dang bor lho shar gnyis las/ yi ge'i gzugs dang skye gnas/phyi mo ste dbyangs/ brtsegs pa'i tshig bcas mtshungs shing rjes khrid dang bcas ldan dgos par lho bas 'dod cing / gsal byed kyi yi ge gcig yang yang bskor zhing / de yang snga phyi'i bar thag cher mi ring bar rjes khrid kyi nyams dang ldan dgos zhes shar bas 'dod pas (shar ba'i lugs su sgra'i nyams der rkang bar bskor ba/tshig la bskor ba/ring bar thos pa/shar ba kho nas 'dod pa'i rjes khrid dang bzhir phyes la/snga ma gsum lho bas kyang khas len par gsungs/)sgra rgyan spyi dang khyad par du dbyangs sogs nges pa'i spyi don du grub la/ don nyams la lho shar gnyis gas snyan ngag gi ro nyams phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan dgos par mi mthun pa med pas don rgyan so lnga'i sngon 'gror song / gsum pa grong tshig spang tshul las sgra'i grong bar lho shar gnyis kus 'dod gtam dang gsang tshig lta bu dmar rjen du bton nas brjod pa skyon dang de spangs nas snyan ngag gi lam yang dag par drangs dgos par 'dod cing / sgra'i grong ba la'ang lho shar gnyis nas tshig gi gcod mtshams log pa dang / ngag tshig gcig la go bya'i don tha dad pa gnyis yod pa'i dbang gis ming de grong skad dam phal skad dang thun skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —363

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ mong du gyar ba skyon dngakaspyir ming tshig de don gnyis la 'jug kyang skabs sdor don de las 'os med pas grong tshig tu mi 'gyar bar 'dod pa sogs skyon dang dmigs bsal gnyis cha nas le'o gsum par bstan pa'i skyon sel bcu'i spyi don kho nar song yod pa yin no//gong gsal gyi dpe brjod dag la don mthun gyis ming btags na/lho ba'i tshig mtshungs nye ba'i snyan pa/ shar ba'i rkang bar bskor ba'i snyan pa/shar ba'i nye bar thos pa'i snyan pa/shar ba'i ring bor thos pa'i snyan pa/shar ba'i bsres pa'i snyan pa zhes bya'o//༈ ring bor bskor ba'i skabs yi ge ring cha can bskor zhing rjes su khrid dgos pa'i don yin zhes 'jam dbyangs kha che ba sogs kyis 'dod mod/ bod mkhas snyan 'grel las/ 'di nyid kyis ring ba'i don ni yi ge ring cha can la mdzad kyang de min te/ yi ge mang bos bar du chod pa 'gyang ring ba'i don te/zhes gsungs/5 na tu gzhonas// lho ba'i lugs kyi shin gzhon la 'jam pa'i yi ge mang zhing rtsub pa nyung dgos par 'dod pa dang / shar bas gtso bo brjod dka' ba'i rtsub pa dag sbyor dgos par 'dod pas sgra rgyan spyi'i khog 'bubs lta bu yin par bshad/don mthun gyis ming btags na/lho ba'i shin gzhon dang /shar ba'i shin gzhon gyi ldog zla zhes bya'o//—364— skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

thun mong min pa'i rgyan/6 don gsag/ lho ba'i lugs kyi don gsal la rjod byed kyi tshig gsal ba'i dbang gis brjod bya gtan tshigs kyis brtags mi dgos par bde blag tu rtogs thub pa zhig dgos par 'dod pa ltar shar ba phal cher gyis kyang de bzhin du bzhed mod/kha cig gis rjod byed kyi sgra mi gsal bar brjod don ha cang rtogs dka' bar byas pa zhig tu'ang 'dod de snga ma don rgyan spyi dang khyad par rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan gyi spyi don du grub cing / de las ldog ste shar ba kha cig gis bzhed pa'i don gsal ni gab tshig gi rgyan gyi 'phros gzhi yin tshul snyan ngag gi rang mdangs gsar bar bshad do//don mthun gyis ming btags na/lho ba'i don gsal dang / shar ba kha cig gi don gsal gyi sdog zla zhes bya'o/ // bod mkhas snyan 'grel las/'di dang gong gi rab dwangs khyad par/rab dwangs ni 'jig rten la grags pa zhig nges par dgos la/'dir ni 'jig rten la grags ma grags kyi nges bzung med cing sgra dang rtags la brten nas don gsal bar rtogs pa mtshan nyid yin no//shar ba'i lugs la'ang rab dwangs ni nges tshig la brtags pas 'grub la/don mi gsal ba 'di gtam rgyud mi shes na brtags pas 'grub nus pa ma yin no//zhes gsungs/skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 363

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/myu/ lho ba'i lugs kyi dzā che /dro zlol/ de'i yon tan sogs khyad chos 'ga' zhig dngos su brjod pa'i shugs la brjod bya'i yul der khyad du 'phags pa'i yon tan rtogs nus pa zhig dgos par 'dod cingakashar bas yul de'i khyad 'phags kyi chos 'ga' dngos su brjod pa'i thugs kyis khyad chos de ldan gyi yul der yon tan sogs rgya che tshul rtogs dgos para'adod pas le'u gnyis pa'i rgya che ba'i rgyan gyi spyi bshad dngos yin no//gnyis kur bsngags yul gyi yon tan rgya che ba/bsngags pa bo'i bsam pa rgya che ba/klog pa bo'am nyan pa bo'i bsam bya'i yul khams rgya che ba'i khyad chos dang ldan dgos par yang gsungs/don mthun gyis ming btags na/lho ba'i khyad chos shugs rtogs kyi rgya che ba dang shar ba'i khyad chos shugs las rtogs pa'i rgya che ba zhes bya'o//༈ snar thang bas/ 'di dang 'og gi rgya che ba'i rgyan la khyad par ci yod ce na/ 'di ni bsngags par 'os pa'i khyad par dang ldan pa ji snyed pa yin la/ 'og gi don rgyan skabs kyi ni bsam pa dang sbyor ('byor ba)gnyis po tsam du babs pas spyi dang bye brag gi khyad par yod do//zhes gsungs/ —366 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

thun mong min pa'i rgyan/8bzhinag/lho ba'i lugs kyi brjid par tshigs bcad phyed snga mar lci ba mang zhing yang ba nyung la phyed phyi mar lci ba mang la yang ba nyung dgos par 'dod cing shar bas snga phyi gang du'ang lci yang do mnyam la tshig sdud dang ldan dgos par 'dod pas brjid pa'i rgyan ni 'khyog por brjod pa'i rgyan thams cad kyi spyi don yin par bshad mod gtso bo rjod byed tshig gi sgo nas 'jog pas sgra rgyan gyi spyi don du song snyam/don mthun gyis ming btags na/lho ba'i mnyam pa'i brjid pa dang /shar ba'i mi mnyam pa'i brjid pa zhes bya'o//༈'di'i skabs kyi lci yang ni rgya gar ltar na sdeb sbyor gyi gzhung bzhin sbyor la/bod la lci yang gi khyad par 'byed du med pas bod rang skad dang mthun pa'i dpe brjod cig 'jog par dka' yang /rin spungs snyan 'grel las/bod la ni lci yang gi tha snyad ma grags pa dang /rgya gar gyi rig pas gzhal te/lci yang gi rnam par gzhag pa tsam byas na/'greng bu can/na ro can dang /mtha' rten can rnams lci ba dang / tshangs sras bzhad sgrar brtsegs pa can yang lci bar gsungs/)de las ldog pa rnams yang bar rigs pas 'grub/ ces gsungs pas phyis kyi 'grel mdzad phal cher khong gi rjes su 'brangs te dpe brjod kyang bzhaga'adi ni bod skad kyi khyad chos dngos dang mi mthun pas/'brug khams sprul gyis dgag pa mang du gnang nas bod kyi tshig sdud skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —367

ngag rig sgyu 'phul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/dang yi ge tho mo ma ning gi khyad par sogs kyi sgo nas lci yang gi rnam bzhag cig gtan la 'beb dgos tshul gsungs mod/lag len thog dgos rgyu'i dpe brjod de khong gis kyang bzhag mi 'dug go/9 mdzesal// lho ba'i mdzes par 'ud nyams mi che bar 'jig rten grags tshod dang mthun par sbyor dgos phyir rang bzhin brjod pa'i khog 'bubs lta bur brjod chog cingagashar bas 'jig rten grags tshod las brgal ba'i 'ud nyams chen pos brjod dgos par 'dod pas 'khyog brjod kyi rgyan spyi dang khyad par du bul byung dang rab btags kyi spyi don dngos yin no// lho shar gnyis gas gtam dang bsngags parasbyar ba'i dbye ba gnyis su 'dod do//༈ 'di'i skabs kyi gtam la bzhed tshul mi mthun pa mang ste/khams 'grel las/'di ni byung ba'am ma byung yang rung nyesnyan ngag mkhan gyis mi phan tshun du gtam gleng mol byas pa skad du sbyar ba'i gtam mngon par brjod pa'i bye brag gam dum bu zhig la dper brjod pa yin/ zhes dang / dpang lo tsā ba chen mos/ dka' thub pa 'ga' zhig gis skye bo kha cig la gtam dris pa la lan brjod pa zhes gsungs pa yin/ des na sngon byung ba'i gtam zhes 'grel zhing dper brjod pa kun mi 'thad do//zhes sogs mang du gsungs kyanganalnga ba chen mo dang kun mkhyen yab sras sogs kyis sngon byung gi gtam —368 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

thun mong min pa'i rgyan/rgyud brjod gzhi byas pa la bzhed do//don mthun gyis ming btags na/lho ba'i 'tsham pa'i mdzes pa dang /shar ba'i lud che ba'i mdzes pa zhes bya'o/// le'u gnyis pa'i ngo mtshar phul byung dang shar ba'i mdzes pa gnyis mi 'dra tshul/sdom tshig las/mdzes rgyan skabs su lag pa lta bu zhig/zhes sogs sngar bshad zin pa de 'dir yang dran par bya'o//10 tibazhi 'dzig/ sems ldan gyi khyad chos sems med kyi chos gzhan zhig la 'jig rten lugs kyi rjes su 'brangs te bkod pa zhig la ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyan zhes bya ste 'khyog brjod spyi dang khyad par rab btags kyi rgyan/bsdus brjod kyi rgyan/sbyar rgyan/gab tshig gi rgyan/gzugs rgyan sogs dang phyogs mtshungs shing de dag gi sngon 'gro lta bur brjod rigs so//tshangs sras bzhad sgrar/rgyan 'di snyan ngag spyi la ཿba cing /tshig sbyor mchog tu gyur ba zhig yin/zhes kyang gsungs ༈'di la rtsa bar dpe brjod gsum yod kyang lho shar mkhas pas bzhed tshul la mi mthun pa med par spyi dang bye brag gi dbye ba yin zhes 'grel mdzad phal mo ches 'dod la/kun mkhyen sdom tshig las/'di la dngos bstan lugs gnyis so so ru//mi gsal 'on kyang khyad skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzinagrwa la/ —369

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/par med 'dod na//zhes sogs dogs slong gnang ba'i 'grel ba rang cag gi khrid bya'i gzhung na shin tu gsal bas 'dir rgyas 'god kyi ngal ba mi dgos so//don brjod kyis ming btags na/spyir brjod kyi ting nge 'dzin/chos gcig bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin/chos du ma bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya'o// 1 ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyan gsum po'i khyad par ni rim bzhin/dgos dbang gis sems ldan du ma'i chos du ma dgod yul bem po'i steng du ci rigs kyis bkod pa dang bo dang /sems ldan gyi chos gcig dgod yul bem po'i steng du bkod pa gnyis pa dang /sems ldan gyi chos du ma sems med kyi bem po'i chos du ma'i tshab tu bkod pa gsum pa'o//le'u gnyis pa'i ting nge 'dzin rab btags sogs rab btags kyi rgyan de rnams la/bzhin/'dra/ snyam/dogs sogs rab btags gsal byed kyi sgra nges par dgos shing 'dir mi dgos pa'i khyad par yod do// / thun min gyi rgyan bcu'i mjug tu snyan ngag phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu/snod du rung ba'i rgyu/rgyu de ldan gyi phan yon bcas gsungs 'dug mod/ 'di dag gi skor sngar sngon 'gro'i skabs su mang du bshad zin pas bskyar zlos mi byed do//༈ yang gsal snang mdzod khrid zin pa'i nyin bshes gnyen rin po che rje btsun dmu dge bsam gtan rgya mtsho mi 'jigs dbyangs can —370 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

thun mong min pa'i rgyan/dga' ba'i blo gros mchog gi gsung bshad bdag gis zin bris su thetab yod pas de cha tshang 'dir bkod na shin tu legs par sems khong gis gsung rgyur/de ring nas bzung snyanangag yongs rdzogs khrid tshar song /nga chos 'di ltar mas bsam zhig byed rgya byung ba chos lugs nas bshad na sngon gyi las zer ba red/da nas bathung khyed cag gis kun rmong kun smyon pag po'i sgo nas drin 'a ma dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brtsi bkur dang rig pa'i gnas la brtson sda sbyos/dge gan ni 'a ma lta mu dang spong ma gi ru byog lta mu migangasamal 'di ltar bzung na chos ngams cad rten cing 'brel 'byung yin pas/dber na char zim babs te sa gzhi brlan zhing myu gu skye ba bzhin rgyad la yon tan legs po 'byor yong /skabs 'di'i khrid rgyas bcas 'tsham po zhig byas yod/de'i steng nas khyen cag rang gis brtson pa bskyed de yon tan gong 'phel du gtong dgos/ de yang gtso tho thod rang gi rig gzhung dag la sbyangs te gzhi rtsa yod pa zhig byas na zhigatu legs/ zhes gsungs so//'di ni bdag gis kyang de ring khyed cag la brjod 'dod pa'i snying gtam ngo ma yin pas sems la dam por bzung ste lag len la ci thebs byed par mkhyen zhes kyang zhus pa lags naX/095/1nyinaskabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 371—

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/mthar sa ba/ rnam sad lha yi jing bur ma 'khyil ba'i//mkhas mchog gsum gyi thugs bcud bdud rtsi'i chab//khyod blo'i kun bzod dpal du legs thob par//dga' gus yi rangs 'dzum dkar grol bar rigs//la la rang don kho nar brel zhing 'tshub//kha cig phrag dog dug gi tsher mar lhungan/phal cher hol rgyugs 'ja' tshon snyeg pa'i tshe//rgya chen gzhung la dpyod pa'i las 'di bzangan/gna' deng tshig rgyan rigs parasbyangs pa phra//bshes gnyen mkhas pa'i gsung gi grol khol nyung //btsan gyis btsur dang spobs pas bris pa yi//rtsom dang rtsom mkhan khri 'bum dgos pa chungan/mo la ma babs lung gis ma zin cingan/klong du ma brdol rang grol ma yin pa'i//thos dpyad myong ba'i dpal gyis bsrubs pa'i nor//tshul 'di'i snod ldan bu la spro bas byin//—372 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga
