thun mong min pa'i rgyan/bdag blo'i khab mig phra mor ma shong ba'i/ /nongs bshad ma lus mkhas mngaspyan sngar 'chags//rnam dkar dge ba'i zla 'od ci mchis pa//ngag rig kun da rgyas pa'i dpyid du bran//snyan 'grel yang gsal snang mdzod kyi zur rgyan ngag rig sgyu 'phul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu zhes pa 'di ni bdag gis gangs ljongs shes rig nor bu'i slob gling nas 'dzin grwa snga phyi dag la gzhung 'di tshar bcu lhag cig khrid khul byas tshe spob ma tsho'i dgos mkho kho nar dmigs te sgo sam ngos su blo thog nas bris pa zhig yin la/khrid yul gyi blo kha mtho dman dang dus tshod sogs kyi dbang gis zin bris kyang rgyas bsdus sna tshogs shig yod/da lor skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwar cung rgyas khrid kyis zin bris kyang de lugs shig btab par/'dzin grwa yongs dang gzhan don gnyer can mang bo zhig gis nges par dpar du 'khod dgos zhes yang yang nan bskulabyas te sdod du ma bcug pas/ bdag gis bris pa'i sngar yod dogs gcod lag la gang yong rnams las legs pa'i cha bsdus/nyes pa'i cha dor/gzhan 'phri snod cung re dgos sar yang de lugs byas/kho tsho'i re ba bzhin mchod brjod dang mjug byang zhig gsar du bsnan khul byas pa yin te/snyan ngag gi gzhung la sbyangs nas nges don gyi rtsom pa bor e 'gyar la 'bad brtson byed mkhan tshor phan cung zad thogs par gyar cig ces rtsothe rig la bcos min gyi dung ba zab pa'i btsun gzugs ldong yor+sha tan rgya mtsho'amami pham tshangs sras rig pa'i 'dod 'jor 'bod pasarab gnas saglang lo'i sa gsaba'i dmar phyogs rdzogs pa gnyis par ( lo734)rnga yul gyi chos sde chen po sgo mang dgon bshad sgrub 'phel rgyas gling nas zhu dag grub par byas pa dang lhan cig casmon pa'o//skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —373

ngag rig sgyu 'phul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/da༅༅//yang gsalasnang mdzod kyi sa bcad sbyogs bcas gzhung gi spyi khog 'char ba'i me 'ongan༈ sa bcad ni rta rgyugs pa na rta la dkyus sa ston pa ltar shin tu gal che zhing gzhung de'i spyi khog bde blag tu blo ngor 'char ba'i dge mtshan bla na med pa dang ldan pa yin pas 'dir snyan 'grel yang gsal snang mdzod kyi sa bcad rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus te 'god par bya'o//de yang snyan ngag gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos dbyangs can zhal lung nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od can zhes bya ba'i 'bru 'grel yang gsal snang ba'i mdzod ces bya bar/rtsa ba'i sa bcad bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i sgo dang /sgo de dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos dngos bshad pa gnyis/dang bo la mchod par brjod pa dang /rtsom par dam bca' ba gnyis/de'i dang bor 'jam dpal dbyangs dang /dbyangs can ma/rig gnas 'di'i brgyud 'dzin 'phags yul gyi paṇa chen rnams/rig gnas 'di la lhag par bka' drin che ba'i bod kyi lo chen rnams/rje rgyal ba gnyis pa/rje'i sras kyi thu bo rnams/rgyal dbang rim byon/kun gzigs lnga ba chen po/chos 'brel dngos thob kyi bla ma rnams/bye brag tu yongs 'dzin khri chen rnam bzhi bcas la rim bzhin mchod par brjod do//gnyis pa rtsom par dam bca' la/rig gnas —374 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

sa bcad phyogs bsdus/'di la bsngags pa dnganadam bca' dngos/zhar byung log rtog dgag pa dang gsum yod do//༈gnyis pa sgo de dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos dngos bshad pa la/lus dang rgyan dang skyon sel gsum/ dang bo la mdor bstan/dbye ba/skad rigs bshad pa/mjug bsdu ba dang bzhi/ de'i dang bor dngos dang zhar byung 'khrul sel gnyis so// gnyis pa dbye bar/tshigs bcad bshad pa/ lhug pa bshad pa/spel ma bshad pa dang gsum/de'i dang bor mdor bstan pa/grol ba sogs so sor bshad pa/ sarga chen po'i mtshan nyid bshad pa dang gsum/ de'i gnyis pa grol ba sogs so sor bshad pa la/grol ba/rigs/mdzod/'dus pa bshad pa bcas bzhi yod do// gsum pa sarga chen po'i mtshan nyid bshad pa la/mtshan nyid/ sgo/ srog mkhas pas bzhed tshul dang bzhi yod do// ཿgong gi lus kyi sa bcad gsum pa skad rigs bshad pa la/ dbye ba/ so sor bshad pa/ skad rigs kyis bcings tshul dang gsum/de'i gnyis pa so sor bshad pa la/legs sbyar/rang bzhin/zur chag 'dres ma'i skad dang bzhi yod do//kau rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa rgyan bshad pa la/shis brjod dang rgyan dngos gnyis/de'i gnyis pa rgyan dngos la mdor bstan dang rgyas bshad gnyis/de'i gnyis pa rgyas bshad la/thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan dang thun mong ba'i rgyan gnyis/ de'i dang bor/ mdor bstan/rgyas bshad/snyan ngag gi rgyu bshad pa/mjug bsdu ba dang bzhi/ de'i gnyis pa rgyas bshad la bcu las/ ༈ dang bo sbyar ba skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 375

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/bshad pa la 'jam rtsub kyi yi ge ngos bzung ba dang /sbyar ba dngos kyi mtshan nyid bshad pa gnyis/ de'i gnyis pa sbyar ba dngos kyi mtshan nyid bshad pa la lho ba'i lugs dang shar ba'i lugs gnyis go/༈ gnyis pa rab dwangs bshad pa la lho shar gyi lugs gnyis so//༈ gsum pa mnyam pa bshad pa la lho shar gnyis so// ༈ bzhi ba snyan pa bshad pa la/mtshan nyid dang rgyas bshad gnyis/de'i gnyis pa rgyas bshad la/sgra'i nyams dnganadon gyi nyams/gnyis ka la grong tshig spang ba dang gsum/ de'i dang bor lho shar gnyis/ de'i gnyis pa shar ba'i 'dod pa bshad par/mdor bstan/rgyas bshad/de'i gnyis pa rgyas bshad la/ dbye ba dang so sor bshad pa gnyis/de'i dang bo dbye bar/ rkang ba la bskor ba/tshig la bskor ba/ring bar bskor ba/shar ba kho nas 'dod pa dang bzhi yod do//gong gi gsum pa gnyis ka la grong tshig spang bar/don gyi grong ba spang ba dang /sgra'i grong ba spang ba gnyis/ de'i gnyis par dngos dang dmigs bsal gnyis yod do// 1lnga ba shin tu gzhon par lho shar gyi lugs gnyis yod/ /drug pa don gsal la lho shar gyi lugs gnyis yod do//༈bdun pa rgya che ba la lho shar gyi lugs gnyis yod do// ༈brgyad pa brjid pa la spyi dang so sor bshad pa gnyis/de'i gnyis pa so sor bshad par shar lho'i lugs gnyis yod do// ༈dgu ba mdzes pa'i yon tan la lho shar gyi lugs gnyis yod do// ༈bcu ba ting nge 'dzin la spyi dang /dbye ba/dogs slong gsum/de'i gnyis pa dbye ba la/chos gcig bkod pa dang /chos du ma bkod pa gnyis yod do//376 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

sa bcad phyogs bsdus//gong gi thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan bshad pa'i gsum pa snyan ngag gi rgyu bshad pa dang bzhi ba mjug bsdu ba gnyis la nang gses kyi sa bcad med/ 'di nas le'u dang bo'i sa bcad rdzogs so//༈ gnyis pa thun mong gi rgyan bshad pa la/mchod par brjod cing rtsom par dam bca' ba dang snod ldan nyan par bskul ba/ gzhung dngos la 'jug pa gnyis so/ / de'i gnyis pa gzhung dngos la 'jug par rgyan gyi don dang dbye ba gnyis/ de'i gnyis pa dbye bar don rgyan so lnga dang / sgra rgyan/ gab tshig gi rgyan dang gsum mo/ /ga don rgyan so lnga'i dang bo rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ so so'i don bshad pa/ mjug bsdu dang bzhi/ de'i gnyis pa dbye ba bshad pa la/ rigs rang bzhin brjod pa/ bya ba rang bzhin brjod pa/ yon tan rang bzhin brjod pa/ rdzas rang bzhin brjod pa dang bzhi yod do// bzhi ba mjug bsdu bar/ 'grel tshul 'ga' zhig dpyad mi bzod par bstan pa dang mjug bsdu ba dngos gnyis yod do// ༈gnyis pa dpe rgyan la mchod par brjod cing rtsom par dam bca' ba dang / dpe rgyan bshad pa dngos gnyis/de'i gnyis par/ mtshan nyid/ dpe brjod/ skyon yon/ mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra/ mjug bsdu ba dang lnga'o//de'i gnyis pa dbye bar brjod bya'i sgo nas sum cu so gnyis yod do// (sa bcad zor yangs pa'i ched du 'di dang 'og gi rgyan thams cad la rgyan re re'i grangs 'dren dang dang gses sogs zhib phrar ma bgrang ngo kyi gsum pa mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra la/ sde tshan dang bo dang gnyis pa/ gsum pa dang bzhi ba/ zhar skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 377

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/byung kha skong bcas yod do// ༈ gsum pa gzugs rgyan bshad pa la/rtsom par dam bca' ba/gzugs can gyi rgyan ngos bzung ba/dbye ba so so'i don/ mjug bsdu dang bzhi/ de'i gsum pa dbye ba so so'i don la nyi shu yod do// ༈bzhi ba gsal byed kyi rgyan la/dngos grub zhu zhing rtsom par dam bca' ba/spyi'i go don gsal bar bshad pa/dbye ba so so'i don bshad pa/mjug bsdu ba dang bzhi/de'i gsum pa dbye ba so so'i don bshad pa la bcu bzhi yod do// /lnga ba bskor ba'i rgyan bshad pa gamatshan nyid kyi sgo nas dbye ba dang /soso'i don bshad pa/ mjug bsdu ba dang gsum/ de'i gnyis pa so so'i don bshad pa la gsum yod do// ༈ drug pa 'gog pa'i rgyan bshad pa la/shis par brjod pa/mtshan nyid dbye ba dang bcas te mdor bstan pa/phye ba so so'i don rgyas par bshad pa/ ma bshad pa kha 'phangs su bstan te mjug bsdu ba dang bzhi/de'i gsum pa phye ba so so'i don rgyas par bshad pa la nyer gsum yod do// ༈ bdun pa don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan bshad pa la/mchod par brjod cing rtsom par dam bca' ba/spyi'i mtshan nyid bshad pa/dbye ba so so'i don bshad pa/mjug bsdu dang bzhi/de'i gsum pa dbye ba so so'i don bshad pa la brgyad yod do// ༈brgyad pa ldog pa can gyi rgyan bshad pa la/mchod par brjod cing rtsom par dam bca' ba/mtshan nyid kyis mdor bstan pa/dbye ba so so'i don bshad pa/mjug bsdu ba dang bzhi/de'i gsum pa dbye ba so so'i don bshad pa la/ sgras zin mtshungs pa'i ldog pa can/rtogs pa mtshungs pa'i ldog pa can/'byed byed mtshungs pa'i —378 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

sa bcad phyogs bsdus/ldog pa can/rigs mthun 'byed pa'i ldog pa can dang bzhi/ de'i dang bor nang gses lnga dang /gnyis par gnyis/gsum par gnyis re yod do// ༈ dgu ba srid pa can gyi rgyan la/ thun mong du mchod par brjod cing rtsom par dam bca' ba/mtshan nyid/dbye ba so so'i don/ mjug bsdu dang bzhi/ de'i gsum pa dbye ba so so'i don la gsum yod do// kau bcu ba bsdus brjod kyi rgyan la/ mtshan nyid/dbye ba so so'i don/mjug bsdu ba dang gsum/de'i gnyis pa dbye ba so so'i don la bzhi yod do// ༈bcu gcig pa phul byung gi rgyan la/mtshan nyid kyi mdor bstan pa/dbye ba so so'i don bshad pa/mjug bsdu ba dang gsum/ de'i gnyis pa dbye ba so so'i don bshad pa la bzhi yodago/ / bcu gnyis pa rab rtog gi rgyanagamachodapar brjod cing rtsom par dam bca' ba/spyi'i mtshan nyid/ dbye ba so so'i don/dogs pa gcod pa/ rab rtog gsal byed kyi sgra bshad pa/ mjug bsdu ba dang drug de'i gnyis pa dbye ba so so'i don la gsum yod do//༈bcu gsum pa rgyu'i rgyan la/rtsom par dam bca' ba/mdor bstan pa/ dbye ba rgyas par bshad pa/ mjug bsdu ba dang bzhi/de'i gsum pa dbye ba rgyas par bshad pa gdangos po'i rgyu dang/dngos med kyi rgyu/mtshar ba'i rgyu dang gsum/de'i dang bor byed po'i rgyu dang shes byed kyi rgyu gnyis/ de'i dang bor 'grub byed kyi rgyu dang /las kyi rgyu gnyis/de'i dang bor skyed byed 'grub pa'i rgyu dang nyams byed 'grub pa'i rgyu gnyis/ gnyis pa las kyi rgyu la/rnam 'gyar gyi rgyu dang / thob bya'i rgyu gnyis/gong gi gnyis pa shes byed kyi rgyu zlo phyi shes byed dang nang shes skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —379

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/byed gnyis te khyon dngos po'i rgyu la nang gses drug yod do// rgyu rgyan gyi rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa dngos med kyi rgyu la/spyi'i mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas mdor bstan pa/dbye ba so sor bshad pa/don bsdu ba dang gsum/de'i gnyis pa dbye ba so sor bshad pa la rgyu med pas 'bras bu yod pa skyed pa bzhi dang /rgyu med pas 'bras bu med pa skyed pa gcig bcas khyon lnga yod do//rgyu rgyan gyi rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa mtshar ba'i rgyu la/mdor bstan pa/dbye ba so so'i don bshad pa/rgyu rgyan thun mong gi mjug bsdu ba dang gsum/de'i gnyis pa dbye ba so so'i don la lnga ste khyon rgyu rgyan la nang gses bcu drug yod do//༈ bcu bzhi ba phra mo'i rgyan la/ thun mong du mchod par brjod cing snod ldan nyan par skul ba/ mdor bstan pa/ dbye ba so so'i don bshad pa/ bsdus brjod dang mi 'dra bar bshad pa dang bzhi/de'i gsum pa dbye ba so so'i don bshad pa la gnyis yod do// ༈bco lnga ba cha'i rgyan la/mdor bstan pa dang / dbye ba so sor bshad pa gnyis/ de'i gnyis par dngos po gsal ba zol gyis sped pa'i cha dang /zol gyis smod cing bstod pa'i cha gnyis/de'i dang bor gnyis dang gnyis par gnyis te khyon bzhi yod do// ༈bcu drug pa rim pa can gyi rgyan la/mtshan nyid/dogs gcod/phra cha rim gsum thun mong gi mjug bsdu ba dang gsum yod do// ༈bcu bdun pa dga' ba'i rgyan la/rtsom par dam bca' ba/ mdor bstan pa/ dbye ba so sor bshad pa dang gsum/de'i gsum par dbye ba gnyis yod do//༈bco brgyad pa nyams ldan gyi rgyan la/mdor bstan pa/rgyas bshad/—380 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

sa bcad phyogs bsdus/dogs gcod dang gsum/ de'i gnyis par khyon brgyad yod do//༈bcu dgu ba gzi brjid can gyi rgyan la/spyir bshad pa/dbye ba spro tshul bshad pa/sngon 'grel 'ga' la zur za ba/don 'grel de'i khyad par bshad pa'i sgo nas mjug bsdu ba dang bzhi yod do// gnyi shu ba rnam grangs brjod pa'i rgyan la/shis par brjod cing com par dam bca' ba/dngos bshad pa/ bsdus brjod cha phra gsum dang mi 'dra bar bshad pa bcas gsum yod do// gnyer gcig pa kun phan gyi rgyan la nang gses sa bcad med/ 1nyer gnyis pa rgya che ba'i rgyan la/spyi'i don dang dbye ba gnyis/de'i gnyis par bsam pa rgya che ba dang 'byor ba rgya che ba gnyis yod do// nyer gsum pa bsnyon dor gyi rgyan la/spyi dang / dbye ba/ thun mong du mjug bsdu ba dang gsum/de'i gnyis par chos yul rang bzhin la bsnyon pa gsum yod do///nyer bzhi ba sbyar ba'i rgyan la/ shis par brjod cing rtsom par dam bca' ba/spyi'i mtshan nyid/ gcod mtshams la brten pa'i dbye ba/bshad zin dran pa'i tshul/slar yang bdun du dbye ba/dogs gcod/mjug bsdu ba dang bdun/de'i gsum par nang gses gnyis dang /lnga bar nang gses bdun yod do// gnyer lnga ba khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan la/shis par brjod cing com par dam bca' ba/mdor bstan pa/dbye ba bshad pa/ ma bshad pa bslab pa dang bzhi/ de'i gsum par dbye ba lnga yod do//gnyer drug pa mtshungs sbyor gyi rgyan la/mdor bstan pa/ dbye ba bshad pa/cha/jug bsdu ba dang gsum/de'i gnyis par dbye ba gnyis yod do// ཿnyer bdun pa 'gal skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar byin 'dzin grwa ga 381

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ba'i rgyan la/shis par brjod cing rtsom par spro ba bstan pa/mdor bstan pa/ dbye ba/ don bsdu ba dang bzhi/ de'i gsum par dbye ba drug yodado// gnyer brgyad pa skabs min bstod pa'i rgyan la/thun mong du shis pa brjod cing rtsom par dam bca' ba/don bshad pa gnyis yod do// ga nyer dgu ba zol bstod kyi rgyan la/mtshan nyid/dbye ba/don bsdu dang gsum/de'i gnyis par mthu nus dpa' ba'i zol bstod gsum yod do// gsum cu ba nges bstan gyi rgyan la/mtshan nyid/dbye ba/dogs sel gsum/ de'i gnyis par mchog dang mchog min gyi nges bstan gnyis yod do// /so gcig pa lhan cig brjod pa'i rgyan la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba gnyis/ de'i gnyis par nang gses gsum yod do// 1so gnyis pa yongs brjes kyi rgyan la nang gses kyi sa bcad med/ gso gsum pa shis brjod kyi rgyan la/dngos dang zhar byung gnyis yod do// gso bzhi ba rab spel gyi rgyan la/mtshan nyid/dbye ba/zhar byung rgyan gyi rigs bsdu tshul dang gsum/de'i gnyis par dbye ba gnyis yod do// ཿso lnga ba dgongs pa can gyi rgyan la dngos dang zhar byung zlos gar gyi mtshan nyid kyang rgyan du bstan pa/don rgyan bshad pa'i mjug bsdu ba nang gses dang bcas yod do//le'u gnyis pa'i sa bcad rdzogs so/// thun mong ba'i rgyan gnyis pa sgra rgyan la/mchod par brjod cing rtsom par dam bca' ba/gzhung dngos gnyis/de'i gnyis par spyir bstan pa dang / so sor bshad pa gnyis/ de'i gnyis pa so sor bshad par/ zung ldan dang / bya dka' ba'i khyad par gzhan dang /—382 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

sa bcad phyogs bsdus/dbyangs sogs nges pa'i bya dka' ba dang gsum yod/ de'i dang bo zung rgyan la mdor bstan rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang bo mdor bstan la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba gnyis/ de'i gnyis pa dbye bar bar du chod ma chod gnyis yod la/ de re rer yang rkang ba'i thog mtha' bar gsum du bskor ba/ de re rer rkang ba gcig nas bzhi'i bar du bskor ba dag yod do// gong gi gnyis pa rgyas bshad la/spyir bshad pa dang so sor bshad pa gnyis/ de'i dang bor/ bya sla ba rkang ba dang bo na yod pa'i zung ldan/ bya dka' ba gnas gzhan la yod pa'i zung ldan/ mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan/ kun tu zung ldan/ bsres pa'i zung ldan/ bzlog pa'i zung ldan dang drug yod/ gnyis pa so sor bshad pa las dang bo bya sla ba rkang ba dang bo na yod pa'i zung ldan la ma chod pa'i zung ldan dang / chod pa'i zung ldan/ chod cing ma chod pa'i zung ldan gsum yod/(sa bcad 'di gsum dpe deb du chad 'dug)dang bo ma chod pa'i zung ldan la rkang ba'i thog mar bkod pa khyon bco lnga yod do/ /(re re bzhin drangs med) ཿ gnyis pa bar du chod pa'i zung ldan la/ spyir bstan pa dang so sor bshad pa gnyis/de'i gnyis pa so sor bshad pa la khyon nang gses bcu gsum yod do//(re re bzhin drangs medakyi gsum pa chod cing ma chod pa'i zung ldan la/ spyi dang / dbye ba/ don bsdu ba dang gsum/ de'i gnyis pa dbye ba la khyon nang gses gsum yod do/ /(re re bzhin drangs medakyig zung ldan gyi rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa bya dka' ba gnas gzhan la yod pa'i zung ldan la/ shis brjod sogs dang / gzhung dngos la skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —383

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/'jug pa gnyis/ de'i gnyis par mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad gnyis/de'i gnyis pa rgyas bshad la rtsa ba'i dbye ba chod ma chod gnyis dang de re rer nang gses drug re ste khyon bcu gnyis yod do//(re re bzhin drangs medakyi zung ldan gyi rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan la/ dngos dang / thun mong du mjug bsdu ba gnyis so/ / ཿ zung ldan gyi rtsa ba'i sa bcad bzhi ba kun tu zung ldan la/klad kyi don dang /gzhung gi don gnyis/dang bo la shis par brjod pa dang /rtsom par dam bca' gnyis/gong gi gnyis pa gzhung gi don la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad gnyis/ gnyis pa rgyas bshad la/rkang ba bzlas pa dang /tshigs bcad bzlas pa/ zung ldan chen po dang gsum/de'i dang bor byed bzlas yang dag sbyor ba dang /gzhan rkang ba bzlas pa gnyis/ phyed bzlas yang dag sbyor ba la khyon nang gses gsum yod/(re re bzhin drangs medakyiganyis pa gzhan rkang ba bzlas pa la mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad gnyis/ de'i dang bor/ lan gcig bzlas pa/ lan gnyis bzlas pa/ lan gsum bzlas pa dang gsum/ gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la dang bo lan gcig bzlas par khyon nang gses drug yod/(re re bzhin drangs med〉gnyis pa lan gnyis bzlas par khyon nang gses gsum yod/(re re bzhin drangs medakyigasum pa lan gsum bzlas par nang gses dbye ba med/ gong gi gnyis pa tshigs bcad bzlas pa la'ang nang gses dbye ba med/gsum pa zung ldan chen po la/dngos dang /khyad par bshad pa gnyis so// ga zung ldan gyi rtsa ba'i sa bcad lnga ba 'dres pa'i zung ldan la —384— skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga

sa bcad phyogs bsdus/nang gses kyi sa bcad med/ ga zung ldan gyi rtsa ba'i sa bcad drug pa bzlog pa'i zung ldan la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ thun mong du mjug bsdu ba dang gsum/ de'i gnyis pa rgyas bshad la rkang ba bzlog pa dang / tshigs bcad phyed bzlog pa/tshigs bcad bzlog pa dang gsum mo/ / ༈ sgra rgyan gyi rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa bya dka' ba'i khyad par gzhan bstan pa la/ shis brjod dang / rtsom par dam bca' ba/gzhung dngos gsum/ de'i phyi mar ba lang gcin dnganaphyed 'khor/kun 'khor dang gsum mo// ༈ sgra rgyan gyi rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa dbyangs sogs nges pa'i bya dka' ba la/spyir bstan pa dang / bye brag sosor bshad pa/mjug bsdu gdang gsugade'i gnyis pa so sor bshad pa la/ dbyangs nges pa dang / gnas nges pa/ gsal byed kyi yi ge nges pa gsum/de'i dang bor khyon nang gses bzhi yod/(re re bzhin drangs medakyi gnyis pa gnas nges pa la spyir bstan pa dang so sor bshad pa gnyis/ de'i phyi mar khyon nang gses dbye ba bzhi yod do//(re re bzhin drangs med) gsum pa gsal byed kyi yi ge nges pa la/spyir bstan pa dang / so sor bshad pa gnyis/ de'i phyi mar khyon nang gses dbye ba bzhi yod do//(re re bzhin drangs medakyi1 thun mong gi rgyan gyi sa bcad gsum pa gab tshig gi rgyan bshad pa la/ mchod par brjod pa/ rtsom par dam bca' ba/ mdor bstan pa/ dbye ba so sor bshad pa/ mjug bsdu ba dang lnga/ de'i bzhi ba dbye ba so sor bshad pa la/ kun tu tshogs pa'i gab tshig smu byed kyi gab tshig rim pa dang bral ba'i gab tshig rab bcom gyi gab tshigaskabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa ga 385

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/mthun gzugs kyi gab tshig rtsub mo'i gab tshig grangs kyi gab tshigarab btags kyi gab tshig ming du 'dus pa'i gab tshig sgrib pa'i gab tshig mthun pa'i sgra'i gab tshig rmongs pa'i gab tshig yongs 'phrog gi gab tshig gcig sgrib kyi gab tshig gnyis sgrib kyi gab tshigayongs 'dres kyi gab tshig dang bcu drug yod do//( rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa skyon sel la/ shis brjod/ dam bca'/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ mjug bsdu ba dang lnga/ de'i bzhi ba rgyas bshad la/ don nyams pa/ don 'gal ba/ don gcig pa/ the tshom can/ rim pa nyams pa/ sgra nyams pa/ gcod mtshams nyams pa/sdeb sbyor nyams pa/ mtshams sbyor bral ba dang dgu la dngos dang dmigs bsal gnyis re yod/ bcu ba yul 'gal ba sogs kyi skyon la/ mdor bstan pa/ so sor bshad pa/ gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu 'gal yang skyon med par bstan pa dang gsum/ de'i gnyis par yul dang / dus/ sgyu rtsal/ 'jig rten/ lung / rigs pa dang 'gal ba bcas drug dang / gsum pa gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu 'gal yang skyon med pa la'ang yul dang / dus/sgyu rtsal/ 'jig rten/ lung /rigs pa bcas drug yod do/ / bstan bcos 'di brtsams pa'i mjug gi bya ba dbyangs can ma snying la zhugs pa'i yon tan bstan pa dngaka rab byed nyer lnga ba'i che ba brjod pa sogs la sho lo ka bcu gcig sbyar byang dang bcas pa yod do// le'u gsum pa'i sa bcad rdzogs so// 'di yang snyan ngag spru ba dag la gzhung gi spyi khog 'char phyir tha snyad pa ldong yon tan rgya mtshos phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa'o//—386 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/

dpe skrun gsal bshad/snyan 'grel yang gsal snang mdzod kyi zur rgyan ngag rig sgyu 'phral 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba 'di ni smra ba'i dbang phyug cherno po sdong yon tan rgya mtsho mchog gis gangs ljongs shes rig nor bu'i slob gling gi skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa (dus mkha' zla ba'i ru dpung nyil snyan ngag khrid skabs zin bris su btab pa lags shingag zur rgyan 'dis 'grel bya nges don mkhas pa'i dbang bo gsum gyi thugs kyi nying khu dri ma med pa yin pa dang gcig khyad par du zin bris 'di'i byed po khong ni tshang mas mkhyen gsal ltar phyi nang gi rgyal khab kun na snyan grags che ba'i snyan ngag pa'am smra ba'i dbang phyug chen po yin pas gzhung tshig la 'grel bshad gnang stangs dang /don gnad rtsal du 'don stangs/ ngo mtshar tshig gi sgyu rtsag ming tshig go dka' ba dag la mchan 'grel dang / lo rgyus ngo sprod/ mkhas pa so so'i bzhed tshul/gzhung gi 'gal mtshams/rgyan gsum ga'i dka' gnad dang dogs gcod cha tshang zhing rgyas bsdus ran pa zhig gnang yod pas/ 'di las bod kyi rig gnas: dngananang bstan chos lugs sogs la'ang nges pa rags tsam rnyed thub par 'dug la/ lhag par du bod kyi rtsom rig gi ro bcud gsar du myong 'dod pa'i skal ldan don gnyer can dag la skom pa la chu dang /ltogs pa la zas zhes pa'i dpe ltar/ kha gsalazhing gobade ba'i lamanas ngag rigagi zhing khams skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/ —387

ngag rig sgyu 'phrul 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/su bgrod chog chog gi gdams pa lhug por gnang yod pa dang gnyis/deng sang snyigs ma'i dus 'dir gzhung chen mo dag lta ci/tha snyad rig gnas tsam sbyong ba la yang nges 'byung bsgoms nas dpe mang la blta klog dang 'chad nyan gang yang mi byed pa'am yang na skabs babs kyi sbyang bya las dpe cha gzhan mang bo zhig klog pa'i dus tshod med pa'i gzhon skyes dag dang / lhag par du rang re'i ma yum slob gling gi blo gsal don gnyer can dag la slob deb tu ha cang mkho gal che ba gsum gyis snyan ngag gi zur rgyan gyi bstan bcos 'di dpar sgrun byed chog par khong la dgongs gnang yang dang yang du zhus pas mthar nged cag gi re ba ltar dgongs gnang thob byung bas/tshad med spro dga' chen pos dpar sgrun gyi 'gan khur yongs rdzogs len khul byas mod/bdag la mtshon na skyes stobs kyi shes rab dang sbyangs stobs kyi yon tan gang yang med pa'i khar dpe sgrig gi nyams myong sogs zhan pas nor 'khrul gyi cha gang mang zhig mchis nges pas slob dpon dam pa khong dang /gzur gnas klog pa bo yongs la snying khong rus pa'i gting nas dgongs dag zhus pa lags/mjug mthar bstan bcos 'di'i byed po khong gi gtsos gangs ljongs mkhas pa'i dbang bo dag gi sku tshe brtan cing thugs bzhed lhun gyis 'grub pa dang /ma 'ongs par bod gangs can gyi rtsom rig gi dga' tshal 'di yar ngos zla dang dbyar gyi mtsho bzhin gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i rgyu ru bsngos pa lags/zhes mgo log bla ma'i yang srid du bsnyad btags pa ltar khas 'che ba'i btsun gzugs bsam pa lhun 'grub kyis khrin tu'u grong khyer spos ngad snang ba ru bris/2009 5 21—388 skabs bcu gnyis pa'i mthar phyin 'dzin grwa la/
